products.name: Velasca 1958 coffee beans
products.description: Velasca 1958 is a premium Milanese coffee brand produced by Almar Drink & Food, born from a simple but powerful vision: to offer Ho.Re.Ca. operators a coffee that combines the prestige of an artisanal label with the reliability of industrial scale. Named after Torre Velasca — Milan's iconic skyscraper inaugurated in 1958, symbol of post-war Italian renaissance and timeless design — the brand carries with it the elegance, innovation and uncompromising quality that define the Milanese spirit. Positioned between mass-market industrial brands and hard-to-scale micro-roasters, Velasca 1958 fills a genuine market gap: premium accessible positioning, scalable professional yield, high-margin structure and territory exclusivity potential. Three distinct whole-bean blends — Aroma, Classic and Intenso — each designed exclusively for professional espresso extraction, allow every operator to find their perfect profile without compromise. The commercial model is built on transparency and flexibility: you pay only for the coffee, with no hidden marketing fees, no rigid obligations and no long-term contracts. products.name: Ginseng coffee
products.description: Almar Ginseng Coffee is the new Italian functional beverage that combines the rich taste of espresso coffee with the energising power of ginseng root — the ancient remedy that strengthens both body and mind. Designed for the modern Ho.Re.Ca. operator, the Almar ginseng range offers 6 different variants to satisfy every customer's taste and wellness preference, from sweet to bitter, from sugar-free to fully vegan and natural. Prepared instantly using a soluble product machine or manually in seconds, ginseng coffee is quick to serve, self-selling and highly profitable. Customers who discover it tend to return daily — making it one of the most effective tools to build loyalty and grow bar revenues without any additional complexity. The Almar ginseng range is structured around three distinct products: Ginseng Coffee is the classic range, available in 6 flavours — sweet, creamy, intense, ginger, bitter and sugar-free — covering every palate and occasion. It can also be served cold, shaken with ice, making it a versatile all-season beverage. Ginseng Neropuro (Bitter) is the unsweetened variant — a bold, authentic ginseng experience to be enjoyed pure or sweetened to taste, just like a traditional espresso. With no added sugar, no dyes and no palm oil, it is the ideal choice for health-conscious customers who want full flavour without compromise. Ginseng Zero+ (Zeropiù) is the most advanced product in the range — certified 100% sugar-free, not only free from added sugars but containing zero sugars at all. 100% vegan, natural, gluten-free and allergen-free, it delivers a fragrant, smooth and genuinely satisfying taste that surprises even the most demanding consumers. Suitable for all ages and all dietary needs, Ginseng 0+ opens the ginseng experience to customers who previously could not enjoy it due to health or dietary restrictions.

products.name: Milkshake

Available in 4 exciting flavours — Salted Caramel, Strawberry, Chocolate and Vanilla — it is incredibly easy to prepare: simply blend the powder with milk (dairy or plant-based) and a few ice cubes for just 40 seconds. The result is a perfectly smooth, velvety texture every time. With its high profit margins and endless customisation possibilities through toppings and add-ons, Mix'n Shake is the ideal solution for any operator looking to stand out and grow their menu offer. products.description: GABA Tea (Jiaye Long Tea) is a functional oolong tea produced through a special anaerobic fermentation process. During production, fresh leaves are placed in an oxygen-free environment, which suppresses the leaf's aerobic metabolism and promotes the conversion of glutamic acid into γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) — an amino acid naturally present in tea leaves.

products.name: Infant formula - FRANCE BéBé BIO
products.description: The France Bébé Bio infant formula range is manufactured in France using milk sourced from French cows. Palm oil-free and enriched with bifidus, our organic formulas are designed to support babies at every stage of their growth while meeting the highest standards of quality and safety.

products.name: Two Sisters Isabella Cheese
products.description: Isabella is a gourmet cheese of exceptionally high and consistent quality. It is like a buttery aged Gouda but nuttier and sweeter. It cuts with ease. Made with milk from free-range grass grazing Holsteins, It can be served as an hors d’oeuvre, in meals or as part of a delightful after-dinner cheese plate. It goes well with both red and white wines. It offers a true indulgence for the genuine cheese connoisseur.

products.name: Christmas Goat Cheese with Cranberries
products.description: Boost your Holiday sales with this 4,5 kg wheel of mild pasteurized Dutch goat cheese with added cranberries. Cranberries and Christmas go hand-in-hand. The Christmas label makes your Christmas assortment extra special and festive! The flavor of the goat cheese is mild, the cranberries add a nice sweet flavor and aroma to the cheese.

products.name: Basil & Garlic Gooda Cheese
products.description: Mild Cheese with a seasoning Basil & Garlic. This creamy smooth cheese has been delicately seasoned with basil and garlic. The slightly higher fat content gives the cheese a richer flavor and creamier texture. It’s a Gooda® style cheese, so it is easy to melt, grate or slice. Great on bagels and in omelets.

products.name: Double Cream Gooda Cheese
products.description: Double Cream Mild Cheese. Due to Holland’s fertile soil and lush green pastures, our cows produce unusually rich milk. Additional cream is then added to the milk for an extra rich cheese we call Double Cream. Double Cream has a mild flavor. It’s sliceable, melts beautifully, ideal is for making creamy cheese sauces. It also makes delicious omelets, tortillas and potatoes. Melt some on a hot piece of apple pie for a special dessert!

products.name: Ewephoria 1 year Matured Sheep Cheese
products.description: Sheeps Milk Cheese 1 year aged. This new creation from Holland is unlike any other sheep milk cheese you have ever tasted before. The milk comes from a small farm where the sheep are treated like family. Even though this cheese has been aged for one year, it has developed a sweet and nutty flavor. This cheese tastes like candy! Experience it for dessert with red or green grapes.

products.name: Pavoncella Olandese
products.description: Pavoncella Olandese is a distinctive 8 months aged Dutch cheese crafted for the true cheese connoisseur. Produced from thermized cow’s milk, this impressive 12 kg wheel is shaped like a mini Parmesan while delivering the rich, buttery flavor profile of traditional Gouda. Through careful aging the cheese develops natural crystals that create a firm texture, nutty complexity and a long savory finish.

products.name: Honey Bee Goat Cheese
products.description: Honey Bee Goat : made with a drizzle of honey added to pure goat milk for a cashew-like nutty sweetness. Slightly sweet, full of flavor, yet not strong or salty. Easy to slice, grate or cube, wonderful in salads or as a snack with fruit.

products.name: Tomato & Olives Gooda Cheese
products.description: Mild Cheese with Tomato & Black Olives. Mild, creamy smooth traditional Dutch cheese, with tomato & black olives added for flavor and texture. The delighful flavor of the fresh red tomaotos and italian black olives, add a pleasant kick to this mild cheese. A perfect compliment for salads and sandwiches, ideal for melting and great by itself as a snack.

products.name: Gooda Walnuts cheese
products.description: Mild Cheese Seasoned with Walnuts. This creamy-smooth cheese has an attractive sprinkling of walnuts. The slightly higher fat content gives the cheese a richer flavor and creamier texture. It’s a Gouda style cheese, so it is easy to melt, grate or slice. This cheese makes an elegant dessert with fresh fruit and a sparkling drink.

products.name: Black Truffle Cheese
products.description: Truffle Cheese : this creamy smooth Gouda style cheese has a generous sprinkling of delicate black Italian summer truffles. Because The age-old European tradition, of serving several cheeses on a tray to form a separate course at the end of the meal, has made it onto the menus of top U.S. restaurants, this popular cheese appears on many after dinner cheese trays. Truffle lovers find it most delicious!

products.name: Dutch Girl Aged Goat Cheese
products.description: Aged Goat Cheese. Dutch Girl is a popular Gouda style goat cheese aged for 7 months to create a rich creamy butterscotch-like flavor. It is sweet and satisfying without the salty or tarte flavors associated with goat cheese. If you like our Ewephoria® sheepmilk cheese, you will love our Dutch Girl® goat cheese. It makes a delightful addition to a cheese plate or as part of an appetizer.

products.name: Two Sisters Serafina Cheese
products.description: Special Aged Cheese. Same cheese as the Isabella except aged 6 months longer. This cheese has developed a sweet butterscotch-like flavor, nutty and salty, with more crunches than the Isabella. The cheese is hard, but softens quickly in your mouth. It is rich and satisfying and a perfect cheese for sharing among friends. It pairs very well with a deep dark red wine.

products.name: Kokos Coconut Cheese
products.description: Mild Cheese with Organic Coconut Cream. Made with fresh, pasteurized cow’s milk and a healthy dash of organic coconut cream, added for extra flavor and creaminess. It's a delightfully unique cheese with a nutty taste and a touch of refreshing sweetness. Enjoy it with fruit or thinly sliced with crisp crackers and chilled white wine or your favorite beverage.

products.name: Strawberry Cheese Cake Cheese
products.description: Is it cake or is it cheese? This 4,5 kg wheel of pasteurized cow's milk has 3 layers with individual colors and sweet taste. The appearance of the cheese will make the Strawberry Cheese Cake Cheese stand out in every deli case. The taste will have people come back for more! A true dessert!

products.name: Truffle Van Goat
products.description: Mild Dutch goat cheese with a generous sprinkling of Italian summer truffles.

products.name: Fourmage
products.description: Fourmage or cheese with four types of milk: buffalo, sheep, cow and goat milk were combined in this fine cheese. The combination of these four grass-fed milks seems to have composed my favorite cheese symphony "Deliciosa". It’s just an amazing cheese, creamy and full of layers on layers of flavor. Once you’ve tried it, you’ll want more and more.

products.name: Fine Herbs Gooda Cheese
products.description: Mild Cheese with a seasoning Fine Herbs. Mild, creamy smooth traditional Dutch cheese, delicately seasoned with nettles. Nettles have long been recognized for having major health benefits. The tangy aroma of nettles adds a pleasant kick to an otherwise mild cheese. It’s a perfect compliment for salads and sandwiches, ideal for melting and great by itself as a snack.

products.name: Peppercorns Gooda cheese
products.description: Mild Cheese Seasoned with Peppercorns. This mild creamy Gouda with black peppercorns offers a taste nice balance. It’s a versatile cheese with a unique and interesting flavor profile. It’s a good cheese to use in salads, sandwiches and omelettes.

products.name: Yellow Meadow
products.description: Yellow Meadow is a 10 kg wheel of pasteurized Dutch cheese which is made with a different culture than a Gouda cheese giving the Yellow Meadow a sweeter aftertaste. The careful aging highlights the sweetness and is enhanced even more by adding sweet wine wine to the cheese. Yellow Meadow is unique, delicious and a true dessert cheese!

products.description: Our Truffle Sauce reinterprets a great gastronomic classic in an all-natural version. products.name: WHITE FRESH TRUFFLES
products.description: The White Truffle, Tuber magnatum Pico , is considered the diamond of the culinary world due to its rarity and unmistakable aroma. Hand-harvested and selected according to the highest quality standards, this product represents the pinnacle of Italian agro-food excellence. It is available from the last week of September until mid-January. To grow and develop, the Precious White Truffle requires specific soils and equally unique climatic conditions: the ground must remain soft and humid for most of the year, rich in calcium, and well-aerated. It is easy to see why so few terrains possess these characteristics, and these very environmental factors make the white truffle as rare as it is coveted. The truffle, especially the Precious White, remains an intriguing and unsolved mystery to this day. No one truly knows why it thrives in one specific spot and nowhere else.

products.name: EL GRAN CARDENAL GOAT CHEESE WITH "RIBERA DEL DUERO" WINE
products.description: Pressed cheese made following a traditional recipe with selected fresh milk. During its traditional production process, bottled Ribera del Duero Designation of Origin wine is added, giving it its characteristic marbling. It has an intense aroma and flavor that balances the sweetness of the goat's milk with the acidity of the wine.

products.name: EL GRAN CARDENAL - Sheep´s Cheese (PGI Queso Castellano) - 6 International Gold Medals
products.description: The jewel in the crown and one of the emblems of Castilian cheese. A highly intense aroma and flavor. Subtle hints of butter, fruit, and nuts. Its buttery texture makes it ideal for slicing, as it doesn't crumble, and the few eyes prevent a spicy aftertaste. Cheese made with the most select milk, collected daily to ensure its freshness and quality, which guarantees greater flavour and great aroma. Made with sheep's milk from farms in Castilla y León following our exclusive family recipe.

products.name: EL GRAN CARDENAL BLENDED IBERICO CHEESE
products.description: Pressed cheese. A typical cheese from the Peninsula Iberica, made with sheep's, cow's, and goat's milk, according to regulations. Made using a family recipe with an exquisite blend of our milks, resulting in a cheese with great intensity and a lingering flavor. Our Iberico cheese is made with 40% sheep's milk, a much higher percentage than the legally required 15%.

products.name: EL GRAN CARDENAL SHEEP´S MILK WITH TRUFFLE CHEESE
products.description: Cheese made with sheep's milk from our finest flocks, incorporating natural truffle from the very beginning of its production. With intense aromas, predominantly lactic from the fermentation process the cheese underwent during its long aging in the cellar. Subtle hints of butter, fruit, and nuts. Always the intense aromas and flavors characteristic of cheeses made with fresh, daily milk. And of course, with that subtle touch of truffle, which, combined with all the other nuances of the cheese, earned it the SUPER GOLD award at the 2016 World Cheese Awards—a true gift for the most discerning palates.

products.name: EL GRAN CARDENAL BLENDED CHEESE WITH TURMERIC
products.description: For this cheese, we combine our blend of milks with turmeric and other natural ingredients such as fenugreek, sage, and a touch of dehydrated onion. This innovative cheese stands out for its intense yellow color and has characteristic oriental flavors. Turmeric is a powerful anti-inflammatory, useful for treating conditions such as arthritis and osteoarthritis. It also helps prevent Parkinson's and Alzheimer's diseases.

products.name: EL GRAN CARDENAL - Sheep´s Cheese with Rosemary (PGI Queso Castellano)
products.description: The jewel in the crown and one of the emblems of Castellano cheese. A highly intense aroma and flavor. Subtle hints of butter, fruit, and nuts. Its buttery texture makes it ideal for slicing, as it doesn't crumble, and the few eyes prevent a spicy aftertaste. Our iconic cured sheep's milk cheese is coated with Iberian lard and a layer of rosemary. Rosemary is an aromatic plant typical of the Mediterranean region. Its aroma permeates our Castellano Sheep's Milk Cheese, giving it a nuanced aroma and flavor.

products.name: EL GRAN CARDENAL GOAT WITH RED PAPRIKA
products.description: This cheese, made with goat's milk and coated on the outside with natural paprika (obtained from dried and ground red peppers), gives it an attractive reddish color, as well as a very special aroma and flavor. The combination of the creaminess of goat's milk and the flavor of natural paprika is one of the best possible combinations in cheese.

products.name: EL GRAN CARDENAL BLENDED SMOKED CHEESE
products.description: Our exclusive cheese is made according to a family recipe with a high percentage of carefully selected sheep's milk (60%) from nearby farms. Our blend of sheep and cow's milk provides a perfectly balanced flavor, characterized by its smoothness and creaminess. The natural smoking process with oak wood imparts an elegant aroma and a deep flavor that enhances the cheese's unique characteristics, making it an ideal choice for everyday enjoyment or special occasions.

products.name: EL GRAN CARDENAL GOAT CHEESE WITH BLACK GARLIC
products.description: A pressed cheese made with pasteurized goat's and cow's milk. It features pieces of black garlic inside. It has a pleasant, aromatic scent. The texture is creamy, and the flavor is unique and distinctive, with a sweet taste and subtle hints of balsamic and licorice. The intensity of the flavor varies depending on the aging process.

products.name: EL GRAN CARDENAL - SHEEP´S CHEESE WITH EXTRA VIRGIN OLIVE OIL CHEESE (PGI Queso Castellano)
products.description: The jewel in the crown and one of the emblems of Castilian cheese. A highly intense aroma and flavor. Subtle hints of butter, fruit, and nuts. Its buttery texture makes it ideal for slicing, as it doesn't crumble, and the few eyes prevent a spicy aftertaste. We add extra virgin olive oil, one of the treasures of the Mediterranean diet, to our emblematic sheep's milk cheese. For this, we use our own oil, from centuries-old olive trees cultivated on the lands once farmed by Saint Isidore and his wife.

The machine is equipped with sensors to automatically produce rice mats every 3 seconds. It can therefore be used by several chefs at the same time. All that's left to do is lay out your Nori sheet and filling, and you're ready to roll.

products.name: Service robot - T10
products.description: The T10 is a latest-generation service robot designed to handle deliveries, customer interaction and the transport of meals or products in restaurants, hotels and other public-facing establishments. It combines high capacity, smooth mobility and voice communication to create a modern, interactive and contactless customer experience. The robot can carry several dishes or items in a single round trip, thanks to a detection camera on each tray, and navigates with precision using SLAM mapping and its smart sensors, optimising its routes according to the venue’s layout and the service being provided. It also offers a unique and interactive customer experience through voice recognition and personalised service, whilst incorporating exclusive 360° detection technology to avoid obstacles and people. Finally, the robot automatically plans its charging cycles and starts each service with a 100 per cent battery charge, whilst being able to display messages or advertisements.

products.name: Cleaning robot - C3
products.description: The CVTE C3 is a 4-in-1 autonomous cleaning robot – sweeping, vacuuming, mopping and drying – designed to suit all types of flooring. Compact and manoeuvrable, it can navigate even through narrow passages (≥ 70 cm wide, ≥ 30 cm high), whilst ensuring a thorough and automatic clean. It can clean up to 650 m² per hour, making it suitable for medium to large environments, with a running time of approximately 4 hours and an automatic return to its docking station to recharge, refill with clean water and empty the dirty water tank.

products.name: Maki Cutter - ASM260CE
products.description: The AUTEC ASM260CE maki slicer makes cutting rolls easier. With this machine, you can cut up to 2,400 pieces per hour whilst maintaining consistent size and quality. The safety system has been enhanced to prevent any risk of accidents during use. Thanks to its large cutting table, you can slice three maki rolls or a special roll (e.g. Dragon Roll) in a single pass. The slight angle of its blades allows for a delicate and precise cut, mimicking the movements of a sushi chef. This ensures that even the most delicate rolls are cut to perfection. The machine is constructed with resin components and a metal table, making assembly, disassembly and cleaning extremely straightforward.

products.name: Rice mixer - ASM780CE
products.description: The ASM780CE mixes and cools your rice, saving you time every day and ensuring consistency whilst complying with HACCP regulations. At the end of the cycle, it automatically dispenses the vinegared rice into the Sharibox, sparing you any tedious handling. Like all AUTEC machines, the ASM780CE has been designed for ease of assembly, use, dismantling and cleaning. A range of settings are available to achieve the desired result.

products.name: Induction noodle cooker – KFOODCONNECT
products.description: The KFOODCONNECT is an induction cooker that allows you to cook a hot meal in just a few minutes, on a self-service basis, without the need for an open flame or supervision. It couldn’t be simpler to use: place your ready-to-heat meal in a compatible container (disposable aluminium or stainless steel), set it in the centre of the glass hob, select your cooking mode and press start. A built-in fan removes any potential debris during cooking, and the machine switches off automatically at the end of the cycle with an audible signal.

products.name: Rice Washer - RM401AG
products.description: Effective rice washing is the first essential step in making high-quality sushi. That is why, in Japan, this task is entrusted to the most experienced person. The RM401AGCE rice washer weighs, washes and dispenses the rice with the exact amount of water required for cooking. Water-efficient, with a 90 kg capacity and fully automated, the RM401AGCE will save you time, money and space. Rice Mini has developed a machine that is easy to use, whether for assembly, disassembly or cleaning. Its control panel is intuitive, making it easy for all team members to operate.

products.name: Onigiri Machine - ASM575CE
products.description: The ASM575CE quickly and consistently produces onigiri in various shapes and sizes, thanks to a pair of moulds (one pair included), thereby simplifying the production of this Japanese speciality. This Autec machine offers high output, capable of producing up to 1,950 onigiri, 2,600 nigiri and between 1,625 and 5,200 makunouchi per hour. The hopper has a storage capacity of 10 kg of sushi rice and is fitted with a keep-warm system to ensure the rice remains at the correct temperature.

products.name: Nigiri Machine - ASM440CE
products.description: The ASM440 is the ideal solution for any kitchen looking to combine high productivity with impeccable nigiri quality. With this machine, you’ll enjoy greater speed and convenience, with an output of up to 4,200 rice balls per hour. Featuring fully customisable settings (size, density and compression), the ASM440 guarantees perfect consistency and uniformity in the weight and appearance of your nigiri. It is fitted with a turntable to collect your nigiri in batches of 1, 3, 5, 7 or 9 pieces, rotating in both directions. This allows two people to work simultaneously on the same machine thanks to its ‘Both Side Taking’ function – a first in the industry.

products.name: Pearls
products.description: The Pearls Selection by Acetaia Terra del Tuono represents the frontier of molecular gastronomy, transforming our finest Balsamic Vinegar of Modena and Condiments into elegant, small spheres. These "balsamic pearls" provide a sophisticated burst of flavor and a unique texture that mimics the luxury of caviar. Culinary Innovation: Created through a spherification process, they encapsulate the rich, bittersweet essence of our traditional vinegars in a modern, liquid-core form. Aesthetic & Taste: Designed to add a refined gourmet touch to any dish, they are perfect for garnishing appetizers, seafood, risottos, or desserts without diluting the presentation. Versatile Range: Our collection includes a variety of flavors, from the classic Dark Balsamic to fruity and floral infusions, offering a creative palette for chefs and food enthusiasts alike. Pure Ingredients: True to our philosophy, they are crafted without artificial colorants or preservatives, maintaining the 100% natural integrity of our ingredients.

products.name: Emilio Soft Drink – Sparkling Non-Alcoholic Aperitif
products.description: EMILIO is the first alcohol-free drink, 100% natural and with no added sugar, crafted with premium grape musts from our lands, pure spring water, and our finest Balsamic Vinegar of Modena PGI. A lightly sparkling beverage, it is well-balanced with a surprising flavor profile. The name Emilio was chosen as it encapsulates the true soul of Emilia-Romagna, our home region in Italy. Delicious when enjoyed chilled on its own or over ice, it is highly refreshing and also ideal for children, as it contains no added sugars. Thanks to the perfect balance of its ingredients, its pleasant tannic notes, and a dry, enveloping finish, it is also perfect for creating extraordinary Cocktails and Long Drinks. Emilio is packaged in 200 ml bottles.

products.name: Fruity Balsamic Condiments
products.description: The best premium quality fruit juice meets our Balsamic Vinegar of Modena IGP or White Condiment, giving life to these delightful, fruity, bittersweet Italian elixirs. Perfect on red meat, salads and vegetables, excellent also on white meat, such as chicken and turkey. These great bittersweet condiments are the perfect solution to garnish fruits and desserts. Moreover, their natural fruity taste is really interesting on grilled fish, seafood, raw fish and grilled vegetables. Ideal paired with aged cheeses, in fact the natural sweetness balances their sharp and strong taste.

products.name: FIL GOOD! The First Ever Melty and Stringy Balsamic Vinegar
products.description: Fil Good is the world's first product combining the unmistakable flavour of Balsamic Vinegar of Modena PGI with a spectacular melt-and-string effect. A 10 cm round medallion that transforms when heat is applied, turning deliciously gooey and stringy, wrapping and realizing falvour into every ingredient with rich, bold flavour. 100% natural and vegan.

products.name: Rose Balsamic Condiment
products.description: Born from the centuries-old art of our family Acetaia, the Rose Balsamic Condiment is our latest expression of beauty, refinement, and the relentless pursuit of extraordinary taste, where Tradition meets Innovations. Crafted from our finest White Balsamic Condiment, naturally sweet, madre from a careful selection of aromatic Italian grapes, Moscato and Malvasia, which is then left to slowly infuse with real, edible rose blossoms. Once the infusion is complete, the rose blossoms are carefully removed, leaving behind only their delicate floral essence, a subtle sweetness and a refreshing tartness that elevate the natural character of the condiment. The result is a condiment of rare sophistication: 100% natural, with no added sugars, no artificial flavourings, no compromises. Just the finest Italian ingredients and the quiet patience that only a family Acetaia can offer.

products.name: White Balsamic Condiments
products.description: White Balsamic Condiments made with of selection naturally sweet and aromatic Italian grapes, Moscato and Malvasia. products.name: Gourmet Sauces with a White Balsamic Base

Sweet Chili & Lemon: A vibrant, fruity spread that delivers a gentle, spicy kick, perfect for those seeking a lively contrast. Ginger & Lemon: A refined and zesty experience, featuring real chunks of ginger for an authentic, spicy depth. 100% natural and incredibly versatile, these sauces are the secret ingredient to transform any meal into a gourmet experience.

products.name: The first Sphere with Balsamic Vinegar of Modena to Grate

Designed for modern cuisine, it transforms a traditional liquid condiment into a creative tool that can be grated, ground, or sliced directly onto your dishes, offering precise flavor control and a sophisticated aesthetic. This "balsamic solid" provides a unique way to enhance both the taste and presentation of your recipes with a refined gourmet touch. It is exceptional for adding a sophisticated balsamic touch to risottos, pastas, and seafood tartares, or as a bold accent on fresh cheeses and salads. products.name: Fresh Goat Cheese
products.description: Alphenaer fresh goat cheese logs have a fresh, soft and deliciously creamy taste. The pure taste of this goat cheese can be combined in an infinite number of flavours and dishes. Delicious in salads, on sandwiches, in desserts and in all kinds of pastries. Available in four flavours: natural, honey, cranberry & cinnamon, truffle. Available in 1kg logs for foodservice and 2.6kg logs for industry.

products.name: Goat & Cow Curd
products.description: The fresh goat & cow curd is available with different kinds of ingredients.

products.name: Goat Cheese Spread
products.description: The fresh spreadable goat cheese has a delicious taste that is pure and fresh. This variety is smoother and more velvety than the usual fresh goat cheese and therefore easy to spread. In addition, the fresh cheese has a fat content of just 16%, without losing any of its delicious flavour

products.name: Ripened Goat Cheese
products.description: Alphenaer soft ripened goat cheese log has a fresh and soft, deliciously creamy taste. The flavour varies from soft creamy and firm (when young) to spicy and creamy (when fully ripened).

products.name: Goat Cheese Pearls
products.description: The fresh goat cheese pearls in oil are easy to use in salads, as tapas or as a snack. A combination of fresh goat cheese in garlic and herbs infused sunflower oil is a really delicious cheese.

products.name: Goat Cheese Pucks
products.description: Fresh goat cheese pucks are ideal and easy to use in salads, on sandwiches, pizzas and as tapas. A combination of a product that tastes good and on that is easy to use!

products.name: Goat Brie
products.description: Wonderfully soft Alphenaer Goat Brie is made from goat milk according to a traditional recipe. The flavour varies from soft creamy and firm (when young) to spicy and creamy (when fully ripened). Also available as Mini Brie.

products.name: Lactose-free UHT Goat Milk
products.description: New in our Alphenaer range is the lactose-free goat milk. Lactose-free goat milk is rich in protein, easily digestible, 100% natural and without additives. And also very tasty.

products.name: Goat Cheese Crumbles
products.description: The fresh goat cheese crumbles are easy to use in a wide variety of dishes and provide a beautiful finishing touch. Our cheese crumbles are a tasty addition to salads, pastas, pizzas and all kinds of other dishes. Use these cheese crumbles on variety of pastries, tapas, cheese sauces and fondues.

products.name: truffle sauce
products.description: Truffle Sauce with 5% Truffle A delicious Italian sauce made with mushrooms and 5% truffle , offering an intense flavor and refined aroma. Ideal for pasta, risotto, meat and gourmet dishes.

name: KUCUKBAY YAG ve DETERJAN SANAYI A.S.

products.name: Orkide Corn Oil
products.description: We produce the Orkide Corn Oil from kernels of corn and refine it in our state-of-theartfacilities. With its high contents of fatty acids and triglycerides, it is a good source of energy. Orkide Corn Oil is ideal for warm dishes, pastries, rice, pasta and especially for fries and friedpastries since it is resistant to heat. Sauteed red meat and chicken meat are also a perfect fit for Orkide Corn Oils.

products.name: Orkide Extra Virgin Olive Oil
products.description: Orkide Extra Virgin Olive Oil is prepared with the pressing methods of the Aegean and Gulf regions and is approved by connoisseurs for its superior flavour. You may use it in salads, appetizers, dishes warm and cold and in pastries. May be consumed directly at breakfast alongside toast. Experts suggest at least one spoonful of olive oil every day for its health benefits.

products.name: ORKİDE BASIL INFUSED OLIVE OIL
products.description: Orkide Basil Infused Extra Virgin Olive Oil was produced by mixing fresh basil and extra virgin olive oil. It doesn’t contain any chemicals, artificial ingredients. This infused oil is a harmony of extra virgin olive oil and the natural essence of basil. This infused oil is a harmony of extra virgin olive oil and the natural essence of basil. It is a very effective and good dressing for roasts, vegetables, stir-fry’s, salads and many other dishes. This variety of infused olive oil is the perfect way to add flavour to your bruschetta, pasta, risotto and other dishes.

products.name: ORKIDE FRY FRYING OIL
products.description: Orkide FRY Frying Oil is a product specially developed for professional kitchens. It can be used in pastries and desserts such as deep-fried rolls filled with cheese/meat, savory pastry pockets, deep fried water thin dough with raw minced meat filling, doughnut, as well as fries like potato, croquet and seafood. It allows to prepare light, golden and crispy fries. It is resistant to high temperature. It doesn't burn, foam, or cause smoke or odor.

products.name: ORKIDE DIAMOND VEGETABLE GHEE (Vegetable Ghee for Syrup-Based Desserts)
products.description: Orkide Diamond may be used in all sherbet-based and phyllo-dough desserts. Perfect for traditional Turkish desserts thanks to its consistency, odour and flavour indiscernible from the baking fats of Urfa. It adds flavour and a golden sheen to sherbet-based and phyllo dough desserts. Prevents the layers from sticking, allows the baklava’s layers to rise ideally, and makes the dessert crisp and makes it dissolve in your mouth. Allows the sherbet to seep into every layer.

products.name: ORKIDE VEGETABLE GHEE
products.description: Orkide Vegetable Ghee is a vegetable fat developed in state-of-the-art refining units. It is an aromatic, water free and 100%-vegetable based fat which is generally used in cooking meals. It can be used in a variety of foods from rice dishes to pastries, adding a unique buttery flavour to your dishes. It’s a good fit for cooking on a larger scale. It can be used for hot meals in dining halls, restaurants, and cafeterias.

products.name: ORKIDE BAKING FATS
products.description: Orkide Baking Fats, with a high melting point and great proofing performance, is the chief helper of pastry chefs everywhere. As Orkide Oils, we know the pastry chefs, we know what they need, and our research and development department is working tirelessly to deliver them everything they want and more. Our margarines, with their special structure, provide the chefs with the maximum proofing performance.

products.name: Orkide Sunflower Oil
products.description: We produce the Orkide Sunflower Oil from the seeds of the sunflower and refine it in ourstate-of-the-art facilities. You may use the Orkide Sunflower Oil in all meals warm and cold, in fries, salads and pastries. As it is resistant to high heat, it is ideal for fried pastries, stir-fries, meat, vegetables, and fries.

products.name: ORKİDE CHILI PEPPER INFUSED OLIVE OIL
products.description: Orkide Red Hot Chili Pepper Infused Extra Virgin Olive Oil was produced by mixing fresh red hot pepper and extra virgin olive oil. It doesn’t contain any chemicals, artificial ingredients. This infused oil is a harmony of extra virgin olive oil and the natural essence of chili peppers. It is a very effective and good dressing for roasts, vegetables, stir-fry’s, salads and many other dishes.

products.name: Orkide Olive Oil
products.description: Orkide Olive Oil (Riviera) blends the unique taste and smell of extra virgin with the lightness of refined olive oil. With its light flavour, it is a healthy option for all warm dishes, fries, and pastries. With a lighter colour and a lighter aroma compared to extra virgin, Riviera is especially fit for fries and cold dishes. It’s the most ideal and healthy option for marinading vegetables and making fries in the oven or on the stove.

name: DURU BULGUR GIDA SANAYI VE TICARET A.S.

products.name: Classic Tarts / Crumble Tarts / Cookies Krumiri
products.description: All tarts are made with a basic shortcrust pastry recipe, which contains a high percentage of premium ingredients: sugar, eggs, margarine, etc. Compared to the competition, the percentage of jam is higher. Production still involves many manual steps, offering a product that's just as homemade. Crumble cakes are jam tarts with a butter biscuits covering, the butter used gives a lovely flavor to the cake and make tarts more crunchy. Also in Crumble tarts production, there are still handmade passages, in particular the preparation of the crumble and its spread on the surface of the cake The recipe comes from a German friend of us and the quality of the product is so high that often we sell in pastry shops. Cookies: artisanal biscuit made with fresh butter and stone-ground flour. Ideal for any moment of the day, for daily consumption, but also as a gift.

products.name: CRADEL Rusk
products.description: Rusks: The basic preparation is that of bread with the addition of little sugar; the list of ingredients is very short and the procedures are exactly the same as those of the past. Our Rusk contain exclusively sunflower oil, for those who want an artisan product that is low in saturated fat.

products.name: CRADEL'S Cookies "Righelle"
products.description: Cookies: artisanal biscuit made with fresh butter and stone-ground flour. Ideal for any moment of the day, for daily consumption, but also as a gift.

products.name: Chocolate-Covered Frozen Sour Cherry
products.description: The Oblačinska sour cherry is not just another fruit, it is a cornerstone of Serbian agriculture and one of the most respected industrial cherry cultivars in the world. Originating from the village of Oblačina near Prokuplje, this autochthonous variety accounts for approximately 85% of Serbia's entire sour cherry harvest, a crop that consistently ranks the country among the top six global producers. Each cherry is hand-selected at peak ripeness, then individually quick-frozen within hours of harvest to lock in its signature dark red color, juicy flesh, and bold tangy character. The frozen fruit is then coated in precision-tempered Belgian chocolate, available in both milk and white varieties, using advanced enrobing technology under strictly controlled conditions. The result is a product where two traditions meet: the depth and intensity of a centuries-old Serbian fruit heritage, and the smooth, refined sweetness of premium European chocolate. No artificial flavors, no preservatives, no added colors. Just real fruit and real chocolate, frozen at the moment of perfection. Whether served as a standalone indulgence straight from the freezer, used as an elegant dessert component, or featured on a curated charcuterie board, this product delivers a sensory experience that is unmistakably bold, the bright acidity of the cherry cutting through the richness of the chocolate with every single bite.

products.name: Chocolate-Covered Frozen Raspberry
products.description: The raspberry is Serbia's most iconic agricultural export, known throughout Europe as "Red Gold" and representing 10% of the nation's total food exports. Our chocolate-covered frozen raspberry is the flagship product in the Panberry collection: the one that started it all and the one that defines the standard. We source Meeker and Willamette varieties from certified orchards across Western Serbia and Šumadija, the legendary raspberry heartland around Čačak, Arilje, and Ivanjica. These summer-bearing berries are hand-picked at optimal ripeness, then rushed to our facility in Ratina where they are sorted, graded, and IQF flash-frozen within hours of harvest. What makes the raspberry unique in the collection is its bold, tangy-sweet flavor and complex drupelet structure. Unlike the smooth profile of blueberry or the sharp tartness of cherry, the raspberry delivers a dynamic aromatic intensity that cuts through rich chocolate with precision, creating the most vibrant, high-contrast pairing in the range. Available in Dark & White or Milk & White Belgian chocolate, with or without sugar. Clean-label, two-ingredient composition. Fully certified for every major global market. Private label ready from day one.

products.name: Chocolate-Covered frozen Banana
products.description: Unlike our berry varieties sourced from Serbian orchards, our chocolate-covered frozen bananas begin their journey in the fertile plantations of Ecuador and Costa Rica, regions renowned for producing the world's finest Cavendish bananas. Sourced through certified organic and fair-trade partnerships, these bananas represent the gold standard in tropical fruit cultivation. Each banana is harvested at three-quarters ripeness, the perfect stage when starches have converted to natural sugars but the fruit retains its structural integrity. Upon arrival at our facility in Šabac, Serbia, they undergo a precisely controlled ripening process before being hand-peeled and sliced into perfect bite-sized coins. The magic happens in the freezing. While berries offer a tart, juicy burst, banana develops something entirely unique: an ice-cream-like creaminess when flash-frozen at –30°C. This naturally sweet, velvety center becomes the perfect canvas for our precision-tempered Belgian chocolate, available in both milk and white varieties. The result is a clean-label indulgence built on just two ingredients: real banana and real Belgian chocolate. No added sugars. No artificial flavors. No preservatives. Simply the creamiest, most dessert-like experience in our entire collection, backed by IFS Food, Kosher, Halal, and EU Organic certifications.

products.name: Chocolate-Covered Frozen Mango
products.description: Revered across Asia as the "King of Fruits," mango brings an unmatched combination of velvety sweetness, vibrant golden hue, and exotic aroma to the Panberry collection. Our chocolate-covered frozen mango represents the perfect marriage of tropical indulgence and European chocolate mastery, a truly global delicacy. We source premium mango varieties from certified plantations in optimal tropical growing regions, selected for their exceptional sugar content, fiber-free texture, and intense aromatic profile. Each piece is hand-cut at perfect ripeness, then rapidly transported to our facility where IQF flash-freezing technology locks in the fruit's natural sweetness and creamy texture within hours of harvest. What distinguishes mango in our collection is its uniquely creamy, almost custard-like mouthfeel when frozen, unlike the crisp structure of berries or the firm bite of stone fruits. The natural tropical sweetness creates a harmonious, mellow pairing with Belgian chocolate that is simultaneously exotic and comforting, adventurous and accessible. Available in Dark & White, Milk & White, or single-variety Belgian chocolate, with or without added sugar. Clean-label composition: frozen mango and premium Belgian chocolate. Fully certified for EU, FDA, Canadian, and South Korean markets. Private label ready with custom packaging options.

products.name: Frozen Strawberry
products.description: Our strawberries are grown on fertile alluvial plains in river valleys, where close cooperation with local family farms allows control over the entire growth cycle. Thanks to strictly monitored primary production, we offer strawberries of superior color, firm texture, and authentic aroma, ready for the most demanding global buyers.

products.name: Frozen Raspberry
products.description: Our raspberries hail from the heart of Serbia, grown on the sun-drenched slopes of the Goč, Kopaonik, Stolovi, and Jelica mountains. Cultivated on small family farms at the foot of these ranges, every berry is a product of decades of tradition and dedicated labor. By directly overseeing primary production on the plots, we ensure that our customers receive fruit of perfect flavor and premium quality.

products.name: Frozen Blackberry
products.description: Just like our raspberries, our blackberries grow in the ecologically pristine environment of forest clearings and mountain regions of Central Serbia. We source the fruit from local farmers whose family farms we monitor from the very beginning of the season. Through direct control of the plantations, we provide fruit of superior firmness, intense color, and purity.

products.name: Frozen Blueberry
products.description: Our cultivated blueberries are grown on modern family plantations located in ecologically pristine regions of Serbia. Thanks to controlled growing conditions and optimal sun exposure, the berries are large, firm, and of consistent quality. We carefully monitor every step from planting to ripening to ensure premium blueberries with rich aroma, ready for the most demanding global markets.

products.name: Chocolate-Covered Frozen Pineapple
products.description: The pineapple is nature's golden treasure, a symbol of hospitality and tropical abundance. Our chocolate-covered frozen pineapple brings this exotic icon into the Panberry collection: a bright, refreshing contrast to our berry-focused lineup, and a product that captures the essence of distant shores. We source premium pineapple from certified tropical plantations, selecting only fruit that has reached optimal ripeness for maximum sweetness and that characteristic vibrant golden-yellow color. The pineapple is carefully hand-cut into uniform pieces, then rushed to our facility where it undergoes IQF flash-freezing within hours of processing — locking in the tropical aroma and juicy texture. What distinguishes pineapple in our collection is its bold, bright sweetness and refreshing acidity. Unlike the complex tartness of berries, pineapple delivers a clean, sunny flavor that elevates the chocolate experience with tropical brightness — creating the most refreshing, palate-cleansing pairing in the range. Available in Dark & White or Milk & White Belgian chocolate, with or without sugar. Clean-label, two-ingredient composition. Fully certified for every major global market. Private label ready from day one.

products.name: Chocolate-covered frozen Blueberry
products.description: Serbia's blueberry industry is one of Europe's great agricultural success stories. In barely a decade, the country has transformed from a modest producer into a top-10 global blueberry exporter, with nearly 3,000 hectares of modern plantations and over 4,000 registered growers supplying premium fruit to retailers across the EU, UK, and beyond. Our chocolate-covered frozen blueberries are sourced from hand-selected domestic harvests grown in the fertile orchards of central and western Serbia, regions around Šabac, Arilje, and Užice where the climate, clean water, and altitude produce berries of exceptional size, sweetness, and color. Each blueberry is sorted for uniformity, then individually quick-frozen within hours of picking to preserve its deep purple pigment and full nutritional profile. The frozen berries are then enrobed in precision-tempered Belgian chocolate, available in both milk and white varieties, creating a product with a uniquely smooth flavor profile. Unlike the tart bite of cherry or raspberry, the blueberry offers a gentler, naturally sweet character that makes it the most universally appealing variety in the collection. It is, quite simply, the crowd-pleaser. The result is a clean-label product built on two ingredients: real frozen blueberry and real Belgian chocolate. No preservatives. No artificial flavors or colors. A product backed by IFS Food, Kosher, Halal, and EU Organic certifications, ready for retail shelves, HoReCa channels, and private label partnerships across global markets.

products.name: Frozen Apricot
products.description: Our apricots are the product of the most famous micro-locations in the Danube valley and on the slopes of low Pannonian mountains. The diversity of these terrains allows us continuity and premium quality of varieties characterized by velvety skin and intense aroma. IQF technology quickly freezes the hand-cut fruit, preserving its golden color and natural structure without ice formation, resulting in a premium product for the global market.

products.name: Frozen Sour cherry
products.description: The dominant Oblacinska sour cherry comes from our partner orchards. Our IQF pitted sour cherries retain their structure and ruby color, without damaging the fruit during the process. Recognized for its high dry matter content, it is ideal for the most demanding industries looking for individually frozen, clean, pitted fruits.

products.name: Frozen Berry mix
products.description: Our IQF Berry Mix is a carefully selected combination of five types of the highest quality fruit from the ecologically pristine regions of Serbia. Composed of raspberries, blackberries, strawberries, cultivated blueberries, and red currants, this mix offers a lavish balance of flavors, colors, and nutritional values. IQF technology ensures that each berry in the blend maintains its individual shape and freshness, making it an ideal solution for quick and easy use in all sectors of the food industry.

products.name: Chocolate-Covered Frozen Strawberry
products.description: The Senga Sengana strawberry is not merely a fruit, it is a piece of Serbian agricultural heritage. Developed in the 1950s by crossing Senga Fruchtbar with Marco's Colorado, this variety has become synonymous with quality strawberry production across Central and Eastern Europe for over seven decades. Unlike modern commercial varieties bred primarily for shelf-life and transport durability, Senga Sengana was selected for intense aroma and exceptional flavor. Its medium-sized, conical berries develop a deep, uniform crimson color when fully ripe, with flesh that strikes a perfect equilibrium between sweetness (7-9°Brix) and gentle acidity. Our chocolate-covered frozen strawberries capture this varietal excellence at its peak. Harvested during the brief, intense Serbian summer (June-July), the berries are individually quick-frozen within hours of picking to preserve their volatile aromatic compounds. The frozen fruit is then enrobed in precision-tempered Belgian chocolate, available in dark, milk, and white varieties, creating a confection that honors both the fruit's heritage and Belgium's chocolate-making tradition. The result is a clean-label product with just two ingredients: real Senga Sengana strawberry and real Belgian chocolate. No preservatives. No artificial colors or flavors. Simply the pure taste of Serbian summer, preserved and elevated.

products.name: Frozen Plum
products.description: We are proud of our plums originating from the hilly regions of Central Serbia, an area with the longest tradition of plum cultivation in Europe. We oversee the entire production process on family estates, ensuring authentic flavor and superior fruit texture. IQF technology allows perfect separation of the fruit, preserving all natural properties of the plum, ready for global distribution.

products.description: Delicious gluten-free Brazilian cheese rolls made with cassava flour. Reheat in the oven or Air Fryer for a quick, hot appetizer or snack.

products.name: 100% IBERICO BELLOTA HAM ALTA GASTRONOMIA
products.description: One of the jewels of FISAN that remains in the memory of the most exquisite palates. Sweetness, intense flavour, deep, fresh and long-lasting aroma are the extraordinary nuances offered to the palate by the 100% Iberico Bellota Ham Alta Gastronomia. Its fat infiltration makes each small slice melt in the mouth and its memory lasts for more than 50 months of curing time. Its secret: the selection at origin of the best purebred Iberian pigs, patience and rest in our natural cellars in Guijuelo, culminating in one of the best Pata Negra Ham you will ever remember. Only the exceptional pieces are classified as Alta Gastronomia. *** Superior Taste Awards 2024

products.name: GASTRONOMIC SHORT PASTA
products.description: Our short pasta, on the other hand, represents a new expression of Italian tradition. Unique on the market, it reinterprets one of the most classic shapes in a multicoloured and lively version, where craftsmanship meets modern creativity. Natural vegetable and spice powders (non-GMO) give subtle nuances of flavour and maintain bright colours even after cooking, for a striking visual impact.

products.name: GASTRONOMIC LONG PASTA
products.description: Our long pasta (tagliatelle, tagliolino, pappardella) is made using a traditional rolling process that creates a thin, elastic sheet of pasta, guaranteeing superior texture and firmness. After being folded and cut, it is slowly dried at a low temperature for about 24 hours, keeping the properties of the wheat intact and offering a perfectly “al dente” result. We use only 100% Italian eggs and 100% Italian durum wheat semolina, for a pasta that increases in volume during cooking, resulting in a full and substantial texture on the palate.

products.name: BIO ORGANIC SAN GRAZIANO – BLOOD ORANGE Organic Soft Drink
products.description: BIO ORGANIC SAN GRAZIANO Blood Orange is a premium Italian organic soft drink made with San Graziano natural mineral water and 20% juice from selected cold-pressed Italian blood oranges. Its intense, naturally sweet flavour is balanced by a fresh citrus finish, creating an authentic and refreshing drinking experience. Crafted with high-quality organic ingredients for premium retail, fine dining and hospitality. Available in a 275 ml glass bottle.

products.name: SPUMA ALPINA – ARANCIATA Italian Orange Soft Drink

This was to enhance the taste, but not only. For centuries ago, it was believed that bison grass was… an aphrodisiac that gave the bison’s strength and energy. Today, Żubrówka is our national pride and showpiece, best proven by the numerous awards won at prestigious competitions and trade fairs. ŻUBRÓWKA IN THE WORLD Exported to more than 40 countries, it has quickly become one of the most popular and best-selling spirits in its category. In addition to Poland, Żubrówka is produced in many other countries under various names, including Russia (Зубровка), the United States (Wisent Vodka), Ukraine (Зубрівка). Its market share is growing rapidly – according to a report by The Spirits Business, it ranked third among the best-selling vodkas in the world in 2023.
