The product features compact leaves and a vibrant color, typical of fresh artichokes. Versatile and refined, it is ideal for enhancing appetizers, side dishes, and gourmet preparations, bringing the authentic flavors of Mediterranean tradition to the table.

products.name: SUN DRY TOMATOES PUREE
products.description: Gastronomic preparation obtained from selected green olives, finely ground and blended with oil, resulting in a cream with a smooth and homogeneous texture. The product is characterized by a delicate yet distinctive flavour, typical of green olives, with fresh and slightly savory notes.

products.name: GRILLED COURGETTE IN SUNFLOWER OIL
products.description: The grilled courgettes, perfectly intact, after being selected are subjected to appropriate washing. They are then immersed in an aqueous solution of white wine vinegar, citric acid, L-ascorbic acid and salt. The courgettes extracted from the solution are drained, seasoned with various spices and potted with the addition of oil and, once plugged, are subjected to pasteurization (heat treatment). Lastly, are packaged with thermopack (made with heat-shrink plastic).

products.name: ASPARAGUS CREAM
products.description: Rich and velvety asparagus cream, made with selected asparagus to enhance their delicate and natural flavour. Sunflower seed oil adds smoothness, while wine vinegar brings a pleasant touch of freshness. Aromatic notes of garlic, parsley and a hint of chili complete the profile, creating a well-balanced and versatile cream, perfect for appetizers, crostini and gourmet preparations.

products.name: SEMI-DRIED TOMATOES IN SUNFLOWER SEED OIL
products.description: After being selected, the semi-dried tomatoes are carefully washed. They are then immersed in an aqueous solution of white wine vinegar, citric acid, L-ascorbic acid, and salt. The cherry tomatoes, once removed from the solution, are drained and seasoned with various spices. They are then bottled with oil and, once capped, pasteurized (heat treated). They are then packaged in thermopacks (made of heat-shrinkable plastic).

products.name: APULIAS BOMB
products.description: Bomba Pugliese is a gastronomic specialty inspired by the tradition of Southern Italy, made with a selection of finely sliced Mediterranean vegetables preserved in sunflower seed oil. The product stands out for its intense and mildly spicy flavor, balanced by the presence of wine vinegar and natural aromatics. Ideal as a ready-to-use condiment.

products.name: BLACK OLIVES CREAM
products.description: Gastronomic preparation obtained from selected black olives, finely ground and blended with oil, resulting in a cream with a smooth and homogeneous texture. The product is characterized by a delicate yet distinctive flavour, typical of black olives, with fresh and slightly savory notes.

products.name: GARLIC CREAM
products.description: The garlic cream, with an intense and persistent flavor, can be spread on canapes, bruschetta or in combination with a tomato sauce or other sauces in the sauce of pasta. The segments, perfectly intact, are immersed in an aqueous solution of white wine vinegar and then seasoned with various spices and reduced to cream.

products.name: BITETTO TERMITE OLIVES IN BRINE
products.description: Bitetto termite olives are a typical variety from the Bitetto area, in Puglia. These olives are characterized by their oval shape and intense green skin, which tends to darken as they ripen. They are appreciated for their rich and fruity flavor, with slightly bitter and spicy notes, which make them ideal for direct consumption.

products.name: NOCELLARA OLIVES IN BRINE
products.description: Olives of the Nocellara del Belice variety, grown exclusively in the Belice Valley, in Sicily. Hand-picked and processed using traditional methods, these olives are known for their meaty pulp, crunchy texture and balanced flavor, slightly bitter with herbaceous notes.

products.name: GREEN OLIVES CREAM
products.description: Gastronomic preparation obtained from selected green olives, finely ground and blended with oil, resulting in a cream with a smooth and homogeneous texture. The product is characterized by a delicate yet distinctive flavour, typical of green olives, with fresh and slightly savory notes.

products.name: KALAMON OLIVES IN BRINE
products.description: The Kalamata olive, or Calamata olive, is the drupe of an olive cultivar typical of the area of Messinia, in the southern Peloponnese (Greece), which takes its name from the main city, Calamata. /The drupe is used as a table olive, preserved in vinegar or in olive oil. In the European Union, Calamata olives are protected as a protected geographical indication. Olives of the same variety, which grow elsewhere, are called Kalamon olives.

products.name: GRILLED EGGPLANT
products.description: Selected eggplants, sliced, grilled, and then preserved in oil. They feature even slices with distinctive grilled streaks and the typical grilled color. On the palate, they are delicate and aromatic, with a balanced flavor and a tender yet firm texture. Ready-to-eat product, suitable as an appetizer, side dish, or ingredient in culinary preparations.

products.name: FRIARIELLI
products.description: Friarielli are the young inflorescences and leaves of Brassica rapa, typical of southern Italy, particularly the Campania region. They feature deep green leaves, slender stems, and tender florets. Their flavor is distinctive, slightly bitter with peppery notes that become more pronounced after cooking.

products.name: LUPINS IN BRINE
products.description: Lupins in brine are legumes belonging to the Fabaceae family, known for their unique flavor and crunchy texture. These seeds are subjected to a soaking and cooking process to remove the bitter and toxic substances naturally present. Once prepared, the lupins are preserved in brine.

products.name: SUN DRIED TOMATOES
products.description: Sun-dried tomatoes are rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals. Furthermore, the dehydration process removes water, allowing the tomatoes to be preserved for a long time without losing their flavor, making it even more intense.

products.name: PITTED LECCINO OLIVES IN BRINE
products.description: Leccino olives are a variety of Italian olives, native to Tuscany, known for their delicate and fruity flavor. When seasoned, Leccino olives take on an even richer and more aromatic character.

products.name: ARTICHOKES CREAM
products.description: Artichoke Cream is made from carefully selected, high-quality artichokes, offering an authentic flavour and a smooth, velvety texture. Prepared with simple, carefully chosen ingredients, it enhances the natural taste of artichokes while maintaining a delicate balance that makes it suitable for a wide variety of dishes. Perfect as a spread on bread and bruschetta, it can also be used to enrich pasta dishes or served alongside cheeses, cured meats, meat, and fish. A versatile cream, created to bring the genuine flavour of artichokes to your table with simplicity and quality.

products.name: GREEN OLIVES IN BRINE
products.description: Product obtained from firm fruits of Olea europea sativa, picked just before full maturity, treated with caustic soda with the Castelvetrano Method for the de-bittering process and subsequently purged, desalted and acidified. Once the stability of the product has been obtained, they are packaged in brine.

products.name: Lavender ESQ
products.description: Experience the enchanting harmony of nature with our herbal tea, featuring exquisite tea leaves from our exclusive estates, the vibrant essence of bergamot liquid and delicate lavender. Each sip is a sensory journey that transcends the ordinary, promising a tea adventure you won't forget.

products.name: Winter Brew
products.description: Savor a symphony of flavours, where succulent strawberry, mango, tangy cranberries, cherry and orange peel with aromatic cinnamon and cloves dance together. With notes of hibiscus, apple and rose petals, each sip is a fragrant whirlwind of taste and aroma that leaves you starry and enchanted.

products.name: Wellness Range - Clarity
products.description: A refreshing blend of lemon verbena, fennel, spearmint, lemon peel, lemongrass and ginger, brought together with a bright lemon flavour. Fresh citrus notes lead the cup, balanced by the coolness of spearmint and the gentle warmth of ginger. Light, fragrant and refreshing, it makes a lovely choice for a soothing cup at any time of day. A refreshing herbal infusion with a bright lemon aroma, cooling spearmint character, and delicate herbal notes. Fennel and lemon verbena add subtle sweetness and depth, while ginger provides a gentle warming spice. The cup finishes clean, crisp, and pleasantly refreshing.

products.name: Uva Region - FBOP
products.description: Grown at elevations between 3,000-5,000 ft, Uva FBOP is distinct in character, Uva FBOP pours a bright coppery to reddish liquor. Its fresh, penetrating aroma carries a cool note reminiscent of wintergreen. Medium-bodied and smooth, it delivers a lively yet refined cup suited to both morning refreshment and relaxed afternoon enjoyment.

products.name: All Natural - Tangy Ginger
products.description: A refreshing cup with a soothing blend of green tea with spicy ginger and zesty lemon. invigorate your taste buds with every warm sip!

products.name: Premium Black Tea Leaf Pekoe
products.description: A refined expression of Sri Lankan craftsmanship, this Low Grown Ruhuna Pekoe is sourced from the southern tea-growing region renowned for producing rich and flavourful teas. The elegantly curled, shotty Pekoe leaves offer a golden infusion with amber highlights. Bright and medium in strength, the tea reveals delicate notes of fruit with a smooth, mellow finish, creating a vibrant yet sophisticated tea experience.

products.name: Organic - Ceylon Black
products.description: A smooth and strong black Single Estate tea, hand-picked from the Golden Valley of Bogawantalawa

products.name: All Natural - Lemongrass Liquorice
products.description: A caffeine-free tea with a zesty combination of refreshing lemongrass and liquorice is fresh and mellow with hints of natural sweetness.

products.name: Vanilla Sunrise
products.description: A high-grown tea that's flavoured with the heady richness of vanilla and scented with glorious marigold petals. This awesome Ceylon Tea will upgrade you to a luxurious feel right from the first sip. Elegant and dark-hued in tone, this brew will tingle your palate in your rhapsodic mood.

products.name: All Natural - Minty Green
products.description: Pure green tea from the Golden Valley of Ceylon blissfully balanced with a twist of refreshing Moroccan mint. Enjoy the breath of fresh air with every warm sip.

products.name: All Natural - French Earl Grey
products.description: Finest black tea from the Golden valley of Bogawantalawa perfectly balanced with natural “bergamot” with a fruity and floral twist to add to its speciality. A memorizing brew with heavenly aroma for a perfect day.

products.name: Specialty Tea - Bridwell Haze
products.description: A premium tea perfect for a meditative brewing ritual. The delicate haze balls gently unfurl in hot water, creating a misty infusion with subtle, layered notes of floral, smoky and earthy undertones. Bridwell Haze is more than just a tea, it is an artistic and sensory experience that is beautifully authentic.

products.name: Organic - Sweet Summer
products.description: A tantalizing, sweet and fruity tea blend inspired by the Swedish classic Söderblandning. Made from hand-picked tea from the valley of Bogawantalawa

products.name: Premium Black Tea Leaf OPA
products.description: Our OPA Loose Leaf tea is made with slightly open whole leaves that brew into a bright, deep amber cup, smooth and mellow from the first sip. Traditionally handpicked, processed and sourced from the low elevation estates of Ceylon, OPA leaves develop a caramelly aroma with delicate woody under notes with a clean finish.

products.name: Wellness Range - Tranquil
products.description: A gentle blend of chamomile, apple, cardamom and cloves, enriched with delicate passion and vanilla flavours. Soft floral notes of chamomile meet the natural sweetness of apple, while cardamom and cloves add a subtle warmth. Finished with smooth vanilla and a hint of passion fruit, this is a fragrant, mellow infusion with a pleasantly sweet character. A delicate floral herbal infusion with soft chamomile and sweet apple notes, enhanced by fruity passion fruit. Subtle cardamom and clove provide gentle spice, while vanilla adds a smooth, rounded sweetness. The cup finishes mellow, aromatic, and pleasantly warming.

products.name: All Natural - English Breakfast
products.description: A bright full bodied black tea, rich and brisk in the morning to revive your senses. Brought to you by only the finest teas from the Golden Valley of Ceylon Tea.

products.name: Forever Green
products.description: Elevate your tea journey with "Forever Green," a fusion of the bold and dynamic Young Hysen tea leaf. This vibrant and invigorating green-tea promises an everlasting freshness that ensures your tea moments are forever vibrant and unforgettable.

products.name: Peach Dream
products.description: Peach Dream captures the essence of sun-ripened peaches layered over a rich black tea base. Velvety and aromatic, this blend delivers a smooth, juicy flavour with soft floral notes and a hint of natural sweetness. A dreamy infusion that comforts and refreshes with every sip.

products.name: Specialty Tea - Golden Valley Gloom
products.description: A masterpiece of handcrafted tea from Bogawantalawa Estate. These leaves are meticulously handpicked and expertly hand-rolled by the estate’s own Tea Maker, ensuring unmatched precision and quality. This tea is celebrated for its mellowness, smooth flavour, and a gentle hint of Bogawantalawa's signature brightness. Golden Valley Gloom is a reflection of the estate’s dedication to tradition and craftsmanship

products.name: Berry Enchantment
products.description: Berry Enchantment is a vibrant blend of premium Ceylon Black Tea delicately combined with juicy berry inclusions and luscious blueberry notes. Bright and lively, this refreshing tea offers a smooth cup layered with sweet berry character, gentle fruity undertones, and a soft lingering finish. Fragrant and uplifting, it delivers a delightful fusion of Ceylon tea and ripe berry indulgence.

products.name: Specialty Tea - Bridwell Dragon Balls
products.description: Bridwell Dragon Balls are exquisitely hand-tied signature teas suitable for life’s most memorable moments and refined gifting. These elegant, compact spheres are meticulously crafted by skillfully binding premium green tea leaves and tender buds together. When steeped in hot water, these exquisite tea balls gently bloom and unfurl into a breathtaking flower-like display, transforming your cup into a moment of theatre and tranquillity. In flavour, they offer a light and delicate infusion with soft floral notes and a subtle natural sweetness.

products.name: Elegant Earl Grey
products.description: Elegant Earl Grey Tea is a distinguished blend of premium Ceylon Black Tea delicately enhanced with the refined citrus character of bergamot. Bright and aromatic, this well-balanced tea combines the richness of Ceylon tea with soft floral and fruity notes, creating a smooth and refreshing cup with an elegant finish.

products.name: Chamomile
products.description: The calming scent of chamomile is guaranteed to take you on a soothing journey to relaxation, as its gentle floral notes envelop you in calmness. With its natural goodness this tranquil, aromatic beverage is the perfect brew to discover serenity at the end of a hectic day.

products.name: Tranquil Tea
products.description: The calm scent of golden chamomile flowers with mildly stimulating hibiscus and lavender buds create the perfect fragrance to lull you into an idyllic mood. We've thrown rose petals into this mix of scents to ensure you are off to a blissful state of transcendence.

products.name: Sabaragamuwa Region - FBOP
products.description: Cultivated below 2,000 ft in elevation, Sabaragamuwa FBOP reveals its character from the first pour. A dark amber to reddish-brown liquor carries notes of caramel, ripe fruit, and honey with subtle earthy undertones. Strong, full-bodied, and malty, it delivers a rich, satisfying cup suited to both morning and evening enjoyment.

products.name: Emerald Delight
products.description: Emerald Delight Green Tea offers a refreshing and delicate flavour, with subtle grassy notes and a hint of natural sweetness. Its smooth, well-balanced taste invigorates the senses, leaving a crisp and rejuvenating finish.

products.name: Specialty Tea - Sommerville Morning Dew
products.description: Somerville Morning Dew is a handcrafted specialty tea from the prestigious Wanarajah Estate. The leaves are naturally withered, hand-rolled, and expertly fermented using traditional methods to preserve their purity and character, to make curled black leaves and delicate silvery tips. In the cup, Somerville Morning Dew reveals a bright orange liquor with a smooth, juicy texture and a refreshing minty finish.

products.name: Forest Berry
products.description: Forest Berry bursts with the rich, tangy flavours of wild berries, beautifully layered over a smooth black tea base. Its vibrant aroma and naturally sweet, slightly tart taste offer a refreshing escape into nature with every sip. A lively and uplifting blend that finishes with a crisp, fruity flourish.

products.name: Dimbula Region - FBOP
products.description: Grown at elevations between 4,000-5,500 ft, Dimbula FBOP produces a bright coppery to reddish-amber liquor with delicate floral notes, light citrus sweetness, and a subtle oaky undertone. Medium-bodied, brisk, and well balanced, it offers a lively yet smooth cup, ideal for both morning refreshment and relaxed afternoon enjoyment.

products.name: Jasmine Blossom
products.description: Jasmine Blossom blends the delicate, soothing notes of green tea with the sweet, fragrant aroma of jasmine flowers. This aromatic infusion offers a calm, refreshing taste, perfect for moments of relaxation and tranquility.

products.name: Wellness Range - Nourish
products.description: A warming blend of turmeric, cinnamon, ginger, lemongrass and chicory root, finished with a touch of caramel flavour. The earthy notes of turmeric and chicory meet the gentle spice of cinnamon and ginger, while lemongrass brings a fresh lift to the cup. A smooth, comforting infusion with a naturally warm and inviting character. A warming and aromatic herbal blend with prominent ginger and cinnamon notes, complemented by the earthy character of turmeric and chicory and a fresh citrus lift from lemongrass. A subtle caramel sweetness rounds the cup, leaving a smooth, warm, and pleasantly spicy finish.

products.name: Lemon Lush
products.description: Lemon Lush is a zesty blend that pairs the fresh, grassy notes of green tea with the bright citrus burst of lemon. Light, refreshing, and invigorating, this uplifting infusion delivers a crisp, tangy flavour and a clean, revitalizing finish perfect for any time of the day.

products.name: Mango Magic
products.description: Mango Magic blends the bold richness of black tea with the tropical sweetness of ripe mangoes. This fragrant, fruity infusion offers a smooth, vibrant taste that transports you to a sun-kissed paradise with every sip.

products.name: Organic - Earl Grey
products.description: One of the classics. A mild smooth black tea flavoured with a lovely citrusy hint of Italian bergamot. Grown in the sunny Ceylon tea gardens of Loinorn.

products.name: Organic - Red Vanilla
products.description: Made from the Rooibos from the foot of Cederberg Mountain in South Africa and flavoured with natural vanilla, this colorful tea offers an exotic, smooth and sweet experience

products.name: All Natural - Soft Lavender
products.description: A very special and delicate tea from Norwood estate picked only during the crisp morning hours perfectly balanced with soothing lavender buds. An impeccable way to unwind your day in heavenly bliss.

products.name: Minty Rose
products.description: This aromatic tea is blended with rose petals in addition to crushed mint leaves which spring with distinct hints of green-tea giving an intensely exotic finish. Treat yourself to this flavourful splendour and you'll always be asking for more.

products.name: Soothing Chamomile
products.description: Delicate and soothing, this elegant chamomile infusion reveals gentle notes of crisp apple, soft meadow herbs, sun-dried hay, and subtle honey sweetness. Naturally caffeine-free, it offers a smooth and comforting cup with a mellow floral character, making it an ideal brew for moments of relaxation and quiet evenings.

products.name: Lychee Bliss
products.description: Lychee Bliss a luxurious fusion of bold black tea and the juicy sweetness of lychee. Fragrant and full-bodied, this blend offers a smooth, exotic taste with floral undertones and a naturally sweet finish. A delightful escape that lingers on the palate with soft, fruity elegance.

products.name: Uda Pussellawa Region - FBОР
products.description: Cultivated at elevations between 5,000-6,000 ft, there is a quiet grace to Uda Pussellawa FBOP that reveals itself from the first pour. A bright golden-amber liquor unfolds with delicate floral notes and lingering citrus nuances, creating a refreshing and refined cup ideal for relaxed afternoons or evenings.

products.name: Peppermint
products.description: Refresh and relax your soul with the invigorating charm of a caffeine-free herbal infusion. Crafted with pure peppermint leaves, this blend delivers a crisp, cooling burst of minty delight, creating a tea experience that's as soothing and uplifting as a gentle breeze on a sunny day.

products.name: Citrus Mint
products.description: An invigorating zest of a sensational herbal tea crafted with the exquisite Ceylon Black Tea infused with lively lemon flavour, lemon peel, and refreshing spearmint. Each sip is a burst of citrusy freshness and minty delight that will awaken your senses and elevate you to new heights of excitement.

products.name: All Natural - Unwinding Vanilla
products.description: A rich black full bodied tea beautifully balanced with real vanilla. A memorizing treat with hints of caramel and natural sweetness. This blend is a splendid way to sooth even the most stressful day.

products.name: Lemon Twist
products.description: Lemon Twist blends the bold richness of black tea with the zesty, refreshing essence of lemon. The bright citrus notes perfectly complement the tea's robust flavour, leaving a clean and invigorating finish.

products.name: Ruhuna Region - FBOP
products.description: Grown from sea level up to 2,000 ft in elevation, Ruhuna FBOP opens with a deep reddish-brown liquor and rich, malty aroma layered with molasses-like sweetness. Notes of dark chocolate, caramel, and ripe fruit emerge alongside subtle earthy undertones. Full-bodied and bold, it delivers a rich, satisfying cup suited to both mornings and evenings.

products.name: Organic - Rooibos Twist
products.description: A light and earthly tea with a dash of papaya, orange and licorice that will leave you with a sweet taste and a mad craving for another cup.

products.name: Apple Whisper
products.description: Apple Whisper pairs the bold richness of black tea with the crisp, comforting sweetness of ripe apples. Aromatic and smooth, this blend offers a warm, fruity embrace with subtle tart undertones, finishing with a mellow, lingering apple note that soothes and satisfies.

products.name: Exotica
products.description: Tea leaves are smoothly harvested and scented with ginger and pineapple. Delicately rolled and dried to maintain flavour, the tea leaves are carefully mixed with freshly picked ginger roots to slowly absorb their fragrance and flavour. Tea lovers everywhere consider this as the perfect combination of green tea in your cup.

products.name: Golden Brew
products.description: Grown and carefully handpicked from the Golden Valley of Ceylon. Known for its brightness and medium strength, this black tea brews a well-balanced cup with a smooth finish. Golden Brew is perfect for everyday drinking, whether enjoyed on its own or with milk.

products.name: All Natural - Queen of Roses
products.description: A blissful blend with taste and aroma matching the visual beauty of delicate rosebuds. This exquisite tea brews a perfect light gold liquor with the soothing aroma of roses and hints of natural sweetness.

products.name: Specialty Tea - Bridwell Zen
products.description: Bridwell Zen Tips is a premium green tea crafted from carefully selected young, tender leaves and buds nurtured in the Golden Valley of Ceylon. In the cup, Zen Tips reveals a mild and soothing flavour profile, layered with subtle grassy and floral notes and a gentle astringency. This tea is the perfect match for tea lovers who value a tranquil, meditative tea-drinking experience.

products.name: Cardamom Blaze
products.description: A symphony of flavours for spice enthusiasts, this herbal brew features the finest tea leaf, a tantalizing blend of cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, ginger, black pepper and the exotic touch of star anise, all spiced to perfection. Each sip will ensure your chai moments are forever infused with excitement.

products.name: Soursop Exotic
products.description: Sousop Exotic Combines the gentle elegance of green tea with the lush, tropical essence of soursop. Its bright, fruity notes are perfectly balanced by the tea's natural smoothness, creating a refreshing and mildly sweet cup. A vibrant blend that enlivens the senses and leaves a clean, exotic finish.

products.name: Golden Green
products.description: Harvested from our own tea plantations at Norwood Estate in the Golden Valley of Ceylon, this exceptional Ceylon Green Tea is grown in the cool mountain climate renowned for producing teas of remarkable character and purity. Carefully crafted using traditional methods, only the finest tender leaves are selectively handpicked to preserve their natural freshness and delicate flavour. A bright and pure Ceylon Green Tea, it is mildly astringent and wonderfully refreshing, with fresh herb notes complementing its smooth and elegant character. The infusion is clear and lively, delivering a refined tea experience inspired by the serenity of Sri Lanka’s high-grown tea gardens.

products.name: Crimson Hibiscus
products.description: Crimson Hibiscus is a vibrant herbal infusion crafted from carefully selected hibiscus petals, offering a bright crimson cup with a refreshing tartness and delicate floral notes. Naturally caffeine-free, this lively infusion delivers a smooth and invigorating character with a pleasantly crisp finish, making it a refreshing choice.

products.name: Specialty Tea - Leopard's Pounce Tea
products.description: Leopard’s Pounce Tea is a rare, hand-crafted masterpiece made from Kotiyagalla Estate tea bushes over 100 years old. These exceptionally tender leaves are naturally withered, hand-rolled and slow oven-dried, preserving the purity, character and soul of the leaf. In the Cup, Leopard's pounce turns into a yellow liquor, which brings a flavour that is soft and sweet, with herbal notes combined with a floral aroma.

products.name: Zesty Lemon
products.description: Zesty Lemon is a refined blend of premium Ceylon Black Tea delicately infused with the vibrant essence of natural lemon. This well-balanced tea delivers a bright and aromatic cup with refreshing citrus notes, mild sweetness, and a clean, lively finish. Smooth and medium-bodied, it offers an elegant tea experience suited for any time of day.

products.name: Mighty Mint
products.description: Mighty Mint combines the bold richness of black tea with the cool, refreshing essence of mint. This invigorating blend offers a crisp and aromatic experience, perfect for a revitalizing moment of relaxation.

products.name: Classic Delight
products.description: This black tea delivers a bold and invigorating flavour, with rich, malty notes and a smooth, full-bodied finish offering a perfectly balanced taste that lingers with warmth and depth.

products.name: Nuwara Eliya Region - FBOP
products.description: Cultivated above 6,000 ft in elevation, Nuwara Eliya FBOP is a tea of quiet delicacy, revealing a pale golden to light amber liquor. Its floral character carries delicate citrus notes and a gentle hint of eucalyptus freshness. Light-bodied and crisp, it delivers a refreshing cup ideal for the freshness of morning.

products.name: Organic - Warm Turmeric
products.description: This tea offers a warm and tantalizing fusion of turmeric, licorice and cardamom. A perfect alternative to more traditional teas.

products.name: Organic - Green Dream
products.description: A refreshing green tea with a dash of sweet mango and passionfruit. Grown in the sunny Ceylon tea gardens of Norwood

products.name: All Natural - Jasmine Green
products.description: A soothing green tea perfectly balanced with delicate jasmine flowers and lemongrass. This tea fusion brews a rich golden liquor with floral and citrus notes releasing a fresh grassy green tea finish at the end.

products.name: Earl Grey
products.description: Slightly superior to the traditional Earl Grey, FBOP from the Golden Valley of Ceylon Tea and oil of bergamot are artfully combined by our tea masters to give connoisseurs that distinct richness. An excellent beverage for an evening of high tea along with a true feel of royalty.

products.name: All Natural - Very Berry
products.description: This berrilicious and aromatic fruit twist brews an amazing liquor with a berry rich blast flavour that adds colour to your day!

products.name: Mint Cascade
products.description: Mint Cascade is a refreshing blend of premium Ceylon Black Tea delicately complemented by cool mint notes. Bright and lively, this invigorating tea offers a smooth medium-bodied cup with a crisp minty character, gentle natural sweetness, and a clean lingering finish. Its fresh aroma and cooling sensation create a revitalizing tea experience perfect for any time of day.

products.name: Passion Island
products.description: Passion Island combines the deep richness of black tea with the bold, tangy sweetness of pure passion fruit. Bursting with tropical aroma and a vibrant, juicy flavour, this energizing blend offers a smooth body and a bright, lingering finish that delights the senses.

products.name: English Breakfast
products.description: Awaken your senses with our "English Breakfast" tea, featuring the exclusive pekoe leaf from our high grown estates. This classic blend is the flawless embodiment of refined taste, promising a morning ritual that's both smooth and exhilarating, setting the perfect tone for your day.

products.name: Moroccan Mint
products.description: A refreshing blend of fine Ceylon green tea and peppermint, offering a delicate green tea character complemented by a bright, cooling mint note. The cup has a fresh, clean aroma with a lively and refreshing flavour, followed by a smooth, cooling mint finish.

products.name: Specialty Tea - Bridwell Jade
products.description: An artisanal tea celebrated for its vivid jade-green hue and fine, needle-like leaves. Sourced from the highlands of Bridwell Estate, it offers a light, refreshing cup with subtle floral and grassy notes, a gentle astringency and a lingering sweetness perfect for those who appreciate refined and nuanced teas.

products.name: Bombay Chai
products.description: Bombay Chai Tea is an aromatic blend of premium Ceylon Black Tea enriched with a carefully balanced selection of natural spices and authentic chai elements. Bright and lively, this warming tea reveals layers of cinnamon, cardamom, clove, and subtle sweetness, creating a smooth and comforting cup with a gently spiced finish. Fragrant and invigorating, it offers a classic chai experience inspired by the vibrant spirit of Bombay.

products.name: Strawberry Punch
products.description: Strawberry Punch combines the deep richness of black tea with the sweet, refreshing taste of fresh strawberries. This fruity and aromatic blend leaves a pleasant aftertaste, creating a luxurious tea experience.

products.name: Dawn of Love
products.description: Scented with rose, marigold and lotus petals, this tea is geared to lift your amorous spirit from the very first sip. Darkly elegant in tone and endowed with ample fruitiness, this tea is ideal to enjoy any time of the day. It's equally suited to enhance your romantic mood coupled with that amber sunset.

products.name: Minty Breeze
products.description: A naturally caffeine-free herbal infusion with a fresh, crisp menthol aroma and a cool, refreshing character. Made from pure peppermint leaves, it delivers a clean, lively cup with a pleasant cooling sensation and a refreshing mint finish.

products.name: Organic - Ginger Twist
products.description: Say hello to the world’s best ginger and licorice (according to us), giving you that soothing and warming taste with a sweet touch that lingers on your tongue.

products.name: Charles' Earl Grey
products.description: Tipta Earl Grey Tea is an elegant and aromatic blend that combines black tea with the floral and refreshing flavour of bergamot. The elegant citrus flavor enhances the deep flavour of the black tea, providing a luxurious and relaxing experience.

products.name: Kandy Region - FBOР
products.description: Grown at elevations between 2,000-4,000 ft, Kandy FBOP pours a bright reddish-brown liquor, warm and inviting. Its fragrance reveals mild floral notes with gentle spice, soft woody tones, and malty warmth. Medium-bodied and well rounded, it delivers a smooth, pleasant cup suited to enjoyment at any hour.

products.name: Specialty Tea - Bogawantalawa Royale

products.name: Vellón de Fuentesaúco Matured cheese (Zamorano PDO)

It has a natural brown rind, and a well-defined "pleita" (traditional design etched to the crust by the mould sheaf-pattern) which is bathed in olive oil frequently during ripening. The paste is firm and compact, yellowish ivory in colour, and may have small eyes, evenly distributed throughout the surface. Zamorano cheese is characterized by having genuine aromas and flavours: specific to raw sheep's milk, well developed and persistent on the palate. products.name: ULTRAFILTRATION (UF)
products.description: Ultrafiltration (UF) has emerged as a transformative technology in the dairy industry, offering significant advantages in the processing of milk and dairy products. Ultrafiltration, which utilizes advanced membrane filtration techniques, improves product quality, reduces waste, and increases operational efficiency by enabling the precise separation of milk components. It enables the revaluation of many products previously considered byproducts, such as whey or UF permeate. UF is also used in other liquid foods outside the dairy industry. Other UF projects carried out by Gemak include: Extraction of lysozyme from egg whites, Production of lactose-free milk, Extraction of protein from silkworm cocoons, Clarification of fruit juice and tea extracts, and clarification of brewed coffee, Gemak utilizes and designs systems employing various UF methods, including spiral-wound, plate-and-frame, ceramic, hollow fiber, and tubular membranes. Leveraging its expertise in engineering and manufacturing, Gemak ensures that its ultrafiltration systems deliver maximum efficiency and reliability. It is strengthening its position as a one-stop solution partner for the dairy and liquid food products industry.

products.name: PASTEURISER
products.description: With the high-tech automation system, the process can be controlled at every step that saves time, eliminates human errors, records all data, enables remote control of the system for efficient production and ease of use. Gemak automatic pasteurizers are stand-alone units with automatic control of pasteurization temperature, flow diversion and continuous data recording for traceability and quality systems. Our design allows optimum high heat recovery with Alfa-Laval plates and gaskets for low operating cost. Pasteurizers are also available with integrated dosing/mixing systems for specialty products and inline CIP systems with capacities ranging from 500 to 50,000 l/h. All pasteurizers are pre-assembled and factory-tested to allow speedy installation and commissioning on-site.

products.name: Vacuum Cooker
products.description: Gemak Cooker makes high quality production with high quality equipment, full automation and extra hygienic system. The unit includes preparation, cooking, and holding-cooling parts. Products are weighed, transferred and mixed according to recipe in the preparation stage. Prepared mix is transferred to the tank underneath the preparation unit. The mix is cooked under pressure, Brix and temperature are controlled, if the mix is in requested condition, it is transferred to holding-cooling tank underneath this section. Products are cooled to the required temperature and then transferred to the storage tank. The system works with full automation. Manufactured in one frame which made of AISI 304-316 stainless steel.

products.name: FREEZER
products.description: High production flexibility. Special care in choosing materials, which are all top quality, to guarantee robustness, corrosion resistance, and durability. Refrigerator compressor with a built-in semi-sealed piston (if there should be a malfunction, can be opened and adjusted), which is more reliable and efficient than a sealed compressor. products.name: Sterilizer And Ultra High Temperature (UHT)
products.description: GEMAK automatic sequential standardization units are used for standardization of fat, protein, totally solid and non-solid fat in milk and cream immediately after the cream separator. The control of the unit can be done either with the control unit of the unit itself or via the control unit of the pasteurizer. GEMAK skid-mounted modular standardization systems are manufactured with in-line technology for milk and cream, flavored milk, milk and powder production for fermented products, cheese milk, ice cream mix, and many other dairy product applications.

products.name: Cleaning Systems (CIP)
products.description: CIP unit is an advanced automatic cleaning-in-place system used for cleaning process equipment such as tanks, filling machines, pasteurizers, sanitary pipes, aseptic tanks, plate heat exchanger and other process equipment. They are compact units that provide a wide range of flexible solutions with capacities and options for every customer. The fully automated CIP units can be designed up to 5 pressure lines with separate PLC control and all of the system. CIP units automatically control the cleaning time, detergent temperature, flow, and concentration. The control of detergent concentration and sorting of liquids in the CIP unit is done using a conductivity transmitter. Mobile CIP units are also available. Capacity: 10.000 lt/h - 60.000 lt/h (2,2 gpm to 264 gpm ) Application Areas: Dairy Industry Liquid Food Industrial Plants Chemical Industry Pharmaceutical Industry Potable and Process Water

products.description: The Brie de Meaux PDO from Fromagerie Dongé is an essential reference among traditional brie cheeses. Made from raw cow’s milk and crafted using artisanal methods, it is distinguished by its soft, bloomy rind, fine and downy, and a carefully controlled maturation that reveals the full richness of its terroir. Beneath its slightly speckled white rind, the paste is supple, creamy at the core, offering complex aromas of fresh mushrooms, hazelnut, and undergrowth, with a long, elegant finish on the palate.

products.name: L'Apéro Frenchi
products.description: Fresh goat’s or cow’s cheese balls with a melting center, delivering a true explosion of sweet or savory flavors. All the authenticity and indulgence of cheese in a convenient, ready-to-enjoy format!

products.description: Produced in the Jura Mountains, Comté AOP Juraflore is slowly aged in the natural cellars of Fort des Rousses, where it benefits from unique conditions that reveal the full richness of its terroir. Depending on the ageing period (from 6 to 36 months), Juraflore develops a remarkable aromatic profile, with fruity, roasted and lightly milky notes, and a texture that is both smooth and slightly crystalline. Each wheel reflects the perfect balance between traditional craftsmanship and precise ageing expertise. Comté AOP Juraflore embodies French cheesemaking excellence through several key factors, combining the strength of its terroir, rigorous selection, and mastery of the ageing process.

products.name: Triple Cream goat Brie style

products.name: Camembert de France
products.description: Réo Camembert de France is a pasteurized cow’s milk cheese produced in Normandy by Laiterie Réo. Made using the same traditional cheesemaking methods as PDO Camembert de Normandie, it benefits from authentic expertise that gives it a soft, creamy texture and a well-balanced flavor with delicate milky and mushroom notes. Thanks to its smooth, melting texture and approachable character, this Camembert appeals to both lovers of traditional cheeses and consumers looking for a versatile and convivial cheese, ideal for enjoying on a cheese board or incorporating into warm dishes and recipes.

products.name: Petit d'Affinois Double Cream
products.description: Petit d’Affinois Double cream brings the beloved taste and texture of our flagship Fromager d’Affinois Le Fromager, to a convenient, pre-pack format. This soft-ripened cheese specialty is deliciously creamy with a silky smooth texture and a thin rind.

products.name: PDO Roquefort La Cave

products.name: Raclette cheese Livradoux

Crafted using traditional cheesemaking expertise, it is distinguished by its smooth, creamy texture and its mild, fruity flavor, enhanced by delicate milky notes. Made from high-quality milk sourced from mountain pastures, Livradoux Raclette is perfect for sharing during convivial raclette meals, but it can also be enjoyed melted, baked in gratins, or incorporated into a variety of gourmet dishes. Its well-balanced character appeals both to casual cheese lovers and to discerning connoisseurs seeking authenticity and genuine regional flavors.

products.name: Fleur des Alpes
products.description: Fleur des Alpes is a pasteurized cow’s milk cheese produced by Fromagerie Verdannet. Similar in style to a Reblochon, it is distinguished by its soft, creamy texture and smooth, melting paste. Its flavor is mild and well-balanced, with delicate milky notes and a subtle hint of hazelnut, making it appealing both to cheese enthusiasts and to consumers looking for an approachable cheese. Versatile and enjoyable, Fleur des Alpes can be served on a cheese board or used in cooking, particularly in traditional Savoyard dishes such as tartiflette. Its rich character and creamy texture make it a favorite among lovers of Alpine cheese specialties.

The result is a perfectly balanced texture and a beautifully uniform appearance, offering a tasting experience that is both refined and authentic.

products.name: Comté cheese cream

Its smooth, creamy texture makes it ideal for elevating both everyday dishes and gourmet creations.

Beneath its natural rind lies a supple, smooth paste, delicately perfumed, where fresh caprine notes are beautifully balanced by subtle woody and slightly nutty hints from the truffle. Careful aging enhances its aromatic complexity while preserving remarkable finesse. A characterful yet approachable cheese, perfect for a cheese board, shaved over gourmet salads, or as a refined finishing touch on warm dishes.

A truly indulgent specialty, it stands out for its exceptionally smooth, rich, and silky texture. The Barisien offers delicate notes of fresh cream, sweet butter, and fresh milk, complemented by subtle hints of mushrooms and woodland undergrowth. On the palate, its balance between milky sweetness and creamy richness creates a refined and highly indulgent tasting experience. The range is also available in flavored varieties that are especially appreciated for festive occasions : Truffle-filled or Morel-filled.

products.name: Flavoured Camembert

Herb Camembert: Fresh and approachable, it develops aromatic herbal notes (parsley, chives, sometimes garlic or shallot depending on the recipe). Espelette Pepper Camembert: The creaminess of Camembert is enhanced by Espelette pepper, bringing warm, slightly fruity and subtly spicy flavors.

products.name: Goat's Tomme Caprin des Volcans

Its supple, melting texture reveals clean yet well-balanced goaty aromas, with notes of hazelnut, undergrowth, and a slight rusticity typical of Auvergne tommes. The ageing process brings a long, lingering finish on the palate. It stands out for its strong expression of the volcanic terroir, which imparts minerality and aromatic complexity to the goat’s milk.

products.name: Flavoured sheep's milk Tommes
products.description: In the limestone highlands of southern Aveyron, where sheep’s milk has shaped a centuries-old cheesemaking culture, Maison Gabriel Coulet reinterprets tradition with elegance and creativity. Rooted in a legacy best known for its mastery of Roquefort, the house applies the same precision of ageing and respect for terroir to a collection of refined flavoured Tommes, crafted exclusively from rich, characterful sheep’s milk. Each wheel is slowly matured to achieve a supple, velvety texture, allowing the natural sweetness and depth of the milk to unfold—then elevated by carefully chosen botanicals and spices: Fenugreek brings warm, toasted notes, evoking walnut, caramel and a subtle hint of maple Wild Garlic infuses the paste with fresh, green, woodland aromas and a delicate, lingering savoury edge Espelette Pepper brings a delicate warmth to a fruity expression with subtle smoky notes. The result is a collection of cheeses that balance authenticity and modernity—accessible yet distinctive, indulgent yet precise.

products.description: The cranberry is a superfruit from the Northern United States and Canada. Its cousins can be found in a number of regions around the world. The cranberry is very firm and dense with a ruby red colour and has a slightly tart taste and a very fruity aroma. It can be eaten in any form - fresh, dried, as juice, in jam, mixed with cereal for a complete breakfast or as an accompaniment to a wide variety of preparations, including your main course (and is traditionally served along with the Thanksgiving turkey). The cranberry is rich in vitamin C and condensed tannins, making it the first fruit to have its health claims recognized by AFSSA (French Food Safety Agency). Our dried cranberries come from Wisconsin. Located in the Great Lakes region of the United States, this land is ideal for growing cranberries because it combines its best allies: sand, water, sun and cold. Cranberries grow in sandy, dug-out fields. A field of cranberries, which is called an eyelet, measures about 14,000 square meters. A young vine planted gives its first harvest after 3 years and produces in abundance until 25 years. After that, the yield is less, some vines in Wisconsin are over 100 years old! For more than 10 years, we have been working in close collaboration with two suppliers selected for their expertise and quality. When the cranberry is ripe, the fields are immersed and lightly stirred to allow the berries to drop out vines and rise to the surface . Cranberry consisting of 4 small cavities filled with air, they are very light and therefore float on the surface of the immersed field. So just gather it with large buoys and then pump it up . The last step is cleaning and selecting fruits before the distribution. products.name: MIELIZIA ITALIAN ORGANIC CHESTNUT HONEY
products.description: Chestnut Honey Harvested in the chestnut groves of the Alps and Apennines, mainly at the end of summer. Harvest Region and Period Harvested in the chestnut groves of the Alps and Apennines, mainly at the end of summer. Found throughout Italy in hilly and mountainous areas up to 800–1000 m in the north and up to 1200–1300 m in the south. Tasting Suggestions Ideal with meat, fresh and aged cheeses, enhancing their intense flavors. Perfect with dishes featuring light smoky notes. It also pairs exceptionally well with fresh cheeses like ricotta, cow’s or sheep’s milk cheeses, and reaches its peak alongside aged cheeses like Parmigiano Reggiano. Enjoy it also with black tea, non-fruity red wines, or craft beers.

products.name: MIELIZIA ITALIAN ORGANIC WILDFLOWER HONEY
products.description: Wildflower Honey A true blend of honeys, reflecting the endless variety of blossoms visited by the bees. Wildflower honeys showcase a range of textures: they can remain liquid for longer or crystallize quickly, depending on the proportion of nectars from sources such as acacia, chestnut, or forest honeydew. They offer an authentic expression of the harvest territory, capturing its distinct aromas, colors, and flavors. Harvest Region and Period Harvested in spring and summer across virtually the entire Italian peninsula. Tasting Suggestions Delicious spread on bread or added to milk. It is the ultimate table honey. Ideal when incorporated into doughs to promote optimal fermentation and rising.

products.name: MIELIZIA ITALIAN ORGANIC SESAME BAR WITH HONEY
products.description: MIELIZIA SESAME AND HONEY BAR Mielizia organic sesame and honey bars are produced with only two ingredients: sesame and Italian honey from our beekeepers. As for our honey, the sesame batches we select for the production are subject to thorough controls and analysis to guarantee food safety. Our bars are sources of fiber and produced without aromas and syrups. Soft and crunchy they are a perfect tasty and healthy snack for a break, indoor and outdoor everyday life and activities and for those who practice sport.

products.name: MIELIZIA ITALIAN ORGANIC ORANGE HONEY
products.description: Orange Blossom Honey One of the most popular monofloral honeys, renowned for the intense yet refined aroma of zagare (orange blossoms). It is harvested in spring and early summer across the regions of Southern Italy and the islands. Harvest Region and Period Harvested in spring and early summer across Southern Italy and the islands. Tasting Suggestions Ideal for baking, as well as sweetening and flavoring yogurts, cream-based desserts, or whipped cream; its true flavor shines best in raw or unheated applications. The pairing possibilities are endless. This honey works wonderfully in omelets, spring vegetable salads, creative vinaigrettes, raw or cooked fish, and stretched-curd cheeses of various aging stages (such as scamorza, provola, caciocavallo, and mozzarella).

products.name: MIELIZIA ITALIAN ORGANIC FRUIT SPREADS
products.description: Mielizia organic fruit spreads are produced without pectin and naturally sweetened only with grape sugar and a delicate honey from our beekeeping members. Throughout the entire production process, we pay maximum attention to the product to fully preserve its organoleptic qualities. This is what makes our jams intensely fragrant, rich in flavor, and remarkably smooth and easy to spread.

products.name: MIELIZIA ITALIAN ORGANIC BISCUITS
products.description: Mielizia Organic Shortbread Biscuits are made with a few carefully selected organic ingredients, including Italian soft wheat flour and organic Italian honey from our beekeepers. Mielizia organic shortbread biscuits are perfect for a healthy, nourishing, and tasty breakfast or snack break. They contain no syrups or flavorings, no animal fats or palm oil, and no added eggs or milk.

products.name: MIELIZIA ITALIAN ORGANIC ACACIA HONEY
products.description: Acacia Honey In spring, around May, acacia trees—whose scientific name is Robinia pseudoacacia L.—become covered in clusters of white flowers from which bees produce this particularly precious honey. Harvest Region and Period During the flowering season, which lasts about 10 days, bees tirelessly dive into nectar-filled blossoms from morning till night. This honey is harvested in spring in acacia woods, particularly in the Prealps, though it is found throughout the peninsula: Piedmont, Lombardy, Veneto, Friuli-Venezia Giulia, Tuscany, Emilia-Romagna, Abruzzo, Campania, and Calabria. Tasting Suggestions Naturally liquid, it dissolves easily and is perfect for sweetening coffee, tea, and all beverages without altering their flavor. It is ideal for poaching or candying fruit, preparing original salad dressings, or incorporating into cake and bread doughs, as well as fruit salads. It pairs wonderfully with fresh cheeses, as well as aged ricotta and lightly aged blue cheeses.

products.name: Spout Pouch

Consumer Convenience: Ergonomic, easy to open, reclose, and consume on the go without requiring utensils. Efficient Space & Weight: Weighs up to 70% less than glass or rigid plastic bottles, significantly lowering shipping emissions, storage footprint, and packaging waste. Maximum Evacuation: Flexible body allows consumers to squeeze out nearly 99% of the contents, minimizing food waste. Target Applications: Baby food purees, fruit smoothies, dairy products (drinkable yogurt), sauces, salad dressings, syrups, oils, and personal/home care liquid refills.

products.name: Flat Pouch / Pillow Pouch

products.name: Retort Roll Film
products.description: Roll film (roll stock) is continuous, multi-layer laminated barrier film wound onto cores, engineered for high-speed automated Form-Fill-Seal (VFFS/HFFS) packaging and lidding applications. Automated Line Efficiency: Engineered for seamless tracking, high-speed unrolling, and precise cutting on automated packaging machines. Versatile Use: Ideal for flow-wrapping, pillow pouches, 3-side seal forming, and tray-lidding applications. Target Applications: Ready meals, wet pet food, dry snacks, confectionery, seafood, meat products, sauces, and institutional bulk packs.

products.name: Recyclable Pouch (Mono PP, Retortable)
products.description: A Mono-PP pouch is an eco-friendly pouch made entirely from one type of plastic (polypropylene). Because it is not mixed with other materials, it can be fully recycled after use. 100% Recyclable: Made from a single plastic type so it goes straight into standard plastic recycling bins. Eco-Friendly: Lowers plastic waste and cuts down carbon emissions during production. Looks Great on Shelves: Stands up firmly with bright, clean colors and sharp printing. Great for Food & Pet Food: Keeps ready meals, soups, sauces, and pet food fresh at room temperature.

products.name: Flexible Packaging (Pouch)

products.name: Goccia di Latte Ricotta Frozen
products.description: Our Goccia di Latte is an ultra-fresh cow’s milk ricotta. It is considered a true cheese because it is made from whole cow’s milk rather than whey . It can only be found in Romagna, as it originates from ancient local recipes passed down through generations. Its smooth taste and unique sweetness make it perfect to enjoy by the spoonful, loved even by children. It is also delicious as a filling for crescioni, cappelletti, and tortelli. Shelf Life 1 year, 15dd once thawed

products.name: Pecorino Romagnolo
products.description: Thanks to its delicate flavour, Pecorino Romagnolo is a very pleasant way to end a meal. It is perfect as an aperitif, paired with a good glass of white wine and accompanied by broad beans or home-made jams. A semi-matured cheese made from sheep's milk to be served on any occasion, with friends or relaxing at home.

products.name: Stracchino Frozen
products.description: Stracchino is a creamy cow’s milk cheese with a soft texture and a milky flavor marked by a slight tang that distinguishes it. Its consistency makes it easy to spread on bruschetta or canapés, and it can also be used to enhance the flavor of meat- and vegetable-based dishes. Shelf Life 1 year, 15dd once thawed

products.name: Cacio & Pepe Sac à Poche
products.description: The recipe for Cacio&Pepe roots itself in the dishes of the farmers and shepherds of the Roman countryside and has conquered Italian and international cuisine over the years. It is a simple but tasty cream made with completely natural ingredients, based on pecorino cheese and ground black pepper. It has an intense and pleasantly pungent flavour and its creaminess makes it perfect for enhancing pasta dishes in a few simple steps: just add some of the cooking water and the sauce is ready to please any palate.

products.name: Il vero Formaggio Scoparolo
products.description: Scoparolo is a matured pecorino deeply rooted in the rural traditions of Romagna. Its curious name comes from an old custom: cheeses were stored in broom closets, as wine barrels took up space in the cellars. Farmers would leave the cheeses to rest on wooden shelves, turning, brushing and oiling them with great care. When the overseer asked the farmhand to fetch the cheese, he would refer to it as the “Scoparolo” – the one kept among the brooms. Today, this cheese proudly bears that name and preserves its rustic soul. Vero Formaggio Scoparolo® is the result of meticulous artisanal craftsmanship. It offers a rich, intense and harmonious flavour, with a well-balanced profile that is bold yet refined, leaving a long-lasting impression without overwhelming the palate.

products.name: Formaggio Muccarolo
products.description: At Antica Cascina, cheese-making tradition meets innovation. The Muccarolo Cheese embodies the prestige of the production and aging techniques of our renowned Scoparolo. After thorough research, we applied this heritage to cow's milk, creating a matured cheese with a unique flavor. With its compact, chalky-textured ivory-colored paste, Muccarolo Cheese offers a full and harmonious tasting experience, with a smooth, melting aftertaste, ideal for those seeking sweet yet authentic flavors.

products.name: L'ulivo misto in giara
products.description: Ulivo is born from a slow ripening process where the cheeses rest in special containers wrapped in fragrant, freshly cut olive twigs, turning into a product with a unique flavour. Its sweet and fruity taste is the result of the love for our territory that has driven the master cheesemakers to enhance the qualities of the precious olive trees that grow in Romagna. With its delicate aroma and light vegetable notes, this mixed-milk cheese with its slightly irregular shape is the perfect ally to make an impression on friends and relatives.

products.name: Formaggio Caprarolo
products.description: Caprarolo is a ripened goat’s milk cheese matured according to the traditional methods of Romagna. Its identity is shaped by careful craftsmanship: each wheel is tended with patience during maturation, allowing its compact, chalky texture and distinctive pearly-white colour to develop naturally. Thanks to this artisanal approach, Caprarolo reveals an intense and complex aroma enriched by hints of noble moulds, while its flavour is bold yet remarkably balanced, offering layered nuances that unfod gradually on the palate. This cheese expresses both tradition and character: a product that respects the heritage of Romagna cheesemaking while showcasing the elegant, refined personality typical of great goat cheeses.

products.name: Stracchino Sac à Poche
products.description: Stracchino is a creamy cow’s milk cheese with a soft texture and a milky flavor marked by a slight tang that distinguishes it. Its consistency makes it easy to spread on warm bread, piadina, bruschetta, and focaccia. Ideal for: creamy pasta, risottos, omelettes, savory pies, and gratinated vegetables. Also excellent paired with cured ham, fresh cherry tomatoes, and summer salads.

products.name: Sei di Coccio
products.description: A cheese matured in raw earth. Its name evokes a "hard and stubborn" character, reflecting the rustic and bold taste of this unique gem. With a compact, elastic texture and intense notes of earth and hay, Sei di Coccio offers a truly authentic experience. But there’s more: it can continue maturing at your home, in its raw earth shell, until it reaches the perfect texture. When the time is right, break the shell and let the flavor of this earthy treasure come to life. Made with an eye on tradition and a touch of innovation, Sei di Coccio is not just a cheese, it’s an experience.

products.name: Squacquerone di Romagna DOP da 250g
products.description: A symbol of the Romagna tradition, Squacquerone is a cheese made from cow's milk with very ancient origins. Fresh, soft, and creamy, it has a sweet and delicate flavor. A slightly tangy note characterizes it, making it particularly suitable to accompany caramelized figs, jams, and vegetables. In the tradition of our region, it is indissolubly paired with piadina Romagnola, prosciutto crudo, and arugula. Some chefs use it as an ingredient for more refined and unusual recipes, such as fillings or in desserts. The production of "Squacquerone di Romagna PDO" respects the reference disciplinary in all its phases.

products.name: La Tartufaia
products.description: Truffle and cheese come together in a pairing with a bold and unmistakable flavour, designed for the most refined palates. This cream blends the richness of aged cheese with the earthy intensity of truffle, creating an elegant harmony of aromas and textures. Perfect as a gourmet ingredient for risottos, fresh pasta, or meat dishes, it also enhances appetizers, crostini, and gourmet sauces. A small amount is enough to elevate any recipe, turning it into a refined and memorable tasting experience — a true tribute to Italian excellence. Keep refrigerated.

products.name: Balsamic Vinegar of Modena I.G.P. Invecchiato "Etichetta Nera"
products.description: Black goes with everything With a longer aging period in the barrel, “ Etichetta Nera ” achieves a new level of maturity. Here, the cooked must begins to take center stage, imparting a thicker texture and a flavor that leans toward sweet notes. Thanks to its high density, it is essential for bringing radicchio to life, masterfully balancing the richness of meat and delicately enhancing the freshness of fish. A velvety drizzle over grilled vegetables will make your side dish the star of the table. Without addition of caramel, thickeners and colouring agents.

products.name: Balsamic Vinegar of Modena I.G.P. "Etichetta Verde"
products.description: Freshness and well-being It is the youngest in the collection, having undergone a brief aging process in large-capacity oak barrels. It has a smooth texture with low sugar content. Ideal for those seeking a touch of fragrant acidity, lightness, and purity, while keeping an eye on their waistline. Its “green” and spontaneous character is perfect for creative marinades, pan-seared dishes, or to add a burst of energy to crisp vegetables. Without addition of caramel, thickeners and colouring agents.

products.name: Traditional Balsamic Vinegar of Modena D.O.P. "Extravecchio"
products.description: Patience That Becomes Emotion For over half a century, this elixir has been treasured in the heart of our hills. It is crafted exclusively from the must of grapes grown in AltaModena®, expertly cooked before being entrusted to time and the temperature fluctuations of the ancient Acetaia. Aging takes place in sets of barrels made of seven fine woods. A silky texture that transforms every drop into an unforgettable experience and makes your finest dishes truly unique.

products.name: Dolcebalsamico® Fig
products.description: The taste of late summer

products.name: Balsamic Vinegar of Modena I.G.P. Aged "Etichetta Bianca"
products.description: A velvety, magnetic embrace The sweetness of red berries and plum jam, a creamy texture, and a well-rounded acidity. It is based on a historic family recipe passed down through four generations. Drawing small quantities each year from ancient oak barrels, it adds the finishing touch to enhance fresh or aged cheeses, add depth to a hard-boiled or fried egg, and complement a carpaccio, grilled fillet, or white meats. Without addition of caramel, thickeners and colouring agents.

products.name: Dolcebalsamico® Raspberry

products.name: Dolcebalsamico® White Truffle

products.name: Dolcebalsamico® Chili

products.name: Traditional Balsamic Vinegar of Modena D.O.P. "Affinato"
products.description: The First Radiance of Tradition Bottled at the peak of its vibrancy, during the initial stage of a process that will last forever. It is the perfect synthesis of the liveliness and freshness of Trebbiano grapes and the elegance and complexity imparted by fine wood. On the palate, it is a velvety caress, pleasantly balanced by the acetic “crispness”, which invites you to savor and enjoy it.

products.name: Mioaceto® Gold 25 Rincalzi
products.description: Luxury, elegance, poetry A tribute to time and patience: a velvety caress that evokes memories of when life moved more slowly. With notes of bitter cocoa, tobacco, sun-dried fig, and chestnut honey, it is perfect either savored on its own for a reflective moment, or paired with aged cheeses, fine meats, stuffed pasta, and risottos. Every drop is an emotion etched into memory.

products.name: Dolcebalsamico® Classic
products.description: Your everyday comfort We have softened the sharp edges of the acidity to give you a dressing that gently brings out the flavors. It is not made according to any specific production guidelines, only our own strict recipe. Thanks to the characteristic notes of Trebbiano grapes, it is a versatile product perfect for everything from breakfast to dinner.

products.name: Traditional Balsamic Vinegar of Modena D.O.P. "Attilio"
products.description: The Legacy of a Visionary Beyond the craftsmanship lies the heart of a man. “Attilio” is a tribute to our founder, Grandfather Attilio, the man who first knew how to listen to the pulse of time in our hills. This Traditional Balsamic Vinegar of Modena PDO is born from his dream, his palate, and his production philosophy: a precious nectar that rests for many years in fine wood, preserving intact the spirit of the man who gave life to our story. Every drop is an embrace across generations, a tribute to the patience and vision of a man who transformed grapes into legend. The authentic flavor of our roots.

products.name: Mioaceto® Red 10 Rincalzi
products.description: The vibrant energy of juniper A sharp, aromatic, and delicately spiced touch, capable of elevating even the simplest dishes. It rest in juniper wood, sourced from trees now protected and untouched for decades, a rarity that gives this elixir an even more authentic charm. Try it at brunch to add personality and character: Caesar salad, avocado toast, Eggs Benedict, pancakes.

products.name: Mioaceto® Silver 13 Rincalzi
products.description: Comforting, balanced, and mature It envelops the palate with a rich texture and refined aromas of noble woods. Its exquisite balance makes it versatile for any meal and hard to resist. On the palate, it reveals mature notes of dried fruits, sun-dried apricot, raisins, and plum jam, perfect for enhancing fresh pasta, risottos, cheeses, desserts, eggs, and omelettes.

products.name: Family Reserve
products.description: A story that spans generations It originates from the Sereni family, from patience, from the slow, time-honored gestures passed down through generations, and from a deep respect for time. Its color is a bright light brown, and its texture is full-bodied and velvety. Thanks to the high percentage of cooked must it contains, it is smooth and delicate, with a light, subtle hint of acidity. On the nose, aromas of wild berries and cherry intertwine with a fresh, fragrant hint. Perfect for enhancing succulent meats, aged cheeses, fresh fruit, desserts, and stuffed pasta, highlighting their sweetness.

products.name: Balsamic Vinegar of Modena I.G.P. Aged "Ciliegio"
products.description: Scent of seduction A tribute to the signature fruit of Vignola, the hometown of the Sereni family. The product that Attilio Sereni loved to use on his salads for years, along with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt. Not just time, but precious wood: aging in cherry wooden barrels gives this selection an unmistakable sweet-and-sour flavor of ripe red fruits and a floral note. It is the most romantic side of our Acetaia . Without addition of caramel, thickeners and colouring agents.

products.name: Nabulsi
products.description: Nabulsi is a traditional Middle Eastern white cheese, originating from Palestine, where it is especially popular. It is made from sheep's milk, often with the addition of nigella seeds , which give it its characteristic, mildly spicy taste. Nabulsi is semi-hard, salty, and elastic, making it perfect for frying or grilling, during which it creates a crispy crust while remaining soft and creamy inside. Traditionally used as a component of breakfast dishes, it is enjoyed as a snack or sandwich cheese.

products.name: Labneh
products.description: Labneh is a yogurt cheese with a delicate, thick texture and a slightly salty taste, distinguished by its wealth of culinary possibilities. Made according to a Middle Eastern recipe, it is traditionally served with olive oil and za’atar spice. It also works perfectly as a base for cottage cheese with radishes and chives, a topping for breakfast bowls with nuts, fruits, and honey, or even as an ingredient in cheesecakes, tarts, or pancake fillings. Its versatility doesn’t end with desserts – labneh pairs wonderfully with bread, pita, crackers, as well as roasted vegetables or creamy soups. Its creamy texture and delicate taste make it an excellent alternative to ricotta. Furthermore, combining labneh with green or red pesto creates a simple yet impressive flavor duo. And if you enjoy spicy accents, be sure to try our Labneh with harissa – a ready-to-eat product that will satisfy any fan of bold flavors.

products.name: Ayran
products.description: Jasmeen Ayran is a Turkish-style drink that perfectly suits the atmosphere of hot summer days. Made with yogurt, water, and a pinch of salt, it offers a refreshing solution for the heat, effectively quenching thirst and softening the spicy flavors typical of Middle Eastern cuisine. This traditional drink, popular in the Middle East, the Balkans, and Turkey, is an essential companion to grilled dishes. Thanks to its refreshing properties, Ayran pairs wonderfully with spicy meals, providing a moment of relief and flavor balance.

products.name: Mussanara with Nigella Seeds
products.description: Jasmeen Mussanara cheese is a choice for those who appreciate exceptional flavors. Made from high-quality cow's milk, rennet, and salt, it is enriched with the intense flavor of nigella seeds, offering a unique snack inspired by Middle Eastern traditions. Nigella, known for its distinctive aroma and health benefits, adds an unforgettable taste to the cheese, making it stand out from other dairy products. It can be served warm – grilled or fried – or cold. Mussanara with nigella seeds is perfect as an addition to bread and an ingredient in salads or appetizers, bringing an oriental touch to every dish.

Each can contains a fresh lime slice that rises to the surface when opened. This unique feature not only creates an eye-catching presentation but also enhances the drinking experience with an authentic and refreshing lime flavor. The combination of gin, tonic, and real fruit delivers a light and crisp taste. With an alcohol content of 4.9%, this cocktail is refreshing, easy to enjoy, and perfect for any relaxed occasion.

As one of Saudi Arabia’s most iconic soft drink brands, Kinza represents modern identity, premium quality, and innovation. Rooted in Saudi heritage and driven by a new generation, the brand combines authenticity with world-class flavor development. With its fruity taste and refreshing character, Kinza Orange offers a delicious and uplifting drinking experience, making it the perfect choice for consumers looking for a flavorful citrus refreshment.

Instantia is committed to fair trade and sustainability, respecting the environment and working hand-in-hand with small farming communities in each region. Instantia is part of a group of companies with over 15 years focusing on the healthy food industry, offering our clients the highest quality products, the best service, and innovation in processes daily. products.name: Soviera soup spice mix
products.description: Soviera Premium All-Purpose Seasoning is a well-balanced blend characterized by the exceptional taste and aroma of vegetables and herbs. It is perfectly suited for preparing traditional broth and provides an ideal base for all kinds of soups and sauces.

products.name: Whole Milk Powder
products.description: Whole Milk Powder (WMP) is produced by spray-drying fresh pasteurized cow's milk. It is suitable for a wide range of applications, including the reconstitution of milk as an alternative to fresh milk, as well as dairy products, bakery goods, chocolate, confectionery, cheese and ice cream. We offer Whole Milk Powder in several specifications, including different milk fat levels, and from various origins. Please contact us to discuss the available options.

products.name: Unsalted Sweet Cream Butter
products.description: Unsalted Sweet Cream Butter is made exclusively from pasteurized sweet cream from cow's milk. It is a solid, malleable water-in-oil emulsion. Its versatility makes it suitable for a wide range of applications, including bakery products such as patisserie, cookies and laminated doughs like croissants and puff pastry. It is also well suited for savoury applications, including sauces and soups, or for direct consumption as a spread. We offer Unsalted Sweet Cream Butter in several specifications and origins. Please contact us to discuss the available options.

products.name: Anhydrous Milk Fat
products.description: Anhydrous Milk Fat (AMF) is produced from fresh pasteurized cream or butter through a process of heat treatment and centrifugal separation to produce the finished product. Made from 100% cow's milk, it consists primarily of milk fat, with only traces of milk protein and lactose. Ideal for a wide range of industrial applications, it is commonly used in bakery products, chocolate, ice cream, recombined dairy products, and as an ingredient in butter and spreads. We offer Anhydrous Milk Fat in several specifications and origins. Please contact us to discuss the available options.

products.name: Skimmed Milk Powder
products.description: Skimmed Milk Powder (SMP) is produced by spray-drying fresh pasteurized skimmed cow's milk. It is suitable for a wide range of applications, including the reconstitution of milk, dairy products, bakery goods, chocolate, confectionery, cheese and ice cream. We offer Skimmed Milk Powder in several specifications, including different heat treatment levels, and from various origins. Please contact us to discuss the available options.

products.name: Sweet Whey Powder
products.description: Sweet Whey Powder (SWP) is produced by spray-drying fresh whey obtained during the cheese-making process. Made from 100% cow's milk, it is heat-treated at no less than 72°C for 15 seconds (or an equivalent temperature/time combination). Suitable for a wide range of food applications, it is commonly used in bakery products, ice cream, confectionery and yoghurt. It can also support proper colour development under high temperatures. We offer Sweet Whey Powder in several specifications and origins. Please contact us to discuss the available options.

products.name: Unsalted Lactic Butter
products.description: Unsalted Lactic Butter is made exclusively from pasteurized cow's cream. It is a solid, malleable water-in-oil emulsion. Ideal for bakery products, patisserie and laminated doughs such as croissants and puff pastry. It is also suitable for sauces, cooking and direct consumption as a premium spread. We offer Unsalted Lactic Butter in several specifications and origins. Please contact us to discuss the available options.
