products.name: Beamy Ready-to-Use Plant-Based Pasta Sauces
products.description: Beamy’s ready-to-use sauce range brings the taste of iconic Italian recipes into a 100% plant-based format, combining indulgent flavour, satisfying textures and everyday convenience. Crafted with pea protein and designed to deliver a rich and rewarding eating experience, these sauces offer an easy way to enjoy familiar Italian favourites with a plant-based twist. Ready to use and highly versatile, the range is available in three recipes: Plant-based Bolognese, Plant-based Cacio e Pepe and Plant-based Carbonara.

products.name: Goodly Oat Spread
products.description: Goodly transforms gluten-free oats into an irresistibly c reamy spread , offering a delicious new way to enjoy plant-based indulgence. 100% plant-based, dairy-free and soy-free, it is rich in fibre and crafted for consumers looking for great taste, quality and something different from traditional spreads. Its smooth, velvety texture and rich, comforting flavour make it perfect throughout the day, from breakfast to an indulgent snack. A distinctive and free-from option that combines pleasure, versatility and everyday convenience.

products.name: Goodly Oat flakes
products.description: Goodly’s oat flakes range is designed to combine quality, versatility and everyday nutrition in a naturally simple ingredient. Made from carefully selected oats and produced through a fully controlled Italian supply chain, the range offers two formats to suit different uses: Large Oat Flakes , ideal for breakfast, baking and both sweet and savoury recipes, and Wholegrain Porridge Oats , with smaller flakes that create a smooth, satisfying texture and are perfect for porridge and a wide variety of preparations. Rich in fibre and a source of protein , both products are gluten-free and allergen-free , offering a reliable and versatile choice for consumers looking for wholesome ingredients with consistent quality.

products.name: Beamy Dry mix for plant-based Protein mash
products.description: Legume-based dry mix for preparing a 100% plant-based mash, rich in protein and low in fat. Quick and easy to prepare, it delivers a smooth and velvety texture in just a few minutes. Gluten-free and soy-free, it is ideal as a nutritious side dish or as a base for creative recipes.

products.name: Beamy Dry mix for plant-based Mince
products.description: A versatile legume-based dry mix for preparing a delicious 100% plant-based mince with a satisfying texture and great flavour. Gluten-free and soy-free, it is quick and easy to prepare: simply add water and vegetable oil to create a ready-to-cook mince that can be used in a wide variety of dishes. Ideal for pasta sauces, lasagna, tacos, stuffed vegetables and many other recipes, it offers a convenient and flexible way to bring plant-based creativity to everyday cooking.

products.name: Beamy Dry mix for plant-based Bolognese
products.description: A practical legume-based dry mix for preparing a rich and flavourful 100% plant-based Bolognese sauce. Gluten-free and soy-free, it is quick and easy to prepare: simply add tomato pulp and a few basic ingredients to create a hearty sauce with a satisfying texture and full-bodied flavour. Perfect for pasta, lasagna, baked dishes and fillings, it brings the taste and versatility of a classic Bolognese to modern plant-based cooking.

products.name: Beamy Dry mix for plant-based Egg Alternatives
products.description: Plant-based dry mix designed to replicate the functional properties of eggs. Easy to prepare by simply adding cold water, it provides a practical and reliable solution for vegan cooking. Suitable for a wide range of sweet and savoury recipes, including omelettes, scrambled “eggs”, sauces, cakes and sweet creams, ensuring consistent, high-quality results across multiple applications.

products.name: Beamy Dry mix for vegetable Medallions
products.description: A versatile legume-based mix, ideal for preparing 100% plant-based veggie medallions and a wide range of recipes. Quick and easy to prepare, it simply requires the addition of water and oil to obtain a workable mixture, perfect for making burgers, veggie balls, medallions and other creative dishes. Rich in protein and fibre, it is available in three flavour varieties designed to suit every taste: beetroot, tomato & olive, and carrot & spinach.

products.name: Beamy Dry mix for Plant-based Meat Alternatives (Burger & Veggie balls)
products.description: Legume-based dry mix for preparing 100% plant-based burgers and veggie balls. Gluten-free and soy-free, it is quick and easy to prepare, offering a versatile solution for a wide range of recipes and serving occasions. Simply add water and vegetable oil to create a ready-to-cook mixture with a consistent texture and excellent versatility in the kitchen. Ideal for burgers, veggie balls and other creative and tasty plant-based preparations. Available in four flavours: Beef, Chicken, Curry and Spicy.

products.name: Mr.Beans Protein Cream
products.description: Mr. Beans Protein Spread is an innovative plant-based spread made with Italian legumes and cocoa , created to combine indulgent taste with strong nutritional value. Naturally free from gluten, soy, milk and nuts, it is rich in protein and fibre and offers a balanced alternative to traditional sweet spreads. Smooth, satisfying and versatile, it is perfect for breakfast, snacks or whenever you want a delicious plant-based treat. A distinctive way to rediscover legumes in an unexpected, enjoyable format.

products.name: Mr.Beans Italian legume puffs
products.description: Mr. Beans Savoury Snacks reinvent the way to enjoy legumes with irresistibly crunchy, flavour-packed bites made from a blend of 100% Italian legume flours. Rich in protein and fibre, gluten-free, non-GMO and not fried, they combine great taste with a distinctive plant-based recipe designed for every snacking occasion. Perfect as an on-the-go snack, a mid-day break or an aperitivo, they offer a bold and satisfying alternative to conventional savoury snacks. Available in three flavours: Sea Salt, Vegan Cheese and Wasabi.

products.name: Goodly Natural Plant Protein Easy Cake mix
products.description: Goodly Natural Plant Protein Easy Cake Mix is an innovative 100% plant-based blend made with selected legume protein concentrates, created to make delicious high-protein baking simple and convenient. Gluten-free , rich in protein and fibre , and with no added sugars, it combines strong nutritional value with ease of preparation and reliable results. Simply add water to create soft, indulgent cakes with a satisfying texture, ideal for chocolate cakes, mug cakes and a wide variety of sweet baked treats. A versatile solution for enjoying plant-based desserts without compromising on taste or convenience. Available in two formats : 450 g and 180 g.

products.name: Mais Corvino Biscuits
products.description: Mais Corvino Biscuits bring the distinctive character of this ancient Italian corn variety into a naturally indulgent sweet treat. Made with 100% plant-based ingredients and gluten-free, they combine a rustic texture with a rich, satisfying taste, offering an original alternative to conventional biscuits. Perfect for breakfast, coffee breaks or an everyday snack, they turn the unique personality of Mais Corvino into a versatile and enjoyable product. Available in three flavours: Vanilla, Pistachio and Chocolate Chips.

products.name: Mr.Beans Delicious Chickpea and Cocoa Spread
products.description: Mr. Beans Chickpea & Cocoa Spread is a delicious 100% plant-based spread made with chickpeas and cocoa, created to offer a surprisingly indulgent way to enjoy legumes. Naturally dairy-free and nut-free , and a source of fibre , it combines a smooth, creamy texture with a rich cocoa taste for a satisfying everyday treat. Perfect for breakfast, snacks or spreading on toast, pancakes and baked goods, it offers a distinctive alternative to traditional sweet spreads and brings a playful new twist to plant-based indulgence.

products.name: Mais Corvino Puffed Cakes

There’s something for everyone.

products.name: bread roll variety
products.description: Fresh and crisp with a soft, moist interior – that’s how rolls should be. With this belief firmly anchored at the heart of our work, DEH considers the quality of bread rolls to be our first and most important concern. Customers often choose their regular shopping spots according to the quality of the rolls. Available in four convenience levels from the raw dough, pre-proofed dough, par- and fully baked rolls, we offer the right product for every purpose: Classic wheat rolls and special rolls decorated with delicious seeds, sweet rolls as well as baguette, snack and party buns. The immense variety and outstanding quality of our bread rolls are what sets us apart.

products.name: fried pastries
products.description: At DEH you will find the most varied range of fried pastries: small, large, sugar-coated, glazed, colorful, fruity, creamy or with chocolate. Our jelly-filled doughnuts have brought home the DLG award several times now, and are a highlight not just in carnival season or on New Year‘s Eve. The deep-frozen fried pastries are flexible to use. After thawing, they are ready for sale and ready for consumption.

products.name: mini berliner
products.description: The new Mini Berliner addresses the growing "small bites" trend by offering sweet indulgence in a convenient bite-sized format. Measuring approximately 53 mm in diameter and a weight of 24 g, they are ideal as a snack for any occasion. Fried in premium sunflower oil, the light and airy dough delivers a wonderfully soft texture. Combined with a perfectly balanced dough-to-filling ratio, the Mini Berliner becomes an ideal impulse purchase.

products.name: danish pastry
products.description: These products cater to the desire for familiar bakery goods with a fresh contemporary twist. The “Franzbrötchen” flavors mentioned are also available as Danish pastry swirls, such as Poppy Seed and Nut Pastries .

products.name: pizza donut
products.description: Two Innovations set to drive impulse sales One of the highlights for the impulse and convenience segment is the new Pizza Donut . Unlike many comparable products, the Pizza Donut is a real donut . The light yeast dough is traditionally deep-fried in oil and only then topped with savory fillings. Thanks to the traditional deep-frying process, the Pizza Donut combines all the familiar quality characteristics of a donut: a light crumb, long-lasting freshness, and extended shelf life. The result is a moist, savory donut with a flavorful garlic filling – a completely new taste experience in the snack segment. The Pizza Donut is available in two flavors: Cheesy and Margherita – each 80 g. Both varieties can even be conveniently prepared in an air fryer at 160 to 180°C within just five to seven minutes

products.name: Tuna Steak in olive oil
products.description: Rizzoli Tuna Steak in olive oil, Yellowfin quality, with a drizzle of oil. More practical and better for the environment: the can contains less oil than the standard 80g can. By not having to drain the can, it avoids dispersing the oil into the environment while safeguarding water resources and soils. Fished responsibly with non-trimming nets and in accordance with the practices of ISSF (International Seafood Sustainability Foundation), which promotes and protects the transparency, traceability and sustainability of tuna fishing while preserving other species and future availability. Also Dolphine Safe certified, for respect of marine wildlife. Rizzoli Tuna Steak in olive oil is a source of Omega 3 and phosphorus, rich in protein, vitamin B12 and iodine, a handy ingredient that should never be missing from your pantry for quick and tasty recipes.

products.name: Anchovy Fillets in extra virgin olive oil
products.description: One of Rizzoli’s great classics, the firm and meaty Anchovy Fillets in extra virgin olive oil are kept in the historic golden tin. The delicacy of the oil enhances the natural flavor of the anchovies without covering it, giving an authentic and unmistakable taste. Matured for a period of at least four months in barrels, when they have reached the right degree of ripeness and the meats are firm and flavorful, they are manually arranged in tins one by one and packed in extra virgin olive oil. Icons of taste and style.

products.name: Anchovies in Spiced Sauce 90g
products.description: Rizzoli Anchovies in Spiced Sauce are the symbol of our history and tradition, stretching back more than a 120 years. The recipe has never changed; it is a jealously guarded secret, transmitted orally down through the generations. This is the only way to create a speciality that has rightfully earned pride of place in the Italian food tradition. “Any real food lover will mop up every drop with some bread!” The spices and vegetables in the Sauce arrive here fresh, and we prepare and cook them slowly. And then it takes a long time for the Sauce to age in oak wood barrels that previously contained Marsala wine.

products.name: Anchovy Fillets from the Cantabrian Sea in 100% italian oil
products.description: North of Spain, the Atlantic Ocean is called the Cantabrian Sea. The waters of this sea are cold, rich in oxygen and plankton; these special conditions make the anchovies meaty and flavorful. Processed entirely by hand, on the day, at the fishing site and left to age for long periods in temperature-controlled barrels. This is why they are the best in size, flesh and taste. MSC-certified anchovies from sustainable fisheries that ensure that a strict standard is met in terms of environmental sustainability without compromising the balance of ecosystems.

products.name: Anchovy Paste in Olive Oil
products.description: Rizzoli’s Anchovy Paste in olive oil is made by combining our best anchovies carefully ground with oil, salt and natural flavorings. A soft specialty to enjoy on crostini, on pizza, in salads, on pasta or as an ingredient for the tastiest recipes. The 60 g tube format is practical and safe, perfect for storing in the refrigerator after opening.

products.name: Anchovy Fillets from the Cantabrian Sea in olive oil
products.description: Anchovy fillets from the Cantabrian Sea are the result of a high-quality artisanal process. From fishing to packaging, everything is executed to perfection. Due to its cold waters rich in oxygen and plankton, anchovies caught in this sea are unique. In addition, we only catch them in the spring when they are larger and full-bodied. MSC-certified anchovies from sustainable fisheries that ensure that a strict standard is met in terms of environmental sustainability without compromising the balance of ecosystems.

products.name: Peter's Farm
products.description: Premium veal from Peter's Farm is top-quality meat that is tender, lean and easily digestible. Peter's Farm calves are kept in a unique stall system. At Peter's Farm veal, we do things slightly differently. Peter's Farm calves live in herds of around 40 animals. There are skippy balls and brushes hanging within these spacious stalls to encourage activity. Moreover, anyone can take a look inside the stall themselves online via one of the webcams. Our commitment to animal welfare, including rest and freedom for our calves, forms the basis for the high quality of our products. First-class packaging and labelling, together with a wealth of support, information and educational materials, provides you with all the quality assurance you need to make the veal from Peter's Farm a success in your organisation.

products.name: JAN
products.description: The products in JAN's range are made from the best cuts of veal. JAN proves that quality and convenience go well together. From succulent veal burgers to sous vide cooked veal products, experience veal like you have never done before. Jan: a typically Dutch name at first sight. But also a name with a rich history. Jan represents the family history of the VanDrie Group. It was Jan van Drie who, with the first calf he bought, laid the basis for the way we now enjoy the tastiest and best veal. Veal from which Jan now also makes the tastiest ready-to-cook products. Putting processed and time-consuming meat dishes on the table in no time at all without compromising on quality or flavour; with JAN's veal products that’s possible. From osso buco to spareribs, careful preparation techniques like sous vide cooking put these classics within everyone's reach. For the advanced chef a welcome addition, for the consumer a user-friendly way of preparing veal. With JAN, we give you a convenience product that ties in with your specific needs. Specialised and proven recipes, tailor-made packaging and availability in the fresh and frozen segment.

products.name: Vitender
products.description: A beautiful, deep pink colour, more bite and slightly heavier meat than regular veal; that's Vitender. Vitender is the young rosé veal of VanDrie Group. The meat comes from calves aged six to eight months. The unique taste and characteristics arise from the feed being slightly different than with the other meat concepts. Vitender has competitive pricing and is easy to prepare. A perfect product for commercial kitchens, catering companies and the meat processing industry.

products.name: Tendriade
products.description: At Tendriade, we dedicate all our expertise to taste and quality. Committed to a responsible supply chain that respects animal welfare, we offer you tender and flavorful veal from carefully managed farms.

products.name: Gourmet
products.description: Our Gourmet portioned convenience products bring together flavourful veal and attractive presentation. A guaranteed bestseller in your refrigerated display. The innovative packaging method keeps the products fresh longer. The packaging preserves juices and flavour. The pieces also remain perfectly in place, even when the product is hung on a rack or placed on a sloping shelf. Attractive packaging that ensures longer shelf life; this is how we can reduce food waste. Gourmet finds its way into the kitchens of many connoisseurs every day and above all it is easy to prepare. Quality on the table in no time. Isn’t that what everybody wants?

products.name: Friander
products.description: If you want truly young beef, choose Friander. Its delicious taste, pleasant structure, ease of preparation and favourable pricing mean Friander should not be missed in the range. The meat comes from calves aged between eight and twelve months. Through a rich diet, in which versatile compound feed predominates, and the specific knowledge and skills of the veal farmer, Friander positions itself attractively between veal and beef.

products.name: VanDrie Controlled Quality Veal
products.description: VanDrie Controlled Quality Veal is veal with a mild flavour that we have enjoyed for generations. The meat is tender, easily digestible, low in cholesterol and rich in vitamins and minerals. It is a wonderful meat product that easily fits into any varied menu. The veal comes from our own chain. The calves are well looked after by the farmers we collaborate with, many of whom we have worked with for generations. Quality assurance throughout the chain allows us to provide the best guarantees on animal welfare, food safety and traceability. This is the strength of VanDrie Group's integrated chain.

products.name: Ameco Premium Select
products.description: Especially for top restaurants, Ameco selects the best quality meat from Dutch beef. Recognizable by the golden label. The extreme marbling of the meat gives it special properties during preparation. A true taste sensation for the restaurant visitor!

products.name: Ajvar
products.description: Ajvar is a traditional condiment, spread, or relish called ajvar, originating from the Leskovac area. The ajvar is produced exclusively from local red pepper varieties. The peppers are roasted over an open flame and they are cleaned, minced, dried, and fried slowly and by hand. The flavor is pleasant and peppery as this ajvar shouldn't contain any parts of seeds nor the dark and charred parts of skin that comes off during the roasting process. Ajvar can be sweet, piquant or hot.

products.name: Dried Chanterelle and Porcini mushrooms

Boletus edulis, known as Cep, Porcini or Penny-bun Bolete, is a most sought-after edible wild mushroom. Porcini mushrooms are a cult favourite in the culinary arts because of their rich flavour and numerous health benefits. They are, for example, high on antioxidants and a good source of proteins.

Bagna Cauda is usually served with traditional vegetables of Piedmont like grilled peppers, cardoons, boiled cauliflower, radish, leeks, carrots, lettuce, steamed potatoes, baked onions and red chard. products.name: Rer rice of the emperors

It owes its color and nutritional properties to the skin that surrounds it. It has a subtle and delicate taste and is rich in fiber, vitamins and minerals. It can be cooked in salads, or as an accompaniment to meat, fish or vegetables.

products.name: Black forbiden rice
products.description: In its "Céréales du monde" range, Sabarot offers you the exclusive black forbidden rice. This rice is exclusively reserved for the Chinese Emperor, and therefore only consumed in the Forbidden City, and has a nutty taste. In addition to being tasty, this forbidden rice has a high nutritional value (rich in essential amino acids, antioxidants, fiber and minerals). So treat yourself: in a salad, as a side dish or even as a dessert!

products.name: Extra dried morels
products.description: Sabarot morels are selected with the utmost care to offer you a noble product with a powerful flavor that pairs wonderfully with meat or fish dishes, but also enhances simple dishes like potatoes or pasta. The extra morels are whole, so you benefit from all the parts of the morel that provide its full aroma. Feel free to use the rehydration water to intensify the flavor even further! For over 30 years, Sabarot has been creating supply chains worldwide to ensure the quality and origins of its mushrooms. All Sabarot mushrooms are rigorously selected before being packaged in France, in the Haute-Loire department, in the heart of Auvergne. Sabarot’s primary goal remains the high-end production of regional products, in line with the company's tradition and the gastronomic reputation of the region.

products.name: Burgundy snails
products.description: Selected in keeping with French gastronomic tradition, our Burgundy snails ( Helix pomatia ) offer foodservice and specialty retail professionals consistent quality and effortless preparation. They stand out for their tender yet firm texture, ideal for your shells, pastries, or gratins.

products.name: Extra porcini mushrooms
products.description: Sabarot porcini mushrooms, like other mushrooms, are selected with the greatest care. The porcini mushrooms is very often considered as one of the best mushrooms of the undergrowth! In a pan, in a sauce or simply with some potatoes or on pasta, it is a real treat.

products.name: Bamboo rice 400 g
products.description: Bamboo rice is characterized by its unique pale green color and delicate taste with hints of pantes. It is rich in vitamin B and antioxidants. After cooking, bamboo rice has a moist and sticky texture. This makes it ideal for risottos or sushi. It can also be used as a side dish and will bring a colorful and unique touch to all your dishes! (Available in 1 kg).

products.name: France green lentils
products.description: These green lentils are packaged in France, they have a very good resistance to cooking, to consume in soups, salads, verrines, mashed potatoes or simply as a side vegetable.

products.name: Cèpes extra in jar 37 cl
products.description: Sabarot extra porcini are quick and easy to use. Whether pan-fried or in omelettes, you'll be flavouring your meals in no time at all.

products.name: France pois cassés 500g
products.description: Les pois secs et les petits pois proviennent de la même plante. Le légume sec est récolté à maturité alors que le pois est récolté avant. Une fois la peau retirée, la graine se sépare en deux cotylédons pour donner le pois cassé vert, ou jaune s'il est exposé à la lumière. Le pois cassé peut être consommé en accompagnement d'une viande, d'un poisson ou en purée.

products.name: Blond Lentils
products.description: The history of lentils goes back to the Neolithic period. They were then much larger than they are today, and were already part of the diet of the Egyptians, Greeks and Romans. Larger than the green lentil, the blond lentil can be eaten as a velouté or, why not, a hummus? Easy to prepare, blond lentils lend themselves to all kinds of fantasies: in soups, salads, verrines or purées.

products.name: Le Puy green lentils A.O.P.
products.description: Formerly A.O.C. and now A.O.P., Le Puy green lentils is the result of an agriculture respectful of nature. With its incomparable taste and recognized worldwide by the greatest chefs, this product from the Haute Loire region benefits from the microclimate of the volcanic soil of Velay. Its taste and texture (firm when cooked) are obtained thanks to the soil of Haute Loire. Don't hesitate to cook it in salads, with a little salt, fish, or even as a dessert.

products.description: Truffles are a typical product of the Langa region, still shrouded in mystery today as they were in the past. From September to January, the ‘Trifolau’ (truffle hunters) accompanied by their faithful dogs search for them under brambles and lime trees. Gran Cucina produces truffle condiments with white and black truffle to dress delicious risotti, succulent first courses and delicate velvety soups

products.name: RED PESTO
products.description: From the most traditional sauces of Liguria, Gran Cucina creates a refined and delicious taste. Pesto in sauce is the classic pesto recipe enriched with a sun-dried tomato sauce, while Pesto al Pomodoro has a fresh tomato sauce added to it. These two condiments are the perfect accompaniment to Gran Cucina pasta such as tagliolini or egg tagliatelle. Our red pestos have a very delicate flavour.

products.name: GASTRONOMIC SHORT PASTA
products.description: Our short pasta, on the other hand, represents a new expression of Italian tradition. Unique on the market, it reinterprets one of the most classic shapes in a multicoloured and lively version, where craftsmanship meets modern creativity. Natural vegetable and spice powders (non-GMO) give subtle nuances of flavour and maintain bright colours even after cooking, for a striking visual impact.

products.name: GASTRONIMIC LONG PASTA
products.description: Our long pasta (tagliatelle, tagliolino, pappardella) is made using a traditional rolling process that creates a thin, elastic sheet of pasta, guaranteeing superior texture and firmness. After being folded and cut, it is slowly dried at a low temperature for about 24 hours, keeping the properties of the wheat intact and offering a perfectly “al dente” result. We use only 100% Italian eggs and 100% Italian durum wheat semolina, for a pasta that increases in volume during cooking, resulting in a full and substantial texture on the palate.

products.name: PIEDMONTESE SAUCES
products.description: Bagna cauda sauce (literally” hot sauce”) is a traditional condiment which dates back to the late Middle Ages when the farmers created a new and unusual dish: a rustic dish, with distinct flavours that contradicted the usual meals of each day. The prestigious garlic, the salty anchovy and the olive oil create a tasty dish for the winter. Bagna Cauda is usually served with traditional vegetables of Piedmont like grilled peppers, cardoons, boiled cauliflower, radish, leeks, carrots, lettuce, steamed potatoes, baked onions and red chard. It also goes well as a pasta sauce and with boiled or scrambled eggs.

products.name: GENOVESE PESTO
products.description: The fresh, fragrant leaves of Genovese basil create a pure symphony when combined with the authentic flavour of Pecorino and Grana Padano cheese. It is the most authentic pesto, with the scent of summer. This Ligurian sauce, known throughout the world, is prepared with the most authentic and high-quality ingredients such as Genovese Basil PDO, pine nuts, Grana Padano and Pecorino cheeses, and the finest olive oil and extra virgin olive oil. Our fresh Genovese pesto, prepared with care and skill, is the only one on the market that is neither pasteurised nor sterilised, with a shelf life of two years at room temperature and no chemical additives. It is prepared according to tradition, giving it a grainy texture and the typical bright green colour of fresh Genovese basil. It is a flavourful sauce that is ideal not only for pasta dishes such as spaghetti, tagliatelle or linguine, but also for adding flavour to vegetable soups and boiled meats.

products.name: ITALIAN PESTOS - PISTACHIO, LEMON, GARLIC AND CHILLI PEPPER PESTOS
products.description: A recipe that preserves the green colour of pistachios as well as a very concentrated texture and flavour, Our pistachio pesto, with its distinctive flavour, is widely used to enrich first courses, like pasta, gnocchi or risotto, excellent on bruschetta, leavened products (baguettes, focaccia). Garlic, oil and chilli pepper is one of the simplest recipes in Italian cuisine, a flagship of Italian sauces. It is perfect to dress pasta, but can also be used to prepare hot bruschettas. The lemon pesto is a recipe with refined and aromatic Mediterranean flavours that evokes the Neapolitan coast with its limoncello and the scents of Sicily. It is an excellent condiment to pair with pasta (cold or hot) such as our lemon tagliatelle. All pestos are excellent as a base for fish crostini or meat and fish dishes.

products.name: Canned tuna
products.description: Ecuador is the world's first banana exporter, offering premium Cavendish bananas ( Musa paradisiaca ) with availability and production throughout the year. Ecuador's geographical location provides ideal climate conditions that influence the quality, flavor and longer shelf-life of the fruit compared to other producing countries. Rich in Vitamin A, C, folic acid, B complex, Vitamin E, potassium, iron and magnesium. Aids digestion and helps neutralize acidity. Planted area: 190,381 hectares, of which 95% are for export, producing approximately 1,900 boxes per hectare. Certifications: GlobalG.A.P., Fairtrade, USDA Organic, Rainforest Alliance, BASC.

products.name: Quinoa
products.description: Ecuadorian quinoa ( Chenopodium quinoa ) has unique organoleptic and nutritional properties compared to quinoa produced in other markets. Grown in the inter-Andean valleys at altitudes of 2,500 to 3,800 meters above sea level, it has a distinctive golden color and is known as "golden quinoa." Quinoa is valued as the only food of vegetable origin that contains all essential amino acids, trace elements and vitamins, and does not contain gluten. It is a great source of calcium, iron and vitamin B. Ecuadorian quinoa is only lightly polished, maintaining its organoleptic characteristics through an environmentally friendly and lower cost industrial process. Available in two varieties: Tunkahuan (sweet, low saponin) and Pata de Venado (sweet, low saponin, organic).

products.name: Avocadoes
products.description: Ecuadorian Hass avocados ( Persea americana ) are grown in the highlands and coastal regions, offering two harvest seasons throughout the year highland production from January to April and August to December, and coastal production from March to July, ensuring near year-round availability. Rich in monounsaturated fats, vitamins E, A, B1, B2, B3, fatty acids, proteins and minerals. Helps lower blood cholesterol and supports hemoglobin formation.

products.name: Goldern Berries
products.description: Ecuadorian golden berries ( Physalis peruviana ) are a true Andean superfood, packed with nutrients and recognized worldwide for their exceptional nutritional profile. Ecuador's great biodiversity produces multiple ecotypes of this exotic fruit. Rich in vitamins A, B1, B2, B3, B9, C, E, K and provitamin A, as well as fiber, potassium, calcium, iron and phosphorus. Considered a nutritious option as a first solid food for babies. Estimated production of 546 hectares. Packed in 1.2kg cardboard boxes, 180 to 240 boxes per pallet, 20 to 22 pallets per container. Certification: GlobalG.A.P. Preferential tariff 0% under the EU-Ecuador Trade Agreement.

products.name: Chocolate
products.description: Ecuadorian chocolate made from Nacional and/or CCN-51 cocoa offers floral and fruity flavors that are unique in the world. The industry is fully configurable and can develop new products in accordance with the technical specifications of international consumers. Available in different percentages of cocoa: 55%, 70%, 75%, 80% and 100%, with ingredients such as nuts, dried fruit and superfoods, as well as milk and sugar chocolate for mass market consumption. The consumption of dark chocolate reduces stress levels thanks to the production of endorphins that give the body a sense of well-being. Chocolate mixed with fruit multiplies the health benefits and provides a quick source of energy.

products.name: Pineaple
products.description: Ecuadorian pineapples ( Ananas comosus ) have an incomparable flavor thanks to the microclimate of the country, resulting in excellent quality, flavor, sweetness, texture and color, making Ecuador the 7th largest pineapple producer and exporter worldwide. The main variety is Golden Sweet (MD2), characterized by its sweet taste, size and aroma, with a perfect balance between sweetness and acidity and a long shelf life.¡

products.name: Green Coffee
products.description: Ecuadorian green coffee ( Coffea arabica / Coffea canephora ) is one of the best coffees produced in South America. Harvesting takes place manually to ensure product quality and good agricultural practices. Mixed planting is used in plantations with fruit trees, rainforests and conservation areas, ensuring environmental protection. Various ecosystems permit coffee to be grown throughout the country, even in the Galapagos Islands. Specialty coffee has achieved scores above 91 points on the SCA scale in cupping events. The origin denominations "Lojano Café de Origen" and "Café de Galápagos" protect the identity and quality of the coffee.

products.name: Shrimps
products.description: Ecuador is the world's leading producer of white shrimp and shrimp is the country's main non-oil export product. Ecuadorian white shrimp ( Penaeus vannamei ) is recognized globally for its exceptional flavor, quality and texture. Free of chemicals and antibiotics, it is an important source of protein, Omega-3, and Vitamins B12, D and E. Available raw or cooked, whole (HOSO) or tails (HLSO, P&D, PUD, PPV, EZ Peel), in block or IQF format. Over 200,000 hectares of farms ensure year-round supply. Certifications: GlobalG.A.P., BRC, BASC, BAP, HACCP, Bio Suisse, Organic EU. Preferential tariff 0% under the EU-Ecuador Trade Agreement.

products.name: Dragon Fruit
products.description: Ecuadorian dragon fruit ( Hylocereus spp ) is an exotic fruit whose climatic and soil conditions produce an intense aroma and very refreshing, sweet pulp. Available in two varieties: Yellow pitahaya, characterized by its thorny skin, 8 to 10cm in size, white pulp with small black seeds and sweet juicy flavor; and Red pitahaya, with a thick rind, larger size (12cm), white pulp with small black seeds and sweet juicy flavor.

products.name: Green Plantain
products.description: Ecuadorian green plantains ( Musa paradisiaca ), Barraganete variety, are grown in ideal climate conditions that ensure constant production throughout the year. With high nutritional value, they are an important source of potassium, magnesium and phosphate, which helps prevent hypertension and heart attacks. Rich in vitamins A, B6 and C, high in fiber and carbohydrates. Cooked green, they are beneficial for diabetics as they contain a complex carbohydrate released very slowly over time.

products.name: Taro
products.description: Ecuadorian taro ( Xanthosoma sagittifolium ) has distinctive characteristics due to climatic conditions that promote quality products with high nutritional value, produced in an environment free of synthetic fertilizers and agrochemicals. Available in two varieties: Blanca Xanthosoma and Lilia Colacasia. Taro provides nutrients, carbohydrates and proteins, and contains large amounts of dietary fiber which helps regulate the digestive process and lower cholesterol. It is a short-cycle crop planted and harvested throughout the year.

products.name: Mangoes
products.description: Ecuadorian mangoes ( Mangifera indica ) stand out for their unique tropical flavor and fragrance due to ideal soil conditions. Available in four varieties: Tommy Atkins, Ataulfo, Kent and Keitt, in red or yellow depending on the variety. Rich in more than 20 different vitamins and minerals. Ecuador has approximately 7,700 hectares in production, of which 5,500 are dedicated to export.

products.name: Cacao
products.description: Ecuador is the third largest cocoa producer in the world, with approximately 600,000 hectares under cultivation and a production capacity of 360,000 tons. Two main varieties are offered: Fine Aroma Cocoa (Nacional), recognized worldwide for its unique aroma and flavor, used as the base ingredient for premium gourmet chocolates; and CCN-51, known for its high yield for large-scale chocolate production. Archaeological research has found traces of cocoa in the Ecuadorian Amazon dating back more than 5,000 years, proving that chocolate originated in Ecuador.

products.name: Snacks
products.description: Ecuadorian snacks are mainly made with green plantains, ripe plantains, cassava, taro, native Andean potatoes, sweet potatoes, beets and other vegetables. Among them, chifles crispy green plantain chips are the most iconic and sought-after Ecuadorian snack in international markets, recognized for their unique crunch, natural flavor and clean ingredients. Snack exporters have innovated the production process and most exporting companies hold internationally recognized quality certifications, allowing products to enter the most demanding world markets. Products are marketed worldwide under own brands and private labels.

products.name: Sweet Passion Fruit
products.description: Ecuadorian sweet passion fruit ( Passiflora ligularis ) is a native variety known for its anti-stress properties and exceptional nutritional value. With a round oval shape, orange skin when ripe and a sweetness of 14 to 17 degrees Brix, it stands out for its refreshing and juicy flavor. It is an excellent source of vitamins A, B1, B2, B3, B9, C, E and K, as well as fiber, potassium, calcium, iron and phosphorus. Estimated production of 900 hectares. Each piece is individually protected by foam mesh and packed in 2kg cardboard boxes, 160 boxes per pallet. Certification: GlobalG.A.P. Preferential tariff 0% under the EU-Ecuador Trade Agreement.

products.name: ORGANIC GLUTEN FREE BUCKWHEAT PENNE
products.description: For over 10 years, our facility has included a dedicated laboratory exclusively devoted to gluten-free flour processing. In this area, we work with a variety of flours such as rice, whole rice, corn, buckwheat, oat, amaranth, and quinoa, transforming them into different pasta shapes including tagliatelle, penne, fusilli, maccheroni, and lasagna. Most of these flours are sourced from Italian agriculture, and we use only water to transform them into pasta. Our mission is to produce organic pasta, and our gluten-free range is designed not only for people with coeliac disease, but also for those who value the nutritional benefits of a varied diet based on different grains. We strongly believe in the importance of incorporating a diversity of cereals into everyday nutrition, which is why we have developed this range. In addition, we also use vegetables in our gluten-free recipes to enhance both flavour and natural colour, offering even more variety and appeal.

products.name: ORGANIC EGG PASTA TAJARIN
products.description: Egg pasta is a traditional specialty of our region. The name “tajarin” refers to thin, hand-cut tagliolini, prepared just as our grandmothers used to make them. Today, we offer a wide range of egg pasta shapes, including tagliolini, tagliatelle, pappardelle, lasagne and fusilloni. Our long pasta is still hand-nested, preserving the authentic look and feel of homemade pasta, while fusilloni are bronze-die extruded to achieve a distinctive rustic texture.

products.name: ORGANIC RED LENTILS FUSILLI GLUTEN FREE
products.description: Pasta d’Alba offers a complete range of legume-based pasta, crafted from carefully selected Italian-grown raw materials. We work exclusively with red lentils, green peas, and chickpeas, sourced from specific regions across Central and Southern Italy, ensuring full traceability and origin control. These legumes are transformed into a variety of traditional pasta shapes, including tagliatelle, fusilli, maccheroni, penne, gnocchetti and lasagne. Legume pasta is increasingly appreciated worldwide for its nutritional benefits and versatility. Naturally rich in plant-based proteins, it is particularly suited for vegan and vegetarian diets, as well as for athletes and consumers seeking high-protein food alternatives. Thanks to its already high protein content, this range pairs perfectly with vegetable-based sauces, offering a balanced, nutritious, and contemporary meal solution.

products.name: ORGANIC DURUM WHEAT CASERECCE
products.description: Semolina wheat pasta is one of the most iconic expressions of traditional Italian cuisine. We use exclusively certified organic Italian durum wheat, which we transform simply by adding water, in full respect of traditional methods. Our range includes a selection of long pasta such as tagliolini, tagliatelle, pappardelle, and spaghetti, as well as a variety of short, bronze-die extruded shapes, including penne, fusilli, gigli, maccheroni, caserecce, fusilloni, paccheri, and many more.

products.name: ORGANIC TURMERIC TAGLIOLINI
products.description: While traditional plain pasta remains a cornerstone of Italian cuisine, a significant part of our assortment is enhanced with carefully selected ingredients directly incorporated into the flour, creating distinctive, value-added products. Vegetables Rooted in the Italian tradition of everyday pasta consumption, our vegetable range is designed to elevate daily meals with both taste and functionality. We use spinach, beetroot, carrot, and tomato—natural sources of fiber, vitamins, and minerals that enrich both the nutritional profile and visual appeal of the product. Herbs and spices Our herb and spice-infused pasta combines flavor with natural functionality. Turmeric is included for its well-known antioxidant properties, while nettle provides a natural source of iron and micronutrients. Aromatic herbs such as basil and sage complete the range, delivering refined flavor profiles and authentic character. Chestnut & mushrooms Inspired by the culinary heritage of our region, chestnut and mushrooms add depth and authenticity to our recipes. Our mushroom range features porcini mushrooms, highly valued in Italian gastronomy for their intense aroma and premium quality.

products.name: ORGANIC GLUTEN FREE WHOLE RICE AND HULLED LEGUMES DINOSAURS
products.description: At Pasta d’Alba, we believe that healthy eating habits begin from the very first meals. Inspired by our passion for quality and nutrition, we have created a premium organic pasta collection dedicated to babies and young children. Designed for the weaning stage and beyond, our Baby Pasta Collection combines carefully selected organic ingredients with fun, child-friendly shapes that transform every meal into a delightful experience. Our assortment includes a wide variety of miniature pasta shapes, including dinosaurs, alphabet letters, vehicles, stars, boats, airplanes, angel hair, elbows, orzo, and many more, perfectly sized for little hands and growing appetites.

products.name: RISO CARNAROLI
products.description: Carnaroli rice was born in 1945 from the crossing of Vialone and Lencino rice; Like Vialone, it has a not small grain, but unlike the latter it has an elongated grain. Carnaroli rice can be considered the best quality rice of all varieties of rice and in many respects it represents excellence among all Italian varieties of rice. The starch of Carnaroli rice is the richest in amylose, a substance that helps to make the grain consistent while always keeping it al dente. Its unrivaled gastronomic aptitudes lie in its excellent absorption capacity of aromas and condiments and in the balanced release of starch during cooking which allows it to mix and enhance the most diverse flavors and foods, therefore also suitable for the preparation of rich salads and tasty timbales. The cultivation of Carnaroli rice is not simple and therefore there has never been a large production of this variety of rice. Among the varieties of Italian rice, Carnaroli rice is the one that requires the most attention because it is mainly subject to imitations.
