products.name: SUGO ALLA NERANO "GLI AUTENTICI"
products.description: The year was 1952, when at the bay of Marina del Cantone, in the small rural village of Nerano, on the Amalfi coast, to satisfy the appetite of a certain prince of Sirignano, who had dropped in unannounced, the owner of the 'Maria Grazia' restaurant, Signora Rosa, allegedly prepared the famous 'Spaghetti alla Nerano' by making do with the few ingredients she had on hand at the time of her unexpected visit, courgettes and cheese. Legends aside, the ingredients needed for this dish are indeed few, but first-rate. Rustichella d'Abruzzo in its 'Autentici' is inspired by the taste and simplicity of the original recipe to bring one of the best-loved condiments of Neapolitan cuisine to your table.

products.name: PAPPARDELLE ALL'UOVO
products.description: "Pe 'fa' is the delicacy of the recipe you don't need a graduate côca, and even if the thing is remedied you will lick your fork pure." Thus said one of Aldo Fabrizi's sonnets on Pappardelle all'uovo, the most representative format of Lazio and Tuscany, territories rich in game and therefore homelands of traditional meat-based recipes. Wild boar, mushrooms, sausage and truffles are just some of the condiments that can be used to create recipes with a unique taste, made even more special by the texture of this format.

products.name: TONNARELLI AGLI SPINACI
products.description: Artisan pasta format flavored with spinach leaves from Italian cultivation, similar to Spaghetti but with a larger diameter, it goes well with an organic Rustichella tomato and basil or Arrabbiata sauce, or an unpasteurized organic Pesto alla Genovese from Rustichella d'Abruzzo.

products.name: GNOCCHI DI PATATE
products.description: Potato gnocchi made with 5% more durum wheat semolina than the traditional recipe, which gives a better texture to the gnocco making it even softer and more full-bodied. We recommend pairing with all the white and red Rustichella d'Abruzzo sauces, accompanied by a drizzle of INTOSSO Rustichella raw extra virgin olive oil.

products.name: PANETTONCINO GLASSATO ROSA
products.description: Pink-glazed mini panettone Limited Edition; a great classic that simply can’t be missing from the Christmas table.

products.name: TUBO DALI - WORLD PASTA DAY 2025
products.description: With the "Dalí Tube," the dreamlike imagination of the surrealist painter is transformed into a bold and surprising pairing. Imagine crossing a landscape suspended between reality and dream: the tonnarelli with pepper and lemon release an unusual balance, between the spiciness of the pepper and the citrusy freshness of the lemon, while the pistachio pesto reflects the rich colors and boundless creativity typical of his works. Just like in a painting where nothing is as it seems, in the kitchen each bite transports you to a parallel universe, where the boldest combinations become poetry. A gift for those who love to be surprised and want to bring an extraordinary taste experience to the table. In this tube you will find: Tonnarelli with Pepper and Lemon (500g) Pistachio Pesto (130g) Wooden Fork from Rustichella d’Abruzzo

products.name: SUGO ALLE OLIVE
products.description: Ready sauce prepared by slow boiling of tomato pulp, typical of the Italian tradition, with black Leccine olives and extra virgin olive oil from the Aprutino Pescarese area.

products.name: LASAGNE ALL'UOVO
products.description: Lasagne Rustichella d'Abruzzo, thin rough and porous egg sheets like those prepared at home and perfect for holding the sauce in the best way, are prepared with a higher number of fresh eggs, about 7 per kilo of semolina. Lasagne are the undisputed protagonists of traditional and gourmet recipes based on vegetables, or as a tasty timbale filled with grilled aubergines, buffalo mozzarella and fresh tomatoes. If, on the other hand, you prefer the classic flavors of the Italian culinary tradition, we recommend pairing it with a White Sausage Ragù or a Genovese Sauce by Rustichella d'Abruzzo.

products.name: FUSILLI MAIS BIO SENZA GLUTINE
products.description: All the flavor of corn enclosed in a specialty produced using only organic raw materials of Italian origin, controlled and selected. We recommend the combination with the "Ortolana" sauce or the "Norma" Rustichella d'Abruzzo sauce.

products.name: SPAGHETTI RISO INTEGRALE BIO SENZA GLUTINE
products.description: They are the most famous and sold format in the world, the symbol of Italianness abroad. They owe their name to their resemblance to "small strings" due to their thin and elongated shape and are present in all regional culinary traditions: from north to south of Italy. Made by Rustichella d'Abruzzo with 100% organic brown rice flour, pure water from our mountains and our classic artisan production process, they preserve all the organoleptic qualities while maintaining essential vitamins and amino acids for the body. Spaghetti is extremely versatile and goes perfectly with most toppings. Universally preferred and appreciated is the classic combination with Rustichella d'Abruzzo fresh tomato sauce and basil. To better appreciate its texture, we recommend the simplest of the recipes, with Rustichella d'Abruzzo Extra Virgin Olive Oil and Pecorino di Farindola.

products.name: FUSILLI COL BUCO
products.description: This format originally from Campania, with a shape similar to an elongated Fusillo, was made by Neapolitan housewives by rolling a bucatini around a knitting needle. Delicious with a simple tomato and basil sauce or Pecorara Rustichella d'Abruzzo, accompanied by Pecorino di Farindola and Rustichella d'Abruzzo Extra Virgin Olive Oil.

products.name: TUBO MAGRITTE - WORLD PASTA DAY 2025
products.description: The "Magritte Tube" is a tribute to the enigmatic surrealism of René Magritte, where reality and imagination challenge each other in a play of symbols. The artisanal linguine, soft yet defined in their contours, evoke the precision of his compositions, while the classic Genoese pesto, with its bright green color, recalls a clear sky crossed by surreal clouds. This combination unites the tangibility of high-quality pasta with the dreaminess of a fresh and enveloping sauce: a dish that invites reflection, just like Magritte’s paintings, on the fine line between what we see and what we imagine. An unexpected taste experience, perfect for those who wish to bring a touch of mystery and creativity to the table. In this tube you will find: Linguine (500g) Genoese Pesto (130g) Wooden Fork from Rustichella d'Abruzzo

products.name: FREGOLA TOSTATA
products.description: Originally from Sardinia, this artisan pasta shape is made only with durum wheat semolina and water by "rubbing" the semolina in a large earthenware basin, where a mixture of water and saffron is sprinkled (which gives the wonderful intense yellow color) and where "by hand" these irregularly shaped balls of semolina are made and then toasted in the oven. The traditional recipe calls for Fregola cooked with clams or seafood risotto with lemon zest or with turnip greens, cherry tomatoes, garlic and Parmigiano Reggiano; alternatively it is possible to season this characteristic format with roasted courgettes, cherry tomatoes and Rustichella d'Abruzzo Extra Virgin Olive Oil flavored with Chilli, or according to the recipe of the starred Chef William Zonfa, who cooks it with artisan sausage, blueberry and Extra Oil Virgin of Olive INTOSSO PrimoGrano Rustichella d'Abruzzo.

products.name: FARRO DICOCCUM CHICCHI
products.description: Controlled from sowing to harvesting, our TRITICUM DICOCCUM spelled fields belong to a controlled supply chain, which began as early as 2004 with the PrimoGrano project when the possibility of tracing crops from sowing was still beginning to be discussed in Abruzzo. Whole Farro is ideal for summer salads based on cherry tomatoes, capers, flakes of Parmesan, fragrant basil, buffalo morsels and monocultivar oil Evo INTOSSO PrimoGrano Rustichella, or as a base for tasty and fresh appetizers, or as a first course for based on fresh sautéed vegetables and a drizzle of INTOSSO PrimoGrano Rustichella monocultivar oil.

products.name: TUBO GLI AUTENTICI - AMATRICIANA
products.description: A tube that safeguards an Italian icon: authentic Amatriciana, prepared with real guanciale from Amatrice and fragrant tomatoes. The bucatini, with their true and genuine soul, wrap the sauce in a full embrace, creating a bold and unforgettable bite. A sincere tribute to the purest tradition. In this tube you will find: - 1 Wooden Fork - 1 Rustichella d'Abruzzo Bucatini 500g - 1 Gli Autentici Amatriciana Sauce 300g

products.name: TORTIGLIONI GRANO SARACENO
products.description: Contrary to what the name would suggest, Buckwheat is not a cereal but an annual herbaceous plant, belonging to the Polygonaceae family. There are two hypotheses on the origin of the name: the first attributes it to the color of the Saracens' skin as it is dark, the second because it was widespread in Italy by the Saracens. It differs from common cereals for the high biological value of its proteins, which contain the eight essential amino acids in optimal proportions. With remineralizing and energizing properties, as it has high levels of magnesium and manganese, Tortiglioni are also a tasty alternative to a gourmet first course.

products.name: PACCHERINI AL MELOGRANO
products.description: "Punica granatum", originally from Asia Minor (Persia and Afghanistan), the pomegranate and its fruits reached Europe thanks to Phoenician merchants. The name derives from “apple” because it recalls its shape and color and “grain” for the internal consistency of the seeds, very similar to corn. Protagonist of countless stories and legends, in the Greek world this plant was sacred to Juno and Venus. In ancient Rome, brides wove pomegranate branches in their hair, a symbol of fertility and wealth. Maximum splendor in art and culture occurs in the Renaissance, a subject present in the works of Caravaggio and a fruit used to make the dishes of Italian and European banquets unique.

products.name: PANETTONCINO GLASSATO CIOCCOLATO
products.description: Chocolate mini panettone Limited Edition; a great classic that simply can’t be missing from the Christmas table.

products.name: SUGO POMODORO E BASILICO
products.description: Ready sauce prepared by slow boiling of tomato pulp, extra virgin olive oil from the Aprutino Pescarese area, basil, carrots, onion and salt; just like it used to be. To be consumed at room temperature or slightly heated over low heat.

products.name: PENNE RIGATE
products.description: One of the best known and best-selling short pasta shapes in the world, they are traditionally combined with the "alla Arrabbiata", "alla Amatriciana" or "alla Norma" Rustichella d'Abruzzo sauce or with a fresh and light tuna-based sauce, mozzarella and cherry tomatoes or with scampi and zucchini.

products.name: TUBO GLI AUTENTICI - PUTTANESCA
products.description: Bold, direct, impossible to ignore: Puttanesca is an explosion of Mediterranean flavors; with capers, olives, and bright tomato. The Spaghettone del Leone, thick and proud, responds with character, offering a chewiness that amplifies every note of the sauce. A daring dish that conquers from the very first taste. In this tube you will find: - 1 Wooden Fork - 1 Rustichella d'Abruzzo Spaghettone del Leone 500g - 1 Gli Autentici Puttanesca Sauce 300g

products.name: GNOCCHI DI PATATE GLUTEN FREE
products.description: Potato gnocchi with an even softer and more full-bodied texture. The classic recipe sees them cooked "alla Sorrentina" with smoked provola and homemade tomato sauce. We also suggest pairing it with two particular Rustichella d'Abruzzo condiments: the Abruzzo Pear Tomato PrimoGrano in pieces with salted ricotta, and the White Ragù with "Porcini Mushrooms".

products.name: CREMA DI BASILICO
products.description: Made through an innovative production process with no pasteurization, which makes it top quality even in its flavour. Perfect for preparing a fresh summer first course, for example combined with Rustichella d’Abruzzo Pizzichi di Farro. The perfume of basil adds the final touch even to your seafood-based and meat-based dishes. To be consumed at room temperature or slightly heated at low flame. After opening keep refrigerated and consume within 3-4 days.

products.name: TROFIE
products.description: Originally from Liguria, this artisan pasta format is traditionally served with pesto, seasonal green beans and potatoes, or with cherry tomatoes, courgettes and Parmigiano Reggiano or asparagus and ham. They also go well with organically grown tomatoes and basil or Genovese Rustichella d’Abruzzo.

products.name: PENNETTE RIGATE
products.description: With a smaller diameter than penne rigate, this particular shape of short pasta is known to be the most used in the creation of a first course with "Vodka and pancetta" dressing or with "pachino" tomatoes and basil, or with an "all 'Ortolana ”or Rustichella d'Abruzzo“ Peperoni ”.

products.name: PANETTONE GLASSATO PISTACCHIO
products.description: Panettone filled with “Sicilian Pistachio” cream. The intense pistachio flavor is enclosed in a soft dough made with sourdough starter.

products.name: SUGO ALLA CARBONARA
products.description: Typical dressing of the Italian tradition with eggs, smoked bacon, cheese and extra virgin olive oil from the Aprutino Pescarese area. It goes wonderfully with Spaghettone PrimoGrano and Spaghettone del Leone Rustichella d’Abruzzo.

products.name: LAGANELLE ALL'UOVO LIMONE
products.description: Give yourself a moment of happiness with Rustichella d'Abruzzo lemon Laganelle, prepared with high quality durum wheat semolina, fresh eggs and lemon juice added to the dough, bronze drawn and dried at low temperature, to give to the pastry an unmatched texture. The scent of lemon combined with that of fresh eggs will captivate you right from the opening of the package. We advise you to prepare them with a condiment based on seafood, bottarga and a drizzle of INTOSSO PrimoGrano Rustichella monocultivar Extra Virgin Olive Oil, or to combine them with our Marinara Clams sauce.

products.name: LINGUINE
products.description: Of the same length as spaghetti but with a rectangular shape, linguine is one of the classic shapes of the Rustichella d’Abruzzo line. The bronze drawing and low temperature drying make the texture of this format perfect for fish-based condiments such as seafood, shrimp and zucchini, or Rustichella d’Abruzzo "pesto alla Genovese".

products.name: PANETTONCINO GLASSATO PISTACCHIO
products.description: Pistachio mini panettone Limited Edition; a great classic that simply can’t be missing from the Christmas table.

products.name: ORZO PASTA
products.description: Particular pasta shape similar to barley grains, ideal for the preparation of legume soups, vegetable soups or simply as a pasta in broth. Also recommended for a cold pasta salad with cherry tomatoes, mozzarella, basil and extra virgin olive oil flavored with Rustichella d’Abruzzo porcini mushrooms, or more simply as a "healthy" appetizer with INTOSSO Rustichella d’Abruzzo extra virgin olive oil.

products.name: POMODORO A PEZZI PERA D'ABRUZZO PRIMOGRANO
products.description: The specialty of the PrimoGrano Line, the autochthonous tomato variety called "Pera" grows in Abruzzo, is unique in its kind and different from all other types of tomato. Cultivated for centuries, it is characterized by the fact that it has very few seeds, is very pulpy, and has a weight between 300 and 500 grams. Particularly suitable for the preparation of sauces, its sweet and velvety taste, combined with its low acidity, characterizes this vegetable making it more valuable than the more common varieties. To better appreciate its organoleptic properties, we recommend using the "raw" Abruzzo Pear Tomato, tossing it in a pan together with the pasta, and adding only a drizzle of INTOSSO PrimoGrano Extra Virgin Olive Oil with a few fragrant basil leaves.

products.name: PANETTONE GLASSATO MANDORLE
products.description: A crunchy coating of icing and almonds over a raisin-enriched dough, a great classic that simply can’t be missing from the Christmas table.

products.name: SALSA TARTUFATA
products.description: Produced through an innovative production process that does not require pasteurization and enhances the quality of the ingredients, the truffle sauce has the plus of the highest quality Molise truffles and Extra Virgin Olive Oil from the Aprutino Pescarese area

products.name: ORECCHIETTE DEL PRETE
products.description: Handicraft format typical of the Puglia region, takes its name from the characteristic shape of small ears made by pressing the dough with the thumb. The classic recipe sees them prepared "alla Pugliese" with turnip tops, sausage and garlic but they also go well with a full-bodied meat sauce. They can be combined with Pecorara sauce or Rustichella d’Abruzzo sausage.

products.name: PANETTONCINO
products.description: Mini panettone; a great classic that simply can’t be missing from the Christmas table.

products.name: SUGO ALL'AMATRICIANA "GLI AUTENTICI"
products.description: There is no real Amatriciana without guanciale amatriciano. Rustichella d'Abruzzo takes up the ancient recipe according to tradition. In addition to the ever-present guanciale di Amatrice, it uses products from the Abruzzo region such as red garlic from Sulmona among the ingredients.

products.name: PACCHERINI BLUE SKY
products.description: With a blue color, the new Blue Sky with Spirulina Algae and bergamot essential oil are ready to conquer you.

products.name: CASARECCIA INTEGRALE BIO SENATORE CAPPELLI
products.description: Type of Fusilli in a "double S" shape, with a characteristic central groove, originally from Sicily, but also known in other regions of Southern Italy. It combines well with Rustichella d'Abruzzo meat sauce and condiments with vegetables or seafood.

products.name: PAPPARDELLE ALL'UOVO IN ROSA
products.description: A tribute to the strength and beauty of women. A gesture of celebration, a symbol of unity, an invitation to share. Every dish tells stories of courage, passion, and uniqueness. Rustichella d'Abruzzo celebrates women all over the world.

products.name: SPAGHETTONI PRIMOGRANO
products.description: Spaghettone is a classic that cannot be missing on your tables. Produced with 100% Abruzzo durum wheat semolina, bronze drawn and dried at low temperature, it has an unmistakable texture and aroma of wheat. The recipe par excellence sees it as protagonist in Carbonara or in combination with some white and red Rustichella d'Abruzzo condiments, such as "Cacio e Pepe" or "Salsiccia".

products.name: MEZZEMANICHE
products.description: With its cylindrical shape, this short format is widely used during the summer, in combination with seafood-based condiments or scampi and zucchini. They also go very well with different sauces such as "alla Bolognese", "alla Salsiccia", "alle Olives" and "Tomato and Basil" Rustichella d'Abruzzo.

products.name: CONDIMENTO PASTA CACIO E PEPE
products.description: Typical condiment of Roman cuisine, made by following the traditional recipe. To be consumed at room temperature or slightly heated at low flame. After opening keep refrigerated and consume within 3-4 days.

products.name: PANDORINO
products.description: Mini pandoro; a great classic that simply can’t be missing from the Christmas table.

products.name: RIGATONI
products.description: This short pasta shape, which has longitudinal grooves, is one most used in the creation of first courses based on seafood, scampi and zucchini, with mushrooms and truffles or stuffed, but also as a base for a baked pasta, season for example with aubergines and mozzarella.

products.name: FETTUCCINE INTEGRALI BIO SENATORE CAPPELLI
products.description: The Rustichella d'Abruzzo organic whole wheat fettuccine "Senatore Cappelli" have the unmistakable rusticity and intense aroma of the wheat of the past. They are bronze drawn and slowly dried at low temperatures, so as to present a unique texture capable of accommodating and retaining any type of condiment. Extremely versatile in the kitchen, they are perfect with fish-based condiments such as shelled prawns, crispy leeks and organic Rustichella Extra Virgin Olive Oil, or with an organic Genovese pesto from Rustichella d’Abruzzo.

products.name: PANETTONE CIOCC.MONORIGINE
products.description: Dark Chocolate Monorigine Panettone with Cocoa Beans from São Tomé

products.name: SUGO ALLA TERAMANA "GLI AUTENTICI"
products.description: A taste of Abruzzese Sunday lunches: rich tomato sauce with tender, bite-sized meatballs, prepared according to tradition. A generous and comforting recipe from Gli Autentici, bringing the warmth of home cooking to every dish.

products.name: OLIO E.V. D'OLIVA VARIETA' INTOSSO
products.description: The INTOSSO Monocultivar Extra Virgin Olive Oil is a superior category oil obtained directly by cold pressing of freshly picked Abruzzo olives, and solely by means of mechanical procedures. With a delicate flavor, traditionally harmonious and balanced, the INTOSSO has clear aromas of artichoke and tomato leaf on the nose, fruity and intense in its nuances. In the ancient Abruzzo tradition, the INTOSSO variety of olives was consumed as a table fruit throughout the year, and after long salting and governing procedures, it was preserved in terracotta basins.

products.name: PENNE RUSTICHE PRIMOGRANO
products.description: One of the most known and appreciated shapes in the world made with 100% Abruzzese durum wheat semolina, bronze drawn and dried at low temperature, which is used in many recipes: mushrooms, sausage and saffron or the traditional ragù all'abruzzese and Pecorino di Farindola. It also goes very well with all Rustichella d'Abruzzo white and red sauces.

products.name: BUCATINI
products.description: Similar to thicker Spaghetti, they take their name from the characteristic central hole. It combines well with full-bodied sauces such as "Amatriciana" (made with pork or bacon and tomato), "Carbonara" and "Cacio e Pepe", without disdaining a fish-based condiment such as sardines and mussels, typical Sicilian dishes.

products.name: PANETTONCINO LIMITED EDITION
products.description: Mini panettone in the Limited Edition version; a great classic that simply can’t be missing from the Christmas table.

products.name: TUBO BOTTICELLI - WORLD PASTA DAY 2025
products.description: The "Botticelli Tube" is a tribute to the grace and harmony that characterize the work of the Renaissance master. Just like in his famous paintings, where every detail is visual poetry, this tube encloses delicate and balanced flavors, capable of evoking the lightness of a Spring or the ethereal beauty of a Venus. The selected ingredients harmonize with elegance, creating a refined and harmonious tasting experience. It is an invitation to rediscover the simplicity of beauty, transforming every dish into a small masterpiece to be enjoyed slowly and with wonder. In this tube you will find: Spaghetti (500g) Tomato & Basil Sauce (270g) Wooden Fork from Rustichella d'Abruzzo

products.name: LAGANELLE ALL'UOVO TARTUFO
products.description: The intense scent of black truffle blends with the enveloping one of fresh eggs and durum wheat semolina to give you an unforgettable culinary experience. Try the Truffle Laganelle from Rustichella d'Abruzzo in the classic recipe with porcini mushrooms, walnuts and for truffle lovers, fragrant flakes of black truffle from Alba. We also suggest pairing with our Truffle Sauce or Porcini Mushroom Sauce, accompanied by a drizzle of INTOSSO PrimoGrano Rustichella d'Abruzzo monocultivar Extra Virgin Olive Oil.

products.name: RAGU' ALLA GENOVESE "GLI AUTENTICI"
products.description: It can truly be considered the pride of Neapolitan cuisine. There are various theories about the origin of the dish's name, some believing that sugo alla genovese is related to the Genoese cooks present in Naples during the Aragonese period in the 15th century, who cooked meat-based sauces with which to season pasta. This sauce is mentioned as 'raguetto' in Cavalcanti's famous recipe book in the 19th century, albeit in a less elaborate version. This recipe could not be missing from Rustichella d'Abruzzo's authentic traditional sauces, a true homage to the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies.

products.name: MACCHERONI (STORTINI)
products.description: Short pasta format similar to the letter "C", it prefers vegetable and fresh ricotta based sauces or a simple tomato and basil sauce. Ideal with Rustichella d'Abruzzo "all'Ortolana" and "alle Olive" sauces.

products.name: CAPELLINI
products.description: With a diameter between 0.85 mm and 0.92 mm, this format of "thin spaghetti" is one of the most popular of the Rustichella d'Abruzzo line, and goes well with broth or soup, or can be sautéed with a sauce of oil, ginger, lemon zest and Sichuan pepper, or simply seasoned with fresh tomato sauce and basil.

products.name: PACCHERINI AL BERGAMOTTO
products.description: The origins of bergamot are uncertain and shrouded in an aura of mystery. Legend has it that the plant was imported by Christopher Columbus from the Canary Islands, arriving in Reggio Calabria from the Spanish city of Berga, hence its name. The first bergamot plantation was the work, in 1750, of the owner Nicola Parisi along the coast of the Giunchi. Harmonious and pleasant, its essence is used as an antidepressant and antioxidant.

products.name: PENNINE
products.description: With a smaller diameter than penne and with a longer length, this short pasta shape goes very well with vegetable sauces but also with a simple Rustichella d'Abruzzo tomato and basil sauce.

products.name: SAGNE A PEZZI PRIMOGRANO
products.description: Typical format of the local culinary tradition made with 100% Abruzzese durum wheat semolina, bronze drawn and dried at low temperature, it is perfect in legume soups, as well as with beans, crispy bacon and Extra Virgin Olive Oil INTOSSO Rustichella d ' Abruzzo or with scrambled eggs and "cace e ove" livers. It also goes very well with a Rustichella d'Abruzzo "Salsiccia" or "Ragù Bianco" sauce.

products.name: TUBO DEGAS - WORLD PASTA DAY 2025
products.description: Delicacy and harmony coexist in the "Tubo Degas," a tribute to the French painter famous for his elegance and lightness. The saffron tonnarelli bring a golden hue that recalls the reflections of light in his studies of bodies in motion, while the cacio e pepe sauce, iconic of Roman tradition, offers a refined and velvety touch. This pairing unites the grace of saffron’s color with the aristocratic simplicity of cacio e pepe, creating a dish that is balanced, sophisticated, and at the same time familiar. Perfect for those seeking a culinary experience that is sober yet full of nuances, just like the delicate dancing figures portrayed by Edgar Degas. In this tube you will find: Saffron Tonnarelli (500g) Cacio e Pepe Sauce (180g) Wooden Fork from Rustichella d’Abruzzo

products.name: TUBO GLI AUTENTICI - NERANO
products.description: The magic of Nerano is born from the encounter between zucchini, basil, and that velvety touch of cheese that makes it unique. The trenne, with their welcoming shape, collect and protect the creaminess of the sauce in a perfect balance. A dish that tells of the simplicity and beauty of the Coast. In this tube you will find: - 1 Wooden Fork - 1 Rustichella d'Abruzzo Trenne 500g - 1 Gli Autentici Nerano Sauce 300g

products.name: SUGO AI PEPERONI
products.description: Ready sauce prepared by slow boiling of tomato pulp, typical of the Italian tradition, with peppers and extra virgin olive oil from the Aprutino Pescarese area. The combination of Creste di Gallo and Rustichella d'Abruzzo "Malloreddus" Sardinian Gnocchi is particularly suitable. To be consumed at room temperature or slightly heated over low heat.

products.name: LAGANELLE ALL'UOVO ZAFFERANO
products.description: Fresh eggs and high quality durum wheat semolina accompany the main ingredient of this format, the Saffron DOP of L'Aquila, added to the pistil mixture to give you a unique gourmet experience. Try the Laganelle Rustichella d'Abruzzo with crispy bacon, a leek fondue, Abruzzo pecorino and a sprinkling of saffron for lovers of this precious spice. We suggest pairing with our Sausage sauce accompanied by sautéed radicchio and a drizzle of INTOSSO PrimoGrano Rustichella d'Abruzzo monocultivar oil.

products.name: PENNE RIGATE RISO INTEGRALE BIO SENZA GLUTINE
products.description: Loved all over the Peninsula, penne rigate are characterized by the typical oblique "nib" cut, proverbial for their versatility in the kitchen thanks to the "design" that allows you to better retain any sauce inside, and the presence of deep grooves that favor the condiments to adhere better. Produced with only 100% organic brown rice flour and with an artisan production process characterized by slow drying at low temperature, they retain all their organoleptic properties and are perfect for the preparation of pasta dishes with meat-based sauces, or accompanied by condiments. based on vegetables such as peppers, courgettes and artichokes. Try them also with an organic "Arrabbiata" sauce by Rustichella d'Abruzzo.

products.name: TUBO GLI AUTENTICI - TERAMANA
products.description: Teramana, rich in Abruzzese tradition, combines tomato, meat, and aromas in a warm and enveloping balance. The egg Chitarrone, rough and generous, gives softness and intensity to every forkful. A dish that smells of family Sundays. In this tube you will find: - 1 Wooden Fork - 1 Rustichella d'Abruzzo Le Rustichelle 500g - 1 Gli Autentici Teramana Sauce 300g

products.name: STUZZICARELLI AL PEPERONCINO
products.description: For lovers of spicy notes, the Chilli Stuzzicarelli, made by Rustichella d'Abruzzo by adding to the mixture of fresh eggs and durum wheat semolina, chili powder, could not be missing, for an experience of true passion on the palate. The texture, also visible to the naked eye, allows the dressing to totally embrace the Stuzzicarello which is indissolubly linked to the pasta as in an embrace between lovers. We suggest preparing them with pecorino fondue and crispy bacon, or combining them with our Genovese sauce, for lovers of intense flavors, or with Clams alla Marinara for lovers of seafood recipes.

products.name: CALAMARATA
products.description: Rustichella d’Abruzzo Calamarata is named after the calamari (Italian for ‘squid’) and looks like their rings. It is produced on Saturdays because the drying process needs to last 40 hours. The classic recipe is with seafood with a bit of Rustichella d’Abruzzo PrimoGrano INTOSSO extra virgin olive oil and parsley. We recommend it with Rustichella d’Abruzzo “alle Vongole alla Marinara” sauce or “alla Napoletana” sauce with a bit of Rustichella d’Abruzzo chili-pepper-aromatized extra virgin olive oil.

products.name: SPAGHETTI MAIS BIO SENZA GLUTINE
products.description: All the flavor of corn enclosed in a specialty produced using only organic raw materials of Italian origin, controlled and selected. We recommend the combination with the "Ortolana" sauce or the "Norma" Rustichella d'Abruzzo sauce.

products.name: SUGO ALLA PUTTANESCA "GLI AUTENTICI"
products.description: A great classic for fish sauces. Puttanesca is tomato sauce with 'aulive e chiappariell', olives and capers in Neapolitan dialect. Rustichella d'Abruzzo loves tradition and brings to your tables the recipe as it was once made but only with highly selected ingredients from the land of Trinacria.

products.name: TAGLIATELLE ALL'UOVO
products.description: The genuine Emilian tradition and the ancient Abruzzo pasta art enclosed in an egg nest rich in flavors and aromas. Let yourself be captivated by the scent and texture of Rustichella d'Abruzzo Tagliatelle Nests, designed to make all those traditional recipes that are still handed down from mother to daughter. We suggest pairing it with our Bolognese sauces and Porcini Mushrooms, or the Tartufata, accompanied by a drizzle of INTOSSO PrimoGrano Rustichella d'Abruzzo monocultivar Extra Virgin Olive Oil.

products.name: PICI
products.description: Similar to Spaghetti but wider, Pici represent one of the recent innovations of the Rustichella d'Abruzzo Regional Formats. The classic condiment with which they are accompanied is aglione, a tomato sauce combined with a particular type of garlic that is born and grows only in Sarteano (Siena) and surroundings, but can also be combined with a liver sauce or more simply alle criciole (crumbs of Tuscan bread fried in olive oil). We also recommend pairing with Porcini Mushroom Sauce and the delicious Rustichella d'Abruzzo Truffle.

products.name: RISO ARBORIO
products.description: Belonging to the category of superfine rice, Arborio rice was born in 1946 from the cross between Vialone rice and Lady Wright rice. It is a rice with very consistent and elongated grains, larger not only than Italian rice, but also larger than rice produced all over the world. Arborio is one of the varieties that is grown particularly in the Po valley, because it adapts well to the climatic conditions of the area, especially in the case of clayey and alluvial areas. Unmistakable thanks to its large and pearly beans and its high yield. During preparation, the grains cook perfectly and evenly, keeping the starch-rich central core al dente and always ensuring excellent creaming. Arborio rice is ideal for all risottos and for any preparation of dry rice, in particular for rich timbales.

products.name: CANDELE LUNGHE
products.description: One of the traditional types of pasta from Campania. Long, candle-shaped and thicker than 1 cm, this pasta needs to be snapped before being cooked in a pot. The traditional recipe is Candele Lunghe cooked in oven as a classic “red” timballo (meat ragu, mozzarella and Parmigiano Reggiano cheese) or “white” (besciamella sauce, artichokes, cherry tomatoes, olives and bufala mozzarella cheese). It combines well with sauces such as Rustichella d’Abruzzo “alla Pecorara” and “all’Ortolana”.

products.name: STUZZICARELLI AL NERO DI SEPPIA
products.description: The sea and its scents, colors and flavors. Rustichella d'Abruzzo Stuzzicarelli al Nero di Cuttlefish, prepared with fresh eggs, high quality durum wheat semolina and natural cuttlefish ink liquid, bring to your table the taste of the best seafood recipes. Try them with cod, a sprinkling of bottarga, fresh parsley and Rustichella d'Abruzzo extra virgin olive oil, or combine them with our Marinara clams with a drizzle of INTOSSO PrimoGrano Rustichella d'Abruzzo monocultivar oil and fresh parsley.

products.name: CHITARRA
products.description: Format similar to spaghetti but with a greater thickness and a square section instead of a round one, which derives from the typical tool used for its preparation (called "guitar"), which gives this pasta a decisive texture capable of completely capturing the condiment, which can range from a simple but delicious tomato and basil, to a more full-bodied and rustic one such as sausage and radicchio up to a more “healthy” one such as the “pesto alla Genovese” Rustichella d'Abruzzo.

products.name: PACCHERI
products.description: Originally from Campania, this macarone-like format is one of the most cooked in Italy and in the world. There are numerous recipes that see the Paccheri as protagonists: from prawns with porcini mushrooms and 'nduja, to mozzarella and pepper sauce, or with shrimp and mullet bottarga or even with cherry tomatoes and burrata, but also stuffed with asparagus and buffalo mozzarella or vegetable caponata.

products.name: SPAGHETTI BIO SENATORE CAPPELLI
products.description: They represent the most famous and sold format in the world, a symbol of Italianness abroad. Historically they owe their name to the resemblance to "small strings" due to their thin and elongated shape, and are present in all regional culinary traditions: from North to South of Italy. Spaghetti is extremely versatile and goes perfectly with We suggest the "healthy" combination with Rustichella d'Abruzzo organic tomato and basil sauce and a drizzle of raw Rustichella organic extra virgin olive oil.

products.name: PIZZICHI FARRO BIO
products.description: Special format similar to maltagliati but with crinkled edges, it is produced by Rustichella d'Abruzzo with only organic wholemeal spelled flour 100% from Abruzzo and the traditional Rustichella artisan production process that allows the pasta to retain its high quality. There are many recipes that lend themselves to this particular format: ideal to accompany a Tondino del Tavo Bean soup from the Rustichella PrimoGrano line seasoned with INTOSSO Extra Virgin Olive Oil, or in the "Viva l'Italia" version by Maria Stefania Peduzzi, owner of RdA, who prepares it in a summer version with pachino tomatoes, buffalo mozzarella, capers, INTOSSO PrimoGrano Extra Virgin Olive Oil and fresh basil.

products.name: FUSILLI
products.description: Originally from southern Italy, they were made in ancient times by expert hands, quickly twisting a piece of spaghetti around an iron. Today, fusilli represent one of the best known short pasta shapes in the world. Recommended with a "Sausage" or "Genovese" Rustichella d’Abruzzo sauce.

products.name: PESTO AL PISTACCHIO
products.description: Produced through an innovative production process that does not require pasteurization, and which makes it qualitatively superior even in taste without compromising the high quality of the ingredients, this type of pesto is produced with the precious pistachio of Bronte di Catania, with the plus Extra Virgin Olive Oil from the Aprutino Pescarese area. We recommend pairing with Rustichella d'Abruzzo 100% Abruzzese TRITICUM Farro formats.

products.name: TONNARELLI AL NERO DI SEPPIA
products.description: Artisan pasta format flavored with Squid Ink, similar to Spaghetti but with a larger diameter, it goes well with both fish-based sauces with rocket and cherry tomatoes, and in the "seas and mountains" version with prawns and bacon. Also perfectly in tune with an organic Tomato and Basil sauce or Rustichella d'Abruzzo Olives and a drizzle of Rustichella organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil.

products.name: TONNARELLI AI FUNGHI PORCINI
products.description: An artisanal pasta format flavored with Italian-grown porcini mushrooms, similar to Spaghetti but with a larger diameter, it goes well with an organic Rustichella tomato and basil or Arrabbiata sauce, or an organic unpasteurized Rustichella d'Abruzzo Pesto alla Genovese.

products.name: SUGO ALLA NAPOLETANA
products.description: Ready-made sauce prepared by slow boiling of tomato pulp with anchovy paste, parsley and extra virgin olive oil from the Aprutino Pescarese area. Absolutely to try with the Tonnarelli with cuttlefish ink and the long Rustichella d’Abruzzo spaghetti. To be consumed at room temperature or slightly heated over low heat.

products.name: SPAGHETTI FARRO BIO
products.description: The debut of the Rustichella d'Abruzzo spelled line dates back to 1991, the year in which our product was elected novelty of the year in Italy and set a sales record in the United States of America, following an article on the peculiarities of spelled appeared in the New York Times. The Spaghetti format is ideal for a lunch with friends where taste and lightness come together in a single moment. We suggest the combination with the organic Arrabbiata sauce for chilli pepper lovers, accompanied by a drizzle of raw Rustichella organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil, or the Rustichella organic Tomato and Basil sauce for lovers of delicate flavors.

products.name: RAGU' ALLA BOLOGNESE "GLI AUTENTICI"
products.description: The real rule for an authentic Bolognese is milk. This was said by the forefather of Italian cuisine, Pellegrino Artusi, author in 1891 of 'Science in the Kitchen and the Art of Eating Well'. His book contains a recipe for maccheroni alla Bolognese. When dressing the maccherone al dente, he advises: 'When the sauce is made, if you want to make it even more delicate, finally add half a glass of cream'. Rustichella d'Abruzzo confirms the original traditional version in its new recipe.

products.name: RICCIA
products.description: Formed with a shorter length than Riccia Lunga, it has the characteristic wavy edges that allow it to be combined with most of our condiments, from red to white, and is particularly suitable in ancient traditional Abruzzo recipes. Particularly appropriate is the combination with the sauce with Porcini Mushrooms and Norma di Rustichella d'Abruzzo.

products.name: PANETTONE ARANCIA E GOCCE DI CIOCCOLATO
products.description: Orange and chocolate chips panettone; a great classic that simply can’t be missing from the Christmas table.

products.name: CAVATELLI
products.description: Originally from Molise region, this type of artisan pasta in a lengthened shape and a groove on the inside, is widespread in Southern Italy. Its traditional recipe is with meat ragù or broccoli and sausage. It combines well also with Rustichella d’Abruzzo “ragù bianco con Porcini” and “sugo bianco alla Salsiccia” sauces.

products.name: GARGANELLI ALL'UOVO
products.description: The history of this format born in Emilia Romagna, known and highly appreciated especially abroad, is rich in historical and culinary anecdotes. Thanks to their particular shape and the stripes on the external surface, Garganelli with egg can be prepared in broth, as many traditional recipes want, combined with some of our full-bodied sauces such as those with Sausage or Olives, or prepared with a vegetable pesto, pine nuts and Pecorino cheese for lovers of a healthy and balanced lifestyle.

products.name: PAGLIA E FIENO ALL'UOVO
products.description: The Paglia e Fieno Tagliatelle with egg tell the story of all those families who still find themselves today to celebrate Sunday around a set table. The embrace between durum wheat semolina, fresh eggs and spinach, give the palate the joy of conviviality and traditional flavors. Try our specialty with full-bodied meat-based sauces or with more delicate vegetable-based sauces. Our suggestion is to try them with one of our Sausage, Olive and Genovese sauces, accompanied by a drizzle of INTOSSO PrimoGrano Rustichella d'Abruzzo monocultivar oil.

products.name: PANETTONE FICHI E CIOCCOLATO
products.description: Fig and chocolate panettone; a great classic that simply can’t be missing from the Christmas table.

products.name: TUBO CARAVAGGIO - WORLD PASTA DAY 2025
products.description: Inspired by the strong contrasts of light and shadow that made Michelangelo Merisi famous, the "Caravaggio Tube" offers an intense and passionate taste experience. The bright red of the chili in the tonnarelli and the deep warmth of the tomato and basil sauce evoke the dramatic color contrasts of his paintings, where every detail is sculpted by light. Opening this tube means immersing yourself in a theatrical atmosphere: the spicy notes alternate with the enveloping flavor of tomato, creating a play of opposites that highlights every ingredient. A tribute to the master of chiaroscuro, capable of transforming a simple meal into a sensory masterpiece. In this tube you will find: Chili Tonnarelli (500g) Tomato and Basil Sauce (270g) Wooden Fork from Rustichella d'Abruzzo

products.name: TUBO GLI AUTENTICI - GENOVESE
products.description: Time is the secret ingredient of Neapolitan Genovese: sweet onions that melt away, and meat that becomes silky - a fragrance that tells of the patience and love of Neapolitan kitchens. The strozzapreti catch this full-bodied sauce with elegance, holding onto its every nuance. A sincere encounter between intensity and tradition. In this tube you will find: - 1 Wooden Fork - 1 Rustichella d'Abruzzo Strozzapreti 500g - Gli Autentici Genovese Sauce 300g

products.name: CHITARRONE PRIMOGRANO
products.description: Format similar to spaghetti but with a greater thickness and a square section instead of a round one, which derives from the typical tool used for its preparation (called "guitar"), which gives this pasta a decisive texture capable of completely capturing the condiment, which can range from a simple but very good tomato and basil, to a more full-bodied and rustic one like sausage and radicchio up to a more “healthy” one like the “pesto alla Genovese” Rustichella d'Abruzzo.

products.name: FETTUCCINE ALL'UOVO
products.description: Who has never eaten a plate of egg fettuccine? Rustichella d'Abruzzo offers one of the most popular pasta shapes in the world in the "nest" version, which embodies traditions and flavors. The rough and porous texture and the intense aroma of durum wheat semolina and fresh eggs that is released when the package is opened will conquer your heart and your palate. Try them in a delicate version with our PrimoGrano Abruzzo Pear Tomato, a drizzle of INTOSSO PrimoGrano monocultivar Extra Virgin Olive Oil and a leaf of fresh basil, or, in combination with our Porcini Mushrooms, Sausage and Genovese sauces, and a sprinkling of Abruzzo pecorino.

products.name: TRAGHETTI PRIMOGRANO
products.description: Il Traghetto is made with 100% Abruzzo durum wheat semolina, bronze drawn and dried at low temperature. It is a particular format that goes very well with white fish dressings or with a nice homemade ragù. The sauces with "Porcini Mushrooms" and "Bianco alla Salsiccia" from Rustichella d'Abruzzo represent two further combinations that we recommend you try.

products.name: GNOCCHETTI
products.description: Originally from Sardinia and with a shape similar to a striped shell with a length of around 2 cm, they represent the most prepared traditional dish on all important occasions, from historical re-enactments to village festivals, passing through festivals and weddings. The simplicity of this format, which derives from the mixing of the best durum wheat semolina and water and from the bronze drawing with low temperature drying, is combined with the great variability of condiments that can be combined. The classic recipe is "alla Campinadese", which includes a sauce based on Sardinian sausage ragù, fried in Extra Virgin Olive Oil with chopped onion, tomato, saffron threads and grated Sardinian pecorino. Vegetable condiments range from the classic "broccoli and sausage" to a delicate pesto of spinach, almonds, Extra Virgin Olive Oil INTOSSO PrimoGrano Rustichella d'Abruzzo and Parmigiano Reggiano.

products.name: SPAGHETTINI
products.description: Made of the same length as spaghetti but with a smaller diameter and therefore shorter cooking time, the noodles go very well with Rustichella d'Abruzzo fish sauces or simply with garlic, oil and chilli.

products.name: PASSATA POMODORO PERA D'ABRUZZO PRIMOGRANO
products.description: Specialty of the PrimoGrano Line, the autochthonous tomato variety called "Pera" grows in Abruzzo, is unique in its kind and different from all other types of tomato. Cultivated for centuries, it is characterized by the fact that it has very few seeds, is very pulpy, and has a weight between 300 and 500 grams. Particularly suitable for the preparation of sauces, its sweet and velvety taste, combined with its low acidity, characterizes this vegetable making it more valuable than the more common varieties.

products.name: PESTO ALLA GENOVESE
products.description: Produced through an innovative production process that does not require pasteurization, and which makes it qualitatively superior even in taste without compromising the high quality of the ingredients, the classic Genoese pesto produced by Rustichella d'Abruzzo looks exactly like fresh pesto on the palate. freshly made at home, a feature that distinguishes it for quality and taste. The plus of the Extra Virgin Olive Oil from the Aprutino Pescarese area makes it a condiment that you cannot do without on your tables. We recommend pairing with Rustichella d'Abruzzo Giant Fusilloni. Together with fresh ricotta, it represents an alternative to the filling of Rustichella d'Abruzzo Cannelloni.

products.name: TONNARELLI PEPE E LIMONE
products.description: An artisanal pasta format flavoured with pepper and lemon from Italian cultivation, similar to Spaghetti but with a larger diameter, it goes well with an organic Rustichella tomato and basil sauce or Arrabbiata, or an unpasteurised Rustichella d'Abruzzo organic Pesto alla Genovese.

products.name: FETTUCCINE
products.description: Made with high quality durum wheat semolina and water, this classic format of Italian cuisine goes well with the "Bolognese sauce", prepared according to the traditional recipe with pork, veal and beef, minced meat and cooked in a fried butter, bacon and herbs, cooked with broth, red wine and tomato sauce, and generously covered with Parmesan.

products.name: CASARECCIA
products.description: Type of Fusilli in a "double S" shape, with a characteristic central groove, originally from Sicily, but also known in other regions of Southern Italy. It combines well with Rustichella d'Abruzzo meat sauce and condiments with vegetables or seafood.

products.name: Pane Guttiau flatbread 250g
products.description: Very similar to the famous Pane Carasau, this bread is made with a drop of extra virgin olive oil and a pinch of salt. Pane Guttiau is irresistible as an aperitif, delicious during a meal and the perfect accompaniment to clear and creamy soups. Weight : 250g

products.name: Savoiardone Biscuit 350g - soft savoiardi
products.description: The traditional recipe of Savoiardone di Sardegna the name deriving from the big size of the biscuit hasn’t changed for centuries as a symbol of authenticity, thanks to the lack of any preservatives or chemicals. The biscuit is prepared using only three Italian ingredients, including free-range chicken eggs 50%, sugar, and flour, and presents a distinctive softness compared to the other regional savoiardi. Weight : 350g

products.name: Pane Carasau flatbread 250g
products.description: Invented in Sardinia, loved throughout the world: this bread is tasty, crispy and as thin as a sheet of music. Its new 250g size makes any aperitif more enjoyable, it’s a delicious snack when paired with cured meats and cheese, and gives an original flavor to full-bodied first courses.

products.name: Fregula Tostata Ball of semolina 500g
products.description: These delicious small balls of durum wheat semolina and water are typical of Sardinian cuisine. They are perfect with tomato sauce and clams and a hint of cured fish roe.

products.name: Panscrok - crunchy healthy snacks
products.description: Sardinian bread has a new shape. Small balloons, crunchy and light, ideal for a tasty snack between meals. Delicious and appetizing flavors will conquer the palate of aperitif lovers. Flavours: Classic, Truffle, Pecorino cheese, Onion, Pizza, Rosemary

products.name: Malloreddus pasta 500g
products.description: Also known as small Sardinian gnocchi, malloreddus are typical of the island’s rich culinary heritage. Made from durum wheat semolina flour and water, they are delicious served with a rich, full-bodied sauce. Weight : 500g

products.name: Tiramisu Kit
products.description: The package contains 8 Savoiardoni di Sardegna, the preparation for the Tiramisù cream, soluble coffee powder, unsweetened cocoa powder and a convenient tray for the preparation. The consumer just needs to add only 400 ml of cream for desserts and the Tiramisu is ready. in just 10 minutes and 5 simple steps for preparation. The Kit allows you to create 8 portions of Tiramisu, easy, fast and fun to prepare. Our market research has allowed us to better analyze the tastes of consumers and in this way the recipe for cream and coffee has been perfected.

products.name: CURED BEEF
products.description: Only through meticulous, hand-selection, one by one, can we ensure that each piece is unique and of the highest quality. The passage of time and a slow curing process over several months then impart a unique and authentic flavor to this product. A delicacy worthy of the most discerning palates.

products.name: CURED WAGYU LOIN
products.description: The best of the best. This is cured Wagyu loin. Cured loin from the best wagyu with the highest infiltration. Marbling 9+. From authentic pure blood Wagyu. Only with a pure blood wagyu can you achieve maximum marbling. Highest quality cured wagyu that melts in your mouth. Incredibly soft. A delicacy at the height of the best palates. This product is suitable for HALAL consumption. Cured wagyu loin made with wagyu slaughtered with the Islamic rite.

products.name: BEEF CHORIZO
products.description: Homemade mild and spicy beef chorizo, totally natural, without additives. Made with La Vera paprika and top quality lean pork. Very slow curing, so that it does not have any acidity. We make with the best quality of each of the best ingredients that go into our chorizo: beef meat, paprika with Protected Designation of Origin from La Vera, garlic from Las Pedroñeras and sea salt. But what will end up giving all the particularities to the chorizo is the slow curing, so that it does not have any acidity and reaches the maximum bouquet and thus achieves the most traditional flavor.

products.name: CURED WAGYU
products.description: Wagyu is a japanese breed of steer with exquisite meat. It is identified by its characteristic marbling or fatty infiltration in the muscle fibers, which gives it a soft texture that makes it melt in the mouth. For this reason, it is considered by many experts to be “the best meat in the world.” With this famous meat, we make WAGYU cured meat, with a unique aroma and flavor. The cut of the pieces has great grain to ensure that the cured beef is very juicy. The more veined, the better the quality. To make this cured WAGYU, only very, very selected pieces of wagyu steer, with a higher category infiltration. This is how we get our cured wagyu with the highest quality possible, juicy, soft and with a great bouquet. This product is suitable for HALAL consumption. Cured wagyu made with wagyu slaughtered with the Islamic rite.

products.name: CURED BEEF LOIN
products.description: GEAL's most special cured beef is made from a selection, one by one and manually, of the pieces that present the highest quality. Pieces that the passage of time and slow curing over the months give this preparation a unique and authentic flavor. An exquisiteness at the height of the best palates. The cut of the pieces has great grain to ensure that the cured beef loin is very juicy. The more veined, the better the quality. To make this cured beef, only very, very selected pieces of cow are used. This is how we get our cured beef loin with the highest quality possible, juicy, soft and with a great bouquet.

products.name: CURED BLACK ANGUS LOIN
products.description: The Black Angus loin is made from selected Black Angus pieces, of the highest quality and with the greatest infiltration. Pieces rated PRIME, the maximum in Black Angus quality. Pieces that the passage of time and slow curing over the months give this preparation a unique and authentic flavor. A delicacy at the height of the best palates. The cut of the pieces has great grain to ensure that the jerky is very juicy. The more veined, the better the quality. This is how we get our jerky with the highest possible quality, juicy, soft and with a great bouquet.

products.name: CURED BLACK ANGUS
products.description: Our dried Black Angus beef is made from carefully selected cuts of exceptional quality with optimal marbling. These PRIME-grade cuts represent the pinnacle of Black Angus quality. Thanks to a slow and extended curing process over several months, this preparation develops a unique and authentic flavor. A delicacy that will delight even the most discerning palates. The cuts, with their fine, marbled grain, guarantee a very juicy dried beef. The more pronounced the grain, the better the quality. This is how we achieve dried beef of impeccable quality: juicy, tender, and with exceptional aromas.

products.description: Normandy Cream UHT 35% Fat Homogeneous, slightly ivory liquid cream with a fresh, authentic cream taste . Ideal for adding richness and smoothness to your preparations.

Carefully cultivated and processed for consistency, it is ideal for sushi and traditional Japanese or Asian dishes. With a clean aroma and reliable performance, it meets professional kitchen and global foodservice standards.

products.name: Lotus Jasmine Rice
products.description: Lotus Jasmine Rice is a premium fragrant rice variety, cultivated in the fertile Mekong Delta — one of the world’s most renowned rice-growing regions. Nurtured by a tropical climate, nutrient-rich alluvial soil, and pure water sources, each grain offers a soft, silky texture and a naturally delicate jasmine aroma that lingers from cooking to every serving. Produced under strict quality control and aligned with international food safety standards, Lotus Rice delivers consistent excellence trusted by partners worldwide.

products.name: ST25 Premium Rice
products.description: ST25 Premium Rice is a renowned Vietnamese rice variety known for its long, crystal-clear grains, natural pandan-like aroma, and gentle sweetness. When cooked, it is soft, fluffy, and well-separated. Produced with modern European technology, ST25 ensures high purity, food safety, and stable quality, making it ideal for retail, horeca, and global distribution.

products.name: Red Rice
products.description: Natural Color. Wholesome Nutrition. Red Rice is a premium whole grain, valued for its distinctive natural hue, nutty flavor, and rich nutritional profile. Packed with antioxidants, fiber, and essential nutrients, it supports a balanced, health-conscious lifestyle while adding both depth of flavor and visual appeal to every dish. Highly versatile, Red Rice is ideal for a wide range of culinary applications — from salads and grain bowls to hearty meals and modern cuisine.

products.name: Ready Rice – Long Grain White Rice
products.description: Everyday Staple. Ready in Seconds. Long grain white rice is valued for its light, fluffy texture and mild, clean taste, making it a versatile choice across a wide range of cuisines. With Lotus Ready Rice, this everyday staple is perfectly prepared and ready in just 90 seconds — offering convenience without compromising quality. products.name: Clearspring Organic Japanese Silken Tofu
products.description: Clearspring’s award-winning* authentic Japanese Silken Tofu has a silky, smooth texture, and a delicate creamy ﬂavour. Tofu is a high protein, low fat Japanese staple. Our Tofu is made using just three simple ingredients: fresh water, whole organic soya beans and nigari. Our producer has been dedicated to perfecting the art of making Tofu since 1973 and in partnership with Clearspring has created a unique-recipe, ambient silken organic tofu which tastes just like the fresh tofu sold on the streets of Japan. The production process is relatively simple. The organic soya beans are steamed and then pressed to extract soya milk. This is then combined with water and nigari. Nigari is a naturally occurring mineral-rich coagulant derived from seawater which is a great source of magnesium chloride. The use of high protein soya beans and traditional method of using nigari ensures our multi-award-winning Tofu delivers the perfect taste and texture with every mouthful. It was officially voted the ‘The Nation’s Favourite Organic Food & Drink Product’*! It is also incredibly versatile. You can enjoy it straight from the pack or use it to make a wide variety of delicious sweet and savoury dishes including scrambled tofu, miso soup, salads, dips, sauces and sweet desserts.

products.name: Clearspring Organic Japanese Brown Rice Crackers
products.description: Our award-winning Organic Japanese Brown Rice Crackers are the perfect snacks for any occasion. Full of flavour and crunchiness, they are a delicious way to enjoy wholegrain brown rice and sesame seeds, which have been uplifted with the fulsome flavour of naturally aged organic Tamari. They are also gluten free! Our Organic Brown Rice Crackers are made by a third-generation family producer in Japan’s Hyogo prefecture, where they have been dedicated to making rice crackers since 1952. They are truly artisanal in their approach, employing traditional methods and decades of expertise to ensure that each batch is baked to perfection. Our Brown Rice Crackers are made just the way we suggest you eat them - slowly and with mindfulness. The process starts with 100% organically grown brown rice which is carefully steamed to make a brown rice dough. This takes three to four times longer than when using highly processed white rice. The dough is then cooled with water and the texture is carefully checked by hand to ensure it has just the right consistency. Then the Tamari and seasoning is added to the dough, before being cut into circular rice cracker shapes. The crackers are slowly dried and left overnight to settle, to ensure that any moisture is removed. This slow drying process is one of the secrets to the great taste and texture of our Brown Rice Crackers. The final step is to oven bake the crackers which gives these crackers a final flourish of flavour and crispiness.

Why not try enjoying them as a topping on your yoghurt or cereal, as an ingredient for a fruity organic dessert or spread on your favourite crackers. You can even pour them into ice pots and freeze, to enjoy on a hot summer’s day. Our delicious Organic FRUIT Purée pouches are made by a family-producer in Italy who has been making delicious, naturally ﬂavour-ﬁlled fruit purées for over 25 years. products.name: Clearspring Organic Seaveg Crispies
products.description: A deliciously moreish snack, roasting this organic nori for just a few seconds adds a distinct crispiness to that unique umami ﬂavour of the sea. A light dusting of seasoning then turns this popular sea vegetable into a convenient and tasty on the go snack for your family. Equally great for garnishing your ramen bowls, with rice, or simply sprinkling over salads. To grow this sustainable and organic seaweed, nori spores are carefully planted onto nets made of woven rope and suspended into calm, shallow bays. The height of each net is carefully ﬁxed so that it remains above the water level during low tide, giving the growing nori maximum sunlight, and below the water level so that the plants receive a regular washing at high tide. The delicate nori plants will grow until they cover the entire net. When they are ready to be harvested, they are brought ashore where they are thoroughly cleaned. The nori is then ready to be pressed into a thin sheet which is then chopped into smaller portions – just like you would expect to see when you buy a packet of nori to make sushi at home. The nori sheets are ﬁnally seasoned with sunﬂower oil, unreﬁned sea salt (also available in Chilli, Ginger & Turmeric ﬂavours), before being toasted and cut into delicious crispy sheets - perfect for snacking. We use only organic certiﬁed nori for our Seaveg Crispies™, which is grown in the luscious clear water off the coast of South Korea. This is important to us because you can be assured that the natural environment within those waters is protected.

products.name: Caffè Barbera Mago - Whole Bean Coffee Blend - 250gr

Mago's magic begins with the whole coffee bean. We have roasted each bean individually, then cooled it rapidly with dehumidified air. The magic continues when you grind the beans right before you make your coffee. This ensures a coffee that tantalises your tongue with its excellent acid balance. You enjoy truly clean coffee. You support ecological growing practices. The farmers cultivating these coffee beans embrace organic practices, rejecting deforestation to obtain higher yields and adopting erosion control methods. Add our patient, unrushed Italian coffee roasting practises, and you get an exceptionally flavourful and satisfying espresso each and every 'clean' cup. The richness of the coffee will tantalise every sense with joy.

In lactose-free products, a special production technique is therefore applied that breaks down lactose into its two component monosaccharides, glucose and galactose. Lactose-free cheeses by Nonno Nanni preserve the unique and inimitable flavour of Nonno Nanni fresh cheeses, which are now also available to those who couldn’t enjoy them before.

products.description: The rotary continuous retort ACBV is specially designed for sterilisation of products packed in glass bottles and jars (Milk, beverages, soupes, vegetables, …) The continuous agitation of the product during the heating and cooling process prevents from any burnt product. Possible applications for this type of continuous autoclave are ready meals, intravenous pharmaceutical solutions, baby food and pet bags.

products.name: continuous sterilizer retort for beverages
products.description: Overpressure sterilizers using steam air heat media, are specially designed for all sterilized liquids (soups, dairy products, soya milk, coconut milk, rice milk, coffee milk, protein based energy drinks). Hydrolock sterilization can be part of a 2 stage HTST (High temperature Short time Sterilization). With this 2 stage HTST the results are great in term of color and organoleptic qualities.

products.name: ACP continuous retort sterilizer for pouches & trays
products.description: With a 20 years experience of continuous sterilization of flexible pouches, Hydrolock has reinforced its leadership in this field, with a new machine fully automated that is including robots for product handling. Steam air heating media and pressurized cooling are the 2 main steps for this packaging. The process is semi static with some flip over of the packaging during the process. Ready to eat meals, IV pharmaceutical solution, babyfood and petfood pouches are possible applications for this kind of continuous retort.

products.name: SWEET AND SOUR YELLOW MINI CHILIES
products.description: Whole mini chillies shaped like drops, uniform in size and firm in texture. Crisp, sweet and sweet and sour. Original, attractive and decorative, they are ideal for accompanying your aperitifs, paired with cold cuts and cheeses, for decorating fresh salads and for preparing original pizzas, first and second courses.

products.name: NON-STICK COOKING SPRAY
products.description: Highly practical spray release agent for easy removal of various types of dough from any surface. It has a brand new formula that is completely wax-free and has high adhesive power. Shake well before use. Spray a thin, even layer, keeping a distance of 25/30 cm from the surface.

products.name: DONUT Pizza ALFREDO or MARGHERITA with Garlic Cream filling
products.description: A first-of-its-kind savoury donut pizza made with authentic donut-style dough filled with creamy garlic and finished with pizza-inspired toppings. Product concept A frozen savoury donut pizza snack that combines the softness of donut dough with the familiar taste cues of pizza. Neither a traditional pizza nor a classic donut, it creates a new savoury snacking format for modern on-the-go consumption. Key product features Authentic donut-style dough with a soft, fluffy and short-bite texture Mildly savoury garlic cream filling Pizza-inspired toppings with sauces, cheeses and herbs Compact 80 g format, convenient to handle and easy to consume on the go Industrially produced while retaining a handmade-inspired appearance Available variants DONUT Pizza MARGHERITA with Garlic Cream Filling: topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella and cheddar cheeses DONUT Pizza ALFREDO with Garlic Cream Filling: topped with white sauce, soy pieces, mozzarella cheese and chives B2B value A distinctive savoury snack innovation designed to stand out in frozen bakery, food-to-go and convenience assortments. Its unique donut dough base, indulgent garlic cream filling and familiar pizza flavours help create strong shelf appeal and clear category differentiation.

products.name: Butter Croissant DUO with Chocolate, Vanilla or Raspberry Filling Options
products.description: Butter croissants of two contrasting colors are formed by a special technology, combining two different doughs . 1. The pastry contains as much as 21% of butter . 2. The pastry is available with chocolate, vanilla or raspberry filling . 3. Wheat sourdough is used in the production, highlighting the taste of the butter croissant. 4. A long-lasting dough development period improves the flavour of the product, its pastry structure, adds extra crispness to the croissant and enhances expressiveness of its layers.

products.name: Pastry with Mascarpone and Raspberry-Pomegranate Filling
products.description: Double pleasure in a crispy dough – the silky texture of mascarpone cream and the freshness of raspberry-pomegranate. 1. Two fillings (31%): mascarpone-curd and raspberry-pomegranate. 2. Made from layered Danish dough, characterized by a special crispness and clear characteristic layers of dough. 3. Sugar decor – great look, taste and crunch. 4. There are deep cuts on the sides of the cake, which make the different fillings perfectly visible. 5. Can be baked straight from the cold without defrosting.

products.name: French baguette FILLINI with ham, cheese and garlic butter
products.description: An innovative ready-filled garlic baguette with ham and cheese, offering easy preparation, consistent quality and strong category growth potential. Key innovation The first-ever industrially produced ham and cheese garlic baguette, created through a specialised process that integrates the filling while preserving the texture, stability and quality of a classic bakery product. Format flexibility Available in 235 g for sharing occasions and 120 g for individual snacking. Consumer value A familiar garlic baguette upgraded into a richer, more satisfying format: easy to prepare, generous in taste and ideal for sharing. Trade value A distinctive bakery product with strong shelf appeal, simple preparation and clear potential to expand frozen or chilled assortments.

products.name: Bread PROTEIN with Sunflower and Poppy Seeds (fully baked)
products.description: A source of protein, no added sugar, with rye sourdough and a crunchy seed decoration - a modern version of everyday bread for those looking for more benefits without compromising on taste. Protein source: with plant-based proteins from peas, potatoes and rice. About 14 g of protein per 100 g of product, and as much as 35 g of protein in one 250 g loaf. This responds to the growing trend of protein-enriched, more filling and nutritious everyday products. Rye sourdough: gives the bread a deeper, more mature flavor and a more natural character, while helping to keep the product fresh and soft for longer. CLEAN LABEL: made from 100% natural ingredients, without E additives. No added sugar. Seed decoration: a mixture of sunflower and poppy seeds provides a pleasant crunch, visual appeal and adds fiber. Baked: already baked, so no additional baking is required. This saves time, reduces preparation steps, and makes it easier to maintain a consistent cooking process.

products.name: Pastry with Rhubarb and Vanilla Flavour Cream Filling
products.description: A crispy Danish pastry with refreshing rhubarb tartness and soft vanilla cream. Rhubarb (24%) and vanilla cream (14%) : with soft rhubarb cubes and a smooth vanilla cream. Vanilla fillings are among the 3 most popular flavors in the world. The perfect balance of sweetness and sourness. Danish pastry layers: the high fat content of the layering allows for thin layers of dough that acquire a beautiful golden color and special crispiness when baked. Sugar decoration: gives the product an attractive appearance, while the crunch of caramelized sugar adds extra texture. This enhances the impression of a fresh, just-baked product. Artisan look: the open shape allows for a clear view of the filling, while the irregular layers and rich decoration create a handmade impression.

products.name: Donut SKINNY WITCH with Blueberry Filling
products.description: „Skinny Witch“ – born from the desire to create a magic treat for those who love sweets but want to keep guilt at bay. Like a true witch, it hides magic – less fat and sugar, but more natural flavor and freshness. A rich duo of blueberries and coconut flakes – fruity freshness and extra fiber in every bite. Blueberry filling – a real trend: beloved by consumers, blueberries provide natural flavor and antioxidant benefits – enriching the donut with a refreshing and light sensation. Less fat: 30% less fat than a regular donut. No heavy feeling. High in fiber: 7.5 g / 100 g – promotes satiety, supports digestion, and helps maintain balance. Less sugar: 50% less sugar than traditional donuts – natural sweetness from blueberries and coconut. Topped with coconut and blueberry flakes: adds color, texture, and extra fiber and nutrients. Visually distinctive and naturally rich.

products.name: Donut with KITKAT®
products.description: Fluffy donut with creamy KITKAT flavoured filling, covered in chocolate frosting and generously sprinkled with crispy KITKAT® chocolate-waffle pieces. "Take a break, enjoy KITKAT"® – only this time in the format of a donut. Creamy interior (17%): a combination of vanilla cream, KITKAT chocolate paste, cream cheese and cocoa. Crunch that people appreciate: Chocolate frosting + waffle chips create a clear crunch mooment, while crunch is often associated with higher quality (93%) by consumers. Cooperation with KITKAT®: strengthens credibility and encourages spontaneous choice. It is easier to attract attention both in a café, at a gas station and in retail – this is a familiar taste that does not need to be explained. Modern padel recipe: the "short bite" donut dough is extremely soft and fluffy, and the special recipe and method of shaping reduces the amount of fat, which makes the donut "lighter". No extra effort: the donuts are fully prepared – just defrost and enjoy.

By the way, the longer the Mie noodles are, the better, because in China noodles are a symbol of long life. It is not for nothing that they are the most popular dish at birthday parties in China.

To prepare 4 servings, heat 400 ml of Shan’shi coconut milk in a wok, stir in 4-5 teaspoons of Shan’shi Red Curry Paste and bring to the boil. Add meat, fish and vegetables as desired and allow to cook. Serve the Thai curry with rice as an ideal complement for a complete meal.

products.name: Sweet & Sour Sauce

With Shan’shi rice noodles as a side dish Sweet & Sour Sauce becomes a wholesome meal.

Shan’shi Soy sauce is also a perfect dip for sushi, maki and sashimi.

products.name: Coconut Milk 400ml Light
products.description: Coconut milk is an essential part of Asian cuisine. Shan’shi Coconut milk light is the reduced-fat and reduced-calorie version. It is obtained from the flesh of fresh coconuts. Coconut milk is an exotic ingredient for soups, rice and curry dishes, but is also suitable for all kinds of desserts. Due to the reduced fat content, Shan’shi Coconut milk light is particularly recommended for light, fruity summer drinks.

products.name: Thai Chili Sauce
products.description: Chili sauces are an absolute must in Asian cuisine and this is reflected in the incredible range of different types. A particularly spicy chili sauce is Shan’shi Thai Chili sauce. It is a delicious composition of hot red chilies and garlic. With its piquant note and the slight taste of garlic, it is ideal for poultry and grilled food.

products.name: Coconut Milk 165ml Light
products.description: Coconut milk is an essential part of Asian cuisine. Shan’shi Coconut milk light is the reduced-fat and reduced-calorie version. It is obtained from the flesh of fresh coconuts. Coconut milk light is an exotic ingredient for soups, rice and curry dishes, but is also suitable for all kinds of desserts. Due to the reduced fat content, Shan’shi Coconut milk light is particularly recommended for light, fruity summer drinks.

products.name: Bean sprouts
products.description: Their versatile uses make Bean Sprouts an indispensable ingredient in Asian cuisine. The seedlings of the mung bean taste very good in wok dishes, but are also delicious as an accompaniment to meat and fish and in many salads. Before use, Shan’shi Bean Sprouts an should be rinsed thoroughly in cold water to really bring out their flavor! Briefly heated, they remain nice and crunchy and can fully develop their taste.

products.name: Vienna Ice Coffee / Classic
