products.name: Soy Sauce Sweet
products.description: Soy sauce is probably the best known and most used condiment in Asian cuisine. Shan’shi Soy Sauce Sweet is made from fermented soybeans, roasted wheat and Salt . A longer maturation process makes it thicker and gives it a sweet aroma. This makes Shan’shi Soy Sauce Sweet ideal for seasoning any Asian dish and rounds it off in a sweet and spicy way.

products.name: Udon Noodles
products.description: Udon noodles are thick wheat noodles from Japan and are ideal for sautéing with meat or vegetables or as an ingredient in soups. They are characterized by their thick and soft texture, which distinguishes them from other types of pasta. They are the thickest noodles in traditional Japanese cuisine.

products.name: Sambal Oelek
products.description: Sambals are an integral part of every Indonesian cuisine. They are hot spice pastes made from boiled chillies and salt. Shan’shi Sambal Oelek is a classic variant, and consists of a large amount of red chilies. Shan’shi Sambal Oelek can be used in many ways: it gives every wok dish a slight to intense spiciness, but it also goes well with dishes such as goulash, chili con carne or spaghetti Bolognese.

products.name: KnabberNossi: Classic Wrap
products.description: Savory beef and pork meet a fluffy, lightly browned tortilla wrap: This combo is unbeatable! And the taste? Exquisite! KnabberNossi Wraps are available both in single-serve packs and in a convenient three-pack.

products.name: Chili Sauce Hot
products.description: Chili Sauce Hot is very popular in Asian cuisine. There are a variety of chilli sauces that differ in taste and degree of spiciness. Native to the cuisine of Southeast Asia, this sauce is made from the sprouts of red chillies and is considered to be particularly hot, but also very digestible. It goes well with fish, meat and vegetable dishes. To give your Asian dishes the right amount of spiciness, mix a few spoonfuls of chilli sauce into your wok or pan while cooking.

products.name: Chili Sauce Sweet
products.description: The importance of chili products in Asian cuisine is reflected in the wide range. Chili Sauce Sweet is one of the most popular variants. This sauce is made from medium-sized chillies and is used primarily in Thai and Indonesian cuisine. Shan’shi Chili Sauce Sweet impresses with its piquant-sweet taste as well as a subtle pineapple note. The sweet chilli sauce goes particularly well with spring rolls and fried fish and seafood.

products.name: Soba Noodles
products.description: Soba Noodles are buckwheat noodles from Japan that are used as an ingredient in soups or fried noodle dishes. They are suitable for cold dishes. In Japan Soba Noodles are served either hot in a broth or cold with a soy-based sauce. They are also an excellent source of protein and also make a good pasta alternative.

products.name: Teriyaki Sauce
products.description: With Shan’shi Teriyaki Sauce you can quickly and easily prepare a typical Japanese dish. Teriyaki Sauce is based on a Soy sauce with ginger and sesame seeds. For 2 servings, simply fry approx. 300g of meat, seafood or vegetables, add Shan’shi Teriyaki Sauce and simmer for 3-4 minutes. Shan’shi rice noodles round off Teriyaki Sauce to a wholesome meal.

products.name: Glass Noodles
products.description: Glass noodles are a popular side dish in East Asian cuisine. They are made from mung bean sprouts and are transparent when cooked. Shan’shi glass noodles are ideal for soups, salads, as well as for braised and fried dishes.

products.name: Vienna Ice Coffee / No Sugar
products.description: The classic ice coffee, but with no added sugar, for those who live life at full intensity. Because you want to really feel that coffee kick when you enjoy an iced coffee, but also, let’s face it, because you don’t need any sugar to sweeten yourself up. Shelf life: 12 months Ambient 100% Arabica coffee Made from fresh milk from the Austrian Alps Up to 80 % milk in the recipe Particularly creamy

products.name: Wasabi Paste
products.description: Wasabi Paste is a very spicy horseradish paste that is a staple in Japanese households. Shan’shi wasabi paste is traditionally served with Shan’shi Soy sauce for sushi, maki and sashimi. It is also ideal as a seasoning paste for dishes with fish, such as grilled or fried salmon or tuna. Shan’shi wasabi paste also gives a fiery taste to steaks and various types of seafood salads.

products.name: Crab Chips
products.description: Shan’shi Crab chips are shrimp crackers originally from Indonesia. They are made according to the original recipe with shrimp and high-quality tapioca flour without preservatives. Ground shrimp and the tapioca flour made from the cassava root are mixed into a dough, cut into slices and baked out after drying. Shan’shi Crab chips, also known as Krupuk, are a popular cocktail snack and an essential part of any Indonesian table.

In general, Shan’shi Peanut Oil is used when high temperatures are required to prepare the food. It is therefore suitable, for example, for frying, for frying in a wok or for grilling.

products.name: Red Curry Sauce
products.description: With Shan’shi Thai Red Curry Sauce a typical Thai dish is quickly cooked. Hot chilies give the sauce the spiciness that Thailand is so well known for, while the coconut milk gives it a wonderfully tangy flavor. For 2 servings, simply sauté approx. 300g of meat, fish or vegetables, add Shan’shi Thai Red Curry Sauce and simmer for 3-4 minutes. Thai Red Curry is rounded off with Shan’shi rice noodles to create a wholesome meal.

products.name: Yellow Curry Paste
products.description: Shan’shi Yellow Curry Paste is a typical Thai spice paste for yellow curry. The cooking and seasoning paste made from yellow chilies is the mildest variety in the Shan’shi range and can therefore easily conjure up curries for milder tastes. To prepare 4 servings, heat 400 ml of Shan’shi coconut milk in a wok, stir in 4-5 teaspoons of Shan’shi Yellow Curry Paste and bring to the boil. Add meat, fish and vegetables as desired and allow to cook.

products.name: Oyster Sauce
products.description: Shan’shi Oyster Sauce is a real all-purpose sauce in Chinese cuisine. But it is just as ideal for refining grilled meat.

products.name: Rice Noodles
products.description: Rice noodles are a widespread type of noodle made from rice flour, especially in Thailand. Shan’shi Rice noodles are the typical flat rice noodles for the traditional noodle dish in Thai cuisine.

products.name: Coconut Milk 165ml
products.description: Coconut milk has become an indispensable part of Thai cuisine. Obtained from the pulp of fresh coconuts, it is perfect for refining sauces and soups. The high coconut content of 80% can cause the product to solidify, ie the liquid portion settles at the bottom. The solid, fatty part of the Coconut milk can easily be used instead of oil or butter in the wok.

products.name: Bamboo Shoots
products.description: Bamboo shoots are one of the most popular vegetables in Chinese cuisine. products.name: CONCENTRATED JUICES

products.name: SOY SAUCE
products.description: Soy Sauce is a rich and flavorful fermented sauce, originating from China and now widely appreciated around the world, including Italy. Renowned for its deep umami taste, it is a versatile condiment used both as a finishing touch and as an ingredient in a wide range of culinary preparations, adding depth and balance to every dish. Our sauces have long been appreciated on Italian and international tables, enhancing flavors and providing the perfect accompaniment for both main courses and side dishes.

products.name: Fontina PDO
products.description: Fontina PDO is one of the jewels in the crown of mountain cheeses. With its soft, elastic, melt-in-the-mouth texture, intense aroma and characteristic but not excessive eye formation, it is a cheese to be enjoyed on all occasions. Fontina PDO has specific characteristics that make it clearly recognisable, despite the many attempts at imitation. It has a thin, compact, orange-brown rind and a flattened cylindrical shape. The wheel has an average weight of around 9 kg.

products.name: Grana Padano PDO
products.description: It is an aged Italian PDO hard cheese that originates from the Po River Valley in northern Italy. It has a flaked, grainy texture, which is why it's classified as a 'grana'-style cheese – 'grana' being 'grainy' in Italian.

products.name: Ricotta
products.description: Semi solid non aged product obtained by the coagulation of milk whey. The product can be used both for sweet recepies and savoury ones, making it a necessary ingredient in every kitchen.

products.name: Pecorino Romano PDO
products.description: It's an hard and cooked cheese, produced with whole sheep's milk from flocks raised in the wild and fed on natural pastures. The production area of Pecorino Romano DOP includes the entire territory of the Lazio and Sardinia regions, and of the province of Grosseto, in the Tuscany region. It comes with an ivory color, a grainy paste that is suitable for grating, an intense aroma and taste quite savory

products.name: Mozzarella di vacca
products.description: It's one of the best known Italian cheeses in the world, and certainly the most imitated, fresh cheese with a soft and stretched paste. It has its origins in southern Italy during the Middle Ages. Its name comes from the term “mozzatura”, the practice of the cheese maker of breaking off a piece of stretched paste with his thumb and index finger to form a “mozzarella”. Today this artisanal technique, like the whole production process, has been replaced by modern industrial technology

products.name: Provolone
products.description: It’s a pasteurized whole cow’s milk cheese. The most surprising aspects of this cheese are the size and its typical shape, which can weigh from a few grams to over 100 kg. The characteristic pear, mandarin, melon, bottle and salami shapes refers to the need in the past of identifying the community of origin with a specific shape. Provolone Dolce requires a minimum maturing period of a few weeks and for this reason is a paste with a delicate and buttery flavour, whereas Provolone Piccante has an intense and sharp flavour, due to the long aging period which can even last for years for the largest sizes

products.name: Pecorino di Sardegna
products.description: Hard sheep's milk cheese

products.name: Parmigiano Reggiano DOP
products.description: The most famous and appreciated italian cheese, classic symbol of the italian culinary tradition

products.name: Primosale
products.description: A fresh cheese that was born in Sicily but has spread throughout Italy. It is generally produced with sheep or cow's milk but also with buffalo milk. Primosale BIANCO is the natural version where no filling is added. It is fresh and slightly salty to the palate. There are different varieties: Primosale PEPATO black peppercorns are added, which give a spicy flavour to the cheese. Primosale PEPERONCINO pieces of red hot chili peppers are added to the curd before the shaping phase. Primosale RUCOLA fresh rocket leaves are added to the curd, which give a fresh and slightly bitter flavour, typical of rocket salad.

products.name: Asiago PDO
products.description: It is a cow's milk cheese, originating from the Plateau of Asiago from which it takes its name. There are two types of Asiago: Asiago Pressato (fresh ) and Asiago d’Allevo (aged) both covered by the Standards of Production of the Consortium of Protection for DOP production, which was obtained in 1996.

products.name: Stracchino
products.description: Soft cow's milk table cheese

products.name: Pecorino Sardo PDO
products.description: It is a semi-cooked cheese produced with whole sheep’s milk. It is produced in two distinct typologies: Dolce (sweet, aged 20-60 days) and Maturo (mature, aged over 60 days). The production area of Pecorino Sardo PDO is within the entire territory of the Sardinia region. Pecorino Sardo PDO has a cylindrical shape and flat surfaces, with a variable weight. The colour of the cheese ranges from white to straw-yellow, depending on how mature it is. The consistency is firm with a few eyes, and soft for the Dolce variety. The rind is smooth and thin for the Dolce variety, with a white to straw-yellow colour, while that of the Maturo variety is thicker and has a more brownish colour. The Dolce variety is sweet-aromatic or slightly sour, while the pecorino Maturo is stronger and pleasantly piquant.

products.name: Pecorino di Sicilia
products.description: Semi-hard sheep's milk cheese, can be flavoured with pepper, rocket, tomato etc

products.name: Scamorza
products.description: Scamorza is a stretched curd cheese obtained by processing only Italian cow's milk. There are two types: white and smoked. White:White in color, which becomes straw yellow as it continues to be stored and with the classic pear shape, short neck and head, it has a smooth surface and compact consistency. The taste is delicate, slightly savory. Due to its consistency and its characteristic flavor, the it’s perfect for the preparation of dishes cooked in the oven and is also delicious when tasted grilled. Smoked: The distinctive flavour and tawny colour come as the result of a particular smoking process, obtained through the exposure of smoke coming from certified wood shavings. A delicate taste, able to satisfy any kind of palate.

products.name: Camembert de Buflonne
products.description: Italian version of the classic French camembert. It is made from Buffalo milk, which makes the product sweet and perfect to taste accompanied by a light beer or a delicate sparkling wine.

products.name: Burrata di Andria IGP
products.description: Traditional italian cheese from Puglia region. Know and appreciated for it's sweet taste and enriching consistency. The external sack is made from mozzarella while the inside is creamy and made from cream and streched cheese paste.

products.name: Burrata & Stracciatella
products.description: Different Burrata flavours, to enrich and increase the particular taste of the original Burrata. Stracciatella, which is the filling if Burrata, is a perfect ingredient to add to your dishes.

products.name: Mascarpone&Gorgonzola
products.description: Cheese delicacy made from Mascarpone and Gorgonzola. It is the perfect mix between the sweet mascarpone and the tasty Gorgonzola

products.name: Mascarpone
products.description: Soft fresh italian cheese made from cream. It is know for your velvety and smooth texture and milky taste. It is originally from the lombarida region and it is known world wide becuase it is the main ingredient of Tiramisù

products.name: Gorgonzola DOP
products.description: Blue cheese from cow's milk typical of North Italy. It has a sweet but tasty flavour.

products.name: Taleggio DOP
products.description: Typical from Lombardia region with very ancient origins.

products.name: Mozzarella di Bufala Campana DOP
products.description: Mozzarella di Bufala Campana DOP is a fresh cheese entirely produced with Buffalo Milk and it is the symbol of the South Italian culinary tradition. It can be appriciated alone or as ingredient to enrich the final flavour.

products.name: High-Quality “Oro Rosa” Cooked Ham
products.description: Oro Rosa High-Quality Cooked Ham is designed to meet the most sophisticated demands of consumers and operators of high-end establishments. A product that stands out not only for its excellent presentation but also for its aromas and enveloping flavor. These characteristics make it a standout and have earned it an excellent ranking in Gambero Rosso’s prestigious list of Italy’s best cooked hams, within the category of cooked hams sold in stores and high-end restaurants. A masterpiece of craftsmanship: made from the fresh hind leg of exclusively Italian heavy-breed pigs, the Oro Rosa High-Quality Cooked Ham is a premium-quality cooked ham, deboned using the “osso sfilato” technique and hand-tied outside a mold—an innovative method that enhances its tenderness and brings out its flavors. It is the result of a meticulous production process in which the meat is seasoned with a decoction of medicinal herbs, spices, and honey—prepared at least 24 hours in advance and simmered slowly at low temperatures—and is completed by slow cooking, also carried out at low temperatures, which lasts up to 27 hours and ultimately renders the meat tender, rich in flavor, and preserves all its natural properties.

products.name: Strolghino

products.name: Chèvre au Bleu
products.description: The 'au Bleu' is a goat's cheese with blue veins. The blue culture is added to the milk. Then air is injected into the cheese so that the blue veins can develop. The blue veins are therefore not injected afterwards. After first being matured for 6 weeks in the Netherlands, it is refined for another 4-6 months in a French cave. A goat cheese matured in cheese coating cannot breathe. That affects the taste. That is not the case with the Eminence Grise, which can continue to breathe during the ripening process and therefore develops a very soft taste. This also applies to the blue vein in the cheese. If you seal it off by means of a coating… then the mold effect will stop and become bitter. Due to the natural crust, the mold continues to develop and becomes very fine and mild in taste. This makes the au Bleu a very accessible cheese for a wide audience. The same fungus as the Roquefort (penicillium roqueforti) is used for the blue vein. The difference in sharpness is clearly noticeable. The above story has been approved by the Superjury of the World Cheese Awards in 2021. During this international cheese selection, where more than 4000 entries took part, the Tomme Chèvre Grise au Bleu was named THIRD BEST CHEESE IN THE WORLD! A first for the Netherlands, because never before has a Dutch cheese been awarded so highly.

products.name: Quescrem Plus Cream Cheese

products.name: Quescrem Cream Cheese with Garlic and Fine Herbs
products.description: Add a distinctive flavor to your dishes with a cream cheese made with garlic and fine natural herbs and no artificial flavorings. Its characteristics make it perfect for both hot and cold preparations thanks to its intense yet balanced flavor.

products.name: Quescrem Professional Pastry Pipping Bag 800g
products.description: The Quescrem Profesional 800g Piping Bag is a cream cheese with a natural, fresh and creamy flavour, designed for foodservice and organised catering. Reduce plastic consumption and minimise food waste by making the most of every last bit of cheese with the Quescrem Profesional 800g Piping Bag.

products.name: Manchego PDO Cured PDO Cheese
products.description: Our Manchego Cheese is made in the region of Castilla La Mancha, from sheep's milk of the Manchega breed , with a minimum maturation period of 60 days. The Manchega sheep graze in the fields of La Mancha, thus producing a peculiar milk that contributes to give the rich and characteristic flavor to the aforementioned product.

products.name: Sheep Cheese with Black Garlic
products.description: SHEEP CHEESE WITH BLACK GARLIC is a unique and flavorful cheese that combines the creamy, rich qualities of sheep's milk cheese with the deep, sweet, and umami-rich flavor of black garlic.: Description: Color: The cheese typically has a pale white base color, with dark streaks or specks from the black garlic, creating a visually striking contrast. Texture: Depending on its aging process, the texture can range from semi-soft to firm. The black garlic, often finely chopped or pureed, may add a slightly sticky, soft texture in the areas where it is mixed into the cheese. Aroma: The aroma is a blend of the rich, slightly tangy scent of sheep's milk cheese and the complex, balsamic-like fragrance of black garlic. There’s a sweet, molasses-like undertone from the black garlic that complements the earthy, nutty scent of the cheese. Flavor: The flavor profile is complex and harmonious. The sheep’s milk cheese is creamy, with a mild tanginess and nuttiness, while the black garlic introduces a deep, slightly sweet, and umami-rich flavor with notes of balsamic vinegar, caramel, and a hint of aged balsamic or tamarind. Together, they create a rich, savory-sweet balance with a touch of earthiness.

products.name: Sheep Cheese with Tomato Jam
products.description: Sheep cheese with tomato is a simple yet flavorful combination that merges the creamy richness of sheep's milk cheese with the fresh, tangy brightness of tomatoes. The richness of the sheep cheese pairs beautifully with the tomato's acidity and sweetness, creating a balanced, savory bite. This pairing is ideal for salads, on toasted bread (bruschetta), as part of antipasto platters, or incorporated into pasta dishes. A drizzle of olive oil, fresh herbs like basil or oregano, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper can elevate the dish.

products.name: Sheep Cheese with Black Truffles
products.description: SHEEP CHEESE WITH TRUFFLES is a luxurious and aromatic type of cheese that combines the rich, creamy flavors of sheep's milk cheese with the distinct, earthy notes of truffles. Description: Color: The cheese typically has a pale white color, interspersed with specks of black from the truffles. Texture: Depending on its aging process, the texture can range from semi-soft to firm. The truffle pieces within the cheese add a slightly uneven texture, giving a unique mouthfeel. Aroma: The smell is unmistakably rich and earthy due to the truffles, with a deep, musky scent that blends harmoniously with the mild, buttery aroma of the sheep’s milk cheese. Flavor: The cheese boasts a complex flavor profile. It is creamy, slightly tangy, and nutty from the sheep’s milk, with a pronounced earthy, garlicky flavor from the truffles. The truffles lend an umami-rich depth, making each bite an indulgent experience.

products.name: Goat Cheese
products.description: Our goat cheese is made from pasteurized goat’s milk produced in the Toledo mountains and the Madrid sierra. These areas are rich in thyme, rockrose, heather and fragrant grasses, which give our cheese its distinctly delicious flavour. It is made throughout the year. The maturity is for a minimum of 30 days, the rind is natural and it has a paprika colour. The interior of the cheese is white, with evenly distributed eyes. Our goat cheese Campos de Toledo is described as creamy and mild with a very distinct flavour.

products.name: Sheep Cheese with Olive Oil
products.description: Sheep cheese preserved in extra-virgin olive oil is one of those simple-but-luxurious foods, It’s a traditional product that combines two Mediterranean classics: rich sheep’s milk cheese and high-quality Spanish olive oil. This cheese is rich and creamy with a savory, slightly tangy sheep’s milk core. The Extra Virgin Olive oil adds fruitiness, slight bitterness and a peppery finish This cheese style is versatile. You can pair it with Red Wines as a Rioja Reserva or Tempranillo, fruity and structured complement to the cheese’s richness, or serve it with crusty bread, olives, Marcona almonds, sun-dried tomatoes, honey or quince paste.

products.name: DORADO Mixed milk cured cheese
products.description: The Dorado cheese is made from an exclusive recipe developed by Pedro Garcia Navalmoral (CEO and President of Quesos Navalmoral SA) as a result of an exhaustive R&D work at Quesos Navalmoral SA. Dorado cheese is a mixed cheese made from 50% pasteurized sheep's and 50% pasteurized cow's milk collected around La Mancha region. Using a selection of exclusive lactic cultures, and maturing under special conditions during at least 6 months of age, provide to this cheese with an authentic sweet complex flavor profile, and a smooth texture.

products.name: Manchego PDO Viejo Cheese
products.description: Our Manchego Cheese is made in the region of Castilla La Mancha, from sheep's milk of the Manchega breed , with a minimum maturation period of 60 days. The Manchega sheep graze in the fields of La Mancha, thus producing a peculiar milk that contributes to give the rich and characteristic flavor to the aforementioned product.

products.name: Sheep Cheese with Quince Jam
products.description: Texture: It typically has a firm yet creamy texture with a slight density. Flavor: Offers a balanced blend between the smoothness of sheep's cheese and the sweetness of quince, often with fruity and sweet undertones. Color: Can vary from ivory white to a pale yellow hue, depending on the ripening period. Aroma: Tends to have a delicate aroma with subtle and sweet notes from the quince. Presentation: Usually presented in wedges or slices, with pieces of quince evenly distributed throughout.

products.name: Sheep Cheese
products.description: Sheep cheese is made from milk collected in different farms in the area of the Montes de Toledo, producing a special milk that provides the delicious and characteristic flavour to the product. It is made throughout the year. We differentiate the semi-mature and mature cheese according to the curing period . The first one has a ripening period of at least 60 days, the cured one of 180 days and the old one of 270 days. The cheese has an ivory color, and the holes are evenly distributed throughout the paste. The texture is creamy and melts in the mouth. It has a mild, nutty flavour that is unique to sheep’s milk.

products.name: Iberico Cheese
products.description: Iberico cheese is a pressed paste cheese made with a mixture of three milks (cow, sheep and goat). It is the most popular cheese in Spain, and according to the proportions established in section 4 of Annex I of Royal Decree 262/2011, of February 28th, approving the quality standards for cheese and melted cheese. All cheese sold under the name "Iberico" must be made with fresh milk in the following proportions: maximum of 50% of cow's milk, minimum 15% of goat's milk and minimum of 15% of sheep's milk.

products.name: PANNA COTTA RIANS
products.description: Panna Cotta with Rians sauce is a traditional Italian dessert, made in the heart of Berry in the village of Rians. This dessert stands out for its creamy sweetness, firm yet melting texture, and its red berry or passion mango sauce that enhances the flavor of the panna cotta. The sauce is homemade, ensuring an original taste and a silky texture.

products.name: ROULE RIANS
products.description: The unbeatable freshness of Rians is also found in our Rolled Cheese. Different flavors like Garlic and Fine Herbs, Pineapple, Cranberry... and our new ones Shallot/Chive and Tomato/Basil. The secret of our recipe? It's made from our traditional white cheeses that have been produced for generations. Then it’s flavored according to the taste and rolled like a log, so it’s easy to slice and enjoy with (or without) a piece of bread. We just melt for the fresh taste.

products.name: RIANS PROTEIN FAISSELLE
products.description: Faisselle is a fresh cheese loved for its light and creamy texture, and it’s a good source of protein, which helps build and repair body tissues. For 100 grams of Rians faisselle, there are about 8 g of protein, making it a suitable choice for balanced diets and daily protein intake.

products.name: CREAMY
products.description: Our Triple Cream Crémeux comes from the tradition of cream-enriched cheeses like Brillat Savarin. A soft cheese with a bloomy rind, the Triple Cream Crémeux has a smooth, creamy texture and a delicious creamy taste. Cheese platters can also be enhanced with, in addition to this truly exceptional cheese, the Summer Truffle Creamy Cheese which combines the creaminess of a Triple Cream cheese with a summer truffle center, or the Amber aged with beer.

products.name: CREME BRULEE RIANS
products.description: Rians Bourbon Vanilla Crème Brûlée is made following the French tradition with just five main ingredients: cream, skimmed milk, eggs, sugar, and Madagascar Bourbon vanilla, offering a creamy, melt-in-your-mouth texture and a fragrant, caramelized floral taste. The topping is made of caramel pieces that create a thin, crunchy layer on top, either cold or by browning it in the oven or with a blowtorch. Rians also offers a pistachio version, which combines milky sweetness with pistachio flavors that have almond and praline notes, always topped with caramel pieces for that crunch.

products.name: VINTAGE, REFINED WITH CHABLI
products.description: A true regional specialty, the Millésime aged in Chablis, is a cow's milk cheese. This soft washed-rind cheese is rubbed with Chablis white wine, giving it its fine and distinctive taste. Its texture melts in your mouth, and its rind develops a lovely creamy color with orange tones that turn more coppery as it matures.

products.name: EPOISSES GERMAIN AOP
products.description: Made with whole milk that’s slowly curdled, gently molded, and drained for 24 hours, it’s then salted. After that, Epoisses is aged in a cellar for at least four weeks and washed with Marc de Bourgogne. Our cheesemakers wash it at least five times to get that beautiful orangey color that makes our Epoisses so recognizable. Its balanced, straightforward, and fruity taste, along with its creamy, melt-in-your-mouth texture, make it a truly unique cheese! Also try Époisses by tasting it warm straight from its box! Specially aged for cooking, this cheese then reveals all the richness of its flavors: a melting and creamy texture, powerful woodland aromas… Perfect for warming up your winter meals and creating cozy moments around the table.

products.name: CROTTIN DE CHEVRE GERMAIN
products.description: The Germain Goat Crottin is a goat cheese made from pasteurized milk, shaped and aged in the Berry region. Under its thin white rind, it hides a firm and creamy texture with a mild flavor. This cheese has been recognized multiple times for its taste and quality.

products.name: PYRAMID OF SPREADABLE GOAT CHEESE - RIANS CREMERIE
products.description: Our spreadable goat cheese pyramid is made from pasteurized goat's milk and stands out for its creamy, melt-in-your-mouth texture and slightly salty taste. It's loved for its mildness. Easy to spread, it's perfect for toast, appetizers, and snacks.

products.name: LANGRES GERMAIN AOP
products.description: From the family of soft washed-rind cheeses, Langres is easily recognized by the hollow, called a “fountain,” that forms on its top. This AOP cheese is aged using the traditional method, with repeated “washes” that give it its lovely orange color. Its unique trait is that it has a strong aroma but is mild in taste.

products.name: Rarity range | Luxury coffee
products.description: The collection features three authentic gems: Panama Geisha, refined and silky, with a delicate body reminiscent of tea; Nepal Himalaya, a pure harmony of flavors and aromas reflecting its pristine land; and the legendary Jamaica Blue Mountain, famous for delivering an unparalleled sensory experience.

products.name: Pure origin range
products.description: The Pure Origin range features carefully selected single-origin coffees, roasted to highlight the authentic character and story of each terroir. It offers a journey through the world’s most renowned coffee regions, from Central and South America to Africa, Asia and the Caribbean, including iconic and distinctive origins. Each coffee is identified by a clear sensory signature to guide tasting. The modern, minimalist packaging provides detailed technical information and aromatic notes, making Pure Origin ideal for professionals and coffee lovers seeking distinctive, traceable and memorable coffees.

products.name: Panarabica range | Luxury coffee
products.description: These blends have been scrupulously designed to satisfy the sophisticated and demanding palate of the so-called ‘coffee explorer’: an increasingly attentive and aware consumer, eager for unique and surprising sensory experiences and capable of embarking on real journeys of taste.

products.name: Bioarabica range | Organic coffee
products.description: A range of rare single origins for consumers who embrace a more planet-conscious lifestyle. Coffees that ripen naturally in the shade of lush forests, among wild plants and animals—grown without pesticides or chemical fertilizers, helping protect groundwater and preserve biodiversity.

products.name: Italian Blends | Premium coffee
products.description: Through the Italian Blend line, we celebrate the many souls of Italian espresso with a journey that, without crossing borders, is extraordinarily rich. Each blend pays tribute to an iconic place where coffee is more than a beverage: it is culture, ritual, and identity. Created and roasted in Italy, Bazzara’s Italian Blends combine premium coffees with a distinctive storytelling approach: contemporary design inspired by city maps and landmarks, turning every package into a tribute to our heritage and every cup into an authentic Italian lifestyle experience

products.name: Dodicigrancru | Luxury coffee
products.description: At the heart of the luxury range stands Bazzara’s best seller: a journey around the world in a cup, where 12 magnificent Arabicas come together to create a unique and unrepeatable blend. For gourmet coffee lovers, our finest blend is also available in single‑serve pods and capsules, allowing anyone to enjoy an exclusive espresso in the comfort of their home. It is also offered as ground coffee in our 250g tin.

products.description: Mortadella Nazionale with Bronte PDO Pistachios is made from selected cuts of heavy Italian pork. The cooking process varies depending on the size of the product. It is available in 15 kg sizes encased in natural casing, or in 50 kg and 100 kg sizes packed in synthetic casing. Mortadella La Valle is traditional in every sense. It features a firm, soft, and juicy texture, studded with lardons, generous pistachios, and whole peppercorns. On the nose, it offers typical aromas of subtle, well-integrated spices that enhance the quality pork. The palate is equally well-balanced—full-flavored yet perfectly refined, followed by a clean and elegant finish.

products.name: PARMA HAM PDO 24 MONTHS
products.description: The ideal, exquisitely sweet cured ham capable of satisfying even the most demanding customers. Only the finest Parma Ham PDO—selected for their appearance, rich flavor, and unquestionable quality of raw materials—become “Etichetta Nera” (Black Label). Hams crafted with extraordinary care, appealing equally to the eye and the palate. The aftertaste is pleasant and persistent, never overpowering. The aroma is fragrant and unmistakable, with notes reminiscent of dried fruit and toasted hazelnut, particularly in the longer-aged hams.

products.name: COOKED HAM LA VALLE PRIZED GAMBERO ROSSO
products.description: Prosciutto cotto La Valle "Il Lesso" is a High Quality cooked ham ( Prosciutto Cotto Alta Qualità ) crafted from fresh white-breed pork legs, originally selected for PDO cured ham production. The legs are aged on the bone prior to deboning to tenderize the meat, processed without tumbling ( zangolazione ), manually salted via the artery, and steam-cooked at high temperatures. "Il Lesso" is a pure, honest cooked ham with the sweet flavor of well-cooked pork—its name derives from the ancient Piedmontese tradition of boiling meat. It features an authentic appearance with good marbling throughout the lean meat.

products.name: Frozen Red Peppers Diced 10x10 mm
products.description: Frozen Pepper Production ProcessProduct Description Frozen peppers are produced from fresh, healthy, mature peppers harvested at optimum ripeness. After careful selection, cleaning, cutting, and blanching (if required), the peppers are individually quick frozen (IQF) to preserve their natural color, flavor, texture, and nutritional value. Production Process1. Raw Material Reception Fresh peppers are received from approved growers. Visual inspection is performed for quality, maturity, color, and defects. Damaged, diseased, or foreign materials are removed. 2. Sorting and Grading Peppers are sorted according to size, color, and quality requirements. Defective products are eliminated. 3. Washing Multiple-stage washing systems are used to remove soil, dust, and foreign matter. Water quality is continuously monitored according to food safety standards. 4. Cutting and Preparation Depending on customer specifications, peppers may be processed as: Whole Diced Strips Rings Mixed vegetable blends Seeds, stems, and inedible portions are removed. 5. Blanching (Optional) Some pepper products are lightly blanched before freezing. Blanching helps preserve color, texture, and enzyme stability. Typical blanching temperature: 85–95°C for 1–3 minutes. 6. Cooling Immediately after blanching, peppers are rapidly cooled to prevent overcooking and preserve quality. 7. IQF Freezing Products pass through an Individual Quick Freezing (IQF) tunnel. Freezing temperature typically ranges from -35°C to -40°C. Product core temperature reaches at least -18°C. 8. Metal Detection and Quality Control Frozen products pass through metal detectors. Samples are checked for: Size conformity Foreign matter Color Texture Microbiological compliance 9. Packaging Packed in food-grade polyethylene bags and cartons. Packaging sizes are customized according to customer requirements. 10. Cold Storage Finished products are stored at -18°C or below. Cold chain is maintained until delivery. Key Advantages of IQF Frozen Peppers Maintains natural color and flavor. Preserves nutritional value. Easy portion control. Long shelf life (24 months). Available year-round. Suitable for industrial food processing and retail markets. Typical Product Specifications Green Pepper Red Pepper Yellow Pepper Mixed Bell Pepper Diced Pepper (10x10 mm, 15x15 mm, etc.) Pepper Strips Roasted Pepper (upon request) Storage Conditions Store at -18°C or below. Shelf Life: 24 months. Do not refreeze after thawing.

products.name: Popcorn micro-ondable - Sucré et aux agrumes
products.description: Un popcorn 100% gascon délicatement sucré et au bon goût d'agrumes, à faire éclater avec panache au four à micro-ondes ! Ajoutez un peu d'originalité à vos pauses goûter, fins d'apéritifs et vos soirées télé avec ce popcorn micro-ondable délicieusement sucré et au bon goût d'agrumes. Quelques minutes au micro-ondes et le tour est joué ! Ce popcorn micro-ondable est issu de maïs cultivé dans le Gers. Une origine fièrement mise en avant par Peta Milhoc qui signifie "maïs qui éclate" en Gascon et que l'on prononce Pé-To-Mi-Yok. Conseils de préparation Retirez le film plastique autour du sachet et placez le sachet plié au four à micro-ondes, la face UP vers le haut. Faites chauffer entre 1.5 min et 3.5 min selon la puissance de votre micro-ondes (voir instructions sur le sachet). Ecoutez le POP du maïs qui éclate ! Et arrêtez le micro-ondes lorsque le bruit ralenti à 2 / 3 secondes d'intervalle entre chaque éclatement. Laissez refroidir le sachet avant la dégustation et attention à la vapeur qui peut s'en échapper à l'ouverture. Un maïs issu de l'agriculture régénératrice L'agriculture régénératrice est une approche agricole qui a pour objectif de restaurer, améliorer et renouveler les écosystèmes agricoles tout en produisant des produits alimentaires de manière durable. Cette pratique met l'accent sur la régénération des sols, la préservation de la biodiversité, la conservation de l'eau et l'application d'une agriculture plus résiliente et écologique. Les producteurs-partenaires de Peta Milhòc s'inscrivent dans cette démarche, en s'employant à réduire leur consommation d'eau d'irrigation et en pratiquant l'agroécologique. Grâce à l'implantation de couverts végétaux entre les cultures principales, le maïs cultivé pour produire le popcorn permet de capter jusqu'à 6 tonnes de CO2 par hectare. Cette pratique, en œuvrant pour la biodiversité et la santé des sols, bénéficie également aux maïsiculteurs qui sont rémunérés pour le carbone ainsi stocké durablement dans leurs sols.

products.name: Cartoner ET300MC
products.description: As part of the continued development of its packaging machinery range, ETPACK highlights the ET300MC semi-automatic cartoner, a compact and flexible solution designed to support companies in their cartoning operations. The ET300MC is a semi-automatic horizontal cartoner that forms and closes cartons using Hot-Melt adhesive on solid board or micro-flute cardboard blanks. Its continuous operation with manual product loading provides an excellent balance between performance, ease of use, and cost-effective investment. It is ideally suited to the requirements of the food, cosmetics, pharmaceutical, biscuit, chocolate, and confectionery industries. Thanks to its wide format flexibility and variable speed of up to 30 cartons per minute, the ET300MC easily adapts to a variety of production requirements. Its compact design, featuring an integrated electrical cabinet and a stainless-steel chassis mounted on castors, facilitates seamless integration into existing production environments. Robust and reliable, it ensures consistent cartoning quality while improving operator productivity. Optional features, such as inkjet coding integration and an extended infeed conveyor, further enhance its adaptability to specific application needs.

products.name: Wrap-Around Case Packer ETC20
products.description: Thanks to its intermittent operation and a robotic feed with 2 to 6 axes, the ETC20R guarantees versatility, precise product handling and efficient packing in cases. Format changes are quick, repeatable and highly accurate. This case packer is suitable for applications involving micro-fluted or corrugated cardboard cases, flat blanks, trays, cartons, bags, tins, clusters, boxes, etc. It is equipped with standard or application-specific grippers capable of positioning products in different configurations (flat, on edge, upright or staggered). It is also suitable for a wide variety of carton designs (open cartons, trays, sidewall cartons with joined and unjoined flaps, complete cartons with front flaps, displays with or without lids and ready-to-sell). It comes standard with an axis controller and a latest-generation hot-melt glue generator offering high precision application and optimised glue consumption. Several options can be integrated, such as a vision camera system to inspect product quality or carton conformity control. This machine is compact and ergonomic, allowing for different installation configurations. Thanks to its large-capacity, motorised, ergonomic magazine and positive telescopic destacker, it can handle speeds of up to 20 crates per minute.

products.name: Ecowrap® ETW201
products.description: The new generation Ecowrap® ETW201 is designed for sleeve wrapping applications and the application of solid board and/or micro-flute cardboard caps from flat blanks. This machine is particularly well suited to the food industry for bundling or multipacking fruit and vegetable trays, ready meals, individual yogurt pots, cans, dessert cups, and more, as well as for a wide range of other industrial applications. Thanks to Beckhoff’s One Cable Technology (OCT), the Ecowrap® ETW201 stands out with a more streamlined design, enabling the control cabinet size to be reduced by half. This simplifies installation and optimizes floor space. By combining power supply, control, and data communication within a single cable, this innovation reduces maintenance requirements and facilitates technical interventions. It also delivers significant energy savings while maintaining high performance levels and the flexibility needed to adapt to evolving packaging formats.

products.name: RSC Case Packer ETC CA20
products.description: As part of the continued development of its machine range, ETPACK highlights the ETC CA20 Case Erector, a solution designed to optimize product packaging and shipping. The machine automatically erects RSC (Regular Slotted Container) cases with outstanding precision and speed, meeting the requirements of the food, cosmetics, and industrial sectors. Thanks to its wide format compatibility, it can be easily adapted to the specific needs of different production lines. Its quick and intuitive adjustment system enables efficient format changeovers, while its robust construction ensures long-term durability, even in demanding industrial environments. Precise and repeatable case forming guarantees consistent quality, helping to optimize the packaging process and improve overall production efficiency.

products.name: GUTsy Captain Kombucha
products.description: GUTsy Captain Kombucha is a delicious fermented drink, made in Spain, full of live bacteria and slightly carbonated. Kombucha is an ancient drink known in China as the "elixir of immortality". Our Kombuchas are 100% authentic because we use a natural fermentation process, with SCOBY – a live culture of bacteria and yeast. At GUTsy Captain we use green tea and cane sugar in the production of Kombucha. All ingredients are 100% Natural and BIO. In the fermentation process, sugar is reduced by the SCOBY and enzymes and antioxidants are produced. At the end of fermentation, we add the natural flavors. The product has three sub ranges: Kombucha , Kombucha Zero (with zero sugars and calories) and Fresh Selection (with natural juice addition). The range is available in 3 formats: 400ml and 1L bottles and 250ml cans in multiple flavours.

products.name: Agua de Valencia
products.description: VALENCIA, located along the Mediterranean coast, is renowned for its optimal climatic and soil conditions for the cultivation of high-quality oranges. It is within this unique environment that the cocktail Aigua de Valencia was created decades ago, made from natural orange juice and deeply rooted in its place of origin. CHERUBINO carefully selects base wines and premium Valencian oranges, combining them through a controlled production process that results in a well-balanced cocktail with a fresh, fruit forward aromatic profile, low alcohol content, and fine, persistent bubbles. Served well chilled, Aigua de Valencia delivers a clean and harmonious expression, making it an ideal choice for aperitifs, after-dinner gatherings, celebrations, and special toasts.

products.name: Vermouth Vittore Red
products.description: The oldest vermouth in Valencia: made using the same formula devised by Benedetto Valsangiacomo, the third generation of the family, at the beginning of the last century, and developed and positioned as the oldest vermouth in Valencia by his son Arnoldo, the fourth generation. Today, the fifth generation of the Valsangiacomo family has revived the original Vermouth Vittore label as a tribute to the origins of this aperitif. Base white wine 24 botanicals of Mediterranean and Alpine origin, among which stand out Gentian, Wormwood, Coriander, Savory, Sage, Oregano, Chamomile, Sauco, Orange peel. This Vermouth is made from a Macabeo white wine base. The golden color is due to the addition of grape must caramel.

products.name: El Novio Perfecto
products.description: This young white wine is made by processing both varieties separately. We work to achieve a completely dry Muscatel and stop the fermentation of the Viura/Macabeo variety with cold temperatures. This results in a wine with a natural sugar concentration and less than 10% alcohol by volume. The result is a sweet, fresh white wine that is very easy to drink. It is dangerously light and fresh it invites you to have a second glass Its long and refreshing acidity is the perfect balance to its addictively sweet touch. “Serve very cold”

products.name: Valle de SantJaume
products.description: VALLE DE SANJAIME has been produced with the traditional method, with both the first fermentation and the second fermentation (in the bottle) taking place under low temperature. The bottles have been kept for 9 months in stacks. In order to respect the original taste and flavors of this cava, the expedition liqueur has been made using the same base wine used in the second fermentation.

products.name: La Novia Ideal
products.description: Bobal Bubbles and Passion. Exclusively made from 100% Bobal grapes, expressing all its fruit character. Fine bubbles Fermentation is stopped by low temperatures in order to preserve the natural sweetness of the grape variety. Very lively with nice bubbles, fresh, light and gradable, low alcohol content, and a pronounced acidity that makes it a seductive wine, and easy to drink. “Serve very cold"

products.name: Bobal de SanJuan red
products.description: Located in the village of SanJuan in Requena old vines 60 years, bush non-irrigated, 700 m above sea level. On the palate, it’s fresh and tasty, reminding of ripe red fruits (cherries) with some notes of pepper The acidity, typical of the Bobal grape variety, is pleasantly balanced with the smooth tannin.

products.name: Citrus Secret
products.description: LEMON AND YUZU COCKTAIL – REFRESHING SPRITZ (5% vol) On the shores of the Mediterranean, Valencia stands out for the exceptional quality of its citrus fruits. From this tradition comes this new cocktail, made from a fresh combination of lemon and yuzu, an Asian citrus fruit prized for its floral and exotic aromatic profile. The result is a light, refreshing and well-balanced spritz, with an alcohol content of just 5% vol. For its production, we carefully select quality wines along with Mediterranean lemons and yuzu of intense aromatic expression, resulting in a vibrant and well-defined cocktail. Lemon provides acidity, while yuzu adds unique and expressive aromas. Its fine bubbles and marked refreshing character make it the ideal choice for gatherings with friends, celebrations, after-meal moments or toasts on special occasions.

products.name: Camo
products.description: CAMO, means camouflage, a camouflaged plot in the vineyard “El Albardín”, limited production. Made in our winery Bobal de SanJuan, located in the Village of SanJuan in Requena. Fermented and matured for 5 months in a raw cement tank, and aged in an 8,000L French oaK barrel for 6 months.

products.name: Inverso Godello
products.description: Fermented must with its lees in stainless steel. Once fermented, the wine is aged in 500-liter French oak barrels, where it will remain for approximately two months before bottling. Silky, good acidity, with a fresh and long finish.

products.name: Cuva Vella
products.description: CUVA VELLA was born from what we call an “oenological oblivion”. Working on the winery’s traceability, we traced it back to a Moscatel from vintage 1980, which wasn’t sold and remained in a chestnut barrel in our old cellar in Valencia. An oxidation process started (which still goes on nowadays), so that the wine was no longer fit for its traditional use. It stayed in the barrel, where Mistela from successive years was being added until it was completely filled in. The wine continued its development, and some years ago, when we were shutting down the cellar in Valencia, this oenological “jewel” was discovered. After the first bottling, the tank was completed with a similar volume of fresh moscatel from that year. For the second bottling, and in order to maintain the identity of the first one, we “refreshed” the amount that was being bottled with fresh Mistela from that year (about 10%), thus leaving the “solera” as it was.

products.name: Ulises Valsangiacomo
products.description: Fermentation in barrels of French oak (500liters). Daily hand-made batonnage made for two months, while the wine is ageing on its lees. Unctuous and creamy, balanced acidity. Elegant and with a nice finish.

products.name: Clos de SanJuan
products.description: This wine is made in our family cellar in San Juan Requena, fermented and matured for 10 months in the tanks of raw concrete and then aged in barrels of French oak for 12 months (500L).

products.name: Malvasía de SantJaume
products.description: Fresh and floral, white wine made from the Malvasia grape variety. Protected Designation of Origin Valencia. It is a dry Malvasia wine with a touch of Merseguera, which adds an extra freshness and acidity. Long finish.

products.name: Bobal de SanJuan rosé
products.description: Produced at our Viticulotres de San Juan winery located in the village of SanJuan in Requena. Fermented in tanks of raw concrete. Fruit-driven, reminds of red berries, mostly acid strawberries and raspberries, with light notes of banana and caramelized apple over some refreshing hints of fresh fennel and herbs on the background.

products.name: Garnacha de SantJaume
products.description: Cold maceration in stainless steel tanks, with uncrushed grapes, partly with the stem. The fermentation ends in tanks of raw concrete. The wine is then transferred for a short period of time into barrels of different ages, where the malolactic fermentation takes place. During this brief oak ageing, a natural microoxigenation boosts the hints of fresh fruit without hiding it behind the oak.

products.name: Inverso Godello Velo Flor
products.description: After careful manual harvesting, the grapes are transferred to the pneumatic press, where they are lightly pressed to obtain the free-run juice. This juice is decanted statically and fermented with its finest lees in stainless steel. Once fermentation is complete, the wine is transferred to a single 500-liter French oak barrel, in which we leave a space to allow the yeasts to create the flour veil. The wine remains under the veil for approximately one year before bottling. Intense, glyceric, full-bodied, with a certain salinity and hints of bakery.

products.name: Vermouth Vittore Orange
products.description: The oldest vermouth in Valencia: made using the same formula devised by Benedetto Valsangiacomo, the third generation of the family, at the beginning of the last century, and developed and positioned as the oldest vermouth in Valencia by his son Arnoldo, the fourth generation. Today, the fifth generation of the Valsangiacomo family has revived the original Vermouth Vittore label as a tribute to the origins of this aperitif. Muscat white wine base macerated on its own skins; ORANGE type elaboration; 24 botanicals of Mediterranean and Alpine origin, among which Gentian, Wormwood, Coriander, Savory, Sage, Oregano, Manzanilla, Elderberry stand out, enhancing the flavors of the orange peel which link it even more to our land, Valencia.

products.name: Vittore Reserva Vermouth
products.description: Using the same “antique” formula since 1904, we have aged our Vittore Red Vermouth in American oak barrels for 6 months, resulting in a Vermouth with a subtle hint of wood, which gives it spicy aromas and greater complexity on the palate. In perfect harmony with our base of Mediterranean and Alpine botanicals.

products.name: El Perdío
products.description: Inside of the vineyard “El Albardin”, certified organic, the grapes used to produce this wine have been harvested from the plot called “El Perdio”, with 1.2Ha planted at 660m above sea level on mostly clay soil , dry-grown vines. Made in our winery Bobal de SanJuan, located in the village of San Juan in Requena. 100% Bobal, a part of the grapes ferment together with the stem. Fermentation inside of open-top barrels of 500L each. Ageing in tanks of raw concrete.

products.name: Vittore Reserva Valsangiacomo Vermouth
products.description: The oldest vermouth in Valencia: White wine base with 24 botanicals of Mediterranean and Alpine origin, including gentian, wormwood, coriander, savory, sage, oregano, chamomile, elderberry, and orange peel. This vermouth is made from a base of Macabeo white wine, aged for five years in American oak barrels.

products.name: Moscatel Vittore
products.description: Moscatel liqueur wine from Valencia. Traditionally made “Mistela.” Moscatel Vittore is made from Muscat grape must, which is cold fermented and then fortified with wine alcohol.

products.name: Vermouth Vittore White
products.description: The oldest vermouth in Valencia: made using the same formula devised by Benedetto Valsangiacomo, the third generation of the family, at the beginning of the last century, and developed and positioned as the oldest vermouth in Valencia by his son Arnoldo, the fourth generation. Today, the fifth generation of the Valsangiacomo family has revived the original Vermouth Vittore label as a tribute to the origins of this aperitif. White wine base 24 botanicals of Mediterranean and Alpine origin, among which stand out Gentian, Wormwood, Coriander, Savory, Sage, Oregano, Chamomile, Sauco, Orange and lemon peel. This Vermouth is made from a base of Macabeo white wine base.

products.name: Moscatel de SantJaume
products.description: In the search for the best possible balance, the grapes are vinified in two different ways depending on the parcels from which they come: - Grapes from the higher-altitude plots undergo skin maceration and fermentation at low temperature, enhancing complexity on the palate. - Grapes from the lower plots, riper at harvest, are vinified more traditionally by separating the free-run juice and keeping it in contact with fine lees, which gives the wine its mouthfeel and its most characteristic aromas. A portion of these wines is aged in new French oak barrels, achieving a pleasant balance between complexity and freshness.

products.name: Cassia Cinnamon Oil & Oleoresin
products.description: Cassia Cinnamon Essential Oil Cassia Cinnamon Essential Oil is extracted from selected Vietnamese cassia bark, concentrating its naturally sweet, warm, and intensely spicy aroma into a powerful aromatic ingredient. Rich in cinnamaldehyde, it is suitable for flavor preparations, fragrances, personal-care products, aromatics, and other applications requiring a strong and distinctive cassia profile. Cassia Cinnamon Oleoresin Cassia Cinnamon Oleoresin captures both the volatile aroma and the deeper flavor components naturally present in Vietnamese cassia bark. With its concentrated, full-bodied sweet-spicy character, it delivers consistent cinnamon flavor at a lower dosage and is well suited for seasoning blends, sauces, bakery products, beverages, confectionery, and other processed-food applications.

products.name: Cassia Cinnamon Tubes (Whole)
products.description: Whole Cassia Cinnamon Tubes preserve the bark in its long, natural form, offering a firm texture, robust appearance, and the rich, sweet-spicy aroma characteristic of Vietnamese cassia. Commonly graded by bark thickness and volatile oil content, they are widely used for spice processing, cutting and grinding, extraction, wholesale distribution, and traditional herbal medicine preparations.

products.name: Cassia Cinnamon Broken KABC
products.description: Cassia Cinnamon Broken KABC is a premium skinless broken grade, produced by cutting cinnamon bark and sieving it to achieve a clean and consistent particle size. With its high volatile oil content and naturally sweet, strong-spicy aroma, KABC is particularly suitable for producing high-oil cinnamon powder and other applications requiring an intense cassia flavor.

products.name: Cassia Cinnamon Broken KBBC
products.description: Cassia Cinnamon Broken KBBC is produced from Vietnamese cassia bark with the natural outer skin retained, then cut and sieved into practical, consistently sized pieces. Available in different volatile oil levels, it offers a balanced sweet-spicy cassia aroma and is well suited for grinding, extraction, spice blending, and general industrial processing.

products.name: Cassia Cinnamon Square-Cut
products.description: Cassia Cinnamon Square-Cut is produced from selected Vietnamese cassia bark, cut into compact and relatively uniform pieces for convenient handling, blending, and packing. products.name: Cassia Cinnamon Round-Cut
products.description: Cassia Cinnamon Round-Cut is produced by cutting selected cinnamon tubes into short, uniform pieces that retain the natural circular shape and layered structure of the bark. Available with or without the outer skin, it offers an attractive appearance, rich cassia aroma, and flexible sizing for spice processing, traditional herbal medicine preparations, decorative applications, wholesale distribution, and retail packing.

products.name: Cassia Cinnamon Sticks
products.description: Our Cassia Cinnamon Sticks are carefully processed from selected Vietnamese cinnamon bark, offering a naturally warm aroma, rich flavor, and attractive rolled appearance. products.description: Turn up the heat with Chipotle. It imparts a spicy bite on any type of meat or poultry, it’s even more exciting with fish and salads, potatoes and vegetable dishes.

products.name: Sea Salt Flakes & Smoke
products.description: Be creative and add our Smoked variety to fries or popcorn for a whole new twist. The adventurous cook should oven-roast leeks and he will be rewarded with an extraordinary flavor combination

products.name: Sea Salt Flakes & Wild Garlic
products.description: The fresh, zingy taste and aroma of Wild Garlic crystal flakes allow you to make a masterpiece out of every dish. Dust Wild Garlic over mashed potatoes for a hint of flavor or use it as an easy alternative to crushed garlic.

products.name: Sea Salt Flakes & Lemon
products.description: Sprinkle Citron crystal flakes on a baking tray and layer your fish on top (haddock, salmon, pike-perch or any fish you like). Bake in the oven and prepare for spectacular lemon baked fish without adding fat or burning the fish. Be daring!

products.name: Sea Salt Flakes & Chili
products.description: Add Red Chili to baked fish, roasted vegetables, fresh oysters or scalloped potatoes to add a burst of intense Red Chili flavor or just dust onto jumbo shrimp as with lemon zest.

products.name: Sea Salt Flakes & Wild Mashroom
products.description: Experience the vibrant taste and aroma of Falksalt Wild Mushroom Crystal Flakes. Delicately accent your steak, roasted vegetables, or baked potato with a sprinkle of Wild Mushroom or dust it over creamed mashed potatoes for subtle undertones of porcini mushrooms.

products.name: Sea Salt Flakes & Rosemary
products.description: Try this delectable salt with veal, chicken or lamb, the rosemary aroma will penetrate deep inside the meat. With potatoes, chicken or even bread,just sprinkle on top before roasting or baking.

products.name: Falksalt Sea Salt Flakes Natural
products.description: Many professionals and food enthusiasts consider Falksalt Natural Crystal Flakes to be the finest salt money can buy. Use it as a finishing salt and experience the crispy sensation next time you cook.

products.name: Dried Fruits Mixed
products.description: Premium Mixed Dried Fruit is the ultimate snacking experience for those who want it all. Featuring a vibrant blend of our gently dried, sun-ripened fruits—including sweet apricots, chewy peaches, rich plums, and velvety pears—this mix offers a perfect harmony of sweet, tart, and mild flavors. Packed with a wide variety of essential nutrients, dietary fiber, and potassium, this fat-free blend contains absolutely zero added sugars. It is the perfect, versatile treat to energize your day, elevate your favorite trail mix, or add a colorful burst of natural sweetness to your breakfast bowl!

products.name: Dried Peach
products.description: Dried peaches are a naturally sweet, aromatic snack with an intensified, concentrated fruity flavor. Through gentle dehydration, they develop a pleasantly soft and chewy texture while retaining most of their natural nutrients.

products.name: Dried Apricot
products.description: Premium Dried Apricots are a naturally sweet and deliciously tender snack bursting with bright, sun-ripened flavor. Packed with 3g of dietary fiber and a solid 550mg of potassium per serving, they are a fantastic, nutrient-dense choice to fuel your day. Completely fat-free and containing absolutely zero added sugars, this light 116-calorie treat is perfect to enjoy straight from the pouch, tossed into a trail mix, or chopped over your morning yogurt or oatmeal!

products.name: Dried Pear
products.description: Premium Dried Pears are a delightfully mild and naturally sweet snack with a soft, velvety texture and a subtle honey-like flavor. Packed with potassium and completely free of fat, sodium, and added sugars, they are a perfectly light, 84-calorie treat. Enjoy them straight from the bag, as a refined topping for your morning cereal, or paired with your favorite cheeses!

products.name: Dried apple
products.description: Premium sun-dried apples made from carefully selected Armenian fruits. Naturally dried under the sun to preserve their authentic flavour, natural sweetness and nutritional value. No added sugar, preservatives, artificial colors or flavours. Suitable for retail, food service and industrial use. Pack sizes: 120 g

products.name: Dried Black Plum
products.description: Dried black plums are a deeply flavorful, naturally sweet snack with a rich, complex profile. The drying process concentrates their natural sugars, resulting in a dense, satisfying texture that is packed with essential nutrients.

products.name: Fried rye bread snacks - Bread bites 80g
products.description: Bread Bites are crunchy snacks made from real rye bread, baked with a traditional sourdough starter instead of yeast. This gives them a distinctive taste and natural texture that sets them apart from regular bread-based snacks. They are an easy and tasty snack for any time of day and work well on their own or served with drinks. Bread Bites are our most popular product in Estonia and a great fit for export thanks to their long shelf life and efficient packing, which makes transportation practical and cost-effective. They come in several savory flavors and bring together the authentic taste of rye bread with the convenience of a modern snack.

products.name: Dollar snacks 80g - dollar shaped chips
products.description: Dollar Snacks are fun and crunchy dollar-shaped snacks with a clean, eye-catching packaging design that stands out on the shelf. They’re light, crisp and easy to enjoy as a quick bite or to share with friends. The playful shape and stylish look make them a great product for both local markets and export.

products.name: Texas popcorn 60g,150g
products.description: Texas Popcorn is growing fast, with more than 80% of production exported. We use A-grade mushroom kernels for consistent roundness and great crunch. Our unique packaging drives shelf visibility and converts to sales. We are happy to tailor flavours, pack sizes and formats to your needs, including private label.

products.name: Long potato chips - Grand chips 60g/90g
products.description: Our local invention and No. 1 export article. Our first production line was a home-grown innovation designed and built by our engineers – the Potato Wafer line. That’s how Grand Potato Chips were born. The family recipe remains a closely guarded secret and has earned fans around the world. The result is a distinctive snack with its signature shape, airy crunch and balanced flavours.

products.name: Braised Artichoke Hearts
products.description: Braised Artichoke Hearts reflect the delicacy and authenticity of Mediterranean cuisine. They offer a tender texture and a subtly smoky character that makes them irresistible. Preserved in sunflower oil, they retain all their juiciness and aroma, adding a versatile and gourmet touch to any dish. The elegance of the Mediterranean countryside in every bite.

products.name: Roasted Borettane Onion
products.description: Roasted Borettane Onions, processed fresh , remain crisp. Slowly braised and marinated in sunflower oil , they retain their natural juiciness and delicate aroma, making them ideal to accompany meats, salads, or enjoy as a gourmet appetizer. Italian sweetness with the perfect touch of elegance.

products.name: Gourmet Cocktail Mix
products.description: A carefully selected mix combining Gordal olives with pit, Kalamata olives with pit, gherkins, and baby onions . Its naturally mild flavor, with reduced salt, turns every bite into a balanced and refined experience. Dressed with lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil , this cocktail offers freshness, texture, and sophistication in a single appetizer—perfect for those seeking a gourmet touch on every occasion. The harmony of flavor in every bite.

products.name: Braised Cherry Pepper
products.description: Braised cherry peppers with a sweet and slightly spicy flavor . Their tender texture and balance between sweetness and a hint of spice make them a versatile and healthy accompaniment. They reflect Amanida’s Mediterranean essence: authentic products, balanced and full of natural character.

products.name: Truffled Gordal Olive
products.description: The Truffled Gordal Reina is an exquisite interpretation of Mediterranean tradition. With a firm texture and delicate flavor, it combines low salt content with the subtlety of Mediterranean spices—saffron, rosemary, thyme, and garlic—and the unmistakable natural aroma of truffle , adding depth and distinction. Dressed with lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil , and presented with the pit, it reveals a harmony of flavors that delights the senses and elevates any occasion.

products.name: Sweet Green Piparra
products.description: The Sweet Green Piparra is renowned for its crisp texture and mild flavor, with reduced salt content . Its garlic and bay leaf seasoning provides a delicate aroma that enhances the natural freshness of the pepper. Enriched with lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil , it offers a light, elegant, and harmonious experience. Ideal as a side, for preparing tapas, or as a starter.

products.name: Gherkin
products.description: Small in size but big in character , Baby Gherkins stand out for their naturally mild flavor and reduced salt content , which enhance their freshness and crisp texture. Dressed with lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil, they offer a light, balanced, and refreshing experience—perfect for those seeking a touch of distinction in every appetizer. Small pleasures with a Mediterranean soul.

products.name: Iberian Gordal Olive
products.description: The Gordal with Iberian ham pays tribute to the most emblematic flavors of our land, combining the authentic aroma of Iberian ham. A final touch of lemon juice enhances its freshness and balances every note, creating a gourmet experience as delicate as it is surprising. The essence of Spanish flavor in its most refined form.

products.name: Flame-Grilled Mushrooms
products.description: Our Grilled Mushrooms stand out for their small size and tender texture, enhanced by light grill marks that intensify their natural flavor and bring a subtly toasted nuance. They preserve all their juiciness, offering a balanced and versatile profile. Crafted with Extra Virgin Olive Oil, they are ideal as a side dish for meat and fish, in warm salads, or as a complement to stews and sautés. A simple, authentic product that brings character without overpowering the dish as a whole.

products.name: White Garlic
products.description: Crispy and surprising, Amanida’s White Garlic offers a naturally mild flavor with reduced salt , delicate and balanced in every bite. Dressed with lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil , it is neither pungent nor lingering , providing a light and refined gourmet experience—perfect for appetizers that seek freshness and distinction, as well as for creating countless Mediterranean dishes. Subtlety that awakens the senses.

products.name: Sun-Dried Tomato in Oil
products.description: Sun-Dried Italian Tomatoes capture the full essence of the Mediterranean in its most intense and delicate form . With a meaty texture and mild flavor, they offer a perfect balance between natural sweetness and aromatic depth. Preserved in sunflower oil , they retain their juiciness and character, adding an authentic and sophisticated touch to any dish or appetizer. The soul of the Mediterranean concentrated in flavor.

products.name: Stuffed Cherry Peppers with Cream Cheese
products.description: Our Cream Cheese Stuffed Cherry Peppers offer a smooth and balanced contrast between the natural sweetness of the pepper and the creamy texture of the filling. The cheese brings delicacy and richness, creating a harmonious and light bite. Their small size and carefully curated presentation make them ideal for appetizers, tasting platters, or as a complement to salads and cold dishes where a creamy touch without excessive intensity is desired. A versatile product that brings balance and elegance to every culinary creation.

products.name: Pesto Baby Onion
products.description: Pesto Pearl Onions combine the natural sweetness of the vegetable with a mild and balanced Italian flavor, enhanced by a touch of basil and grape must that adds aromatic freshness and a delicate fruity note . With reduced salt content and dressed with lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil , they offer a refined and versatile experience, perfect for accompanying appetizers or elevating any gourmet creation. Mediterranean sweetness with an Italian touch.

products.name: Roasted Piquillo Pepper from Navarra
products.description: Roasted Piquillo Peppers from Navarra embody the essence of Spanish tradition. Their mild, distinctive flavor reflects the unique quality of peppers grown in the region, carefully selected from start to finish . Carefully roasted, they retain a firm and juicy texture, offering a gourmet experience that combines authenticity, delicacy, and freshness. The authentic taste of an exceptional land.

products.name: Cauliflower Florets with Mediterranean Herbs
products.description: Our Mediterranean Dressed Cauliflower Florets stand out for their crunchy texture and delicate structure, which preserves the full personality of the vegetable, enhanced by our dressing made with smoked Paprika from La Vera (PDO), saffron, and a selection of Mediterranean spices. With a low salt content and dressed in Extra Virgin Olive Oil, they offer a versatile solution for side dishes with meat or fish, as well as for warm salads or more elaborate culinary creations. A product designed to bring character and sophistication with the Mediterranean essence of Amanida.

products.name: Sweet Red Piparra
products.description: The Sweet Red Piparra reveals the most vibrant side of the Mediterranean. With a mild and balanced flavor, and reduced salt content, it is enhanced with a garlic and bay leaf seasoning that adds aroma, freshness, and a subtle touch of character. Enriched with lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil , it offers a light, refined, and colorful experience—perfect for those who enjoy the most delicate nuances of a gourmet appetizer.

products.name: Marinated Baby Onions
products.description: Our Mediterranean Dressed Pearl Onions combine a firm, juicy texture with the natural sweetness of the onion, all enhanced by our unique dressing made with Mediterranean spices—saffron, rosemary, thyme, sweet smoked Paprika from La Vera (PDO), and garlic. With a low salt content and dressed in Extra Virgin Olive Oil, they offer a balanced and versatile profile, ideal as an appetizer or to complement culinary creations with a distinctive Mediterranean touch. The balance between natural goodness and Mediterranean character.

products.name: Natural Gordal Olive
products.description: The Gordal Reina is a jewel of the Mediterranean: an olive with a generous texture and naturally mild flavor , low in salt, combining balance, character, and distinction. Available with pit or pitted, and enhanced with lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil, it offers a gourmet experience that reflects tradition and freshness in every bite. The harmony of Mediterranean flavor in its purest form.

products.name: Borettane Onion with Balsamic Vinegar
products.description: Borettane Onions are a classic of Italian tradition, prized for their crisp, lightly roasted texture and mild Italian flavor. Their preparation with Aceto Balsamico di Modena PGI provides a delicate balance of sweetness and acidity , enhancing their refined and authentic character. Each piece retains its natural juiciness and shine, offering a gourmet experience that combines elegance, tradition, and an unmistakable touch of Italy. Italian excellence at its finest.

products.name: Marinated Gordal Olive
products.description: An olive with a generous texture and mild flavor. Its low salt content highlights the purity of the fruit, while a marinating of Mediterranean spices —saffron, rosemary, thyme, sweet Pimentón de la Vera PDO, and garlic—reveals unique aromatic nuances. Enhanced with lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil , it is available with pit or pitted. The perfect harmony of tradition, aroma, and sophistication.

products.name: Sweet Green Piparra with Mediterranean Herbs
products.description: Our Sweet Green Piparra Pepper with Mediterranean Dressing stands out for its fine, crunchy texture and its mild, balanced flavor, with a low salt content. Its Mediterranean dressing, crafted with smoked Paprika from La Vera (PDO), saffron, and a carefully selected blend of spices, provides a broader, more structured aromatic profile that enhances the natural freshness of the pepper. Enriched with Extra Virgin Olive Oil, it offers a more intense and expressive experience while maintaining the characteristic lightness of the sweet green piparra. Ideal as an accompaniment to various dishes, for preparing "pinchos", or as an appetizer with its own unique identity.

products.name: Obregon Gordal Olive
products.description: With a mild Mediterranean flavor and reduced salt content , this olive stands out for its meaty texture and natural balance. It is marinated with Mediterranean herbs — rosemary, thyme, and garlic —without paprika, and comes with the pit, preserving its full authenticity. Its dressing of natural lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil enhances its freshness and healthy character, true to the spirit of Amanida.

products.name: Stuffed Cherry Peppers with Cheese, "Bonito del Norte" Albacore Tuna, and Anchovy
products.description: Our Stuffed Cherry Peppers combine the smoothness and creaminess of cheese with the balanced intensity of "Bonito del Norte" albacore tuna and anchovy . The contrast between the natural sweetness of the pepper and the character of the filling creates a harmonious and well-defined bite. Their small, carefully presented format makes them the perfect choice for appetizers, gourmet platters, or as a distinctive touch in salads and cold dishes. A product designed to bring contrast and personality to every presentation.

products.name: Marinated Kalamata
products.description: The Kalamata Black Olives are true natural black olive , a genuine Mediterranean treasure. Their mild and balanced flavor, with reduced salt content , is enriched with a marinating of Mediterranean spices— saffron, rosemary, thyme, sweet paprika, and garlic —that unveils unique aromatic nuances. Presented with pit or pitted, and accompanied by lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil , these olives offer a sensory experience that combines tradition, freshness, and sophistication. The natural taste of the Mediterranean in its most exclusive form.

products.name: Smoked Spicy Gordal Olive
products.description: Marinated with a carefully crafted blend of Mediterranean spices— saffron, rosemary, thyme, smoked Pimentón de la Vera PDO, and garlic —that bring aromatic nuances and a distinctive smoky touch. Available with pit or pitted, it is dressed with natural lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil , enhancing its authentic and wholesome flavor.
