With customization options such as RFID tags, laser marking, and printing applications, ALC can be tailored to specific customer requirements while supporting sustainable logistics through their reusable design.

products.name: Ruso Rory
products.description: A Russian-style pea protein patty, stuffed with a punchy 'Veggiessada" and smooth, creamy melted Greek. Crispy on the outside and bursting with juicy, intense flavour on the inside. The Rory is perfect for a craving night, impromptu dinners, exciting meals or to add a unique touch to a get-together with friends.

products.name: Asturian-style Classic Cachopo seitan
products.description: A 100% plant-based cachopo suitable even for the most die-hard meat-eaters: two battered seitan fillets, stuffed with sliced vegetables and piquillo peppers, offer a spicy flavour reminiscent of the traditional cachopo, but without any animal-derived ingredients. Thanks to being cooked whilst still frozen, this dish retains its crispy batter and a juicy, flavourful centre. It’s ideal as a main course, served with chips, salad or roasted peppers.

products.name: Asturian-style Mencía Cahopo seitan
products.description: Inspired by Asturian tradition, inside it conceals a layer of vegetable matachana – a smooth, Vanetta-original spread made from peas and beans – and a subtle hint of Mencía wine, which adds an aromatic touch to this daring recipe. With a crispy, golden exterior, it contrasts with a flavour-packed interior, making it perfect for both the catering sector and for those looking to get creative in their own kitchens.

products.name: Sinjamon Croquettes by Rollito Vegano
products.description: These croquettes, inspired by the legendary Sinjamón from Rollito Vegano (the brand behind the first vegan ham produced in Spain), are the perfect plant-based alternative to homemade ham croquettes. Made with plant-based milk, spiced breadcrumbs and emulated Sinjamon, they’re creamy on the inside and crunchy on the outside. They’re ideal for a quick dinner, a tapas platter or a proper appetiser.

products.name: Asturian-style Quevana Cachopo seitan
products.description: Our crispy Asturian cachopo combines tradition with a plant-based twist: two seitan fillets, stuffed with Quevana – made from fermented cashews – and vegetable sobrassada on piquillo peppers. Easy to cook: straight from the freezer, ensuring the batter retains its crispy exterior and the filling stays juicy. It’s perfect served with chips, salad or sautéed vegetables.

products.name: Asturian-style Brétema Cachopo seitan
products.description: With an improved recipe and tastier than ever, our Brétema Cachopo is back: featuring a creamy, flavourful filling of Azul Carleta, mushrooms and caramelised onions that give it that special touch, and a unique, crispy Vanetta coating. This dish is ideal for epic dinners, meals where you want to impress, or just for yourself on a weekday.

products.name: Non-chicken Milanese-style Plant-based preparation
products.description: A 'Non-Chicken' milanesa (Spanish schnitzel) reminiscent of the traditional dish: thin, stable, with a golden breadcrumb coating that looks spectacular when pan-fried. Made with wheat gluten, ground almonds and a tasty coating of spiced breadcrumbs, it’s perfect served as a main course, with a salad or chips.

products.name: Blue Croquettes
products.description: These croquettes, filled with Azul by Mommus (a Spanish manufacturer of plant-based cheese alternatives made from cashews, water and yeast), have a crispy exterior and a creamy interior with a powerful flavour. Perfect for a dinner with friends, a snack, or all to yourself – because you deserve it.

products.name: Ruso Bleu
products.description: Russian-style pea protein fillet, filled with a vegetable cheddar and ham flavour, with a crispy coating and a juicy centre that will remind you of traditional dishes without compromising on your plant-based diet. Quick and easy to make: in a frying pan, air fryer or, better still, in the oven.

products.name: Galician-style Zorza soy
products.description: The star dish, a reinterpretated recipe of the traditional zorza , with textured vegetable protein and a blend of spices that give it that intense, authentic flavor. Enjoy it in sandwiches, mixed platters, tapas , or as a base for more elaborate recipes (rice dishes, empanadas , fajitas , etc.).

products.name: Spinach - Carrot with Curry Croquettes Mix
products.description: Typical Spanish croquette: creamy inside, crunchy outside. Available in two flavors: spinach or carrot & curry, and made with plant-based beverage, breadcrumbs, spices, and real vegetables. Perfect for daily meals, tapas with some friends or a quick dinner.

products.name: Marinated seitan
products.description: As versatile as pork loins, but make it plant-based. A vegetal version with an intense flavour, marinated in a mixture of sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, oregano, olive oil, and other spices. You can serve it however you like: on a crispy sandwich, as part of a combo meal, or chopped up in salads, wraps, or pasta dishes.

A reliable partner for food manufacturers, distributors and private label projects looking for colour, flavour, heat and consistency.

products.name: Spices
products.description: Spices are a key element in the final identity of a recipe. Salomón offers a complete portfolio of international spices with consistent quality all year round: black, white, green and pink pepper, plus Sichuan, cubeb and Java; cumin, turmeric, coriander, cinnamon, clove, anise, cardamom, ginger, garlic, onion, mustard, nutmeg, saffron, sesame and many more. products.name: Condiments
products.description: Salomón condiments bring flavour, colour and direct functionality to food industry processes. A partner to bring character and consistency to products seeking a recognisable flavour profile.

products.name: Blends and Seasonings
products.description: In international cuisine, every blend tells a story. Salomón develops seasoning blends organised by culinary family —Mediterranean, Middle Eastern and North African, Indian and Asian, Tex-Mex, BBQ and grill, and universal base blends—, with a recognisable taste profile and stable performance across applications. products.name: Cashew Kernel
products.description: Our cashew kernels are a premium snack choice, known for their rich flavor and delightful crunch. Sourced from the finest cashew trees, these kernels are carefully harvested and processed to ensure the highest quality. Rich in nutrients, our cashew kernels are packed with healthy fats, protein, and essential vitamins and minerals. They are an excellent source of energy and make for a perfect addition to various dishes, from salads to desserts, or simply enjoyed on their own as a nutritious snack. With a creamy texture and a subtly sweet taste, our cashew kernels are versatile and can be used in both savory and sweet recipes. Whether you're looking to enhance your culinary creations or seeking a wholesome snack, our cashew kernels are the ideal choice for health-conscious consumers. Experience the delightful taste and numerous health benefits of our cashew kernels today!

products.name: Premium Vietnamese flour made from the best rice
products.description: Our rice and glutinous rice flour are premium quality products, meticulously crafted to meet the diverse needs of culinary enthusiasts and professionals alike. Rice flour is made from finely milled white or brown rice, offering a versatile ingredient that can be used in a variety of dishes, from baked goods to savory meals. It is gluten-free, making it an excellent choice for those with gluten sensitivities or celiac disease. Its fine texture allows for smooth blending in recipes, ensuring a delightful consistency in your culinary creations. Glutinous rice flour, on the other hand, is derived from sticky rice, known for its unique chewy texture and slightly sweet flavor. This flour is essential in many Asian cuisines, particularly for making traditional desserts, dumplings, and rice cakes. Its ability to absorb moisture and create a sticky, pliable dough makes it perfect for crafting delicious treats that are both satisfying and authentic. Both flours are rich in carbohydrates and provide a good source of energy, making them ideal for a balanced diet. Whether you're experimenting with new recipes or sticking to family favorites, our rice and glutinous rice flour will elevate your cooking and baking experience.

products.name: Soft-dried Fruits
products.description: Our soft dried fruits are a delightful and nutritious snack option, perfect for any time of the day. Among our range, our key product is the luscious dried mango, which stands out for its vibrant color, rich flavor, and chewy texture. These mangoes are carefully selected at peak ripeness, ensuring that every bite is bursting with natural sweetness. The drying process preserves the essential nutrients, making them a healthy choice packed with vitamins and minerals. In addition to mango, our selection includes a variety of other soft dried fruits, each offering unique flavors and health benefits. These fruits are ideal for snacking, adding to cereals, or incorporating into baked goods. Experience the wholesome goodness of our soft dried fruits and indulge in the delicious taste of nature's candy!

products.name: IQF fruits
products.description: We take pride in offering a vibrant selection that captures the essence of freshness and flavor. Our mangoes are handpicked at peak ripeness, ensuring a sweet and juicy experience in every bite. The rich golden color and succulent texture make them perfect for smoothies, desserts, or simply as a healthy snack. Next, our dragon fruit stands out with its striking appearance and unique taste. Packed with antioxidants and vitamins, it adds a tropical flair to any dish, whether in salads, bowls, or as a refreshing snack. Lastly, our pineapples are a tropical delight, bursting with sweetness and tang. Ideal for cooking, baking, or enjoying fresh, they bring a taste of the tropics to your table. Explore our range of IQF products and elevate your culinary creations with the finest fruits nature has to offer!

products.name: Sunflower Seed
products.description: Sunflower seeds are a popular snacking choice and are commonly used in trail mixes, nutrition bars, or simply enjoyed on their own. Additionally, they are largely grown in Europe and offer a mild, nutty flavour that can be further enhanced through roasting.

products.name: Macadamias
products.description: Macadamia nuts are tree nuts grown in various places around the world, for example South Africa and Kenya. They have a creamy texture and flavour and like most other nuts, Macadamias also provide various health benefits.

products.name: Sultanas
products.description: Turkey is the primary source of our Sultanas, specifically from the region near Izmir. Sultanas and Raisins share the same fresh grape origin, with the only distinction being that Sultanas are immersed in a potassium carbonate solution.

products.name: Brazil Nuts
products.description: Brazil nuts are tree nuts native to the Amazon rainforest in Brazil, Bolivia, and Peru. They come from the South American Bertholletia excelsa tree which is one of the largest and longest-lived trees in the Amazon rainforest. Brazil nuts provide many different important nutrients including, healthy fats, fibre, and proteins.

products.name: Berries
products.description: Our cranberries come from one of three origins: Canada, Chile or USA. We also offer: Blueberries Goji Berries Blackcurrants Strawberries Sour Cherries

products.name: Raisins
products.description: Our primary sources for Raisins are Turkey, the USA (California), South Africa, and Chile. In the UK, a significant portion of Raisins comes from the Thompson Seedless grape variety, harvested and dried to create raisins.

products.name: Coconut
products.description: We supply a wide range of Coconut products from various origins such as Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Thailand & Philippines. We offer: Desiccated Raw Chip Toasted Chip Coconut Flour

products.name: Prunes
products.description: We import Prunes from Chile and France. The UK receives a new crop around May.

products.name: Pine Nuts
products.description: Pine nuts are small, buttery-flavoured seeds harvested from pine trees, prized for their rich nutritional profile and culinary versatility. Packed with healthy fats, plant-based protein, and essential nutrients they help to support brain function and skin vitality.

products.name: Millet
products.description: Millet is a versatile grain and a major food source in arid regions, particularly across Africa and Asia. In addition, it boasts high levels of magnesium, phosphorus, and fibre, all of which contribute to a wide range of health benefits.

products.name: Dates
products.description: We source our dates from a variety of countries. Using rice flour, we cover our freshly chopped Dates and pit them.

products.name: Pecans
products.description: While it is the only major tree nut that grows naturally in North America, the pecan is considered one of the most valuable North American nut species.

products.name: Chia
products.description: Originating from South America, Chia seeds are in many different dishes and are included as toppings on things like yoghurt, breakfast cereals and smoothies. Being high in omega 3, fibre, protein and antioxidants solidifies them as a staple food across many cultures all over the world.

products.name: Sesame Seed
products.description: Sesame seeds are small but mighty superfoods packed with essential nutrients like calcium, iron, magnesium, and healthy fats. They play a significant role in many cuisines globally, with origins in the Middle East and Asia. We ship Natural, Hulled White and Black sesame seeds.

products.name: Mixed Nuts
products.description: Chelmer Foods is also able to provide other nut products outside of our usual stock items depending on the volumes required. Therefore, if you would like to make an enquiry please call for further details.

products.name: Linseed
products.description: Linseed, also known as Flaxseed, is grown in temperate climates and are used for many things, due to being a fibre crop. Linseed is a powerful superfood rich in omega-3 fatty acids, dietary fibre, and plant-based protein.

products.name: Tropical Fruit
products.description: Our main source of Tropical Fruit is Thailand, however, we do source from other origins such as Sri Lanka and China.

products.name: Walnuts
products.description: The traditional countries of origin used by UK importers for the past several decades have been India and China. However, more recently these have been increasingly supplemented with supplies from Eastern Europe and the USA.

products.name: Almonds
products.description: Our main source of almonds is California. California is the world’s largest producer of almonds with this area producing about 80% of the global almond supply.

products.name: Apricots
products.description: Our apricots are grown in Malatya, Türkiye. We offer both sulphured and natural apricots.

products.name: Poppy Seed
products.description: Poppy seeds are tiny, oil‑rich seeds derived from the poppy plant and are widely used for their nutty flavour and impressive nutritional profile. In addition, they are rich in calcium, magnesium, iron, and fibre, helping to support bone health and sustained energy production.

products.name: Hazelnuts
products.description: Hazelnuts are grown principally in Türkiye (70% of total worldwide production) and Italy (20%), with significant crops produced in Spain, Oregon (USA) and Georgia.

products.name: Mixed Fruit
products.description: We can offer bespoke mixtures of dried fruit to include any of the ingredients in our product range. This is available in either bulk, food service or retail options.

products.name: Pumpkin Seed
products.description: Pumpkin seeds are rich in magnesium, zinc and iron which all support a strong immune system and heart health. The high antioxidant and omega-3 fatty acid content helps to reduce inflammation and promote good sleep.

products.name: Pistachios
products.description: The Pistachio nut is grown on a small tree originating from Central Asia and the Middle East. We mainly source our pistachios from the USA. Pistachios are highly versatile and available in numerous varieties and forms suitable for diverse product applications.

products.name: Currants
products.description: Our main source of Currants is Greece, where black Corinth grapes turn into currants. Greece is by far the largest producer of Currants in the World, whilst the UK is the largest export market.

products.name: Bananas
products.description: Our main source of Banana Chips is the Philippines, specifically the island of Mindanao in the south of the country. We also source from other origins such as Thailand and Vietnam, which export to various parts of the world.

products.name: Figs
products.description: Dried figs are an excellent source of fibre and known for being full of vitamins and minerals, and are recommended as a great addition to your diet. We offer dried figs packed in chopped form.

products.name: Cashews
products.description: We predominantly source our cashew nuts from Vietnam. Cashew nuts are cultivated from a cashew tree, which is a tropical tree originating from Brazil. However, they are now widely grown across several hot climates globally.

products.name: Black Quinoa
products.description: Black Quinoa is a type of grain that is similar to white quinoa but has a darker colour and slightly different nutritional profile. It is a small, round, and black-coloured seed that is also similar in texture to couscous.

products.name: Borlotti Beans
products.description: A variety of kidney bean, this is a large plump bean that is pinkish-brown in colour with reddish-brown streaks. Borlotti beans are widely used in Italian cooking and have a sweetish flavour with a smooth creamy texture. They work well in salads and casseroles. The dried variety needs to be soaked in cold water before cooking.

products.name: Black Eyed Beans
products.description: Black-eyed peas, also known as black-eyed beans, are small, creamy-white beans with a distinctive black spot on one end. They have a mild, slightly sweet flavour and a soft, creamy texture.

products.name: Black Turtle Beans
products.description: Black Turtle Beans are a type of bean that is commonly used in Latin American cuisine. They are small, shiny, and black in colour.

products.name: Pinto Beans
products.description: Pinto beans are a common filling for burritos or tacos in Mexican cuisine as well as chili con carne as an alternative to kidney beans.

products.name: Buckwheat
products.description: Buckwheat is a nutritious, gluten-free seed that is commonly used like a grain. Despite its name, buckwheat is not related to wheat and is suitable for people with gluten intolerance or coeliac disease.

products.name: Popcorn
products.description: Popcorn kernels are naturally whole grain, high in fibre, and can be enjoyed with a variety of sweet or savoury toppings, making them a popular and versatile snack.

products.name: Butter Beans
products.description: White butter beans, a.k.a. lima beans, are large, creamy-white beans with a buttery, sweet flavor and creamy texture. They are commonly used in soups, stews, salads, and casseroles, and are often served as a side dish or mixed with other vegetables and herbs.

products.name: Chickpeas
products.description: Chickpeas are a small, hard, knobby, beige-coloured bean with a diameter of less a centimeter. These pulses tend to look like wrinkled hazelnuts. Many people consume chickpeas in the form of hummus, a type of dip made from mashed chickpeas and tahini.

products.name: Bulgur Wheat
products.description: Bulgur wheat is a nutritious whole grain made from cracked wheat kernels that have been partially cooked and dried. It is a staple ingredient in Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisine, valued for its mild, nutty flavour and quick cooking time.

products.name: Brown Lentils
products.description: Brown lentils are the most common variety – any bag in the grocery store that says “lentils” without any other descriptor is most likely full of brown lentils. This variety of pulse can range in colour from khaki brown to dark black and has a mild, earthy flavour.

products.name: Green Lentils
products.description: Green lentils are extremely similar to brown lentils, but they have a more robust and slightly peppery flavor and come in a range of sizes. These pulses can vary in colour from a pale or spotted green to a green-slate colour with hints of blue and black.

products.name: White Quinoa
products.description: White quinoa is a type of grain that has gained popularity in recent years due to its nutritional benefits and versatility in cooking. It is a small, round, and white-coloured seed that is similar in texture to couscous.

products.name: Red Split Lentils
products.description: We offer a wide range of pulses at Chelmer Foods, from the very popular Red Split Lentils to Black Turtle beans.

products.name: Puy Lentils
products.description: French Type Dark Green Speckled Lentils are a small blue/green lentil known as Puy lentils when grown in the Puy region of France. These pulses have a unique peppery taste and retain their shape well after cooking making them a great addition to lentil bolognese, shepherds pie or salads.

products.name: Dark Red Kidney Beans
products.description: We offer a range of beans including dark red kidney beans, pinto beans, alubia beans, haricot beans, black turtle beans, Borlotti beans etc for use in the retail packing and canning industries.

products.name: Red Quinoa
products.description: Red quinoa is a type of grain that is similar to white quinoa but has a more red colour and slightly different nutritional profile. It is a small, round, and red-coloured seed that is also similar in texture to couscous.

Made with pure butter, chocolate and free-range eggs, without preservatives or artificial colours, they preserve the essence of traditional Spanish wafers. Originally designed for Globus supermarkets in Switzerland , this range combines quality, elegance and tradition. Perfect for breakfast, afternoon treats, or as a delicious complement to desserts and ice cream. Irresistible in every bite!

products.description: Sant Tirs Tulips are crispy wafer cups specially designed to be filled and presented as an elegant edible base for both savoury and sweet creations. Their shape, texture and versatility make them ideal for catering, buffets, restaurants, ice cream shops and pastry professionals. Plain Tulips are perfect for savoury preparations such as salmon or tuna tartare, seafood salads, shrimp cocktail, crab salad, creamy cheese or mousse appetizers, vegetable or avocado salads, and gourmet canapés. Their light, crispy texture and neutral flavour make them an elegant base for cold starters and appetizers. Cocoa Tulips are ideal for sweet pairings such as fruit salads, fruit coulis, ice creams, sorbets, whipped cream, yogurt-based desserts, chocolate or caramel mousse, pastry cream and berries. Their cocoa flavour adds an indulgent touch, making them perfect for mini dessert cups, catering presentations and banqueting.

products.description: Sant Tirs Special Range brings together our gluten-free, organic and sugar-free/reduced-sugar references, created for consumers looking for quality wafers adapted to different needs and preferences. A range that preserves the crispy texture and traditional flavour of Sant Tirs, while offering more inclusive options for today’s market.

products.name: Traditional Sant Tirs Wafers
products.description: Sant Tirs Traditional Wafers Sant Tirs Traditional Wafers represent the most authentic essence of Spanish wafer-making. This range is made with thick rolled wafers , offering a more generous bite and a crispy texture that reflects the traditional style of our artisanal production. The range includes three varieties: plain thick wafers , white-coated thick wafers and cocoa-coated thick wafers . Presented in a classic and elegant packaging, Sant Tirs Traditional Wafers are ideal as a sweet snack, to accompany coffee or tea, or to enjoy with desserts and ice cream. This range is especially suitable for supermarkets, gourmet stores, cafés, hotels, restaurants and distributors looking for authentic Spanish products with a traditional image and high-quality positioning. Caras Wafers Caras Wafers offer a more modern and original interpretation of traditional Spanish wafers. Made with thin rolled wafers , they provide a lighter and more delicate bite, while preserving the crispy texture and authentic flavour that define Sant Tirs products. The range includes the same concept as the traditional line: plain wafers , white-coated wafers and cocoa-coated wafers , but with a thinner wafer and a much more contemporary presentation. Its distinctive box design makes Caras a product with strong visual appeal — not only a delicious sweet snack, but also an original gift in itself. This range is perfect for supermarkets, gourmet stores, concept stores, gift sections, cafés, hotels and distributors looking for products that combine tradition, design and differentiation.

Inspired by the authentic pastel de nata from Mosteiro dos Jerónimos, Belém, Lisbon, this delightful variation delivers a perfect balance of textures and flavours - buttery, delicate pastry paired with a smooth, creamy filling and the natural tartness of mixed berries. Although Gomes lost the election,the dessert won the hearts of Brazilians. products.name: POMACE OLIVE OIL - AMOLIVA
products.description: Olive pomace oil comes from the olive family, ensuring top-notch nutritional quality and excellent culinary performance. It is a blend of extra virgin olive oil and refined olive pomace oil, offering the best of both worlds. During the production of extra virgin olive oil, the olives are pressed and centrifuged to separate the oil from the solid parts of the fruit. While the extra virgin olive oil is obtained directly from this process, the remaining olive paste, known as pomace, undergoes a further extraction process to produce olive pomace oil. Naturally derived from the olive fruit, olive pomace oil is rich in monounsaturated fats, particularly oleic acid, making it a healthier alternative to many other vegetable oils such as sunflower or soybean oil. Its high smoke point and excellent stability at elevated temperatures also make it an ideal choice for frying and a wide range of cooking applications. ❤️ More affordable than extra virgin olive oil and healthier than other vegetable oils 🔥 Ideal for frying and cooking at high temperatures due to its high smoke point 🍽️ Mild flavor that does not overpower the taste of your dishes, making it perfect for sauces, stews, desserts, and more 🧑🏻‍🍳 Reliable choice in homes and professional kitchens 📦 Available in: PET bottle → 1L, 2L, 3L, 5L Tin → 1L, 4L Glass bottle → 250ml, 500ml, 750ml, 1L

products.name: Pistachio Latte Powder
products.description: Chia Tza Teng keeps pace with the latest global market trends by introducing our Pistachio Latte Powder , a premium instant beverage powder designed for today’s fast-growing pistachio craze. Formulated with real pistachio powder , this product delivers a rich, bold, and authentic nutty aroma, combined with a smooth and creamy latte-style mouthfeel. Its elegant green appearance and luxurious flavor profile make it ideal for cafés, bubble tea shops, dessert shops, and specialty beverage brands looking to create trendy, eye-catching drinks. Perfect for pistachio lattes, milk teas, smoothies, frappés, desserts, and limited-edition seasonal menus, Pistachio Latte Powder helps brands capture consumer attention with a premium and memorable flavor experience. Note: This product contains pistachio and should be labeled as containing nuts where required.

products.name: Vegan Creamer
products.description: As the European hand-shaken beverage market continues to grow rapidly, Chia Tza Teng has developed Vegan Creamer Powder to support global beverage brands with a more flexible, export-ready solution. This animal-free formula is designed for international market needs and is suitable for customers looking for plant-based, dairy-free beverage applications. With an enhanced fat content of 32–38% , it delivers a rich, creamy mouthfeel, smooth texture, and refined lingering finish, helping beverages achieve better depth and flavor balance. Our Vegan Creamer Powder blends easily into hand-shaken drinks, milk tea, coffee, instant beverages, and specialty drink formulations. It is an ideal choice for brands seeking to follow vegan, plant-based, and health-conscious trends while maintaining excellent taste and texture. Product Highlights ✅ 100% Animal-Free Formula Suitable for vegan, vegetarian, and lactose-intolerant consumers. ✅ 32–38% Fat Content Provides a rich, smooth, and creamy mouthfeel. ✅ Developed for Global Markets Designed with international export and market requirements in mind. ✅ Silky & Full-Bodied Texture Enhances beverage richness and creates a more satisfying drinking experience. ✅ Wide Applications Ideal for bubble tea, hand-shaken beverages, coffee, instant drink powders, and foodservice formulations.

products.name: Strawberry Flavor Powder
products.description: Strawberry Flavor Powder delivers a bright, sweet, and refreshing strawberry taste with a pleasant fruity aroma and smooth creamy mouthfeel. Its attractive pink color and classic berry flavor make it ideal for milk tea, smoothies, fruit lattes, desserts, and seasonal beverages. Easy to prepare and flexible in application, it helps brands create eye-catching drinks that appeal to a wide range of customers. Vegan creamer formula is also available upon request.

products.name: Yogurt Powder
products.description: Yogurt Powder is inspired by the refreshing taste of yogurt, bringing a balanced sweet-and-tangy flavor to modern beverage and dessert creations. With its smooth texture, light acidity, and pleasant creamy finish, it creates a refreshing taste that is sweet but not heavy. It is ideal for smoothies, yogurt drinks, milk tea, fruit beverages, desserts, ice cream, and seasonal specialty drinks. Its bright and refreshing flavor profile helps brands create products that are both attractive and easy to enjoy, especially for consumers looking for a lighter and more refreshing option.

products.name: Pistachio Flavor Powder
products.description: Pistachio Flavor Powder captures one of the most trending flavors in today’s beverage and dessert market. Inspired by the rising popularity of pistachio drinks, lattes, desserts, and specialty creations, this powder delivers a rich, nutty pistachio aroma with a smooth and creamy mouthfeel. This formula is designed without pistachio powder or nut-derived ingredients , helping brands reduce concerns related to nut allergen labeling while still maintaining the attractive pistachio-style flavor profile. It is ideal for milk tea, lattes, smoothies, desserts, bakery applications, and limited-edition seasonal drinks. With its eye-catching green tone and premium flavor image, Pistachio Flavor Powder helps brands create trendy, Instagram-worthy beverages that stand out in the market.

products.name: Matcha Latte Powder
products.description: Matcha Latte Powder is one of Chia Tza Teng’s highlight products, created to keep up with the growing global trend of matcha beverages. As matcha continues to shine in cafés, bubble tea shops, and dessert menus around the world, this product offers a convenient and eye-catching solution for brands looking to develop trendy green tea creations. With its smooth latte-style mouthfeel, rich matcha aroma, and elegant green appearance, Matcha Latte Powder is ideal for matcha lattes, milk tea, smoothies, frappés, desserts, and seasonal specialty drinks. Easy to prepare and flexible in application, it helps brands create premium, attractive, and market-ready beverages that stand out.

products.name: Taro Flavor Powder
products.description: Taro Flavor Powder is inspired by taro, a popular root vegetable widely used in Asian desserts and beverages for its mild sweetness, creamy texture, and distinctive purple appearance. Our powder delivers a smooth taro flavor with a rich, milky mouthfeel, making it ideal for taro milk tea, smoothies, lattes, desserts, and specialty drinks. We also offer a vegan creamer formula , suitable for plant-based beverage applications and international market needs.

products.name: Mango Flavor Powder
products.description: Mango Flavor Powder delivers the sweet, tropical taste of ripe mango with a smooth and creamy mouthfeel. Mango is one of the most popular fruit flavors worldwide, making it ideal for milk tea, smoothies, fruit lattes, desserts, and summer specialty drinks. Its bright flavor and attractive golden color help create refreshing and eye-catching beverages. We also offer a vegan creamer formula , suitable for plant-based drink applications and international market needs.

products.name: Crème Brûlée Powder
products.description: Crème Brûlée Powder is inspired by the classic French dessert, bringing its sweet caramel aroma, creamy flavor, and indulgent dessert-style experience into modern beverages. Designed for creative drink applications, this powder can be used to make rich crème brûlée toppings, milk foam-style beverages, and walling powder drinks , adding a smooth texture, sweet fragrance, and eye-catching layered effect. With its dessert-inspired flavor profile, Crème Brûlée Powder is ideal for milk tea, black tea, coffee, lattes, smoothies, and specialty drinks. It helps brands create premium, memorable, and visually attractive beverages that stand out on the menu.

products.name: Ube Yam Flavor Powder
products.description: Ube Yam Flavor Powder is formulated with real purple yam powder , bringing a rich purple color, smooth creamy texture, and unique yam-inspired flavor. As purple-themed beverages and desserts continue to create a “Purple Wave” around the world, this product is ideal for milk tea, lattes, smoothies, desserts, and seasonal specialty drinks. With its eye-catching color and trendy flavor profile, Ube Yam Flavor Powder helps brands create memorable and highly attractive beverage products for today’s market.

products.name: Chorizo Riojano PGI
products.description: Made with paprika from La Vera, salt from Añana, and garlic from Las Pedroñeras, the Chorizo protected under the PGI “Chorizo Riojano”, is different to others produced in other regions. It is mild, aromatic, slightly spicy and with an intense colour. For being protected under the PGI “Chorizo Riojano”, the Chorizo must be manufactured in authorized establishments, where external auditors guarantee the different steps in the process, check at the time of receiving the raw materials, production, maturation, drying and packing following strictly the tradition of our ancestors. The “Chorizo Riojano” is made in a horse-shoe shape (Sarta). All the ingredients used in the process are FREE of preservatives or artificial colours. This chorizo is made in La Rioja with specific characteristics such as balanced and intense aroma with a preponderance of paprika and hints of garlic. At Martínez Somalo we are moving forward one step further with the selection of the most prestigious raw materials in the market: paprika from La Vera, salt from Añana, and garlic from Las Pedroñeras, so, this way we can offer the consumer the tastiest chorizo with highest quality ingredients.

products.name: BOBA CHiC Plant-Based Milk Tea Powder – Vegan, Sugar-Free, & Guilt-Free
products.description: BOBA CHiC Plant-Based Milk Tea Powder – Vegan, Sugar-Free, & Guilt-Free Elevate your beverage menu with BOBA CHiC’s Plant-Based Milk Tea Powder. Crafted for the health-conscious market, this 100% vegan and sugar-free formula ensures a slow glycemic response without compromising taste. It delivers the rich, creamy texture of traditional milk tea while remaining free from animal products. The perfect low-burden choice for modern, healthy lifestyle drinks. 100% Zero Artificial Additives — Reducing Compliance Risk at the Source Zero synthetic preservatives, artificial colorings, or chemical flavorings. As Western markets continue to tighten food additive regulations year by year, a clean ingredient list isn’t just a consumer preference — it’s a practical tool for reducing import audit friction. Physical Structure Preservation — Solving the Shelf-Life Challenge for Natural Ingredients Preserving natural ingredients is a recognized technical challenge in the industry. We use physical structure preservation technology — achieving long-term ambient storage without chemical stabilizers, resolving the fundamental tension between ‘natural’ and ‘shelf-stable.’ Cross-border logistics costs remain manageable. Natural High-Fiber Ingredients — Entry Into the Functional Beverage Market Natural high-fiber ingredients such as konjac and psyllium husk are attracting growing attention in the Western health beverage market. These components aren’t just textural differentiation — they’re the basis for building product positioning in fitness channels, organic grocery, and functional food specialty retail. International Food Safety Certifications — Meeting Premium Channel Audit Standards FSSC 22000, ISO, and HACCP certifications cover the selection threshold for premium global retail chains like Whole Foods and Sprouts, so your product application doesn’t get held up at the certification checkpoint.

The vacuum film pulling system and ultrasonic sensor-based high-precision film centering guarantee smooth packaging with minimum waste. A programmable automatic lubrication system and a three-stage electrostatic powder-coated body provide long-lasting durability and minimal maintenance requirements. The machine can operate with or without a photocell and is equipped with a 10’’ touch control screen, offering an intuitive user interface supported by clear graphics for seamless operation. Thanks to PID temperature control, modular design for easy access to every part, and a hygienic structure that allows effortless cleaning, the system delivers consistent quality and reliability. Remote service support via standard Ethernet connection enables quick troubleshooting, while the jaw system detecting product jams ensures maximum efficiency. In addition, the ultrasonic coil diameter measurement and warning system, combined with the film splice detection sensor, further reduce packaging waste and optimize overall performance.

products.name: CITIUS900 SS
products.description: The Hipermak CITIUS900 SS is a high-performance stainless steel vertical packaging machine engineered for medium to high-capacity production environments where reliability, flexibility, and hygiene are essential. Designed to handle a wide variety of products and bag formats, it delivers stable and accurate packaging performance through advanced motion control technology and precise synchronization with dosing systems. Equipped with features such as remote access, automatic centralized lubrication, ultrasonic film tracking, vacuum film pulling belts, and an easy film splicing system, the CITIUS900 SS minimizes downtime while maximizing productivity. Its hygienic stainless steel construction makes it an ideal solution for demanding food production facilities seeking consistent package quality, operational efficiency, and long-term performance.

products.name: WRAPSUS
products.description: Wrapsus places products onto a flat carton sheet and automatically wraps the carton around them (wrap-around method) to form the box. Compared to traditional pre-formed box systems, this method provides tighter, more durable, and more ergonomic packaging. During the wrapping process, the carton perfectly conforms to the shape of the product, minimizing potential damage during transportation and storage. In today’s manufacturing landscape, speed, precision, and cost-efficiency are not just preferences, they are necessities. Wrapsus meets these demands with an intelligent solution driven by engineering excellence.

products.name: PDO PARMIGIANO REGGIANO TRUFFLE CREAM (Tuber aestivum Vitt.)

The goal of Caseificio Comellini, in addition to eliminating lactose, was to produce a cheese with organoleptic characteristics and a flavor identical to that of a traditional cheese. Consumers will not be able to tell the difference between the lactose-free and lactose-containing versions of the product.

products.name: ALKALINE THERMAL WATER SPRAY – 200mL
products.description: Les profondeurs de la Serra de Monchique, en Algarve, naissent de l'eau la plus alcaline du Portugal et du premier spray d'eau thermale alcaline portugaise acheté sur le marché. Deuxièmement, en raison de l'histoire, un século avant le Christ, l'eau Monchique était utilisée par les Romains pour soigner la santé du corps et de l'esprit. Comme leurs propriétés et qualités étaient la forme reconnue qui était apelidada de « Mons Cicus », Montanha Sagrada. Le spray d'eau thermale alcaline Monchique se distingue par ses caractéristiques uniques décoratives avec son pH (9,5), grâce à l'utilisation de la technologie « sac sur valve » qui permet une pulvérisation continue et avec une approbation jusqu'à la dernière fois (99,9%). Testée dermatologiquement et pédiatriquement, l'eau thermale alcaline Monchique est recommandée pour toute la famille, même pour les peaux les plus sensibles. Avec des propriétés suavizantes et protectrices, scientifiquement achetées, hydratées et rafraîchissantes, elles pourraient être utilisées dans le corps et dans le corps, tout au long de l'année et dans n'importe quelle circonstance. Avec un pH alcalin de 9,5, il contient naturellement des minéraux et des oligoéléments bénéfiques pour la santé. Disponible dans un format de 200 ml, le Spray Água Termal Alcalina Monchique se distingue-se peut être utilisé dans n'importe quelle position et l'eau se trouve face à de nombreux incidents qui protègent d'éventuelles contaminations. « Guide de l'utilisateur à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur » est la revendication qui inspire le lancement d'un nouveau produit et qui associe l'eau Monchique au marché dermocosmétique.

products.description: The original Neapolitan Pizza flour approved by the Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana (AVPN) *. A new product designed to meet the needs of expert pizza chefs and, at the same time, offer home cooks a high-level technical product. This Type "0" soft wheat flour yields a high-performing dough, ideal for authentic Neapolitan pizza—soft, fragrant, foldable "a libretto" (wallet-style), and with the iconic tall, airy crust ( cornicione )—as well as for making the large "wagon wheel" ( ruota di carro ) pizza that overflows from the plate. *The Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana, founded in Naples in 1984, aims to promote and protect authentic Neapolitan pizza in Italy and worldwide, according to the official Regulations that define the rules for the collective trademark "Vera Pizza Napoletana.

products.name: Gluten Free Teef pasta
products.description: Gluten-free Teff pasta, bronze-extruded and slowly dried at low temperatures. Free of emulsifiers. Native to Ethiopia, Teff is the smallest grain in the world. This characteristic makes it impossible to separate the different parts of the grain during milling, allowing Teff to retain all its proteins and 8 essential amino acids. Naturally gluten-free, Teff allows us to satisfy the health and functional needs of consumers: it contains a specific type of starch that does not turn into sugar and passes untouched through the digestive tract (resistant starch). The result is a tasty pasta with great resistance to overcooking compared to classic gluten-free pasta.

products.name: Gran Mugnaio flour
products.description: The original "00" Gran Mugnaio Lump-Free Flour, perfect for all kitchen uses. Thanks to a consistent lump-free calibration, it can be used for all culinary applications, both professional and home-use. Particularly suitable for pasta, gnocchi, and pastry making. This flour has been formulated to achieve the best results in preparing traditional and extruded fresh pasta. Additionally, it optimizes the performance of mechanical mixers and pasta extruders. The product does not darken and stays light longer than regular flours. It offers superior cooking durability while handling just like normal flour. It features a balanced protein-to-carbohydrate ratio to ensure a high-volume, elastic, translucent, and rough-textured final product after cooking, making it hold sauce much better.

products.name: Dough for Gran Pizza alla Napoletana
products.description: Homemade Neapolitan-style Gran Pizza dough, in ready-to-use frozen dough balls: a new practical and always reliable solution. Born from the expertise of Molino Spadoni, the dough is made with selected flours and fresh sourdough starter in a convenient pack of two 250 g dough balls for two pizzas. Dedicated to Neapolitan pizza lovers, it is prepared in 5 simple steps: Thaw Allow to rise Stretch Top Bake in a convection oven at 250°C for 4 minutes A professional result is guaranteed: excellent, uniform, and consistent every time.

products.name: Seohae O-myeon
products.description: Seohaeomyeon is a seafood-based premium boutique cup noodle featuring Manila clams from the West Sea of Korea, characterized by its clear, mild broth and distinct flavor profile. Unlike traditional Korean ramen that typically focuses on spiciness, it offers a new, non-spicy alternative that anyone can easily enjoy. Furthermore, it was designed not just as a standalone product, but as a series-based local goods brand with the potential to expand into variations featuring the East Sea and South Sea. Beyond being a simple food item, It was launched as a first-of-its-kind collaboration with the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, the Korea Fisheries Infrastructure and Fishing Communities Agency, and the Gunheon Fishing Village in Boryeong, Chungcheongnam-do. Seohaeomyeon offers a convenient way to experience the ocean and culinary culture of Korea. Through this, the goal is to pioneer a new category of K-Food, both domestically and in the global market.

products.name: GIMNYEONG HAENYEO VILLAGE HIJIKI/ABALONE/TUBAN SHEL RICE
products.description: Inspired by the pristine coastal waters of Jeju Island, this premium rice collection showcases three distinctive local ingredients—hijiki, abalone, and horned turban shell—carefully harvested from the sea by Jeju Haenyeo divers. Each variety captures the unique flavors and textures of Jeju’s marine ingredients, offering an authentic and convenient way to experience the island’s rich seafood heritage. The Hijiki Rice features locally harvested hijiki, known for its distinctive ocean aroma and pleasantly firm texture, creating a light yet flavorful combination with rice. The Abalone Rice is made with Korean abalone, adding its tender, pleasantly chewy texture and rich umami flavor for a more premium dining experience. The Horned Turban Shell Rice highlights the firm and springy texture of locally sourced horned turban shell, complemented by a savory seafood soy sauce that brings out its naturally rich ocean flavor. Each rice dish comes with a specially prepared soy sauce, allowing the flavors of the ingredients to come together harmoniously and making it easy to enjoy a satisfying meal. Combining quality local ingredients with convenience, the collection brings the freshness of Jeju’s sea and the unique culinary heritage of its Haenyeo culture directly to the table. It is an excellent choice for everyday meals as well as a distinctive premium gift representing the flavors of Jeju.

products.name: Buckwheat Noodles
products.description: Made from high‑fiber, protein‑rich buckwheat flour, these gluten‑free noodles have a firm, earthy texture. They help maintain stable blood sugar levels, support heart health by lowering cholesterol, and keep you full longer to assist weight management. Served hot in broth or chilled with dip, they’re a wholesome staple for clean eating.

products.name: Buckwheat Tea
products.description: This roasted grain tea delivers a rich, nutty aroma and a smooth, caffeine‑free taste. Rich in rutin, it helps strengthen blood vessels and support circulation. Its antioxidants combat oxidative stress, while the warm infusion aids digestion and promotes relaxation—a perfect healthy alternative to sugary or caffeinated drinks.

products.name: Strawberry from Gard & wild strawberries jam by La Cuillère Gourmande
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends La Cuillère Gourmande’s strawberry jam made with Gard strawberries and wild strawberries. Handcrafted in small batches and cooked in a copper cauldron, it combines the sweetness of Gard strawberries with the delicate yet intense aroma of wild strawberries. Available in 210 g, 130 g and 50 g jars.

products.name: Apple & salted butter preparation by La Cuillère Gourmande
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends La Cuillère Gourmande’s salted butter-flavoured apple preserve. Handcrafted in small batches and cooked in a copper cauldron, this recipe combines the melt-in-the-mouth texture of the apple with delicious hints of salted butter. Available in 210g, 130g and 50g jars.

products.name: Whole duck foie gras, Maison Patignac
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends the duck foie gras from Maison Patignac, a family-run cannery in Occitanie which, since 1966, has been upholding traditional craftsmanship in the production of gastronomic specialities from the South-West. Made exclusively from French duck foie gras, salt and freshly ground black pepper, this product stands out for its straightforward, simple and authentic recipe. Their expertise has been recognised on several occasions at the Concours Général Agricole de Paris: silver medals in 2005, 2015 and 2016, followed by a bronze medal in 2019. Available in 90g, 130g, 180g and 300g.

products.name: Duck terrine with Menton IGP candied lemon by Maison Patignac
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends Maison Patignac’s duck terrine with Menton IGP candied lemon. Produced at the family-run cannery in Montesquieu-Volvestre, this recipe combines the distinctive flavour of French duck with the slightly tangy freshness of Menton IGP candied lemon. An original and well-balanced combination, seasoned with pepper and spices, which offers a refined take on the traditional terrines of the South-West. Available in 90g and 180g jars.

products.name: Blackberry Jam by La Cuillère Gourmande
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends La Cuillère Gourmande’s blackberry jam. Handcrafted and cooked in a copper cauldron, it brings out the full fruity and slightly tangy flavour of the blackberry. Available in 210 g, 130 g and 50 g jars.

products.name: Non-alcoholic sparkling apple juice Château du Clau
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends Château du Clau’s non-alcoholic sparkling apple juice. With its beautiful golden colour, it is made exclusively from the first apples of the season. This early harvest gives it a pleasant freshness, a lovely liveliness and a tangy flavour that lingers on the palate. Available in 37.5cl and 75cl bottles.

products.name: Culinary confit with Sauternes by La Cuillère Gourmande
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends La Cuillère Gourmande’s Sauternes wine confit. Handcrafted and cooked in a copper cauldron, it brings out the sweet, fruity notes of this famous sweet wine. Ideal with foie gras, cheeses or terrines. Available in 50 g and 130 g jars.

products.name: Organic tinned mountain trout, marinated in lemon and basil by La Truitelle
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends La Truitelle’s mountain trout marinated in lemon and basil. Raised using traditional methods in the fast-flowing waters of the mountains, these small organic rainbow trout are pre-steamed and then tinned whole by hand. Their delicate flesh is accompanied by an oil-free marinade of lemon and basil. A fresh, light and pleasantly tangy recipe, made exclusively from organic ingredients.

products.name: Gourmet tinned organic mountain trout, marinated in olive oil, dill and caraway by La Truitelle
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends La Truitelle’s small mountain trout in olive oil, with dill and caraway. Raised using traditional methods in the fast-flowing mountain streams, these organic rainbow trout are canned whole by hand. Their delicate flesh is enhanced by extra virgin olive oil and the subtle aniseed notes of dill and caraway. A refined recipe with Scandinavian influences. 85g tin

products.name: Non-alcoholic sparkling apple peach  juice Château du Clau
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends Château du Clau’s non-alcoholic sparkling apple and peach juice. A true taste of sunshine, it combines the freshness of orchard apples with the delicate aromas of white peaches. Its lovely roundness and balance between sweetness and acidity make it a fruity and refreshing drink. Available in 37.5cl and 75cl bottles.

products.name: Non-alcoholic sparkling apple raspberry  juice Château du Clau
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends Château du Clau’s non-alcoholic sparkling apple and raspberry juice. With its intense carmine-red colour and delicately pulpy texture, it captivates with its freshness and rich aromas. Its fine balance between sweetness and acidity reveals deep, indulgent notes of raspberry. Available in 37.5cl and 75cl bottles.

products.name: Cassoulet with duck confit wings & Toulouse sausage by Maison Patignac
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends Maison Patignac’s traditional cassoulet, made with duck confit and Toulouse sausage. Prepared in Occitanie by this family-run cannery founded in 1966, this iconic recipe from the South-West combines Lingot beans grown in the Lauragais region, generous pieces of duck confit and fresh Toulouse sausage. The whole dish is simmered in a sauce made with tomatoes, duck fat, onions, garlic and aromatic herbs. Available in several sizes: 380 g, 790 g, 1.350 kg and 2.4 kg.

products.name: Organic tinned mountain trout, with tomato and smoked paprika La Truitelle
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends La Truitelle’s mountain trout with tomato and smoked paprika. Raised using traditional methods in the fast-flowing waters of the moutains, these small organic rainbow trout are canned whole by hand. They are coated in a savoury tomato sauce with olive oil, subtly seasoned with smoked paprika and a hint of Espelette pepper. A delicious, fragrant and delicately spiced recipe.100g tin

products.name: Apple juice  infused with ginger Château du Clau
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends Château du Clau’s apple and ginger juice. This artisanal recipe combines the natural sweetness of apple with the subtly spicy and invigorating flavour of ginger. Available in 1-litre bottles

products.name: La Truitelle organic trout, beetroot and horseradish spread
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends La Truitelle’s organic trout spread with beetroot and horseradish. This creamy spread combines the delicate flavour of rainbow trout with the sweetness of beetroot and the slightly tangy kick of horseradish. A colourful, original and well-balanced recipe, ideal as an aperitif spread on fresh or lightly toasted bread. 90g jar

products.name: Organic hummus with bean and tomato from Maison Patignac
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends Maison Patignac’s organic tomato and bean hummus. This delicious, plant-based recipe combines French lingot beans with tomatoes, seasoned with olive oil, lemon, garlic, cumin and basil. An original alternative to traditional hummus. Available in 90g and 180g jars.

products.name: Vine peach jam by La Cuillère Gourmande
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends La Cuillère Gourmande’s vine peach jam. Handcrafted and cooked in a copper cauldron, it brings out the fragrant and slightly tangy flavour of the vine peach. Available in 210 g, 130 g and 50 g jars.

products.name: Organic veggie terrine from Maison Patignac
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends Maison Patignac’s organic vegetarian country-style terrine. Made from lentils and smoked tofu, this plant-based recipe puts a new spin on the traditional country-style terrine. Rich and slightly smoky, it is a genuine vegetarian and organic alternative to classic terrines.

products.name: Organic apple juice Château du Clau
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends Château du Clau’s 1-litre organic apple juice. Made from apples grown in its own orchards, this filtered juice, with its golden honey colour, delights with its sweetness, delicate floral notes and lovely aromatic finesse. A true classic, both natural and authentic. Available in 1-litre and 25cl bottles.

products.name: Organic trout spread, peas, mint by La Truitelle
products.description: Occitanie Gourmet recommends La Truitelle’s organic trout spread with peas and mint. This creamy spread combines the delicate flavour of rainbow trout with the sweetness of peas and the freshness of mint. A light and zesty recipe, ideal as an aperitif spread on fresh or lightly toasted bread. Available in a 90g jar.

products.name: KOLIOS Authentic Greek Yogurt
products.description: KOLIOS Authentic Greek Yogurt — crafted with pasteurized cow's milk and awarded gold medals year after year for its exceptional quality and superior taste. Discover the signature thick texture and the rich, creamy taste of KOLIOS Authentic Greek Strained Yogurt — available in 10%, 5%, 2%, and 0% fat, so everyone can find their perfect match. Craving something fruity? Our Authentic Greek Yogurt 0% comes layered with strawberry, blueberry, pomegranate & raspberry, or peach — a delicious way to indulge, guilt-free. Prefer it sweet and simple? Try our Authentic Greek Yogurt 0% with honey in a separate portion, pairing that same thick, creamy texture with the natural sweetness of fine honey. And for those who go the extra mile — our Organic Authentic Greek Yogurt, available in 10% or 0% fat, made from Greek organic cow's milk and certified by Bio Hellas.

They are all made from pasteurised sheep's milk.

products.name: KOLIOS Authentic Greek Yogurt 0% fat with Blueberry or Vanilla

The combination of creamy, authentic Greek yogurt and the sweet, aromatic flavour of vanilla creates a balanced and satisfying treat. You can also try KOLIOS Authentic GREEK Strained Yogurt with a Fruity Blueberry flavour . A perfect blend of rich taste and natural goodness in every spoonful! Both flavours come in a generous 500g cup.

products.name: KOLIOS Feta cheese P.D.O.
products.description: KOLIOS Authentic Feta cheese P.D.O. , matured in brine, is made from pasteurised sheep’s and goat’s milk from free-grazing animals. The natural aroma of Mediterranean grasses and the company’s great tradition and knowledge in cheesemaking guarantee the unique, excellent taste of KOLIOS Feta. Feta is a basic ingredient of Greek cuisine. Enjoy it: in an original Greek salad, in sandwiches with sliced tomatoes, with some drops of olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano or pepper on top, or simply as a tasteful addition to almost every Mediterranean dish. KOLIOS Authentic Feta cheese PDO has been repeatedly awarded for its quality and taste by international institutes. Find your favourite: Barrel aged Feta PDO Organic Feta PDO Feta PDO - Less Salt Feta PDO - Lactose Free

products.name: KOLIOS The Traditional classic
products.description: “The Traditional Classic” cheese is the best-known semi-hard cheese in Greece. It has been produced by KOLIOS since 1948 according to a secret family recipe. Made from fresh pasteurised cow’s milk, it is an aromatic cheese with a mild, lightly salted taste. In the same range, you can find: The “Traditional Light” is a reduced-fat semi-hard cheese made from semi-skimmed cow’s milk. The “Traditional Smoked” is made from cow’s milk. It is distinguished for its especially fine aroma and subtly smoky taste.

products.name: Hulled Barley
products.description: Hulled barley (sometimes called dehulled barley) is the result of cleaning and partially debranning barley berries. Minimally processed to remove only the tough inedible outer hull, hulled barley offers superior nutrient content that’s rich in dietary fiber. It is the healthiest barley product.

products.name: Oat Fiber
products.description: Oat fiber is a great source of insoluble fiber with many nutritional and functional benefits. Oat fiber absorbs high amounts of lipids and water, resulting in improved crumb softness and texture. It also improves nutrition, yields, and functionality to foods like cereals, breads, snacks, bars, and meat products.

products.name: Whole Red Wheat
products.description: Whole red wheat, or “berries,” result from a thorough cleaning of hard winter or spring red wheats. The hull and outer shell are removed, leaving the entire edible part—the germ, bran and endosperm—of the wheat kernel. Tasty and nutritious, hard berries are most commonly baked into breads, with significant use in cereals, snack foods, coatings, and binders.

products.name: Rolled Oats
products.description: To create rolled oats, whole grain groats are first steamed, then rolled flat into flakes. Sometimes referred to as “old-fashioned” oats, rolled oats cook faster than steel-cut oats and are a great source of soluble fiber (beta glucans) along with other phytochemicals such as avenanthramides. Rolled oats provide a rich oat flavor to a variety of common products like granola bars, cookies, muffins, cereals, and beverages because they can provide flavor, texture, and nutrition.

products.name: White Hilum Soybeans
products.description: The soybean’s hilum is the “eye” that indicates where the seed had been attached to the pod and can vary in color. White Hilum soybeans are suitable for making tofu, soymilk, tempeh, and other soyfood products. Available as non-GMO, conventional, and certified organic.

products.name: High Protein Soybeans
products.description: These large-seed high-protein soybeans are suitable for manufacturing tofu, soymilk, soy flour, soy protein, and other soyfood products. All of our soybeans are Non-GMO certified and available as conventional or organic.

products.name: Oat Flour
products.description: These ground groats still have their bran layer intact, which makes whole oat flour a great source of soluble fiber (beta glucans) along with essential minerals. Oat flour is an ideal ingredient when you’re looking to add flavor, nutrition, and viscosity to a wide range of end products. Oat flour can be used in dairy products, as a thickener for soups, gravies, and stews, and to add nutrition to breads, muffins, crackers, beverages, and desserts.

products.name: Whole Brown Flaxseed
products.description: Flaxseed can add a nutty flavor and pleasing appearance to a variety of baked goods and other food applications. The healthy and flavorful properties are ideal additions to mixes, breads, beverages, and many other applications where an emphasis on health and nutrition is desired.

products.name: Whole Yellow Kernels
products.description: Produced by direct grower contract on sustainable farms, Grain Millers whole kernel corn is a wholesome ingredient, rich in flavor and fiber. With our state-of-the-art optical sorting technology and industry-leading food safety standards, you can depend on our quality and uniformity perfect for your snack food applications.

products.name: Oat Groats
products.description: Groats are the hulled, whole, and unbroken inner kernels of the oat, and are the source of almost every other oat product available. They contain all three parts of the oat, making them the most nutritious oat product, along with steel cut oats. We kiln them for two reasons. The first is to achieve a nice toasty flavor. The second is to inactivate the enzyme that causes oats to go rancid, thus creating a more shelf-stable product. The result is a healthy, chewy texture that’s ideal for cereals, casseroles, cookies, and more.

products.name: Halawa Extra Chewy
products.description: Halawa Extra Chewy also known as Halawa Chouchieh is a traditional confectionery originating from the Levant area, renowned for its distinctively chewy and dense texture. it is free of preservatives and whitening agent, distinguished by a sweet flavor that does not melt easily in the mouth. its unique consistency and authentic flavor make it satisfying snack for those who enjoy a more substantial texture experience.

products.name: Tahini - Sesame Seeds Paste
products.description: Our Tahini "Daabool Brothers" is made with the finest premium sesame seeds, by grinding 100% of hulled and roasted white sesame with high oil content, giving it a rich earthy flavor with a smooth and homogeneous texture while preserving the original whitish color. Tahini is a staple in many cuisines, especially in the Mediterranean and the Middle East, and the main ingredient in many popular traditional dishes like hummus, baba ghannouj and halawa.

products.name: Halawa Extra Almond
products.description: Halawa Extra Almond is a delicious variation of the traditional halawa, crafted from high quality tahini, and enriched with crunchy almonds. Sweetened with sugar and combined with natural root extract and flavors, it delivers a satisfying nutty taste and a balanced sweetness. its delicate texture and pleasant aroma make it a wholesome and enjoyable snack. Halawa Almond is often served as a dessert, or as a topping for pastries and baked goods.

products.name: Halawa Extra Plain
products.description: Halawa "Daabool Brothers" is a type of confectionery popular in the Middle East, Asia, The Balkans, The Caucasus, Eastern Europe and North Africa. Our halawa Plain is a thick mixture made from tahini (100% sesame seeds) and sweetened with treated sugar in the presence of root extract and flavors. It is vegan with no preservatives. Specialized by its dry crunchy texture and pleasent smell, our halawa is considered a stable sweet snack that can be eaten at any time solely or with bread, tea and coffee.

products.name: Halawa Extra Pistachio
products.description: Halawa Pistachio "Daabool Brothers" is a type of confectionery popular in the Middle East, Asia, The Balkans, The Caucasus, Eastern Europe and North Africa. Our halawa pistachio, similar to our halawa plain, is a thick mixture made from tahini (and sweetened with treated sugar in the presence of root extract and flavors then roasted high quality pistachios are added to the mixture. It is vegan with no preservatives and can be eaten with coffee or tea.

products.name: Halawa Extra Chocolate
products.description: Halawa Extra Chocolate brings together the traditional richness of tahini with the smooth, indulgent taste of chocolate. Sweetened with sugar and blended with root extract, it offers a unique fusion of Middle Eastern heritage. and modern flavor. With its soft texture and inviting chocolate aroma, it is an irresistible snack suitable for any time of the day.

Made in Colombia from fruit grown by local farmers, they are part of a project designed to support farming communities and add value to their produce, notably through a partnership with an association of growers committed to protecting their land. The project contributes to the preservation of Colombia’s páramos, unique high-altitude ecosystems that are essential to biodiversity and water regulation. By creating value around local crops, FEROZ helps develop economic alternatives that enable communities to protect these fragile ecosystems while showcasing Colombia’s exceptional flavours. FEROZ Crisps are made in Colombia from fruit cut into thin slices and slowly oven-baked to naturally concentrate their flavours and achieve a light, crispy texture. Not fried, with no added oil or sugar, they offer an alternative to traditional chips while preserving the naturally intense flavour of the fruit. Easy and quick to cook on a grill or in a non-stick pan, it can be enjoyed on its own – as an excellent accompaniment to wine, ouzo or raki – in salads, snacks, or any other recipe you may imagine! products.name: Go Chill RTD
products.description: Go Chill RTD by Delta Cafés Overview Go Chill is a ready-to-drink (RTD) milk-and-coffee beverage carrying the Delta signature, developed within the Nabeiro Group under the Delta Cafés brand. Launched in 2019, it was created as part of the Mind – Modelo de Inovação da Delta , the group's internal innovation platform. Positioning Go Chill targets a generation with new coffee-consumption habits — mobile, urban, and always on the move. The "on the go" concept is designed for anywhere, anytime consumption: between classes, in meetings, on the metro, or during a quick break, packaged in a practical glass cup. The brand positioning leans toward a younger audience, rooted in surf, skate, and travel culture, though Delta notes the communication reaches across age groups, from 18 to 55. Product range Go Chill is available in seven varieties, including: Caffè Latte — espresso, milk, and creamy milk foam Cappuccino/Cocoa — espresso, steamed milk, velvety foam, touch of cocoa Cappuccino/Oat — lighter combination of espresso and organic oat drink Double Espresso — two espressos, no added sugars Caramel Macchiato Cookies & Cream — more recent launch, coffee with cookies and cream notes A coffee-free variant — ready-to-drink chocolate milk The Caffè Latte format, for example, contains 67% whole milk and 25% Delta coffee, plus sugar, maltodextrin and stabilizers, in a standard 230ml cup. Product development According to Rui Túbal, Marketing Manager for Mais Marcas at Grupo Nabeiro-Delta Cafés, developing a new flavor takes four to eight months , from market trend analysis, to flavor shortlisting, to consumer testing via social media and events, before final launch. Communication Go Chill relies on a fashion-inspired visual identity, digital and outdoor (mupi) campaigns, an active Instagram (@gochillbydelta, ~16,000 followers), and a dedicated site (gochill.pt), using taglines like "Never Still Always Chill" and "Go Chill or Go Home."

products.name: GROUND COFFEE
products.description: Delta Ground Coffee Overview Ground coffee is one of Delta Cafés' core, traditional product categories, alongside coffee beans, capsules (Delta Q), instant coffee, and RTD drinks in the group's wider portfolio. The range is built around single-origin and blended references , each named after its country or region of origin, giving distributors and retailers a clear, geography-driven product line. Roasting philosophy Across the range, Delta uses a consistent production method: slow drum roasting at approximately 194°C for around 20 minutes. This gentle, extended process is designed to develop aromas in a balanced way without leaving excess oiliness on the bean, resulting in coffees that are full-bodied and creamy, with low oiliness and a harmonious flavor. Origin-based range Portugal — Arabica and Robusta blend from top growing regions, full-bodied with light acidity and delicate aroma; positioned as an authentic expression of Portuguese coffee culture Brazil — sourced largely from Cerrado Mineiro and Sul de Minas, balanced acidity, sweet and fruity tropical aroma, good body and rich aroma Colombia — smooth, velvety blend with slight citrus notes, sourced from the Tolima and Huila regions Vietnam — single-origin Arabica from central-western Vietnam, medium caffeine, full-bodied and chocolatey Ritual — Tanzanian Arabica with Angolan Robusta, very intense and full-bodied, red berry and dark chocolate notes, positioned for daily espresso, mocha, or filter coffee Lote Chávena — finely ground espresso blend of Brazilian and Guatemalan Arabica with Ugandan Robusta, optimized for portafilter/espresso machines, with malt, hazelnut, and dark chocolate notes and dense, velvety crema The broader Delta catalogue also includes blends built on Brazilian/Guatemalan Arabica with Ugandan Robusta (malt, chocolate, hazelnut notes), and Angolan Robusta with Guatemalan Arabica (caramel, roasted nut notes), plus a caffeine-free 100% barley alternative with no added fats or sugars. Positioning The ground coffee line is presented as a way to bring authentic, origin-specific coffee experiences home — from everyday breakfast blends to more intense, ritual-oriented options — using traditional brewing methods (filter, French press, moka pot, or espresso machine) rather than the capsule system.

products.name: ADEGA MAYOR Wine
products.description: Adega Mayor Wines Overview Adega Mayor produces wines from its 350-hectare estate in Campo Maior, Alto Alentejo, part of the Grupo Nabeiro portfolio. The wines are made from native and international grape varieties grown across the Argamassas and Godinha estates, with the granite-influenced soils of the Serra de São Mamede giving the range its characteristic freshness and minerality, layered onto the classic body and structure of Alentejo wines. Product ranges The winery organizes its offering into several distinct lines, each with its own identity: Pai Chão — the entry point of the top-tier range, described as being "born in Campo Maior, in union with nature." The Grande Reserva Pai Chão sits above it as Adega Mayor's flagship and most iconic wine, produced only in exceptional years, when nature, time and human expertise truly come together. It's typically a blend dominated by Alicante Bouschet with Touriga Nacional (commonly around 80%/20%), aged roughly 18–24 months in French oak followed by bottle ageing. Tasting notes describe a concentrated, opaque, vibrant ruby wine, intense and complex, with liquorice, dark chocolate and subtle smoky oak notes, full-bodied with elegant tannins and excellent ageing potential. It has been ranked among the top wines of Portugal and top 5 of Alentejo, earning Gold at Mundus Vini (2020 vintage) and the Berlin Wine Trophy, along with strong scores from Wine Enthusiast and Revista de Vinhos (up to 97 points). Adega Mayor Maestro — a line of single-varietal (monovariety) wines. The brand's own framing: because certain grape varieties deserve to be "heard" on their own, the Monovariety range enhances the individuality of each grape's profile within the estate's terroir. Reserva do Comendador — a tribute wine named for Commander Rui Nabeiro, positioned as a narrative-driven bottle meant to reflect his life and legacy. Seleção Mayor — described as a range that draws all the senses to the table. A sparkling wine line, positioned for toasting special occasions. White, red and rosé wines across the broader range, made from grapes including Aragonez, Trincadeira, Castelão, Alicante Bouschet, Syrah and Touriga Nacional for reds, and Antão Vaz, Verdelho and other varieties for whites. Style and typicity As part of the wider Alentejo appellation, Adega Mayor's reds are generally full-bodied, fruit-forward and structured, in keeping with the region's reputation for rich, warm-climate wines. The estate's granitic soils are credited with giving its wines added freshness and minerality compared to some of the softer, warmer-soil wines typical of the wider Alentejo plain. Beyond wine The Adega Mayor brand also extends into olive oils (Adega Mayor Olive Oils, part of the same table-focused philosophy as Seleção Mayor) and a sustainability initiative called the "OR project," a partnership with the natural cosmetics brand Amber that repurposes waste from the winemaking cycle.
