products.name: Delta Q COFFEE MACHINES
products.description: Delta Q Coffee Machines Overview Delta Q is the capsule coffee division within the Nabeiro Group's portfolio, positioned as the group's capsule coffee specialist. As a result of the Delta Cafés group's capacity for innovation, it is characterised by its core values: Quality, Simplicity, Sharing and Innovation. The brand offers a range of 29 blends and several models of Delta Q coffee machines suitable for each consumer, all with the same result: a perfect espresso every time. Nabeiro Group + 2 System concept Delta Q operates a closed capsule system : the machines and capsules that make up the Delta Q system have been developed and tested together to ensure extraction of the perfect espresso, and the use of Delta Q capsules ensures perfect compatibility with Delta Q devices. Machines are designed exclusively for Delta Q capsules — using non-Delta Q pods can affect performance and, per the manufacturer, may shift responsibility for any resulting damage onto the user. Device Report The blend range goes beyond coffee: Delta Q blends include coffees, teas, herbal teas, and cereals created with every taste and every moment in mind, through a careful selection of the best origins and the art of roasting and blending. DeltaQ GL Common technical traits across the machine range Based on manuals and specs for several models (Quick 3, Iconiq, Qool Evolution, Mini Qool), Delta Q machines generally share: 19-bar pump pressure for extraction and crema formation Compact, minimalist design — footprints suited to small kitchens, offices, or apartments One-touch / lever-based operation — raise the lever, insert the capsule, lower the lever, press espresso or long-drink button Automatic extraction cut-off — the machine stops the flow on its own once the programmed volume is reached Used-capsule reservoir — typically holding up to 10 spent capsules, ejected automatically after brewing Water tank capacity ranging roughly from 0.8 to 1 liter depending on the model Power typically in the 1200–1455 W range, 220–240V / 50–60Hz Descaling recommended every three months or roughly every 300 capsule extractions Notable models Delta Q Quick 3 — entry-level, compact espresso machine with lever-loaded capsule housing and a simple two-button interface (espresso ~30cc / long drinks ~180cc) Delta Q Iconiq — a slightly more refined model, similar 19-bar system, 800ml tank, touch-sensitive extraction buttons, 3.5kg Delta Q Qool Evolution — described as the brand's more advanced "forever machine," with programmable volumes for espresso, coffee, and long drinks/infusions, a 1-litre removable water tank, a thermoblock heating element for rapid heating, and an automatic standby shutdown after 10 minutes of inactivity Techinn Delta Q Mini Qool — the most compact model in the line, an 0.8-liter tank version aimed at small counter spaces, still built around the 19-bar pump Brand positioning Delta Q's global site frames the promise this way: every day, Delta Q brings to life the promise to offer an espresso that's always perfect, in the simplest way, combining the widest range of blends with the simplicity, convenience and cleanliness of the capsule system. On the sustainability side, the brand highlights that its capsules are recyclable, aligning with a broader environmental commitment across the machine and capsule ecosystem. DeltaQ GL Sources Delta Q — Grupo Nabeiro (official, EN) Delta Q Global website Delta Q Iconiq — Instruction Manual Delta Q Quick 3 — Instruction Manual Delta Q Qool Evolution — Techinn product page Delta Q Mini Qool — Techinn product page

products.name: Delta Q capsules
products.description: Delta Q Capsules Overview Delta Q capsules are the proprietary capsule-coffee format at the heart of the Delta Q system — a closed ecosystem where capsules and machines are developed together to guarantee, in the brand's words, a perfect espresso every time. The brand offers a range of 29 blends and several coffee-machine models, all built around the same promise: consistent flavour, aroma and creaminess in every cup, achieved through the exact combination of beans from different coffee-producing regions and the art of roasting. Beyond coffee, the Delta Q capsule range also includes teas, herbal teas and cereal-based drinks, created for different moments and preferences. Intensity scale and product architecture Delta Q capsules are organized primarily around an intensity scale from 1 to 15 , allowing consumers and distributors to select blends by strength rather than just by name. Each capsule reference typically comes with a sensory profile broken into Aroma, Body, Acidity, and Intensity scores (each generally out of 10), giving a standardized way to compare blends. Examples across the range: Blend Intensity Origin Tasting notes deQafeinatus 1 — Rich, intense, caramel and roasted nut notes, decaffeinated Qonvictus 5 — Balanced, full-bodied, caramel and chocolate notes, delicate acidity Qanela 7 — Medium body, cinnamon, hazelnut and roasted nut notes aQtivus 8 — Intense, roasted nutty aroma, light fruity touch Qharacter 9 Brazil, Ivory Coast, Colombia Intense flavour, caramel and nut notes, balanced acidity Qalidus 10 Angola, Cameroon, Honduras (decaf version blends Robusta/Arabica) Full-bodied, strong presence, slight acidity, caramel notes Qharisma 12 — Lively, full-bodied, cocoa and roasted hazelnut notes Double 13 — Very intense, full-bodied, slightly acidic epiQ 14 Ivory Coast, Angola, Congo Full-bodied, very intense, low acidity, roasted walnut/nut notes mythiQ 15 (highest) Angola, Cameroon Delta Q's most intense blend, full-bodied, cocoa/chocolate/toasted nut notes The brand also offers origin-specific single-country capsules (e.g., a Colombia reference, intensity 8, with floral and chocolate notes) and lighter/non-coffee options such as Delta Q Pure , a barley-based capsule — notably, Delta Q was the first brand to offer barley in capsule form for a caffeine-free alternative. Sourcing and production philosophy The stated "secret" to Delta Q's quality lies in blending beans from multiple coffee-producing regions in precise proportions, paired with careful roasting technique. Popular blends like epiQ draw specifically on West and Central African origins (Ivory Coast, Angola, Congo), while others combine South American and African/Central American origins depending on the flavour profile targeted. Compatibility and format Capsules are sold in standard sleeves of 10, with larger multi-sleeve packs (40 or 80 capsules) common in export/retail markets such as the US. They are designed exclusively for Delta Q machines, and the brand states that using non-Delta Q capsules in Delta Q devices — or vice versa — is not guaranteed and may affect performance or void responsibility for resulting damage. Most coffee capsules are noted as gluten-free, and nutritional declarations are available per 100g on individual product listings. products.name: Urpiner IPL Dry Hopped Beer

The pale lager is enriched with hops several times, using special American hops, Mosaic. The last dry hopping with Hercules hops gives it its unique character. The taste begins with subtle malty tones, passes into the full taste of a quality lager and reaches the final tones of refreshing fruity bitterness, typical of India Pale Ale beers. Urpiner IPL 13 ° DRY HOPPED is characterized by a high degree of bitternes, up to 34 IBU units, placing it among the most distinctively bitter beers. The intense hop aroma, amber-golden color, fresh crispiness and rich compact foam complete the excellency of this beer delicacy.

products.name: Urpiner Premium beer
products.description: The premium pilsner-type lager is characterised by a higher alcohol content and fullness of flavour. It harmoniously combines malt and hop taste with medium to high crispness. Its distinctive colour and delicious refreshing sensation complement its overall character perfectly. It meets even the most demanding criteria of beer enthusiasts and enjoys the greatest popularity. Its qualities are also evidenced by numerous domestic and international awards.

products.name: Urpiner Classic beer
products.description: This beer is characterised by medium to high crispness. Its clear golden colour will stand out at each gourmet’s table. The beer is intended for drinking after a physically demanding activity and following sport activities. It refreshes the body, supplies it with vitamins and minerals and replenishes body fluids.

products.name: Urpiner Radler Citrus non alcoholic beer
products.description: Urpiner Citrus Nealko is a refreshing non-alcoholic beer-based beverage that combines the full taste of the new Urpiner non-alcoholic beer with natural citrus freshness. It is based on a genuine pale lager that has undergone complete fermentation and maturation before the alcohol is gently removed using modern membrane dealcoholization technology. The result is a golden beer beverage with a rich foam, refreshing citrus flavour, and authentic beer character. Thanks to its minimal alcohol content, it is an ideal choice for drivers, active people, and anyone looking for refreshment without compromise. Best served well chilled.

products.name: Urpiner Dark beer
products.description: A unique dark lager is produced based on an original recipe using water, four types of special malts and hops. The balanced combination of carefully selected ingredients lends the lager its typical malty caramel flavour and aroma. Coffee and caramel notes stand out beautifully in the taste, accompanied by a subtle bitterness of medium to strong intensity. The rich dark colour and rich froth underline the overall impression of this exceptional lager.

products.name: Urpín 93 beer
products.description: A golden middle path for beer lovers who are looking for a compromise between the fullness of Urpiner Premium 12° and lightness of Urpiner Classic 10°. Thanks to the harmonious combination of selected malt and hops with more pronounced bitterness (up to 28 IBU units), the new pale “eleven” achieves a delicious rich taste, pleasant crispness with easy drinking.

products.name: Urpiner Cherry non alcoholic beer
products.description: Urpiner Cherry Nealko is a refreshing mixed non-alcoholic beer beverage created by combining the new Urpiner non-alcoholic beer with juicy cherries. It starts with a carefully brewed pale lager that undergoes full fermentation and maturation to develop its characteristic flavour profile. The alcohol is then gently removed using state-of-the-art membrane dealcoholization technology, preserving its full taste and aroma. The result is a red beer beverage with an intense cherry aroma, pleasantly sweet fruity flavour, and a delicate hop bitterness. Served well chilled, it refreshes, revitalizes, and delivers an authentic beer experience in a non-alcoholic form.

products.name: Urpiner Extra Hoppy Beer
products.description: Pilsener type beer made using the special technique of dry hopping, when the beer is conditioned at low temperatures inside conditioning cellars for a long period of time. Its unique full and balanced flavour is reached through an extra dose of two varieties of hops Cascade and Saaz. The specific hoppy flavour of this exceptional beer is enriched with a beautiful distinctive aroma of dried hop cones. The golden colour, fresh crispness, pleasant bitterness and a rich compact foam underline its exclusiveness.

products.name: Urpiner Exclusive Beer
products.description: An outstanding exclusive lager with higher alcohol content and distinctive body. The taste and aroma is classically hoppy with a more pronounced sweetness. The bright colour, radiant sparkle and rich foam, which are typical for this lager, offer visual pleasure. The lager is intended for drinking on special occasions and for those unforgettable times which bring lasting memories. During recent years the lager has won the hearts of consumers as well as numerous international quality awards.

products.name: PSS RMM Frozen Meat Grinders
products.description: PSS RMM Frozen Meat Grinders are designed for fast and gentle grinding of any fist-sized frozen meat with temperature to -10°C, as well as for fresh meat grinding. Putting them into operation is a guarantee for economic and practical use and achievement of the best results when grinding. The PSS RMM Frozen Meat Grinder guarantees excellent quality of the final product. The fresh or frozen meat is fed into the PSS RMM hopper, where it is collected by two specially designed worms. Then the material is moved towards the grinding set by the short grinding worm. The desired structure can be achieved depending on the composition of selected grinding set. Options Sinew separation device Mirror-effect polished worms Mirror-effect polished hopper Feeding worms for fresh meat Feeding/mixing paddles PSS P lifting device Hopper wall extension Reduction of hopper wall height

products.name: Microcutters
products.description: PSS Microcutters are designed for food industry operations and are used for the finest cutting and subsequent emulsifying of material. The PSS Microcutter construction is so specifically designed that the devices can be practically used not only for meat cutting but also for preparation of pâtés, spreads and sauces of any kind or for fruit and vegetable processing. PSS Microcutters offer a guarantee of effective use because they ensure a continual process of fine cutting and emulsifying and significantly contribute to the preparation of structurally homogeneous mixture of excellent quality. The biggest advantage of PSS Microcutters is the low-placed hopper that enables uncomplicated feeding of the device. Two levels of cutting and high cutting speed ensure very fast processing and required product quality. The outlet pipe characterized by a possibility of rotation and position changing ensures smooth and rapid emptying. The PSS Microcutter includes a digital temperature sensor, whose function is the illustrative temperature recording of material in process.

products.name: Speed Fillers Vacuum
products.description: The PSS SFV Speed Filler Vacuum is a multifunctional device designed for medium and large operations in the food industry. It gives perfect filling of meat products and other food products. The device guarantees effective usage and ensures a continual process of metering and filling of processed materials. The processed material is fed into the hopper, where it is caught by two feeding worms that gently move it towards the metering device. The PSS SFV can also be used with the additional grinding attachment, which ensures quality final grinding and subsequent material filling into appropriate casings. The PSS SFV is as standard equipped with a vacuum system, which inhibits the possible creation of air bubbles in the final product. Options Grinder – attachement with a standard set of grinding plates, and as an option – the plates from 2,5 to 16 mm (SFV 720) Worms and plates for grinding of cooled meat pieces to 3 kg (SFV 720) Set of worms with different step Lifting device for 200l trolleys Dosing device of pulse type for all types of casings – natural or synthetic Dosing tube: standard Ø 12 mm; Dosing tube: optional Ø 10 mm, Ø 17 mm, Ø 20 mm;

products.name: PSS SCG Speed Combi Grinders
products.description: PSS SCG STRONG is designed for food industry operations for fast grinding of any kind of fresh or stained skins as well as whole frozen skins blocks with temperatures down to -15°C. PSS SCG STRONG ensure an excellent product quality ranging from coarse to very fine grinding. PSS SCG STRONG is maximally adapted for skins cutting PSS SCG STRONG is structurally larger and more robust with reinforced walls PSS SCG STRONG has a larger hopper PSS SCG STRONG contains a special patented solution from PSS, which helps cutting skins PSS SCG STRONG has a more powerful engine on the feed screw PSS SCG STRONG has modifi ed and stronger screws (both feed and cutting) PSS SCG STRONG has a front cover completely made of stainless steel and attached with screws Options PSS BES bone elimination system Mirror-effect polished worm Mirror-effect polished hopper Inspection footsteps Inspection platform Hopper wall extensions Safety rail around the hopper

products.name: Speed Mixers Grinders Angle
products.description: PSS SMGAs are a modern combination of Speed Mixers and Speed Grinders. In the mixing section they ensure a gentle and quality mixing and in the grinding section an excellent product quality ranging from coarse to very fine grinding. PSS SMGAs are multifunction devices with a compact, space-saving design. The rotating overlapping paddles gently move the product in every direction to give it the desired structure. The grinding worm area is located in the bottom part of the two-level hopper, where the worm efficiently moves the material to the grinding set. The desired structure is achieved according to a choice of grinding set. PSS SMGAs are supplied with frequency inverters in both mixing and grinding sections, that enables speed regulation and excellent product structure. Options PSS BES bone elimination system Dust lid without sealing Grid cover Plate cover with sealing Weighing system on frame Temperature sensor Cooling system of top injection N2 Cooling system of top injection CO2 Cooling system of bottom injection CO2 Steam injection system Water dosing Mirror-polished worm Mirror-polished hopper and paddles Inspection platform Remote access via internet

products.name: Cured Goat Cheese Montes de Málaga
products.brand: Fromages de chèvre Montes de Málaga
products.description: Aged goat cheese made with enzyme coagulation from pasteurized goat's milk and matured in chambers for 90 to 120 days. Ivory white in color with an intense flavor, notable for its spicy aftertaste and goat aromas. The texture is firm and the finish is long-lasting. It has garnered 11 awards, including Gold Medals at the World Cheese Awards 2023-24 and 2021-22, Silver Medals in 2024-25, 2018-19, and 2017-18, as well as a Bronze Medal in 2016-17. It was recognized as the Best Aged Goat Cheese at Sabor a Málaga 2023 and has won significant awards at the Cincho Awards and other specialized Andalusian competitions.

products.name: Cheese “Natural Reserve” Montes de Málaga
products.brand: Fromages de chèvre Montes de Málaga
products.description: Aged cheese, matured for 5 to 6 months. Made with raw goat's milk and matured in extra virgin olive oil of the Verdial variety during its last two months of aging. It has a medium salty flavor and a very mild bitterness, with a spicy touch and a long finish. It has received three important awards, including a Bronze Medal at the 2025-26 World Cheese Awards, a Silver Medal in 2023-24, and the award for Best Raw Milk Goat's Cheese at Sabor a Málaga 2024.

products.name: Raw goat's milk cheese Montes de Málaga
products.brand: Fromages de chèvre Montes de Málaga
products.description: Raw goat's milk cheese, enzyme-coagulated and matured in chambers for 90 to 120 days. Light in color with a firm texture. It has an intense flavor and aroma with a long finish. It stands out for the complexity of its pungent aroma with clean, animal notes, characteristic of cheeses made with raw milk. It retains all the properties of the milk as it has not been heat-treated, meeting all hygiene and sanitary standards. It has received four awards, including a Silver Medal at the 2024-25 World Cheese Awards and Bronze Medals in 2022-23 and 2016-17, as well as a Silver Medal at the 2007 Fromagora International Goat Cheese Competition.

products.name: Cured Goat Cheese El Pinsapo
products.description: Aged cheese with a maturation period of 180 to 200 days. The paste is ivory yellow, darkening with age. The rind has a characteristic aroma of Roquefort and Camembert. On the palate, it is buttery, smooth, and has a long, lingering finish. The flavor develops from the outside, becoming more complex and intense, with a slight spiciness. The aftertaste is nutty and roasted. It has received 13 awards, including a Gold Medal at the 2024-25 World Cheese Awards, Bronze Medals in 2023-24 and 2022-23, and a Silver Medal in 2011-12. It was awarded First Prize at the 2011 Andalusian Artisan Cheese Competition and has won multiple second and third prizes at the Villa de Teba Artisan Cheese Fair and other competitions.

products.name: El Pinsapo Soft Goat Cheese
products.description: Soft goat cheese, made from pasteurized goat's milk, stands out for its delicate, short maturation process that enhances the milk's natural flavor. Its white color and smooth, creamy texture envelop the palate with a mild, fresh, and subtly lactic experience.

products.name: Semi-cured goat cheese Montes de Málaga
products.brand: Fromages de chèvre Montes de Málaga
products.description: Semi-cured goat cheese made with enzyme coagulation from pasteurized goat's milk, primarily from the Málaga breed, and matured in chambers for 30 to 60 days. Very light in color and with a mild flavor, it features prominent notes of butter and toffee on the nose and palate. The texture is tender, and the finish is medium. It has won 11 awards, including a Silver Medal at the World Cheese Awards in 2025-26, 2022-23, and 2017-18, as well as a Bronze Medal in 2023-24. It has been recognized as the Best Semi-Cured Cheese at Sabor a Málaga in 2017 and 2025, in addition to winning first, second, and third prizes in specialized competitions such as Gourmet Quesos and the Málaga and Andalusia Goat Cheese Competitions.

products.name: Semi-cured Goat Cheese with Pedro Ximénez Sweet Wine El Pinsapo
products.description: A semi-cured cheese, aged for 30 to 60 days, made with a long, artisanal bath of the exceptional Pedro Ximénez wine. Its chocolate-colored rind, imparted by the wine bath, is edible. The paste is medium-firm, dense with few eyes, and ranges in color from white to ivory-white. The predominant aroma is that of wine. On the palate, it has a creamy texture, a pleasant aroma, and is only slightly salty. The flavor is distinctive, full-bodied, and rich, with a dry wine undertone. It has received eight awards, including three Silver Medals at the World Cheese Awards in 2015-26, 2013-14, and 2011-12. It has also won Bronze Medals at the World Cheese Awards 2024-25, 2023-24, and 2011, along with a First Prize at the 2011 Andalusia Artisan Cheese Competition and selection at SIAL Tendances & Innovations 2010.

products.name: Cured goat's milk cheese coated in wheat bran
products.brand: Fromages de chèvre Montes de Málaga
products.description: Aged, enzymatically coagulated goat's milk cheese made with pasteurized goat's milk and matured in chambers for 150 to 180 days. It is coated in extra virgin olive oil and wheat bran, creating the sensation of eating cheese with bread dipped in oil. It boasts 16 awards, including two Super Gold Medals at the World Cheese Awards 2025-26 and 2021-22, and Gold Medals in 2023-24 and 2017-18. It has also obtained Silver and Bronze Medals in various editions of the international competition, in addition to important distinctions such as GOLD at the ICEX 2026 awards, Best Goat Cheese at Sabor a Málaga 2024 and several awards at Gourmet Quesos and the Salón del Queso de Andalucía.

products.name: Fresh goat's milk cheese Montes de Málaga
products.brand: Fromages de chèvre Montes de Málaga
products.description: Fresh format of artisanal elaboration, of enzymatic coagulation elaborated with pasteurized milk of goat of majoritàriament malaguenya breed. White and bright in color, it is very soft in the nose and mouth, with fresh milky notes. Light weight, the texture is firm and the persistence is short with goat-like quality. It has won 3 recognitions, including a Bronze Medal at the World Cheese Awards 2018-19 and the Award for the Best Fresh Format in Sabor a Màlaga 2018, as well as the Third Award for the Fresh Format Pasteuritzat de Cabra at the I Concurs de Formatges Tradicionales de Màlaga 2015.

products.name: El Pinsapo Fresh Goat Cheese
products.description: Fresh cheese made with goat's milk. Homogeneous white color and firm texture. Mild aroma with notes of fresh milk. Mild flavor, slightly salty with no bitter notes. Short finish. Ideal for a healthy diet. It has won 4 awards, including a Silver Medal at the 2024-25 World Cheese Awards and Bronze Medals in 2022-23 and 2016-17, as well as a Silver Medal at the 2007 Fromagora International Goat Cheese Competition.

products.name: Aged goat's cheese matured for at least 9 months
products.description: Aged cheese with a minimum maturation of 9 months. It has a dark rind and a yellow paste. On the palate, it is buttery with a long, lingering finish. The flavor develops gradually from the outside to the inside, becoming intense and spicy. It has won 4 international awards, including a Gold Medal at the 2013-14 World Cheese Awards and Silver Medals in 2019-20 and 2011-12, as well as a Fourth Place finish at the 2011 International Cheese Awards.

products.name: “Natural Reserve” cheese with paprika Montes de Málaga
products.brand: Fromages de chèvre Montes de Málaga
products.description: Aged cheese, matured for 5 to 6 months. Made with raw goat's milk and aged in extra virgin olive oil of the Verdial variety. It has a deep red rind and a whitish paste. This is a true gastronomic gem, distinguished by its balance and elegance. Paprika, extra virgin olive oil, and raw goat's milk are masterfully combined in the making of this cheese, resulting in a balanced product that delights the palate. It has 4 awards, including GOLD ICEX in 2026, First Place in Gourmet Cheeses 2023 in its category, recognition as Best Cured Raw Milk Goat Cheese at Sabor a Málaga 2025 and the Bronze Medal at the World Cheese Awards 2023-24.

products.name: Semi-cured goat cheese with paprika El Pinsapo
products.description: Semi-cured cheese, aged for 30 to 60 days. Naturally white-ivory in color, coated with extra virgin olive oil and paprika. Very mild aroma. Slightly tangy flavor with the aroma of fresh goat's milk. Creamy on the palate. Buttery and very elastic in the mouth. The paprika gives it a distinctive flavor and aroma.

products.name: El Pinsapo Semi-cured Goat Cheese
products.description: Semi-cured cheese aged for 35 to 60 days. Ivory-yellow paste. The rind has a characteristic aroma of Roquefort and Camembert. On the palate, it is buttery, with a mild flavor and a medium finish, very creamy. It has won 8 awards, including a Gold Medal at the 2025-26 World Cheese Awards and a Silver Medal in 2022-23. It has also received four consecutive First Prizes at the Villa de Teba Artisan Cheese Fair (2013-2016) and recognition in the Andalusian Artisan Cheese Competitions.

products.name: El Pinsapo Gran Reserva Cheese
products.description: Matured raw milk cheese with a minimum maturation of 6 months under optimal drying conditions. This is the premium range from Quesos El Pinsapo. After a masterful selection of the milk, this aged raw milk goat's cheese is crafted using the most traditional methods. Its intense aroma has animal notes of goat, characteristic of raw milk. A delight for lovers of strong cheeses. Its flavor is vibrant, deep, robust, and spicy, with a long-lasting aftertaste. It has garnered 10 prestigious awards, including two Super Gold Medals at the World Cheese Awards in 2022-23 and 2017-18, as well as a Silver Medal in 2011-12 and a Bronze Medal in 2025-26. It won First Prize at the Villa de Teba Artisan Cheese Fair in 2019 and at the National Cheese Fair in 2016, as well as First Place at the Rome Awards in 2015, among other distinctions.

Its versatility makes it ideal for sauces, stews, marinades, ready meals, and innovative culinary applications across retail and food service channels. products.name: Frozen White Hominy
products.description: A staple of Latin American cuisine, frozen white hominy is valued for its chewy texture, mild flavor, and ultimate convenience in soups, stews, and traditional side dishes. products.name: Black eyed beans

products.name: Rocoto Hot pepper

Its culinary versatility makes it ideal for crafting pastes, hot sauces, stews, traditional stuffed recipes, and innovative dishes designed to add a distinctive spicy kick, across both the food industry and high-end gastronomy.

Its large kernel size, uniformity, and excellent expansion performance make it suitable for industrial processing and retail packaging.

products.name: Dried Panca Chili

Directly field-sourced and processed in our own facilities, ensuring controlled moisture levels, uniform selection, and full export traceability.

products.name: Dried Yellow Pepper

products.name: GREEK THYME HONEY

Carefully harvested by our family of beekeepers, it is a natural product of exceptional quality, free from additives and produced with respect for both the bees and the environment. Versatile and refined, it is ideal enjoyed neat, over ice or as the perfect base for premium cocktails.

Enjoyed neat, chilled, over ice or as an ingredient in premium cocktails, it reflects the authentic character of one of Greece's most iconic liqueurs.

Crafted with the same dedication to quality and authenticity, each variety delivers a distinctive character while preserving the essence of traditional Greek ouzo.

products.name: GREEK OREGANO
products.description: Oregano is a herb with a slightly sweet and spicy flavor and very intense aroma. It is native and cultivated in shrub lands throughout Greece in cool areas of low altitude since antiquity. Apart from its use as a seasoning, oregano is known for its medicinal properties. Hippocrates, the "father" of medicine in ancient Greece, used oregano to several treatments. The essential oil of oregano (riganelaio) is used in perfume and medicine. The word "oregano" comes from the composition of the words "oros" (mountain) and "ganos" (joy) and means the joy of the mountain. Oregano is widely used in Greek and Italian cuisine, in grilled meats, poultry, fish, pizza, pasta sauces, beans, etc. It is also used to give flavor and aroma in vegetables, wines, and salad dressings.

products.name: GREEK COFFEE
products.description: Greek coffee is a kind of coffee prepared by baking in a coffee pot (briki) crushed into fine powder roasted coffee beans. It is drunk more than any other kind of coffee in many parts of the eastern Mediterranean, Middle East, Balkans and North Africa. This coffee is reached even under the names "Armenian coffee" , "Arabic coffee" or "Middle Eastern coffee." In the countries of the Balkans is commonly called "Turkish" while in Cyprus called "Cyprus." In the Middle East it is common to mix coffee with cardamom and other herbs. According to tradition, the first to prepare such coffee were the Bedouins of the Middle East who put the coffee pot on the sand that covered the ashes and coals to keep them alive. That's why there is a tradition of baking coffee on the sand (on the coals) in the traditional cafes. A key tool in the preparation of Greek coffee is a pot called briki, in which we boil (almost) the mixture of water (75ml) with coffee and sugar, stirring with a spoon. Also characteristic is the thick foam (kaimaki) that is created when boiling the coffee. The preparation of coffee is considered successful when the kaimaki remains while the coffee is served. It is served in a small thick cup in the following names: Sketos (without sugar) (75 ml water + 1 teaspoon of coffee) Me oligi (with a little sugar) (75 ml water + 1 teaspoon of coffee + less than half a teaspoon of sugar) Metrios (with sugar) (75 ml water + 1 teaspoon of coffee + 1 teaspoon of sugar) Glikos (with a lot of sugar) (75 ml water + 1 teaspoon of coffee and 2 teaspoons of sugar).

products.name: Pure Brown Rice Vinegar 360ml
products.description: Description: This exceptional vinegar is artisanally crafted from quality brown rice grown in Fukuyamacho (Kagoshima) and pure mountain water from northern Hiroshima. Slowly fermented in jars, it develops a beautiful amber color, a balanced acidity, and subtle roasted notes. It suits traditional Japanese uses, such as marinating mackerel, as well as everyday uses as a substitute for cider vinegar. Usage: This artisanal vinegar is perfect for marinating fish such as mackerel. It's ideal for vinaigrettes. It can also work very well as a substitute for balsamic vinegar. Storage: Store in a cool, dry place, away from light. After opening, keep refrigerated.

products.name: Mikan juice 100% 180ml
products.description: Description: The mikan is a very sweet kind of mandarin. In the past, it was the fruit the most eaten in Japan. This juice is produced with mikan grown in the region of Wakayama which is known all around Japan for its delicious mikan. They have been peeled one by one in order that only the slight peel that keeps the wedges together remains when the fruits are pressed. This special technique makes a juice very smooth with a sweet taste, just like the one of the fresh fruit you could eat. Flavor: Sweet and smooth, not bitter, not acidic. Use: You can drink it just as it is, in cocktails or water down. It can also be used in pastry (mousses, icecreams, jellies,...). Preservation: Store in a cool, dark and dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

products.name: White Ponzu - Shio Ponzu 360ml
products.description: Description: The ponzu is a popular and widespread sauce in Japan. Its taste is very much appreciated; it is both fresh and deep and rich in umami. Unlike regular ponzu sauces that combines soy sauce, dashi and a Japanese citrus, white ponzu is made with an rice vinegar base. It does not contain soy sauce, that is why it has a slight color. There is also kombu dashi broth, yuzu juice and sudachi juice from Shikoku. It is additive and preservative free and have is well balanced between acidity and umami. Use: White ponzu can be used as a regular ponzu with the advantage that it will not color your preparations. It can be used as salad dressing, accompany scallops, white fish, fatty meats, avocados, asparagus or artichokes... It will also give a deeper taste to your broths. The ponzu is very easy to use because it goes well with European cuisine. Preservation: Store in a cool, dry place, away from light, in the fridge after opening.

products.name: Shichimi with mikan - 7 spices blend 18g
products.description: Description : Shichimi is a mix of Japanese high-quality spices very used in Japan and considered excellent for health. It is traditionally made of seven spices, hence its name in Japanese «shichi» (seven) «mi» (flavor). This shichimi combines 2 products that are the pride of the Wakayama region : Arita mikan peel and sansho pepper. It also contains ginger which brings a touch of freshness. Flavor : The lemon-flavored taste and the freshness of sansho pepper come first. Then come the spicy notes with the fresh touch of ginger and the bitterness of mikan. Use : Shichimi will season a wide range of dishes such as avocado salad or avocado toast, tofu, grilled meat, noodles like udon or even fried potatoes. You can mix some shichimi with the mikan ponzu sauce to make a dressing for salads. Preservation : Keep in a cool place, away from sunlight. Close well and refrigerate after opening.

products.name: Candied yuzu peel 30g
products.description: Description : Yuzu is a yellow Japanese citrus of about 100 g. The candied peels lift the subtle fragrance of yuzu and largely remove the bitterness of the peel. Use : Peels can be used for both savory and sweet dishes. They can also be directly eaten as candy. Preservation : Store in a cool and dry place, away from light.

products.name: White miso 500g
products.description: Description : White miso has beed fermented for a shorter time and contains less salt than other misos. Its color can get darker with time, but this is a natural process and it doesn’t have any effect on the taste. Flavor : Sweet, slightly salty and rich in umami taste. Use : It can be used in sauces, marinades, in mashed potatoes instead of milk or in soups instead of cream. Preservation : Store in a cool, dark and dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

products.name: Mikan juice 100% 720ml
products.description: Description: The mikan is a very sweet kind of mandarin. In the past, it was the fruit the most eaten in Japan. This juice is produced with mikan grown in the region of Wakayama which is known all around Japan for its delicious mikan. They have been peeled one by one in order that only the slight peel that keeps the wedges together remains when the fruits are pressed. This special technique makes a juice very smooth with a sweet taste, just like the one of the fresh fruit you could eat. Flavor: Sweet and smooth, not bitter, not acidic. Use: You can drink it just as it is, in cocktails or water down. It can also be used in pastry (mousses, icecreams, jellies,...). Preservation: Store in a cool, dark and dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

products.name: Sennari Yuzu and Sudachi Ponzu Sauce 360ml
products.description: Description: The ponzu is a popular and widespread sauce in Japan. It combines soy sauce, dashi and a Japanese citrus. It also often includes a little bit of vinegar or mirin. Its taste is very much appreciated; it is both fresh and deep and rich in umami. Use: The ponzu is very easy to use because it goes well with European cuisine. It can be used as salad dressing, accompany scallops, white fish, fatty meats, avocados, asparagus or artichokes... Preservation: Store in a cool, dry place, away from light, refrigerate after opening.

products.name: Vegan Mikan Ponzu 360ml
products.description: Description: This ponzu is made with 30% of mikan juice. Mikan is a Japanese mandarin sweet and almost not sour. Mikan juice is associated with soy sauce, vinegar and other Japanese citrus juices (yuzu, daidai, ogonkan). It gives a ponzu well balanced and sweet, where the mikan sweetness balances the citruses sourness and the powerful taste of the soy sauce. Flavor: Sweet and fresh with delicious fruity notes. Use: Very sweet, the mikan ponzu is suitable for children. It is ideal with meat (grilled, Japanese fondue, stew, etc). This ponzu is also perfect to season salads and carpaccio such as jumbo shrimps ones. Preservation: Store in a cool and dry place, away from light.

One of the most popular ways to serve feta is as “saganaki” , a traditional Greek appetizer served hot and crispy. In this recipe, the cheese is wrapped in phyllo or coated in breading, then fried or grilled until the outside becomes golden and crunchy while the inside remains warm, rich and creamy. For foodservice professionals, feta saganaki is a practical and attractive menu solution. It offers a strong Greek identity, an appealing presentation and a high perceived value for customers. It can be served as an appetizer, a sharing dish, part of a mezze selection or as a side option. An additional advantage of this SKU is that there is almost no loss after cooking, helping professionals maintain better portion control and a more stable food cost. This serving suggestion is commonly paired with honey and sesame , creating a balanced combination of salty, sweet and nutty flavors. It can also be served with herbs, dips or Mediterranean garnishes, depending on the menu concept.

products.name: Jara Honey
products.description: A Jara is a traditional beehive that has been used since ancient times in Georgia. There is no evidence for when exactly Jara appeared. However, several local folktales note that ancient inhabitants found the bees in a tree hollow, that they called this place in the forest ‘the bee tree’. Later, locals understood that the ‘bee tree’ could be replicated. They collected swarms of wild bees and settled them into hollowed wooden logs and then placed them high up in trees to protect them from bears. Such wooden logs were called Jara. After the invention of frame beehives in the 19th century, Jara hives were increasingly replaced by modern beehives. But there are still few places in Western Georgia where Jara hives are still used to make the wild honey Jara.

products.name: Xian GuoYuan 200g Organic Small-fruit Seabuckthorn Puree
products.description: I. Product Information 1.1 Product Name: Pure Seabuckthorn Puree 1.2 Brand: Jishengyuan 1.3 Specification: Stand‑up pouch, 30 ml × 12 pouches per box 1.4 Shelf Life: 12 months 1.5 Implementation Standard: T/ISAS 002‑2021 1.6 Production Licence: SC10614062310496 1.7 Place of Origin: Liangwei Industrial Park, Youyu Eco‑cultural Tourism Demonstration Zone, Shuozhou City, Shanxi Province, China 1.8 Manufacturer: Shanxi Xianguoyuan Biotechnology Co., Ltd. II. Product Advantages2.1 Raw Materials2.1.1 Geographical Indication Origin Seabuckthorn berries are harvested in Youyu County, Shuozhou City, Shanxi Province, home to Shahu Pass, a key ancient Great Wall gateway also known as “Xikou”. “Youyu Seabuckthorn” holds the national geographical‑indication certification trademark (Registration No.: 67707181). 2.1.2 Seabuckthorn Variety Youyu seabuckthorn is a small‑fruited variety. Although its berries are small, they are highly nutritious, rich in vitamin C, vitamin E, β‑carotene, flavonoids and other antioxidant substances. According to the 6th standard edition of China Food Composition Table , fresh seabuckthorn berries contain 800‑1500 mg of vitamin C per 100 g. 2.1.3 Premium Growing Region Youyu County lies between 39°31′N‑40°18′N at an average altitude of 1500 m. During the growing season, it enjoys around 9 hours of daily sunshine with a diurnal temperature difference of up to 20 °C. The area has an arid, low‑rainfall climate and loose alkaline sandy soil typical of the Loess Plateau. These unique geographic, soil and climatic conditions create the outstanding quality and high nutritional value of Youyu seabuckthorn. Youyu has 300 000 mu of naturally‑grown seabuckthorn forests with no chemical fertilisers or pesticides, delivering clean, pollution‑free raw material. In 2024, Youyu County was awarded the United Nations “New Urban Agenda Award for Sustainable Urban and Human Settlements”. 2.1.4 Organic Certifications ‑ Organic Seabuckthorn Berry Raw‑material Base Certification (Certificate No.: 249OP2300262) ‑ Organic Seabuckthorn Puree Production & Processing Certification (Certificate No.: 249OP2300263) 2.2 Production Technology Made with NFC (Not‑From‑Concentrate) process, cold‑pressed fresh fruit and dual‑channel cell‑wall‑breaking pulping. The whole fruit — peel, juice, pulp and fruit oil — is fully utilised. All natural nutrients are well preserved in every drop of puree. No fruit oil is removed, so fat‑soluble nutrients remain intact for better human absorption. 2.3 Expert Endorsement Cao Man, Founder and Technical Director, winner of China’s First‑Class National Science and Technology Progress Award. With over 40 years of seabuckthorn‑industry experience, he leads full‑chain R&D covering planting, variety improvement and product development to deliver reliable premium quality. III. Consumer Instructions3.1 Suitable Groups Suitable for children aged 3 years and above, as well as the general public. 3.2 Consumption Scenarios Ready‑to‑use for any occasion: nutritional breakfast boost, post‑meal refreshment, energy support for work and study, or convenient daily nutrition on‑the‑go. 3.3 Usage Suggestions 3.3.1 Direct drink: Shake well before drinking for original‑flavour lovers. Using a straw helps reduce sharp sourness. 3.3.2 Diluted drink: Mix puree into 200 ml room‑temperature purified water. Add honey or sugar to taste and stir gently. Do not use water above 30 °C to avoid damaging vitamin C and other nutrients. 3.3.3 With yoghurt or oatmeal: Stir an appropriate amount of puree into yoghurt or oatmeal for extra fruit flavour and nutrition. 3.3.4 Smoothie: Blend 1 banana, 200 ml yoghurt or milk together with 15‑30 ml seabuckthorn puree for a smooth, well‑balanced smoothie. 3.3.5 Sparkling drink: Combine ice cubes, 200 ml sparkling water and seabuckthorn puree, stir lightly. 3.4 Recommended Daily Intake 50‑100 ml per day, ideally consumed within half an hour before or after meals. 3.5 Taste Profile This seabuckthorn puree is predominantly sour with gentle natural astringency, finishing with fruity notes and subtle sweetness. The strong initial sourness comes from natural vitamin C, followed by a pleasant sweet‑fruity after‑taste. With regular consumption, most consumers grow accustomed to this distinctive flavour. IV. Important Notes 4.1 This is a natural agricultural product. Minor variations in colour and taste due to different harvest periods are normal and do not affect product quality. 4.2 Seabuckthorn fruit oil is retained in this product. Sediment, tiny lumps or floccules are natural aggregates of pulp fibres, pectin and lipids. This is normal; shake thoroughly before use. 4.3 Store unopened in a cool, dry place. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume promptly.

products.name: Jishengyuan 200ml Stand-Up Pouch Seabuckthorn & Blueberry Puree
products.description: I. Product Profile 1.1 Product Name: Sea Buckthorn & Blueberry Compound Puree 1.2 Brand: Jishengyuan 1.3 Specifications: Gift box packaging: Family packaging: 200ml * 1 bag 1.4 Shelf Life: 12 months 1.5 Implementation Standard: GB/T 31121-2014 1.6 Production License: SC10614062310496 1.7 Place of Origin: Liangwei Industrial Park, Youyu Ecological Culture and Tourism Demonstration Zone, Shuozhou City, Shanxi Province 1.8 Manufacturer: Shanxi Xianyouyuan Biotechnology Co., Ltd. II. Product Advantages 2.1 Advantages of Raw Material Origin: Youyu, Shanxi is located at 39° north latitude with an average altitude of 1400 meters. The diurnal temperature difference exceeds 20℃, and the annual sunshine duration is over 2500 hours. The unique alkaline sandy soil of the Loess Plateau is loose and well-permeable. In 2024, Youyu was awarded the "New Sustainable City and Human Settlement Environment Award" by the United Nations. Youyu County currently has 280,000 mu of naturally grown wild sea buckthorn forests. The unique natural environment nurtures high-quality sea buckthorn that is free from chemical fertilizers and pesticides, characterized by purity and no pollution. It is a high-quality production area of sea buckthorn in China. "Youyu Sea Buckthorn" obtained the National Geographical Indication Certification Trademark in 2024 (Registration Certificate No.: 67707181). In 2023, our company obtained organic certification for sea buckthorn planting bases and sea buckthorn fruits for the first time. Up to now, the company has 2666 hectares of certified organic sea buckthorn bases, with certificate numbers: 2490P2300262 and 2490P2300263. 2.2 Advantages of Raw Material Varieties: The sea buckthorn grown in Youyu belongs to Hippophae rhamnoides subsp. sinensis. Although the fruit size is small, it features extremely high nutrient density and is rich in vitamin C, vitamin E, β-carotene, flavonoids and various other antioxidant components. Per 100 grams of fresh sea buckthorn fruit, the vitamin C content is approximately 800–1500 milligrams (Note: Data sourced from *Chinese Food Composition Table* Standard Edition, 6th Edition). The blueberry puree is processed from Vaccinium uliginosum grown in the Greater Khingan Range and Lesser Khingan Range of Heilongjiang Province, and is produced by Heilongjiang Jinlanbao Ecological Agriculture Development Co., Ltd. Heilongjiang is located in a cold region with large diurnal temperature differences, so the blueberries produced here boast superior quality with high contents of anthocyanins and other nutrients. 2.3 Advantages of Production Process: Organic sea buckthorn puree and blueberry puree are mixed thoroughly and homogenized, followed by aseptic filling, heat sealing and sampling inspection. Afterwards, spray sterilization is conducted at 90℃, and the product is cooled to room temperature in 10 minutes, which ensures food safety while retaining nutrients to the maximum extent. III. Brand Introduction 3.1 Leading Enterprise: Provincial Key Leading Enterprise of Agricultural Industrialization in Shanxi Province, Shanxi Provincial Poverty Alleviation Leading Enterprise, and Leading Enterprise of Agricultural Industrialization in Shuozhou City, Shanxi Province. 3.2 Enterprise Honors: Shanxi Provincial Doctoral Innovation Workstation, Shanxi Provincial Popular Science Education Base, Vice President Unit of International Seabuckthorn Association (China) Seabuckthorn Enterprise Federation, National High-tech Enterprise, Shanxi Provincial Specialized, Refined, Differential and Innovative SME, the 7th National Civilized Unit, etc. 3.3 R&D Center: The company has established in-depth cooperation with Institute of Food Science and Technology, Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences, Nankai University, Shanxi Medical University, Shanxi University of Chinese Medicine and other institutions, and jointly built the "Joint R&D Center for Seabuckthorn Functional Foods". It is also the "Product R&D Department of Seabuckthorn Engineering Technology Center of National Forestry and Grassland Administration" and "Shuozhou City Shanxi Province Seabuckthorn Engineering Technology Research Center". 3.4 Cao Man, the founder and technical director of the company, is a native of Youyu. The sandstorms he experienced in his childhood made him determined to improve the ecological environment of his hometown and contribute to poverty alleviation. He has been focusing on the cultivation, variety improvement and R&D of sea buckthorn for 41 years. He has won many honors including the First Prize of National Science and Technology Progress Award and the First Prize of Science and Technology Progress Award of the Ministry of Forestry, and formerly served as the Director of Youyu County Seabuckthorn Research Institute. IV. Consumption Method and Matching The natural fructose abundant in blueberry endows the product with a mild taste, which perfectly neutralizes the strong sour and astringent taste of sea buckthorn. The combination of the two ingredients presents a wonderful intertwined sweet-and-sour flavor with a dense and fine texture. It combines the dual nutrients of blueberry and sea buckthorn, featuring both healthiness and great taste. The product adopts independent small packages, which are compact and portable, allowing consumers to replenish energy anytime anywhere. The manufacturer also thoughtfully provides drinking straws for convenient consumption, which can reduce the sour taste and keep the product clean and hygienic. V. Warm Reminder Sediment is fruit pulp, which is a normal phenomenon. Please shake well before consumption. Do not consume if the package is swollen or leaking.

products.description: Dried, smoked Szydłów plum with pit, certified with a Protected Geographical Indication, 500 g Product Information: Description: Szydłów plums with pits from our farm (500 g package) have successfully passed a production process compliance check with the registered specification, earning the right to use the Protected Geographical Indication (PGI) symbols and labels. Origin & Heritage: Officially entered into the European Commission’s register of Protected Geographical Indications on October 30, 2010 (Council Regulation (EC) No 510/2006). The geographical production area covers the commune of Szydłów (108 sq km), located in Staszów County, Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, Poland. Culinary Uses: Highly sought after during the pre-Christmas season, these plums are an essential component of traditional Christmas Eve dishes and dried fruit compote. They are also popular as an addition to muesli, yogurts, dishes, and desserts, or as a nutritious standalone snack.

products.name: Aluminum & PET lids
products.description: Lids have a dual role in the food industry: they seal products and are important advertising media. We offer a variety of shapes and colours that can be personalised according to our customers wishes. We offer 4 different types of embossing for aluminium lids: Vermicular embossing and classic embossing : the material is more diffuse, more stable and has a matt appearance; Bidirectional embossing with dots : offers a clearer print image than vermicular embossing; Unidirectional embossing with dots : makes colours appear clear and vivid; Rim emboss : offers a high-quality and clean print image as the embossing is only on the edge where the lid is sealed. We also offer the option of logo embossing : with the help of this technique, you can emphasise certain areas on your board with the resulting relief. The thicker the material, the more spectacular the effect. You can combine logo embossing with rim embossing to achieve a particularly attractive result. You can choose the right shape for your product from a wide range of sinker shapes . These can be round or rectangular. Rottaprint also produces PET lids for sealing PP and PS (polypropylene/polystyrene) containers , which are most commonly used in the food industry, to efficiently protect their contents. We recommend PET lids for many reasons, such as: their excellent tear resistance , uniform release from the container , the possibility of disposal and recycling together with the container , but also because of the possibility of bi-directional embossing. As a customised plastic product, they enable you to use metal detectors as an additional safety aspect in your production. Depending on the contents of your packaged product, PET lids allow your consumers to heat the product in a microwave oven.

products.name: Shelf wobbler
products.description: The shelf wobbler is a promotional and marketing product specifically designed to capture the customer's attention on the product. Its flexibility makes it move smoothly as shoppers pass by the shelf. Shelf wobblers are some of the most effective promotional materials used in retail so far. It’s well known that more than half of all purchasing decisions are made in-store, so a little boost to get customers to focus on your product is welcome. You should be familiar with the features and uses of these products: • The shelf wobbler, also called flag/stag/dangler, is a hybrid product. It consists of two parts: a half self-adhesive label and a half non-adhesive tag . • The sticky area is attached to the product (bottle, bag, container, etc.) or to the shelf, and the non-sticky part is the one that stands out and makes the product distinguishable on the shelf . • This type of label is generally used to signal promotions or new products , as well as to give a product an advantage over its competitors on the same shelf. • Usually the application is done by hand. For automatic application, we recommend testing before deciding on the final solution, as the shape and adhesive-free surface require customized solutions. • The wobbler shape is very important. As a rule, it is made up of two larger surfaces, one that will be in contact with the product and one that will be free in the air, connected by a narrower portion. • Typically, shelf wobblers are made of PP or PET because they are strong materials that do not easily deteriorate such as paper. • Wobblers can have either a matt or glossy appearance.

products.name: Metal labels
products.description: The metal label is represented by the metallic, premium look and the uniqueness it gives to products. Due to the thickness of the metal , embossing and debossing on different levels will be prominent. Often these are among the only and most spectacular techniques used to enrich the metallic label. Using them you will create a unique, tactile experience that will capture the interest and curiosity of your customers. We produce and print high quality self-adhesive metal labels with state-of-the-art machinery and technology . They are suitable for automatic labeling and available in different shapes, sizes and colors . The metallic label is a versatile label suitable for wines and spirits , food in glass containers , perfumes and luxury cosmetics or home care products . Key properties of the metal labels: • Unique/premium appearance • Great tactile effect • Competitive differentiation Advantages of the metal labels: • Due to the material’s resistance , metal labels are successfully used in humid and hot conditions (e.g. wine glass in a cooler, in condes). • The metal labels are placed on a liner made of PET, a strong material that will not interrupt the automatic labeling process. • The main form of finishing is embossing and debossing , with which you will create unique and tactile effects • Metal has a premium look that expresses nobility and strength. • The metallic label makes it easy to choose an attractive design without having to use many colors or special printing inks. • Strong adhesive with excellent adhesion on multiple surfaces, especially glass. • The metal label can be used as an additional security measure – it is much more difficult to counterfeit products compared to those with paper or plastic labels.

products.name: Multilayer labels
products.description: The peel off labels, also known as a piggyback label, is a functional double layer label that gives you the ability to print 3 times more information . These multi-layer labels are the ideal solution for printing mandatory text, translations or use instructions while maintaining a pleasing and attractive product design. You don’t have to compromise when complying with legal labeling requirement s. The two layers give you the extra space you need to display all the information properly. Peel off labels allow two individual labels to be applied at the same time, on top of each other. The upper label can actually be peeled off and applied elsewhere, used as such or removed, depending on its purpose. The bottom label remains fixed on the product. Several options are available for piggyback labels: 1. You can choose between two detachment methods: • complete removal of the top layer ; • partial removal with a book or notebook opening – consumers can read the information as many times as they like, sticking the first layer in place. 2. Printing can be done either on PP sticker or thermal paper. 3. Peel off labels are usually designed with a dedicated, non-adhesive area for easy removal . Peel off labels are the ideal choice when : • you have a lot of information which needs to be displayed in an aesthetic manner; • the label must be successfully opened several times; • you want to interactively signal a promotion and to display the terms and conditions – all on one label; • you plan to integrate unique codes ; • you need a label that is resistant , ready for repeated use; • you want to apply promotional coupons directly to the product as they can be completely peeled off; • your product is small in size , yet you need to present a lot of info in an appealing way.

products.name: Unprinted self-adhesive labels
products.description: If the information you need to print on the label is variable, the simple self-adhesive labels are the right solution for you. We offer you a wide range of shapes, sizes and colors to choose from according to your needs. Simple self-adhesive labels are those labels rolls that are not printed or are only partially printed by the printing house and can have multiple uses . At Rottaprint, we produce everything from durable labels used in the automotive industry, to price labels or logistics labels . When to choose simple self-adhesive label rolls: Simple self-adhesive labels are the right solution when the information on the label is variable and requires printing when packing the product. For example, when the batch number , expiration date or the series of a product must be printed. If you operate in an industry that produces goods with a long product lifetime, the simple labels are necessary. Depending on the material used for the labels, it can be printed using a thermal or a ribbon printer . Variety of materials and adhesives: Depending on the printing method and how the label is used, you can choose from a wide range of materials and adhesives . Our consultants are always at your disposal and will recommend the right solution, based on the requirements.

products.name: Self-adhesive printed labels
products.description: Are you looking for a durable label for your product, in a versatile color or with a special texture? We have the best solution. In Rottaprint’s portfolio you will find a wide range of self-adhesive labels , fitting even the most complex needs. Thanks to our 30 years of experience in the printing industry, we can now offer you comprehensive product solutions. Challenges have always appealed to us, so over the years we have developed innovative solutions to meet the demands of the constantly growing market. Today, our company produces printed self-adhesive labels from the simplest to the most complex in terms of shape, texture and special colours . Whether your product is made of glass, foil, plastic, metal or wood, our labels are easy to apply, even without the use of heat, solvents or water. Choosing the best label for your product is not always easy. There are many factors to consider. That’s why Rottaprint specialists constantly provide you the necessary support to make the best decision. Our special solutions, both for functional and decorative purposes: Refined labels Metal labels C-Wrap labels Multilayer labels Holographic labels RF labels with anti-theft protection can also be found in our product profile.

products.name: RF antitheft labels
products.description: RF labels with anti-theft protection are labels with an EAS label (Electronic Article Surveillance) attached under the self-adhesive label. The purpose of this label is to prevent and report the theft of products in shops and supermarkets. The product performance is given by: high activation sensitivity - alarm triggered by the security gates when someone tries to steal the product from the shop; easy deactivation - at the checkout after the product has been scanned; strong adhesive - ensures easy application to the product and very difficult removal of the anti-theft tag; the RF tag does not obscure the design of the self-adhesive label, so you as a brand have control over how your product looks on the shelf.

products.name: C-wrap labels
products.description: C-wrap labels redefine the way products are presented and offer a cost-effective alternative to conventional labels. They are applied to three sides of the packaging and offer an effective and secure solution for a high quality looking product. The name ‘C-wrap label’ comes from a new way of applying labels to all three sides of the packaging, emphasised by the characteristic ‘C’ shape. The result is elegant and uniform looking labels on the entire packaging, whether it is cartons, boxes or irregularly shaped items. Self-adhesive C-wrap labels are often found in the food sector, particularly on packaged meat, fresh baked goods and fruit and vegetable packaging. The self-adhesive C-wrap label is a multi-purpose solution that replaces both front and back labelling. It adds value by providing generous space for branding and nutritional information. Compared to traditional cardboard sleeves, self-adhesive C-wrap labels are characterised by their strength and cost-efficiency, as they can be placed evenly and exactly where you want them. This innovation offers users the flexibility to adapt to different packaging requirements and improves safety and handling. Self-adhesive C-wrap labels offer flexibility in the choice of liner and can be produced on either a traditional paper liner or a PET liner, which provides extra strength and durability to meet the specific requirements of each product. There is also the option to work with perforations, which not only makes the packaging easier to open, but also ensures the integrity and safety of the product. Applications for the self-adhesive C-wrap label: The label partially covers the top of the packaging, runs down one side and extends underneath (top, side and bottom). This method is the most common application of self-adhesive ‘C-wrap’ labels. In this application, the label provides important information and branding elements. Covers the top of the pack and extends down the two opposite sides (top and side). This method can be chosen to immediately emphasise product specifications or prominent branding elements.

products.name: Lidding film for trays
products.description: Lidding film is an essential element in the food industry. It is a type of plastic film for packaging , specifically designed for sealing and protecting food products . This tray sealing film acts as an effective barrier against contaminants , extending the shelf life of food by shielding it from moisture, oxygen, and environmental factors . In addition, it prevents leaks and ensures safe transportation . Available in printed or unprinted options , this plastic film comes in glossy or matte finishes, depending on the type of tray used. For unprinted films, C-wrap labels or self adhesive labels are a great solution for displaying product information. A printed lidding film enhances brand identity and improves the product’s visual appeal directly on the packaging. We understand the challenges in the packaging industry and we know how frustrating it can be to stop production due to problems in the heat-sealing process. Common issues in the thermosealing process: Condensation on the inside of the film, which prevents a clear view of the product. Insufficient adhesion of the thermosealing film, compromising the sealing. Difficulty opening the package, causing the film to tear instead of peeling off easily. With the right plastic sealing film roll and expert consultation from Rottaprint, we ensure secure sealing and optimal protection for your products. Consumers’ health is our priority: Our purchase, production and delivery flow is built in accordance with the FSSC 22000 standard, comprising the complete scheme of the Food Safety management system, fully recognized by the Global Food Safety Initiative. Our main care is the health of your consumers.

products.name: Flexible packaging
products.description: Unlike classic packaging, which also has self-adhesive labels, flexible packaging is an environmentally friendly solution due to the low energy consumption for the production, transport and packaging of products. Moreover, the generous printing area gives you the possibility to personalize up to 90% of the packaging . This type of packaging is most often used in the food industry, but also for home care products or pet food. Depending on the product you want to pack, our specialists will recommend the best solution. Here are the most popular products that require flexible packaging and how you can choose the right one: Fat-containing products – product freshness and the extension of shelf life are the high priorities. We recommend choosing the foil with oxygen barrier and UV protection . Spices – it is recommended to choose heat-sealable laminated materials that provide UV protection and aroma barrier , so that the product remains fresh and does not lose its intensity. The barrier layer ensures the protection of the product and the preservation of the flavors , while the polyethylene allows a tight sealing . This way, the spices will remain dry and the flavors will be preserved for a long time. Dry foods – for the packaging of products such as sugar, cereals, cornmeal or crunchy snacks (biscuits, chips and wafers), we recommend you to choose a material that does not allow moisture penetration or product damage, and the best choice is the vapor barrier foil. Sensitive foods – foods such as butter, yeast or margarine need packaging that does not allow oxidation. Therefore, we recommend packaging made from metallic paper, laminated with aluminum, which ensures optimum protection . Chocolate candies – it is advisable to use twistable PET, a special material that once twisted, maintains its shape. This ensures efficient protection and preservation of the product . Consumers’ health is our priority: Our purchase, production and delivery flow is built in accordance with the FSSC 22000 standard, comprising the complete scheme of the Food Safety management system, fully recognized by the Global Food Safety Initiative . Our main care is that the flexible packaging we produce is compliant with all safety regulations and cannot threaten the health of your consumers in any way. With our experience, the state-of-the-art equipment and the variety of materials, we guarantee 100% protection of your product . We produce flexible packaging from top materials and provide customized solutions so that your product becomes one of the most noticed by the customers.

products.name: Ice cream paper cones
products.description: We customize ice cream cones to be particularly attractive and tailored to your specific needs. You can choose between two types: classic paper ice cream cones or those made of aluminum foil. products.name: Shrink sleeves
products.description: Shrink sleeves or shrink films are film labels that take on the shape of the container when heated. They are a very effective promotional product as the printable surface is particularly large. This enables a 360° design that takes on the shape of the contents it encases. Shrink sleeves can be used on any type of material , whether PET, glass, metal or wood. They can also be applied to containers with irregular surfaces where it is not possible to apply a self-adhesive label. In addition to their decorative effect, shrink sleeves can also play a functional role for your product. For example, they can seal a product to signal to the consumer that it is being used for the first time. It can also be an essential criterion for hygiene , which is essential in the food industry. The use of perforation (longitudinal and transverse perforation) can also contribute to the sealing of your product, as well as to recycling . Tearing and separating the film from the container allows the packaging to be separated, making it recyclable and more environmentally friendly . We know how important environmental awareness is. We recommend the use of PETg film - a material with a low impact on the environment. Thanks to its high shrinkage, PETg is ideal for irregular packaging shapes and is very resistant. Shrink sleeves can also be successfully integrated into your marketing campaign, for example to offer multipacks .

products.name: Pasta of Gragnano PGI
products.description: Pastificio Ducato d’Amalfi produces authentic Pasta di Gragnano PGI according to the traditional artisanal methods of Gragnano. Made with 100% Italian durum wheat semolina and pure water from the Monti Lattari, our pasta is bronze-die extruded and slowly dried at low temperatures for up to 60 hours. Each pack is carefully hand-packed to preserve its exceptional quality, texture and authentic character. Our Brand Ambassador is Chef Domenico Stile, 2 Michelin stars, who embodies our passion for excellence, craftsmanship and contemporary Italian cuisine.
